jobs.title: PE Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAMPFIRE

Campfire is an AI-native ERP built for mid-sized and enterprise companies. We help finance and accounting teams replace spreadsheets, manual reconciliations, and disconnected systems with one modern platform.

We’re backed by Y Combinator and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. We’ve raised more than $100 million, including a $35 million Series A led by Accel.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, well-connected partnerships leader to build our PE partnerships function from the ground up. You'll design and run a scalable program that engages PE firms and PE-backed companies. You'll work closely with our Head of PE & VC Practice, who will support you as you build the function.

The ideal candidate has already wokred in a PE Partner role, ideally at a technology startup. Experience selling or partnering around Office of the CFO technology is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

 - Support the launch of the PE Partnerships Funcation

 - Build senior relationships with Private Equity Firms

 - Create partnership programs that deliver value to both sides, including customer introductions, portfolio company engagement, co-marketing, thought leadership, and strategic intelligence.

 - Serve as the main point of contact for PE partners, with a clear and consistent story for why they should work with us.

 - Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Strategy, and Executive Leadership to turn partnership activity into pipeline, revenue, adoption, and brand impact.

 - Build repeatable ways to source and manage opportunities from PE partners, including referral processes, partner enablement, reporting, and feedback loops.

 - Develop executive relationship plans for priority firms, and bring in senior leadership where it will strengthen the partnership.

 - Host and run our own PE events, and represent the company at industry events, portfolio company forums, and ecosystem gatherings.

 - Track market trends, and investment activity to spot strategic opportunities and inform internal decisions.

What You'll Bring

 - 3–7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, Private Equity , startup ecosystems, strategic alliances, or a related commercial role.

 - Proven experience in PE partnerships role, function, or program

 - Established relationships and credibility with PE firms

 - A track record of partnerships that delivered measurable business results.

 - Strong executive presence and the ability to earn trust with senior external partners and internal stakeholders.

 - Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

 - Data-driven judgment, including the ability to define KPIs and clearly report on partnership performance and impact.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment.

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach: you're happy to roll up your sleeves, work across teams, and learn from our Head of PE & VC Practice.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, fintech, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, developer tools, or another high-growth technology category. Experience with Office of the CFO technology is strongly preferred.

 - Experience building partner referral, co-selling, or ecosystem programs.

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Sierra’s Applied Research team works to make the models behind our agents better, faster, and cheaper across many kinds of tasks. Our work covers post-training open-weight models for specialized capabilities, new approaches to voice AI, and the benchmarks the field uses to measure agents, including τ-bench.

As an Applied Research Intern, you’ll join the team for a research project, working with a mentor, you’ll pick a problem that matters to how AI agents perform in the real world, run rigorous experiments, and potentially write up what you find for a top venue. If you want your research to reach both the research community and production agents used by millions of people, come do it at Sierra.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own a research project from start to finish, from framing the question and running experiments to writing and submitting a paper.

 - Push agent evaluation forward, for example by extending τ-bench to new domains, modalities, or long-horizon tasks, or by building new ways to measure reliability and consistency.

 - Study how agents reason, use tools, and follow policies over multi-turn conversations, and find out where and why they fail.

 - Explore post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to improve agent behavior, and measure the gains rigorously.

 - Work with large-scale, proprietary datasets of text and audio interactions to find research questions grounded in real customer problems.

 - Work with researchers and engineers across Sierra, and where it makes sense, turn your findings into improvements in production.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Currently pursuing a PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field.

 - A research track record, such as first-author publications or submissions at venues like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, Interspeech or ICASSP.

 - Strong experimental skills: you design clean experiments, build careful baselines, and are honest about what the results do and do not show.

 - Fluency in Python and modern ML tooling (for example, PyTorch, and LLM inference and training stacks).

 - High agency and a builder’s mindset. You’ll work across the stack to get an experiment running.

 - Clear, direct communication, both in writing and when presenting research.

EVEN BETTER

 - Research experience with LLM agents, tool use, or multi-turn dialogue.

 - Experience designing benchmarks or evaluations, especially ones tied to real-world outcomes.

 - Experience with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or long-horizon optimization.

 - Experience with speech, voice, or multimodal models.

 - Open-source contributions to ML research code or benchmarks.

INTERN QUALIFICATIONS

 - The internship is open to students currently enrolled in a PhD program.

 - Duration and start dates are flexible. Interns are embedded with the Applied Research team and work under the guidance of a mentor.

 - The internship is based in our San Francisco office. We are in person Monday through Thursday.

OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

jobs.title: Head of Startups and Venture Capital, Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Head of Startups & Venture Capital to build and lead Fireworks' startup ecosystem: the programs, partnerships, and relationships that make Fireworks the default AI platform for the next generation of AI Native companies. You'll own our relationships with top venture firms and accelerators, design our startup program, and turn the earliest-stage builders into the production-scale customers of tomorrow.

Fireworks is trusted by AI Native companies like Cursor, Vercel, Harvey, and Genspark — many of which started building with us at seed or Series A. The next fast growth AI Native company is being founded right now, and the VCs backing it are deciding which platforms to recommend. This role makes sure Fireworks is the answer. It's a builder role for someone who knows the venture ecosystem from the inside, can earn the trust of partners and founders alike, and can translate that access into measurable pipeline, adoption, and revenue.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define and own Fireworks' startup and venture strategy, including target segments, programs, partner tiers, and goals for pipeline, activation, and revenue.

 - Build and scale the Fireworks Startup Program - technical programming, go-to-market benefits, and graduation paths from self-serve to committed contracts.

 - Build deep relationships with partners and platform teams at top-tier venture firms, accelerators, and incubators, making Fireworks their recommended platform for portfolio companies building with AI.

 - Run portfolio-wide partnerships: perks and credits agreements, office hours, technical workshops, founder dinners, and AI infrastructure briefings for VC portfolios.

 - Represent Fireworks across the startup ecosystem - demo days, accelerator cohorts, hackathons, panels, and founder communities.

 - Track program economics and impact - credit spend, activation, conversion to paid, and revenue influenced - and report to GTM leadership.

 - Bring signal from founders and investors back to product and leadership: which models, workloads, and features the next wave of companies needs.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in startup partnerships, venture capital, business development, or GTM roles at a cloud, developer, or AI infrastructure company.

 - An established network across top-tier venture firms, accelerators, and founders.

 - Proven track record of turning ecosystem relationships into measurable pipeline, product adoption, and revenue.

 - Experience designing and running startup programs (credits, perks, technical enablement) with clear economics and accountability.

 - Enough technical fluency to discuss open-source models, inference performance, fine-tuning, and cost trade-offs credibly with founders and CTOs.

 - Comfort operating in a high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written - you build the plan, then run it.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership skills across Sales, Marketing, Product, Developer Relations, and Finance.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for founders and the early-stage builders.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience running a startup or VC program at a hyperscaler, AI lab, or developer platform.

 - Prior experience as a VC investor, platform lead at a venture firm, or founder / early employee at a venture-backed startup.

 - Existing relationships with AI-focused funds, accelerators, and founder communities.

 - Background in a technical, product, or developer relations role.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Fireworks is the recommended AI inference and model platform across the portfolios of the top venture firms and accelerators.

 - The startup program has clear economics: credits convert to paid usage, and graduates grow into committed contracts.

 - A steady flow of high-potential startups reaches the AI Native sales team early, with measurable sourced and influenced pipeline.

 - The next breakout AI Native companies are building on Fireworks before they're household names.

 - Founder and investor feedback reliably reaches product and leadership and shapes what we build.

 - A high-performing startup and VC team is in place and scaling with the business.

LOCATION

San Mateo, CA / San Francisco, CA

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Ops Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Ops Recruiter at Mercor, you’ll own full-cycle hiring for critical roles across a variety of organizations, with a particular focus on our Delivery org. You will partner directly with General Managers and Account Leads to find high performing operators that will partner directly with the leading AI Labs in the world, playing an instrumental role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. This is a true 0→1 motion, with an opportunity to lay the foundation for the future of recruiting at Mercor.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting (sourcing → close) across a variety of organizations (such as marketing, finance, people ops, with a prominent focus on operations)

 - Partner with b to map out needs and implement continual process improvements

 - Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor’s own product (structured screens, automated work samples, and calibrated rubrics)

 - Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene

 - Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize key funnel metrics (pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield)

 - Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for same-day debriefs, fast offers, and strong candidate experience

 - Build brand: campaigns, referrals, and events that attract top engineers and operators

 - Represent Mercor externally, you’ll be a face of the brand for an exceptionally competitive talent market

 - Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Ashby and other recruiting systems

 - Refinement of technical recruiting motion as the Ops org shifts to hire more frequently from technical backgrounds
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience with full-cycle recruiting across IC and leadership roles

 - Proven ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

 - High motor, outcome-oriented approach; Mercor is in hypergrowth, and hiring is viewed as a key strategic driver of that growth

 - Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with General Managers, Account Leads, and internal leadership

 - Familiarity with a range of roles, emphasis on GTM, Strategy, Operations, ideally with some mastery of technical roles such as SWEs or FDEs

 - Confident representing the Mercor brand to top candidates

 - Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems
 
 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

 - Interest in the human data / AGI space

 - Technical recruiting expertise - Mercor's business is trending in an increasingly technical perspective over time, and we are hiring a greater percentage of technical professionals into client facing operator roles
 
 

IDEAL QUALITIES

 - Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

 - Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

 - Growth Mindset - You don’t need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

 - Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

 - Love for the Craft - we are building a zero to one motion; this hire will bring a low ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition motion
 
 

BENEFITS

 - $15K relocation bonus (for moving to the Bay Area)

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPERBOUND

Sales runs on conversations. Hyperbound helps sales teams turn those conversations into better performance, stronger decisions, and action that moves deals forward.

We’re building the Revenue Activation Platform, connecting sales practice, coaching, and execution. Since coming out of YC S23, we’ve expanded from AI sales roleplay into technology that understands sales conversations, coaches reps in real time, and helps teams act on what they learn.

Companies including LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta trust Hyperbound. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, and we’re building the team to take our next big swings.

THE TEAM YOU'LL BUILD WITH

We’re a team of builders and operators who take ownership and work closely together. We value people who bring ideas, ask good questions, and care enough about the outcome to get into the details.

You’ll work alongside our Field Marketing Manager and partner with Marketing, Sales, and leadership to shape how Hyperbound shows up in person. You’ll have room to develop concepts and own execution, with teammates who share context, give direct feedback, and jump in when it’s time to make something happen.

We move quickly, learn from what happens, and adjust. When something goes wrong, we take responsibility and solve it together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Field Marketer to help create and execute Hyperbound’s events calendar, from conferences and trade shows to dinners, partner events, and hosted activations.

One week, you might be bringing a booth activation to life at a conference with 1,000+ attendees. The next, you’re producing a dinner for 10 sales leaders or figuring out how to build a pop-up café at Dreamforce.

You’ll help shape the ideas and own the work that makes them real: venues, vendors, partners, budgets, timelines, and logistics. Working alongside our Field Marketing Manager, you’ll create experiences that break through the noise, build relationships, and contribute to pipeline.

This role calls for creative judgment, strong project management, and a willingness to move between the big picture and the smallest details.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 - Events experience: You’ve delivered events, experiential marketing programs, or community experiences. You can walk us through what you owned, how you made it happen, and what you learned.

 - Strong project management: You can manage multiple events at once, keep budgets and timelines on track, and coordinate venues, vendors, partners, and internal teams. You anticipate dependencies and surface problems early.

 - Creative judgment: You bring original ideas and know how to make them work for the audience, budget, and setting. You care about creating something people want to participate in and remember.

 - Commercial mindset: You understand how events build brand awareness, strengthen relationships, and support pipeline. You work with Sales on the right audiences, target accounts, outreach, meeting goals, and follow-up.

 - High agency: You find gaps, bring recommendations, and move work forward. You’re resourceful when the answer isn’t obvious and comfortable turning an open-ended idea into a clear plan.

 - Hands-on execution: You’re willing to negotiate with a venue, coordinate shipments, check registration, brief the team, and help set up on-site. You take responsibility for delivering the experience.

 - An instinct for improvement: You use attendee feedback, sales conversations, event costs, and pipeline results to understand what’s working. You recommend what to repeat, improve, or stop.

HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - B2B experience: Experience creating events for business audiences, particularly sales leaders, revenue teams, or enterprise buyers.

 - Range across formats: You’ve worked on both larger conferences or activations and smaller, curated gatherings where the guest list and personal details matter.

 - Startup experience: You’re comfortable with changing priorities, limited resources, and building processes as you go.

 - Partner and vendor relationships: You’ve developed productive relationships with venues, agencies, vendors, or event partners and know how to get great work from them.

WHAT YOUR REGULAR THURSDAY LOOKS LIKE:

 - Review the upcoming events calendar with our Field Marketing Manager. Work through priorities, budgets, and deadlines, and bring a recommendation for a new activation or dinner series.

 - Develop a conference booth concept, compare production quotes, and work with a vendor to make the experience fit the space and budget.

 - Walk through a dinner guest list with Sales, check invitation progress, and confirm the venue, menu, seating, and plan for follow-up.

 - Build the production timeline for a Dreamforce pop-up café, coordinating the venue, partners, signage, staffing, and the details that make it feel like Hyperbound.

 - Review results from a recent event. Gather feedback from attendees and Sales, look at meetings and opportunities, and identify what to change for the next one.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - A strategy-only position. You’ll help develop the concept and do the practical work to bring it to life.

 - A role where every task comes with instructions. You’ll have support and context, and we’ll expect you to bring ideas, make recommendations, and take initiative.

 - A role measured only by attendance. We care about who’s in the room, the experience they have, the relationships we build, and what happens afterward.

INTERVIEW PLAN

 - Intro call with our recruiting team (30 minutes)

 - Conversation with our Field Marketing Manager (45 minutes)

 - Exercise review with the Marketing team (45 minutes)

We’ll share the process and timeline up front and keep you informed at each stage.

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
About Blacksmith

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

The role at Blacksmith

We're hiring our first IT Operations Engineer to own the systems and workflows our employees rely on. You'll shape how IT operates at Blacksmith, from onboarding and device management to identity, access and day-to-day support.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You'll solve problems for teammates, automate recurring work, and build processes that scale with the company. You'll also partner with security and engineering to keep our devices, accounts and internal tools secure.

What you’ll be doing

 - Own onboarding, role changes and offboarding end to end, including device procurement, setup and recovery, account provisioning and timely access removal.

 - Resolve employee issues across hardware, software, networking and accounts, and turn recurring problems into reliable, self-service or automated workflows.

 - Operate and improve identity and access management, ensuring employees have the access they need and nothing more.

 - Manage our employee device fleet, including automated enrollment, patching, disk encryption and inventory.

 - Own software administration, licenses and renewals, keeping track of the tools we use and who has access to them.

 - Partner with business teams to build and maintain internal apps and integrations that simplify their work.

 - Partner with security and engineering on endpoint security, access controls and audit readiness, and maintain clear employee guides and operational runbooks.

You’re a good fit if you have

 - A resourceful approach to troubleshooting and the persistence to work through unfamiliar problems using documentation, investigation and vendor support.

 - A genuine interest in helping people, with the patience and communication skills to support technical and non-technical teammates.

 - A track record of proactively identifying problems and driving them through resolution without waiting for direction, addressing root causes while managing competing priorities.

jobs.title: Systems Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Blacksmith

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

The role at Blacksmith

We are looking for a Systems Security Engineer to build and operate security controls at Blacksmith. Your primary focus will be our bare-metal fleet, with responsibility extending to our AWS control plane, application services and the broader organization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work alongside our systems engineers to harden production systems, strengthen workload isolation, and investigate and remediate security issues. You'll partner with our Security Lead to translate security priorities into engineering work.

What you’ll be doing

 - Identify, prioritize and remediate security risks across our bare-metal fleet, AWS control plane, application services and the broader organization.

 - Strengthen tenant isolation, host hardening, network boundaries and access controls across our platform.

 - Build and operate automated security controls for secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, intrusion detection and response, validating their effectiveness without compromising production reliability or performance.

 - Investigate and respond to security incidents, driving remediation through to completion.

 - Partner with engineering and IT to establish secure defaults and practical security standards across systems and workflows, balancing security, reliability and usability.

You’re a good fit if you have

 - Strong Linux systems experience, with the ability to debug production issues across the kernel, networking and storage stack.

 - A practical understanding of security fundamentals, including least privilege, defense in depth and threat modeling, and the ability to translate risks into technical solutions.

 - Experience with virtualization and Linux isolation primitives, such as Firecracker, KVM, namespaces and cgroups, and an understanding of their security boundaries and tradeoffs.

 - An understanding of storage access controls, tenant isolation and secure data deletion.

 - An understanding of how to use eBPF for runtime security monitoring, including observing process, file and network activity to detect suspicious behavior.

 - Experience securing production AWS environments, particularly IAM, networking and audit logging.

 - The ability to write and debug production code in Go, Rust, C, C++ or similar, and automate security changes through configuration management and infrastructure as code.

 - Strong comfort with agent-driven development and debugging, including directing coding agents, reviewing their changes and validating correctness and security.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous problems into practical engineering solutions, owning implementation through production rollout, and explaining technical tradeoffs to engineers, leadership and non-technical partners.

We welcome candidates from security engineering, systems engineering and SRE backgrounds. You should bring strong systems fundamentals and a demonstrated interest in securing the infrastructure you operate.

Bonus

 - You've found or reported CVEs, done container or VM escape research, or competed in CTFs.

 - You've secured multi-tenant infrastructure running untrusted workloads, such as CI runners, cloud compute or agent sandboxes.

 - You've built or extended eBPF-based detection tooling, turning runtime telemetry into actionable alerts and investigations.

 - You've secured software delivery pipelines, including build isolation, artifact signing, image provenance or secrets handling.

 - You've operated or secured distributed storage systems such as Ceph or MinIO in production.

 - You've secured macOS infrastructure running untrusted workloads.

Compensation and benefits

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401K match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options.

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US).

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

 

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

 

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

 

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Quo, you will spend a majority of your time coding, architecting, and owning moderate to complex components. Beyond your technical work, you may also lead a small team or a project. You might also spend time providing technical guidance, code reviews, and design and delivering on small/medium size projects end-to-end.

POTENTIAL AREAS OF FOCUS INCLUDE:

 - Leveraging AI and advanced technologies to help customers manage and derive insights from their data, optimizing the customer onboarding experience.

 - Empowering users to independently set up, manage, and scale their accounts with a seamless and compliant process.

 - Enhancing core messaging and calling features, improving customer data management, and optimizing the visibility of conversations and contacts.

In any of these areas, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle impactful challenges and help build scalable backend systems that will support a growing user base.

TECHNICAL STACK AND TOOLS:

 - Our backend is built on Node using Typescript.

 - We use Kubernetes on AWS to orchestrate our infrastructure setup and deployment.

 - The overall architecture is event-driven microservices with Temporal and RabbitMQ at the center of it.

 - We use a variety of databases for different purposes: Postgres, Mongo, Elastic, and Redis.

 - Observability Tools: Datadog

 - Other Tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, and Slack

ABOUT YOU

 - Strong experience with Typescript, or experience with object-oriented languages such as Java or C# and Javascript/Node.

 - Strong experience with observability tools, including metrics, structured logging and distributed tracing

 - You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of communication. You hold yourself to a high standard and help empower others to do the same.

 - You are intentional about how your work impacts customers, the community, and each other. You practice empathy, generosity, and thoughtfulness as you evaluate tradeoffs in pursuit of the best solution.

 - You are curious. You better seek to understand the ‘why’ behind things, so that you can better plan and build the ‘how’. You support your teammates and customers through the continuous pursuit of knowledge. You’re a lifelong learner.

 - Your code is a pleasure for your teammates to read and understand and you strive to ensure it is readable, testable, and maintainable.. When working in the codebase, you leave things better than you found them.

 - You embrace AI and find ways to use it to improve your work, rather than shying away from it.

COMPENSATION

The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits:

 - SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $187,000 - $220,000 USD

 - All other US Locations: $169,000 - $198,000 USD

 - Canada: $172,000 - $202,000 CAD

The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

WHO WE ARE

 

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

 

And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements.

 

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. #LI-Remote #PostLI

jobs.title: Founding Strategy and Operations Analyst role
jobs.description:
BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

The Role

Handling claims at scale requires a strong operational foundation. As our Founding Strategy & Operations Analyst, you’ll help build the operational capability that lets ClaimSorted deliver market-leading claims handling while running efficiently as we grow. You’ll work with data to find problems, then take on the projects that fix them, increasing the speed and volume of operational change across the company. As part of this role you will:

 - Design and implement efficient claims processes and procedures, and make sure they are adopted and hold up as the team grows.

 - Build and manage the KPIs and metrics we use to handle claims and run the organisation as efficiently as possible.

 - Analyse operational data to understand problems, surface insights, and turn them into practical solutions.

 - Take ownership of small projects and support complex cross-functional initiatives, from scoping through to delivery.

 - Work with teams across the company to make operational changes land quickly.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

 - 2+ years of experience in consulting, data or analytics, or operations at a startup, tech firm or consultancy

 - Demonstrated experience working with data to provide insights, understand problems and deliver effective solutions

 - Demonstrated experience implementing solutions and running small projects or changes

 - Strong written and spoken communication, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally

 - A generalist mindset: comfortable picking up whatever problem matters most and moving quickly

 - Insurance or claims experience is a plus, but not required

Our Values

 - Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

 - Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

jobs.description:
This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.

Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

 

The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:

 - Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

 - Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time). 

 - Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.

 - Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.

 - Fully remote, with work equipment provided.

 - A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.

 - And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

 

As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include:

 - Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.

 - Answering inbound calls from policyholders who need something changed.

 - Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.

 - Problem solving to resolve customer inquiries effectively.

 - Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.

 - Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

 - Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required

 - Strong work ethic

 - Strong problem solving skills

 - Strong communication skills

jobs.description:
BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

The Role

Handling claims at scale requires simultaneous operational and product expertise. As part of this role you will:

QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Assistant (Freelance contributor)
jobs.description:
Wallbit es la cuenta global para profesionales que trabajan para empresas del exterior. Una experiencia bancaria que te permite cobrar, gastar e invertir desde un mismo lugar, diseñada para que ganar en dólares deje de ser solo el punto de partida y se convierta en un camino concreto para construir tu futuro financiero.

 

Respaldados por Y Combinator y destacados inversores de Silicon Valley, ya ayudamos a decenas de miles de usuarios a gestionar sus finanzas.

 

Si sos una persona a la que le gusta trabajar con autonomía, asumir responsabilidades de principio a fin y llevar sus proyectos adelante, en Wallbit vas a encontrar la oportunidad de aportar valor, tomar decisiones y generar un impacto real a través de tu trabajo.

 

Actualmente buscamos Influencer Marketing Assistant para colaborar en el desarrollo y ejecución de nuestra estrategia de influencers, bajo modalidad freelance.

 

Vas a tener autonomía para organizar tu trabajo y encontrar nuevas oportunidades para conectar Wallbit con audiencias relevantes. Valoramos especialmente a quienes disfrutan de los desafíos, se adaptan rápido y buscan generar un impacto en lo que hacen.

 

Modalidad de trabajo

 - Freelance: horario flexible manteniendo disponibilidad y espacios de coordinación que coincidan con los horarios del equipo.

 - Part-time: 4 a 5 horas por día.

 - Trabajo organizado por entregables semanales, con objetivos y prioridades acordados.

 - Colaboración directa con Head of Growth de Perú.
 

Qué vas a hacer

 - Buscar y proponer creadores que calcen con el ICP de Wallbit (personas que exportan sus servicios al extranjero y cuenten con la necesidad de una cuenta global), revisando su audiencia, alcance, reputación y engagement real. La selección final de cada creador la hace la Head of Growth.

 - Hacer el sourcing en Instagram, TikTok, YouTube y X, y proponer nuevas redes si encuentra buenos perfiles en ellas.

 - Mantener y hacer crecer la base de datos de creadores, incluyendo el backlog de perfiles a re-contactar.

 - Armar y mantener una bolsa de creadores UGC (perfiles sin comunidad propia) que produzcan videos y piezas para usar en las redes sociales de Wallbit o para anuncios pagos.

 - Contactar a los creadores aprobados con mensajes personalizados.

 - Negociar tarifas, entregables y los derechos de uso del contenido en ads (whitelisting, Spark Ads, partnership ads), dentro del presupuesto asignado y con objetivo de costo por entregable y por resultado.

 - Cerrar acuerdos y coordinar con el equipo para contratos, facturación y pagos.

 - Enviar el brief modelo de Wallbit a cada creador aprobado y resolver sus dudas sobre la marca y los lineamientos para el guión.

 - Hacer seguimiento al guión, a la grabación y a sus correcciones, hasta la fecha de publicación.

 - Reunir métricas de cada publicación (views, engagement, clics, registros) y reportarlas cada semana.

 - Llevar un tracker actualizado con el estatus de creadores, negociaciones, contratos, etc., y un reporte mensual de inversión y desempeño.
 

Qué buscamos

 - 1 a 2 años de experiencia en influencer marketing, talent management, ventas o partnerships (agencia, marca o freelance).

 - Experiencia negociando con creadores y cerrando acuerdos con números claros (tarifa, entregables, derechos de uso).

 - Capacidad para evaluar un perfil más allá de los seguidores: engagement, calidad de audiencia, fit de marca.

 - Muy buen manejo de Excel / Google Sheets o Notion para trackear un pipeline de 20 a 30 perfiles por mes.

 - Proactividad y autonomía: cumplir plazos, ownership de las responsabilidades, cuidado del presupuesto, y contar con iniciativa para proponer perfiles, formatos y nuevas redes.

 

Deseable

 - Experiencia previa con fintech, finanzas personales, trabajo remoto o productos digitales.

 - Experiencia contratando creadores UGC y trabajando con pauta paga (Meta, TikTok Ads).

jobs.title: IT Helpdesk Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

 

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

 

WHO YOU ARE:

You’re a hands-on IT leader who has built and run help desk teams at fast-growing startups. You know what keeps engineers productive without sacrificing security and compliance. You’re as comfortable configuring a switch or writing an Intune policy as you are coaching a technician or explaining a new control to the team. You’ve worked in regulated environments, and you understand that CMMC, ITAR and EAR aren’t paperwork; they shape how every system is built and used. You take ownership, document what you do, and want to be on-site where the work happens.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Lead, hire and mentor the IT help desk team, and set clear priorities, SLAs and escalation paths

 - Own day-to-day IT support for Windows, macOS and Linux users across the company

 - Administer our Microsoft 365 GCC and GCC High tenants, including identity, email, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams

 - Manage endpoints through Microsoft Intune and Jamf: enrollment, configuration profiles, patching, compliance policies and app deployment

 - Design, maintain and troubleshoot our Ubiquiti and Cisco network infrastructure, including switching, wireless, firewalls and VPN

 - Maintain a CMMC 2.0 compliant environment: implement and monitor controls, collect evidence, and support audits and assessments

 - Ensure IT systems and processes meet ITAR and EAR requirements for handling controlled technical data

 - Manage onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, and asset lifecycle from procurement to disposal

 - Write and maintain IT documentation, runbooks and user-facing guides

 - Partner with engineering, operations and leadership to evaluate and roll out new tools

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 3+ years of experience managing an IT or help desk team

 - 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment

 - 3+ years of Windows and macOS administration experience; Linux experience is a huge plus

 - 3+ years administering Microsoft Intune and Jamf MDM platforms

 - Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 GCC and GCC High

 - Experience with Ubiquiti and Cisco networking

 - Experience administering a CMMC 2.0 compliant work environment

 - Working knowledge of CMMC 2.0 and ITAR/EAR compliance requirements

 - Ability to work full-time in office, Monday through Friday

 - Must be a U.S. citizen

PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
 
 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior C++ Software Engineer - Drone Stack
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on our Drone Stack team, you will design and integrate complex autonomy and vehicle intelligence systems spanning hardware and software domains. You will integrate hardware and software onto vehicle platforms and deploy autonomy algorithms in both SIL, HIL and live test environments. Computer networking, code integration, and a passion for robotics integration is a must. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable solutions for defense and commercial customers, providing seamless hardware-software integration, troubleshooting, and customer-facing demonstrations.

If you're a strong C++ engineer with no prior drone experience but a keen interest in the space, this role could be an ideal fit.

AT APPLIED INTUITION YOU WILL:

 - Adapt and develop modular and agile autonomy capabilities across diverse defense problems

 - Integrate and deploy autonomy solutions onto embedded Linux and other hardware platforms, including interfacing with sensors and collecting data

 - Troubleshoot complex integration and software issues to ensure high reliability and performance

 - Integrate autonomy software into hardware in collaboration with autonomy engineers that supports full integration with aircraft autopilots, datalinks, sensors, PNT/GPS/INS, ground control stations, etc.

 - Support live flight test of autonomy software on group 1-5 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)

 - Collaborate with 3rd party UAS vehicle vendors on the integration of Applied autonomy software onto OEM UAS hardware

 - Conduct system-level setup, testing, and validation, including software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop evaluations

 - Collaborate with autonomy engineers to implement service-oriented-architecture software and inter-process messaging systems for autonomous UASsCollaborate with DoD warfighter domain experts and 3rd party UAS vehicle vendors to develop and integrate autonomy software onto OEM hardware

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science or related engineering field

 - 5 -10 years of hands-on experience working with robotic systems (hardware, software, and integration)

 - Experience with software programming languages: C++ preferred

 - Experience integrating autonomy/robotics products with Pixhawk autopilots (ArduPilot and/or PX4)

 - Experience integrating with communication busses & protocols: UART/RS232/RS422/RS485 , SPI/QSPI , I2C , Ethernet

 - Experience developing in Docker, containerized deployment environments, and using Linux-based operating systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu)

 - Experience using git, Visual Studio Code, GitLab

 - Familiarity with real-time, edge computing, and safety-critical systems operating in software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), test & operational environments

 - Excellent communication skills and customer-oriented project delivery mindset

 - Willingness to travel frequently for on-site integration and demonstrations (estimated 10–20%)

 - Must be a U.S. Citizen

 - Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in modern C++ (2011, 2017, or 2020 standards), Bash, and CMake

 - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

 - Experience with Agile development practices and CI/CD pipelines

 - Prior work with COTS hardware integration such as Nvidia Jetson and Raspberry Pi

 - Active U.S. SECRET clearance preferred

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager | AI AppSec
jobs.description:
Location: Remote-friendly (with offices in NYC, Amsterdam, and Paris)

At Escape, we empower small security teams to break through headcount limits by transforming manual security work into scalable, streamlined workflows, from attack surface management and dynamic security testing to AI-driven pentesting. Our mission is to align security and engineering and make advanced application security accessible and impactful for innovative businesses worldwide.

Having just raised our $18M Series A, our team of 30 passionate "Escapers" is breaking down barriers and rapidly bringing cybersecurity innovation from R&D to production. Every member of our fast-scaling team is empowered to take on meaningful responsibilities and create real impact.

WHY JOIN ESCAPE?

 - Be part of a high-growth startup at a pivotal inflection point

 - Learn hands-on about cutting-edge applications in AI and cybersecurity

 - Collaborate with a world-class, international team across the US and Europe

 - Take ownership and contribute directly to our rapid growth

 - Grow with a product trusted by top-tier clients—including the Olympic Games, the French Football Federation, Miro, and PandaDoc

YOUR ROLE

As our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager (PMM), you’ll report directly to a founder and own how Escape is discovered, understood, and adopted by the security world. You will define Escape’s category position, crafting narrative and go-to-market strategies across both US and European markets.

You Will:

 - Develop impactful product messaging for Security Leaders and Engineers, translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories

 - Own go-to-market strategies for new feature launches, collaborating closely with the Growth Marketing team to drive pipeline results

 - Lead market and competitive research, sharpening Escape’s positioning and informing product roadmap decisions

 - Drive thought leadership initiatives, including speaking engagements (e.g., partner webinars) and high-impact content

 - Build the sales enablement toolkit, designing pitch decks, battlecards, competitive comparisons, and one-pagers to ensure our commercial team excels

 - Establish foundational PMM processes, playbooks, and strategies to scale and evolve with the company

YOUR IMPACT

 - Security teams instantly understand how Escape fits into their security stack, thanks to your clear and compelling messaging

 - Sales cycles accelerate as reps are empowered with sharp, resonant narratives and robust competitive positioning

 - Feature launches consistently generate traction and move the pipeline forward

 - Escape builds a recognized voice in offensive security, with you as a key architect of our thought leadership

ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years total experience, with at least 2 years in product marketing (ideally in cybersecurity, developer tools, or technical B2B SaaS at high-growth companies)

 - Demonstrated success in marketing to technical audiences, you understand engineers and speak their language

 - Experience supporting product launches end-to-end, from messaging and asset creation to performance analysis

 - Strong storytelling capabilities, able to distill technical topics into compelling, audience-adaptive narratives

 - Collaborative and cross-functional, comfortable working closely with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams

Bonus Points:

 - Start-up experience, particularly in early-stage, fast-moving environments

 - Entrepreneurial spirit—proactive, adaptable, and eager to build from scratch

 - Familiarity with application security, developer tools, or engineering workflows

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Full ownership of a strategic function in a high-growth cybersecurity startup

 - Remote-friendly work culture plus quarterly team meetups and annual retreats

 - Stock options or stock purchase plan

 - Modern, well-equipped offices in NYC, Amsterdam, or Paris (with coffee, snacks, and monthly social events)

 - Career development support and a professional development budget—including free books

Ready to shape the future of application security? Apply to join Escape and make your mark on the next chapter of cybersecurity innovation!

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Research (2026 PhD New Grad) - Seattle
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE:

This role is designed for researchers finishing their PhD who want their work to reach production, not just publication. As a Member of Technical Staff on the Research team, you'll push the boundaries of generative AI, advancing LLMs and multimodal systems through foundational research. Your work will enhance model efficiency, accuracy, and scalability, directly shaping our high-performance AI infrastructure.

You'll be paired with a senior researcher as a mentor and given a real research problem from day one. You'll collaborate with top experts in deep learning, distributed systems, and optimization, and you'll see the models you help create deployed by some of the world's leading companies — often within weeks rather than years.

We welcome candidates who have completed within the last 6 months, or expected completion by December 2026.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Conduct foundational research to advance the capabilities, efficiency, and reliability of LLMs and multimodal systems

 - Design, implement, and evaluate novel model architectures, training methods, and optimization techniques

 - Work alongside engineering teams to transition research prototypes into production-grade systems

 - Analyze empirical results, identify performance bottlenecks, and iterate quickly to improve model quality

 - Bring ideas and emerging directions from your doctoral research into our internal research agenda

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - PhD completed within the last 6 months, or expected completion by December 2026, in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field

 - Research background in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Physics, or a related area, demonstrated through your dissertation, publications, or research projects

 - Experience solving analytical problems using analytic and quantitative approaches

 - Experience communicating research to audiences with different backgrounds

 - Proficiency coding in Python, C/C++, or other similar languages

 - Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - First-authored publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, or similar)

 - Industry research internships, or open-source contributions to ML systems, model training, or inference projects

 - Research or engineering experience demonstrated via grants, fellowships, patents, or coding competitions

 - Experience with large-scale model training, distributed systems, GPU kernel development, or inference optimization

 - Experience taking research code beyond the prototype stage

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk
jobs.description:
Location: Onsite — Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

About the Role

9 Mothers builds hardware in Austin, TX, and this role is the single point of contact for everything that comes into or leaves our building. You own receiving end to end: every package, every packing list, every handoff to the person waiting on it. No prior experience is required. What matters most is that you are reliable and detail-oriented, because a shipment that is misplaced or logged wrong stalls the people who need it.

 

What You'll Do

 - Receive every delivery to the building and check it against its packing list

 - Log each shipment in our receiving system and keep packing lists filed and traceable

 - Organize incoming packages so anything can be found quickly

 - Notify recipients when their items arrive and hand them off

 - For outbound shipments, package and label the item, drive it to the carrier, and confirm it has gone out

 - Keep the receiving area clean and orderly

What We're Looking For

 - Reliable: you are here every day, on time, and no delivery goes uncaught

 - Detail-oriented: you check quantities and part numbers against the packing list and don't let a discrepancy slide

 - Organized, with basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, or an inventory/receiving system)

 - Valid driver's license and a clean driving record

 - Able to lift and move packages up to 50 lb

 - Prior receiving, shipping, warehouse, or inventory experience is a plus but not required

Hours & Location

 - Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., onsite in Austin, TX

 - The hours are fixed so someone is always on hand for every delivery window

 

Benefits

 - Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

 - Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

 - Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

 - The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

 - 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

 - Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

 - Zero Red Tape: You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

 - Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

 - Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

 1. Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call)

 2. Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams)

 3. Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in-person)

jobs.title: G&A Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a G&A Recruiter at Mercor, you’ll own full-cycle hiring for critical roles across a variety of Finance, Legal, Marketing and People. You would be Mercor's first dedicated G&A recruiter, partnering with senior leadership and C-Suites to not only make critical hires for the business, but to lay the foundation for how G&A recruiting will operate at Mercor moving forward. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting (sourcing → close) across a variety of organizations such as marketing, finance, legal and people ops

 - Partner directly with C-Suite Leadership to map out needs and implement continual process improvements

 - Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor’s own product (structured screens, automated work samples, and calibrated rubrics)

 - Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene

 - Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize key funnel metrics (pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield)

 - Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for same-day debriefs, fast offers, and strong candidate experience

 - Build brand: campaigns, referrals, and events that attract top engineers and operators

 - Represent Mercor externally, you’ll be a face of the brand for an exceptionally competitive talent market

 - Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Ashby and other recruiting systems

 - Refinement of technical recruiting motion as the Ops org shifts to hire more frequently from technical backgrounds
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years experience with full-cycle recruiting across IC and leadership roles

 - Proven success hiring across a range of roles and departments, with the ability to context switch across departments with ease

 - Ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

 - Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with General Managers, Strategic Project Leads and Mercor’s President

 - Confident representing the Mercor brand to top candidates

 - Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems
 
 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

 - Interest in the human data / AGI space

 - Prior experience leveraging Ashby as an ATS
 
 

IDEAL QUALITIES

 - Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

 - Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

 - Growth Mindset - You don’t need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

 - Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

 - Love for the Craft - we are building a zero to one motion; this hire will bring a low ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition organization
 
 

BENEFITS

 - $15K relocation bonus (for moving to the Bay Area)

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match
