jobs.title: Senior Manager, Deal Desk
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is hiring a Senior Manager, Deal Desk to build our deal desk from the ground up and run it. Deepgram is a usage-based voice AI platform (speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the Voice Agent API), sold through self-serve plans, enterprise commitments and cloud marketplaces. You'll report to the Chief Accounting Officer and work daily with leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance.

The desk is not a control function. Its job is to help Sales win better deals faster, at prices we can defend.

What you'll do

 - Build the desk: approval matrix, pre-approved playbook, and credit and promo guidelines, so most deals need no approval.

 - Run it day to day: review non-standard deals and give same-day answers.

 - Shape large deals early: commitment size, ramps, product mix and terms.

 - Partner with Product and sales leadership on pricing and packaging.

 - Build pricing insight: deal margin, realized discount, and win rate by discount band.

 - Keep deals clean and audit-ready, with approvals and terms recorded in Salesforce.

 - Use AI to run the desk: an agent does the first-pass review; you make the call and improve the rules.

 - Build out CPQ in Salesforce so the playbook and approvals live in the quote.

 - Partner with Customer Success on renewals at first, then take ownership of renewals as the desk matures.

What you'll need

 - 6+ years in deal desk, deal strategy or pricing at a B2B technology company, with 3+ running a desk.

 - Usage-based pricing experience: commitments, credits, overage, ramps and rollover.

 - A desk, matrix or playbook you built that sales adopted.

 - Financial fluency, including how deal terms affect revenue recognition.

 - Hands-on experience building Salesforce CPQ, plus SQL.

 - Credibility with sales executives, clear writing, and an AI-native way of working you can show.

Nice to have

 - Infrastructure, API or AI company experience.

 - Pre-IPO experience.

 - Cloud marketplace private offers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

 - Has owned or run renewals.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to [email in original advert].

jobs.title: Environmental Health & Safety Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

 

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

WHO YOU ARE:

Astro Mechanica is looking for a hands-on Environmental Health & Safety Lead to own safety for our test operations first and build the EHS function from there. You will work directly with engineering, test, manufacturing, facilities, and leadership to make high-energy work — combustion testing, fuels, high-pressure systems, rotating equipment, and high voltage — safer, more repeatable, and easier to execute responsibly. This is not a desk-only compliance role: you will spend real time on the production floor, in labs, and at test sites, leading training, participating in test readiness reviews, verifying controls in the field, and solving problems in real time. You will build a proportionate EHS system that scales as we add people, equipment, facilities, and test activity. Your first priority is a safety baseline for our test site, then the permits and programs that support it. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Define and put in place the safety baseline for our test operations and new test site, including the site safety plan, emergency response, test readiness reviews, and the programs California requires (such as the Injury and Illness Prevention Program)

 - Build the EHS program in phases, starting with test site safety and extending to manufacturing: risk register, written programs, training matrix, inspections, and corrective-action process

 - Select and manage EHS consultants and training providers, and decide what the company needs now versus later

 - Turn requests from engineering, test, and facilities into one prioritized EHS plan

 - Own core safety programs, including LOTO, electrical safety, hot work, confined space, fall protection, chemical safety, and PPE

 - Lead hazard analyses, test readiness reviews, and management of change for combustion, fuel, high-pressure, and high-voltage testing

 - Deliver hands-on training and field support for commissioning, heavy lifts, rigging, forklifts, and aerial lifts

 - Own permitting and agency engagement with Cal/OSHA, fire departments, CUPAs, and BAAQMD; start with the permits that gate test operations, including fuel delivery, then air and environmental permits; keep records inspection-ready

 - Build emergency response plans and lead incident investigations that drive corrective actions to closure

 - Plan EHS requirements for the manufacturing floor ahead of its build-out, including needed certifications and programs (for example, whether a drug testing program applies)

 - Respond to agency citations and charges in partnership with legal counsel
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 7+ years of EHS experience in aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, energy, or other high-consequence hardware environments

 - Proven track record standing up EHS programs from scratch or near scratch in a startup or rapidly scaling operation

 - Ability to execute a defined safety plan yourself first and grow the function as the company scales; we are hiring an owner and doer before a department head

 - Deep working knowledge of Cal/OSHA, including the Injury and Illness Prevention Program, and core programs such as LOTO, machine guarding, electrical safety, and industrial hygiene

 - Hands-on experience with high-hazard operations, ideally testing of high-voltage, electricity-producing machines, along with combustion testing, pressure systems, fuels, or crane and rigging

 - Experience securing permits and working with fire departments, CUPAs, air districts, and other AHJs

 - Experience selecting and managing EHS consultants and training providers

 - Sound judgment under pressure: you make the call when work is unsafe and help redesign it so it can proceed

 - Aerospace propulsion or hot-fire test experience.

 - Credentials such as CSP, CIH, CHMM, or HAZWOPER are a plus
 
 

PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
 
 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Majors, Healthcare
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

ABOUT THE HEALTHCARE TEAM

 - Our healthcare agents already reach over 50% of U.S. families. We partner with leading health plans, providers, and healthcare platforms to deliver AI agents that handle some of the most sensitive and high stakes conversations in any industry. From helping members understand their benefits to resolving billing questions with empathy, our healthcare agents are transforming how patients and policyholders interact with the healthcare system.

 - Our healthcare customers include major health insurance networks, nonprofit providers, multi-site primary and urgent care practices, healthcare diagnostics companies, and healthcare financial platforms.

 - Join us to transform the patient experience across the healthcare system—and help build technology that makes care more accessible, more human and more affordable for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Go deep on a few accounts. Learn each customer's business well enough that you could be wearing their badge in their hallways

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Decide when to bring in Agent Development, Product, Security, Legal, and Sierra leaders, and what each of them needs to do. You keep everyone aimed at the same goal

 - Raise the bar for the SE team: mentor others, set standards for demos and pilots, and write the playbooks for Strategic deals and GTM processes

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Share what you see across your largest accounts with Product leadership and inform roadmap

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with Strategic customers with deal sizes of $1M+ consistently

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Strong experience in relationship-building with prospect stakeholders, including C-suite executives and technical leaders

 - Experience leading architecture, integration, and security discussions with enterprise architects, engineering leaders, and security teams

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale and defining customer roadmaps to facilitate growth

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience

EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product

OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

jobs.title: Inventory Site Lead (Milpitas)
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

The Inventory Site Lead owns inventory for Milpitas, supporting production, our engineering labs and our contract manufacturers. You'll supervise the Milpitas Inventory team (receiving, warehouse coordinators and material handlers) and own the accuracy of every record: what is on hand, where it is, what it is allocated to, and what has left the building. You'll work closely with the SMT line, Procurement, Engineering and Finance. This is a working-lead role: you set the standard, build the processes, and are on the floor hands on when a count, a receipt or an investigation needs your hands.

Key Responsibilities

 - Team leadership: Supervise the Milpitas Inventory team: set daily priorities, own shift coverage and scheduling (including the swing shift), train new coordinators on SOPs and equipment, and lead hands on alongside the team.

 - Receiving and material handling: Own receiving in NetSuite/ERP end to end: loading-dock pickup, inspection, verification of quantities and part information against POs and packing lists, lot and date-code capture, labeling, put-away and routing to lab, storage or build areas. Resolve receipt discrepancies same day with Supply Chain, Logistics and Engineering. Oversee packaging and outbound shipments.

 - Inventory control: Maintain accurate on-hand, allocated, in-transit and consigned-at-CM balances. Run the cycle-count program. Investigate every variance to root cause (receipt, transaction, kitting, scrap or physical), correct the record, and close the process gap so it does not recur.

 - Kitting and internal fulfillment: Make sure kits for in-house and CM builds are complete, to the released BOM revision, and staged on time. Be the escalation point for engineers requesting parts, tools, equipment and supplies, and make sure the team picks, stages and distributes material for builds and testing without delay. Flag shortages and substitutions before they stop a build.

 - Warehouse operations and safety: Keep lab and warehouse spaces clean, safe and organized. Own the ESD, 5S and safety programs, including handling requirements for ESD-sensitive, fragile and high-value parts. Oversee forklift (8,000 lb), pallet-jack and cart use and keep the team trained and certified. Coordinate material movement between Etched facilities.

 - Processes: Write and maintain the SOPs for receiving, put-away, transfers, consignment, RMA, return-to-stock and scrap. Identify and drive improvements to labeling, storage systems and material flow.

 - Scaling: Plan space, staffing and systems for higher volumes and additional production lines.

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

 - Minimum of three years of experience in inventory or warehouse operations in a manufacturing or electronics environment.

 - Hands-on experience with SAP, NetSuite or a comparable ERP for receiving, transfers, cycle counts and inventory adjustments.

 - Experience managing inventory and leading a team: setting priorities, scheduling, training and holding a standard.

 - Proficient in Excel: lookups, pivot tables and building a clean weekly report from transaction data.

 - Experience running cycle-count programs and investigating variances to root cause.

 - Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate closely with Engineering, Supply Chain and Operations teams.

 - Comfortable on the floor: ESD-controlled areas, lifting up to 50 lb, and standing for extended periods.

 - Valid driver's license and reliable transportation between San Jose and Milpitas.

Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - Exposure to electronics manufacturing (SMT/PCBA), including MSD and ESD handling.

 - Experience managing consigned or customer-furnished material at contract manufacturers.

 - Prior lab or warehouse experience in a semiconductor or hardware environment.

 - Experience supporting inventory audits or compliance processes.

 - Familiarity with startup operations or fast-paced R&D cycles.

 - Forklift certification (training on our 8,000 lb forklift will be provided).

Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
 
 - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

Compensation Range

 - $120,000 - $150,000 annually, plus equity

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and this role is based at our site in Milpitas. We do not have boundaries between teams, and we expect everyone to work across disciplines as needed.

As set forth in Etched's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Founding People Business Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced People Business Partner to build and lead our HRBP function as we scale. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who will partner closely with leaders across the company to develop strong managers, run fair and effective performance and employee relations processes, and keep our organization healthy as we grow. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building from scratch, coaching leaders with candor, and eventually hiring and leading a team of People Business Partners.

What You’ll Do

 - Build the HRBP function. Define how we partner with the business, set priorities as we scale, and grow into hiring and leading a team of People Business Partners.

 - Coach and advise managers at every level, and build leadership training that helps new and experienced leaders give feedback, run effective 1:1s, and develop their people.

 - Own our Impact Review program end to end, including calibration, and build lightweight goal-setting and continuous-feedback practices so nothing comes as a surprise at review time.

 - Lead employee relations, guiding managers through performance issues, PIPs, and exits with good judgment, fairness, and discretion, in partnership with People Ops and Legal.

 - Design and launch engagement and development programs that promote inclusivity, grow skills, and support career and leadership development.

 - Build our leadership pipeline by assessing readiness for lead roles and supporting new managers through the transition.

 - Keep a pulse on org health. Understand team structures, reporting lines, and how teams work together, spot risks early (attrition, burnout, team friction), and recommend changes to org design.

 - Use people data to guide recommendations on performance, retention, and team health.

Must Have

 - 7-10+ years of HR experience, including 3+ years as an HR Business Partner in high-growth or complex environments, with deep knowledge of performance management, employee relations, and org design.

 - Experience building HRBP programs from scratch, not only running existing ones.

 - A track record of designing and running performance review cycles and manager development programs.

 - Strong employee relations judgment. You’ve handled complex, sensitive situations and know how to balance employee care with business needs and legal risk.

 - Credibility and executive presence. You build trust fast, coach with candor, and push back on leaders, founders included, when it matters.

 - Experience supporting teams across multiple countries (US and EU strongly preferred).

 - Interest in leading a team. People management experience is a plus.

 - High ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias toward building and simplifying.

 - Comfort using AI tools and modern HR technology to work more efficiently.

Nice to Have

 - Experience scaling a company through hypergrowth, for example from about 200 to 500+ employees.

 - Background in workforce planning or org design.

 - Experience at an AI or fast-moving tech startup.
 
 

WHY JOIN US?

 - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

THE ROLE

As Contracts Manager, you will play a key role in building and scaling Reflection’s commercial contracting operations. You will own the day-to-day management of our contracting process, from initial intake through execution, working closely with Legal and cross-functional business teams to keep agreements moving efficiently.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced contracts professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, exercises sound judgment, and takes ownership of processes. You will help build the systems, workflows, and playbooks that enable Reflection’s legal team to scale alongside the business, while freeing attorneys to focus on complex negotiations and strategic legal matters.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end contract management process, including intake, triage, tracking, internal approvals, signature coordination, and recordkeeping.

 - Conduct first-pass review and negotiation of routine agreements, particularly NDAs, using established templates, playbooks, and escalation guidelines.

 - Support commercial contracting across a range of agreements, including vendor and procurement agreements, SaaS and technology agreements, data licensing agreements, and other commercial contracts.

 - Serve as a central point of coordination between Legal and business stakeholders, proactively managing follow-ups, outstanding issues, and execution timelines.

 - Coordinate cross-functional reviews with Security, Privacy, Compliance, Finance, and other teams, ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained.

 - Manage contract documentation, version control, signature workflows, and executed agreement storage.

 - Identify nonstandard contractual terms and escalate substantive legal or business issues to the appropriate stakeholders.

 - Develop and improve contracting workflows, templates, playbooks, and standard operating procedures to streamline operations and reduce turnaround times.

 - Maintain contract trackers and reporting on volume, status, turnaround times, and bottlenecks.

 - Identify opportunities to automate and scale contracting processes as the company grows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5+ years of experience in contracts management, commercial legal operations, or a related role.

 - Prior experience working directly with an in-house legal team, supporting attorneys and business stakeholders through commercial contracting processes.

 - Demonstrated experience independently managing commercial agreements from intake through execution.

 - Familiarity with commercial contracts, including NDAs, vendor agreements, SaaS agreements, and other technology-related agreements.

 - Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, internal approval processes, and signature workflows.

 - Familiarity with AI-powered tools and workflows, including the ability to use AI agents and automation to streamline contracting processes, improve efficiency, and scale legal operations.

 - Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of requests and competing priorities.

 - Sound judgment — you know what you can handle independently, when to push a process forward, and when to escalate to Legal.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across legal, technical, and business teams.

 - Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

jobs.title: Lead, Pricing & Monetization Strategy
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE:

We operate at the bleeding edge of the inference market, building entirely new service categories and creating new business models at the forefront of the AI revolution. To bring these to life we need equally innovative monetization strategies that can scale with us as we grow.

We are looking for a Pricing Strategy Director to lead pricing strategy and implementation. You will serve as an internal subject matter expert responsible for the evolution of our pricing models and pricing architecture, aligning price to value, and reducing complexity for our teams and customers. You will work closely with our engineering, product, and GTM teams to accomplish these goals.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Develop and evolve our overall pricing and packaging architecture in partnership with Product, aligning price to the value customers get and simplifying how we sell and how customers buy.

 - Monitor competitor moves, model and hardware cost trends, and shifts in demand across the inference market, and build playbooks so we can respond quickly and consistently.

 - Build financial and scenario models (revenue, margin, adoption, and elasticity impact) that give leadership a clear basis for pricing and packaging decisions.

 - Work with Systems, Finance, and Operations teams to implement monetization strategies across billing, quoting, contracts, and internal tooling.

 - Partner with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, and other GTM teams on ongoing enablement, including pricing guidance, deal frameworks, discounting guardrails, and training, so the field can sell our pricing with confidence.

 - Serve as the internal subject matter expert on pricing, advising executives and cross-functional teams and creating a feedback loop from the market and the field back into our strategy.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of professional experience with at least 4 years in pricing, strategy & operations at a B2B software company, or strategy consulting

 - Highly analytical, with a deep experience building financial and scenario models and turning complex data into clear recommendations

 - Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts and a history of linking pricing decisions to business outcomes

 - Experience with sales and go-to-market strategy, including partnering with field teams on enablement and deal support

 - Ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, Systems, and GTM teams and to influence senior stakeholders

 - Excellent written and verbal communication

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on experience designing usage-based, consumption, or hybrid pricing models for cloud, infrastructure, or developer platforms

 - Familiarity with AI/ML, inference, or cloud infrastructure economics, including compute costs, gross margin, and capacity considerations

 - Experience implementing pricing in billing, CPQ, and CRM systems, and partnering with Finance and Revenue Operations

 - Background in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment where pricing and packaging evolve quickly

 - Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills; comfortable working directly with usage and revenue data

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: (Senior) Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
At BioRender, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s ability to learn, discover, and communicate science – transforming how knowledge is shared and making science open, collaborative, and easily understandable by all.

 

We’re shaping the future of science communication and are looking for talented individuals to help bring this vision to life! 🚀

Strategic Finance advises executive leadership on BioRender’s growth strategy as we expand our product offerings, sales motions, and geographies. As a key member of a small team, you'll own the economics behind some of BioRender’s biggest decisions: where we invest, what we charge, and what we expect back. This is not a typical reporting-heavy finance role: we are looking for a builder who is curious about our customers and our product.

You’ll report to a leader on our Strategic Finance team and partner with colleagues across the business, including sales, marketing, product, engineering, design, people, and IT.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Here's the kind of work on our plate. In a given quarter you'd be deep in two or three:

 - Model our pricing and packaging changes end to end (willingness to pay, revenue impact, churn risk), then work with product and go-to-market to launch them

 - Build the go-to-market acquisition forecast models behind our ARR targets, partnering with revenue operations and setting the final number with leadership

 - Help run our annual planning process, from early scenarios to department budgets and securing founder approval

 - Own analyses of our unit economics, including CAC payback and LTV:CAC by segment and channel, and say where growth spend is paying off and where it isn't

 - Size our investment opportunities before we commit the next dollar or hire, then come back after and say whether it worked

 - Manage spend and headcount approvals with department leaders, and track actuals against plan

 - Partner with accounting, data science, AI engineering, and revenue operations to build the datasets, definitions, and dashboards that make our analysis automated and repeatable

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Relevant experience: investment banking, transaction advisory, equity research, consulting, finance or operations at a technology company, or an equivalent analytical role
 
 - We are looking for the right person and will level the role to fit your experience

 - Outstanding financial modeling: you can build a complex operating model with few errors, then boil it down to one executive summary tab

 - Operational aptitude: you see the business as a living organism of people and parts, not a clean P&L. You can sit with a sales leader or an engineer and learn the business in their language

 - Judgment in the weeds: you dig into imperfect data sources, reconcile where they conflict, decide what to trust, and know when the numbers are good enough to act on. Each pass leaves the data better than you found it

 - Simple and clear communication: you capture a messy analysis in three sentences and one chart, then defend the recommendation in the room

Why join us?

 - We are mission-driven: we work collaboratively towards our shared vision of improving scientific communication and accelerating scientific discovery. BioRender figures have appeared in more than 54,000 publications!

 - BioRender is loved by millions! We have a world-class NPS and a community of loyal fans and users in 200+ countries!

 - Our company is backed by top investors and accelerators like Y Combinator, and we are on a growth trajectory comparable to many top-performing SaaS companies

 - We’re remote-first with team members across Canada and the U.S., offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere.

 

BioRender is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. By submitting this application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BioRender in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Fincrime Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Read this first

This role is not for most compliance people. It is narrow, exacting and unforgiving of vague work. If the "you will not enjoy this" section describes you, don't apply. We'd rather you didn't.

The job

You find risk, measure it and call it. You do not fix it. Every finding you write answers three things: what is broken, how bad it is, and what evidence proves it. You don't soften the rating and you don't propose the remedy. The business owns the fix. You own the truth about the risk.

What you will do

- Test our BSA/AML, KYC, OFAC and transaction monitoring controls end to end, independently of the teams that run them

- Rate every finding (high / medium / low) with evidence that holds up in front of a regulator

- Pull and analyze data yourself; you don't wait for someone to send you a report

- Challenge thresholds, alert logic and sampling assumptions with numbers, not opinions

- Track open issues until owners close them, and escalate when they don't

- Prepare us for regulator exams and audits, and be the person in the room who already knows the weak spots

What you need (non-negotiable)

- 4+ years in BSA/AML, FinCrime, internal audit or regulatory compliance

- Experience at a top-tier audit/advisory firm, in-house compliance, or both. Both is ideal.

- You have written findings that a regulator, auditor or board actually read

- You can say "this is high risk" to a senior leader and point to the regulation which proves it.

- Deep working knowledge of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC and FinCEN expectations

Nice to have

- Law degree (JD) or bar admission

- Degree in engineering, mathematics, statistics or another STEM field

- SQL: you can query transaction data yourself

- Python or R for analysis, sampling or testing alert logic

- Statistics: sampling design, hypothesis testing, threshold and model validation

CAMS, CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA or CFE

- Exposure to AI or model risk (SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF)

You will not enjoy this role if

- You prefer building solutions to finding problems

- You need someone else to pull the data for you

- You round risk ratings down to keep people comfortable

- You are uncomfortable being the person no one wants in the meeting

- You uniform to the norm.

jobs.title: Founding Data Scientist, Capacity & Pricing Optimization
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE:

GPUs are the most expensive and supply-constrained input in AI. Our ability to effectively deploy them towards our customer demand is one of the critical inputs to our growth. We're hiring our first Data Scientist to build and own the quantitative models that drive pricing, packaging, and capacity allocation in order to optimize capacity and balance supply with demand.

The ideal candidate brings expertise at the intersection of operations research and economics with the ability to both model our market, build dynamic pricing models, and design experiments and causal studies. This is a hands-on role: you'll write production-quality code, ship models that drive real decisions, and bring an true ownership mentality to help set priorities in addition to executing on them.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON:

SUPPLY/DEMAND MODELING

 - Build fill-rate models for serverless inference, balancing utilization against performance and latency targets.

 - Model how traffic is shared and multiplexed across models and customers to set safe capacity buffers.

PRICING OPTIMIZATION

 - Design pricing for low-utilization capacity, including spot and preemptible offerings, off-peak and overnight windows, and sub-scale capacity pools.

 - Develop pricing policies to optimize our capacity utilization and price-yield.

 - Design execute experiments and causal studies to estimate elasticity across customer segments, models, and products.

GPU MIX OPTIMIZATION

 - Optimize the model-hardware matching across GPU generations, vendors, clouds, and regions, accounting for workload fit, substitution, and lead times.

 - Optimize our capacity across commitment types and terms, quantifying the tradeoff between cost, flexibility, and utilization risk to guide how we source capacity.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Master’s degree in Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with 7+ years of hands-on experience in pricing, revenue management, or optimization. PhD preferred.

 - Strong grounding in at least two of: stochastic optimization, revenue management and pricing, causal inference and experimental design, or combinatorial optimization.

 - A track record of delivering production quality models that drive direct business impact.

 - Strong coding skills and experience with optimization tooling & methodologies.

 - Ability to communicate tradeoffs and uncertainty clearly to engineers and executives.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience on capacity planning, forecasting, or pricing science teams at a cloud computing provider or marketplace business.

 - Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and LLM inference economics (throughput, batching, utilization, cost per token).

 - Experience as the first quantitative hire in a new function, building models and data pipelines from scratch.

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer | Power
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer, Power to lead customer deployments from kickoff through go-live. You will combine plant systems knowledge with hands-on software configuration, asset data validation, and customer coordination to ensure the platform accurately reflects each facility.

Our software gives industrial operators an accurate operating picture of their facility. You will help customers trust and use it by ensuring each site is set up correctly, explaining the engineering reasoning behind configuration decisions, and training users.

This role is based in our New York City or Pittsburgh office, with 25% to 50% travel to customer sites.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Serve as the technical point of contact across a portfolio of customer sites, leading configuration, deployment, and user training.

 - Ensure every deployment meets customer expectations and agreed product requirements. Define and track success metrics and support adoption.

 - Resolve configuration and deployment issues, keeping customers informed and involving Engineering or the commercial team when appropriate.

 - Deliver product demonstrations, user training, and structured feedback sessions.

 - Launch new customer sites from kickoff through go-live, coordinating requirements, timelines, and risks while improving deployment playbooks.

 - Configure the software and build and validate each site’s asset data against plant engineering documentation so the platform accurately reflects the facility.

 - Apply and refine tagging conventions, naming standards, and asset data taxonomy, resolving inconsistencies so every site is built consistently.

 - Test configurations and workflows across development and production environments, report software issues with clear reproduction steps, and verify deployment quality before customer milestones.

 - Use plant systems knowledge to validate software outputs, investigate incorrect or misleading results, and explain the reasoning behind configuration choices.

 - Turn field learnings into clear, prioritized feedback and serve as a resource on plant systems and operations for the software engineering team.

ABOUT YOU / REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 5+ years in industrial operations, maintenance, or plant systems work, including experience where data accuracy was non-negotiable.

 - Fluency in reading engineering drawings and explaining system function, design intent, and operating considerations to guide accurate software configuration.

 - Experience building or maintaining accuracy-critical plant data: CMMS or EAM master data (SAP PM, Maximo, JDE, or similar), DCS-to-historian tag mapping, loop-check or instrument index verification.

 - Experience integrating large-scale industrial software: SCADA/HMI platforms, data historians, or plant information systems.

 - Strong attention to detail when checking equipment tags, asset relationships, and software configurations against plant documentation.

 - A thorough approach to investigating discrepancies, understanding their causes, and correcting them or involving the right team.

 - Strong organization across multiple customer deployments, including tracking requirements, milestones, follow-ups, and risks through completion.

 - Sound judgment when working with incomplete information, asking focused questions, and explaining the reasoning behind configuration decisions.

 - Clear communication with plant operators, engineers, and corporate leaders, including knowing when to involve Engineering or the commercial team.

 - Willingness to use AI tools to support daily work and verify their outputs for accuracy.

 - Ability to travel 25% to 50% of the time to customer sites.

PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Background working directly with industrial customers through deployment, field service, applications engineering, account management, or technical training.

 - Hands-on field experience in equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, or system walkdowns using P&IDs and electrical one-lines.

 - Ability to write code or control logic and explain how components interact within complex systems and where problems can arise.

WHO WE ARE

At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. 

Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve - and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact.

Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender

jobs.title: Strategic Buyer
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We're looking for a highly organized operator to build the procurement and operations backbone behind our hardware programs. You'll work with engineering, ops, finance, facilities, and outside suppliers to source critical goods and services, run purchasing workflows, and improve the systems that keep us moving fast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes owning messy, high-urgency problems and becoming the person all teams trust to get things done — across lab equipment, facilities, engineering services, production support, and business-critical vendors.

Key responsibilities

 - Own day-to-day purchasing across indirect and NPI spend, converting internal requests into RFQs, quotes, requisitions, and complete, accurate POs (vendor, location, quantity, price, item description, delivery address, and requester context).

 - Track open orders through delivery and communicate PO status clearly to requesters, Supply Chain, Logistics, AP, and Engineering.

 - Review quotes for price, lead time, MOQ, payment and shipping terms, and commercial accuracy; negotiate pricing, expedite fees, and shipping costs.

 - Manage supplier relationships, setting clear expectations on documentation, PO requirements, shipment timing, and payment terms.

 - Partner with AP and Finance on vendor setup, invoice submission, payment requirements, and PO/invoice discrepancies.

 - Improve procurement workflows, trackers, templates, and handoffs as Etched scales.

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

 - 3–5 years in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, NPI operations, manufacturing operations, or hardware startup operations.

 - Hands-on experience issuing and tracking POs, managing RFQs, negotiating with suppliers, and coordinating deliveries across indirect and technical/NPI categories.

 - Experience with ERP/procurement tools such as NetSuite, Mesh, SAP, or Ramp.

 - Familiarity with vendor onboarding, NDAs, W-9s, banking forms, and invoice/payment workflows.

 - Strong written communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

 - Commercial instincts — able to challenge pricing, compare against prior buys, and flag quotes that don’t add up.

 - Strong follow-through: tracks many small open loops and closes them without reminders.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly without perfect inputs.

 - High ownership, low ego, and a bias toward action.

Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - Experience in hardware, semiconductors, electronics, manufacturing, data center infrastructure, or contract manufacturing.

Benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

As a Research Engineer on the Robotics team, you will deploy and refine state-of-the-art AI models for mobile manipulation on real robots.  - Deploy state-of-the-art AI models for mobile manipulation on real robots in production environments.

 - Architect and optimize data pipelines to support the training of advanced robotics models on large-scale datasets.

What We're Looking For

 - Hands-on experience developing software for real-world robotics applications.

 - Mastery of Python and a strong background as a software developer.

 - High engineering competence, with the ability to design complex systems and deploy them in production.

 - A self-starter mindset, with the autonomy to drive projects forward and the adaptability to collaborate effectively.

WHAT WE OFFER

jobs.title: Office Manager, Associate Manager of Operations
jobs.description:
Do you want to help run a Y-Combinator-backed AI startup from the inside, reporting to the COO and working directly with the entire leadership team? Do you thrive on creating order, and do you love a role where every day looks different? If you want autonomy, room to run, and a clear path to a Chief of Staff role, all at the cutting edge of AI technology in financial services, then read on!

WHO ARE WE?

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

WHAT WILL THE OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE DO?

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

WHO WILL LOVE THIS JOB?

 - You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.

 - You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.

 - You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.

 - You are an execution expert: you keep dozens of open items on track with trackers and checklists, and you finish each one on your own, so the COO only has to ask once.

 - You feel at home working with people inside and outside the company: you coordinate schedules across the leadership team, candidates, and interviewers, and you follow up with vendors and procurement teams until you have what you need. You take pride in how you show up, knowing that you are a beacon of Veritus’ values and culture!

 - You communicate with precision: your updates, follow-ups, and SOPs are concise, accurate, and polished, so leaders can act on them right away.

 - You take pride in building repeatable processes: you like turning a manual workflow into a documented, AI-assisted process that someone else could run.

 - You are a scrappy, relentless problem-solver who figures things out and writes the playbook as you go, and who measures success by outcomes: action items closed, materials ready on deadline, and an office that runs smoothly because you run it.

 - You want your work to matter and you want to work with folks who both laugh and get things done. You bring rigor as well as a sense of humor!
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership Operations

 - Run the leadership team's operating cadence: schedule leadership meetings and offsites, track OKRs, and follow up on action items until they close.

 - Prepare recurring company materials, including weekly All Hands slides and KPI reporting, ready by the deadline every week.

 - Take special projects off the COO's plate and run them end to end.

Office Management and Events Planning

 - Run the San Francisco office: snacks and supplies, packages and shipping, vendors, mail, guests, facilities, and the office budget.

 - Schedule and support company offsites, internal team events, and business events, on budget and on time.

 - Coordinate business travel for the team.

Hiring and Onboarding

 - Schedule all candidate interviews promptly as candidates advance.

 - Get every new hire's desk, office access, welcome basket, and first-week schedule ready for day one, using a checklist you build and maintain.

Finance and Processes

 - Assist with invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, budgets, and expense tracking.

 - Turn repetitive workflows into documented, AI-assisted processes that someone else could run.

 - Jump on new and unexpected tasks as they come up.
 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Our ideal candidate...

 - …has experience in an operations, office management, project coordination, or similar organizational role.

 - …is smart and quick to learn, with a strong work ethic and a deep sense of ownership.

 - …is eloquent in writing and in person: concise, accurate, and polished.

 - …is incredibly organized, with meticulous attention to detail.

 - …is humble, eager to learn, and ready to grow with the company.

 - …takes on every task, from leadership meeting prep to restocking the snacks, with the same care.

 - …is positive, has a sense of humor, and has a vision for a company culture they feel passionate about fostering.

 - …uses AI tools every day, and using AI is as second nature as using Google Workspace and Slack.

 - …has experience in any of the following: an early-stage startup, in vendor or facilities management, AI agents or no-code automations, or in fintech or another regulated industry.

Don’t meet all the above qualifications? Apply anyway and tell us in your application why you'd be a great fit!

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 - Base salary: $75K -

jobs.title: GTM Lead US
jobs.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

THE ROLE

As GTM Lead US, you will help take Parallel from zero to its first paying hospitals in the US. You will work side by side with Paul, our CEO and co-founder, who leads the US launch on the ground. You are our first US hire: you will build the pipeline, run discovery and the first pilots, and turn what works into a playbook the next hires can follow.

Parallel uses AI to reduce administrative workload in hospitals, starting with medical coding. Our product is live in around 100 French hospitals and clinics, and the US is one of our first two international markets, with Germany.

 - Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder.

 - Location: New York, in person with Paul. Regular travel to hospitals and conferences across the US. 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris at the start.

 - Team: you will help hire the next 3 to 5 people in 2027 and shape the team for 2027.

Your mission for 2027: with Paul, sign the first US pilots, convert them into paying contracts and build a repeatable playbook.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 1. Build and run the pipeline
 
 - Build the list of target hospitals and health systems, and keep it up to date in our CRM.
 
 - Prospect yourself: cold outreach, LinkedIn, events, intros from our investors and advisors. Your calendar starts empty.
 
 - Run discovery calls with VPs of Revenue Cycle, HIM and CDI directors and CFOs, and bring back what you learn.

 2. Sign and run the first pilots
 
 - Prepare and follow up every meeting with Paul, and own the next steps.
 
 - Run pilots end to end: security review, BAA, data access, kick-off, results.

 3. Build the US playbook
 
 - Write down the ideal customer profile, the pitch, the objections and how we answer them.
 
 - Test our success-based pricing with US buyers.
 
 - Run the feedback loop between hospitals and our product and tech team in Paris.

 4. Make Parallel visible in the US
 
 - Organise our presence at conferences (HFMA, ACDIS, AHIMA) and regional events.
 
 - Turn our first customers into references.

 5. Help build the team
 
 - Help hire the next people: account executives, a medical coding lead, deployment strategists.
 
 - Set up the basics of the US office and tools.
 
 

WHO YOU ARE

Experience

 - Based in the US, with US work authorization.

 - 3 to 6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a customer-facing role with US hospitals or health systems: health-tech sales or business development, revenue cycle, or consulting for providers.

 - At least one early-stage or scale-up experience: you joined a startup of fewer than 50 people, launched a new product or market, or founded something.

 - You have prospected and booked your own meetings.

Mindset

 - Hands-on: you do the work yourself, from cold emails to conference logistics.

 - Persuasive: you can hold a conversation with a CFO or a VP of Revenue Cycle and earn a second meeting.

 - Organised: you run several pilots and follow-ups at once without dropping anything.

 - Builder: you like an empty playbook and turning what works into a process.

 - Clear writer: you write short notes that others can act on.

 - Ambitious: you want to grow with the US business.

Our values

 1. Play to Win

We are not here just to participate, ship something “good enough”, or enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring deeply about outcomes, moving fast and being willing to put in the intensity required when it matters.

 2. High Trust, High Standards

Trust is our default. If you joined us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with responsibility. The more freedom we give, the higher the standard we expect.

 3. Low Ego, Hands-On

No one at Parallel is above doing the work. Titles, seniority and past achievements don't exempt anyone from getting their hands dirty. Everyone should be willing to step into the arena when needed. Leadership means taking responsibility, not creating distance from execution.

 4. Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously

We are extremely serious about our mission. We don't need to be extremely serious about ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laugh, celebrate and bring energy to the people around them. High standards and good vibes are not opposites. We want both.

NICE TO HAVE

 - You know the US hospital revenue cycle: DRGs, CDI, coding, denials.

 - You have worked at a revenue cycle or CDI vendor, or in a health system's revenue cycle team.

 - You speak French.

 - You have been part of a company's launch in a new market.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

We’re hiring a VP of Operations to build and lead the factory operations behind Nox Metals’ growth. You will set up new factories, hire the teams they need, train people to do the work well, and build the leadership structure that keeps every facility running at a high standard.

This is one of our most significant leadership roles. You will own factory launches and operational execution across our facilities, from getting a new site ready to produce to developing the managers and teams who run it every day. We need someone who has built factories before, or who has hired at significant scale and led large operational teams through rapid growth.

You will spend real time on the factory floor. You will make decisions, remove bottlenecks, develop leaders, and stay close to the work as the organization grows.

You will:

 - Own new factory setup and launch, including site readiness, layout, equipment installation, staffing, training, and production ramp

 - Build the organization each facility needs, hiring plant leaders, supervisors, operators, and the support teams required to execute

 - Lead hiring at scale, with clear staffing plans and a high bar for the people who join the team

 - Establish hands-on onboarding, training, and qualification programs so new hires can work safely and perform reliably

 - Hire, coach, and manage leaders who can run large teams, develop their people, and take ownership of results

 - Own day-to-day factory performance across sites, with clear accountability for safety, quality, throughput, productivity, and on-time delivery

 - Build staffing models, shift structures, and management routines that support growth and reliable execution

 - Set practical operating standards, work instructions, shift handoffs, and daily and weekly reviews that teams actually use

 - Work directly with teams on the floor to resolve bottlenecks, address performance issues, and improve how the operation runs

 - Partner with engineering and software teams to put better tools and automation into the hands of factory teams

 - Turn successful factory launches, hiring methods, and training systems into a repeatable playbook for future facilities

You are:

 - An operator with a proven record of opening and ramping factories, or hiring at significant scale and leading large operational teams

 - Experienced building teams and management structures through rapid growth, with concrete results to show for it

 - Strong at identifying talent, making hiring decisions, training people, and developing effective managers

 - Comfortable owning operations across multiple facilities while staying close to the details on the floor

 - Uncompromising about safety, quality, and accountability

 - Direct, decisive, and calm under pressure; you make the call and follow through

This role is full time and in person at our Los Angeles or Detroit facility, with travel between sites as needed.

 - You are credible with hospital leadership (CEO, CFO, chief medical officer) as well as with physicians.

 - You can convince first hires to join a company that nobody in Germany knows yet.

 - You are open to about 3 months of regular trips to Paris, with a long-term base in Germany.

 - Bonus: you know the German healthcare system, or you have already launched a business.

 - Bonus: you have hired and managed a team, or worked on M&A or the integration of an acquired team.

The role
This is a high-ownership, high-learning role at the center of how Kombo grows. You'll generate demand from a curated list of accounts we know we can serve well. ARR is our top metric company-wide, and a strong person in this role can be directly responsible for up to 20% of new revenue in a given quarter.

 3. 1.5-hour case study

 4. Lunch with the team you'd be working with

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

CONTEXT

Parallel closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures, is deployed in 40+ hospitals, and is scaling fast. Founders Paul Lafforgue (Polytechnique, ex-Meta, ex-McKinsey) and Chris Rydahl (who previously built Hublo, Europe's largest healthcare staffing platform) are based in Paris with the team.

Our tech team is 10 people today, all reporting directly to the CTO — and it will double by 2027. A flat structure got us here, now we need managers who stay close to the code to get us there.

The team is organized in streams, each run by a PM and a Stream Owner: Coding, Extraction, and Activity (activity steering, dashboarding, and our assistant products). 

YOUR MISSION

 - Directly manage the engineers of your stream (AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers): 1:1s, feedback, growth, performance.

 - Own a stream end to end as its Stream Owner: drive its technical direction and delivery with your PM.

 - Be a hands-on leader. Expect roughly 50% hands-on / 50% management — a bit more hands-on in your first months.

 - Be responsible for your squad's tech culture: code quality, rituals, standards, knowledge sharing.

 - Onboard new engineers and be the relay when the team changes hands.

 - Work daily with PMs, Ops and the other Stream Owners to keep priorities aligned.

OUTCOMES

 - In your first months, you are a trusted Stream Owner: you know your stream's code, clients and roadmap inside out.

 - Your team ships reliably and at pace, and every engineer knows what's expected of them and how they're growing.

 - New hires are productive fast, thanks to the onboarding and culture you put in place.

 - Over time, your role grows beyond one stream: you help shape how the whole tech org scales.

THIS JOB IS FOR YOU IF

 - You have 5+ years of experience, including at least 2 years managing an engineering team.

 - You've managed 4–5+ people and owned both their performance and the people side (feedback, growth, tough conversations).

 - Your background is strong full-stack software engineering or data — and you still love building.

 - You've worked in startups or scale-ups and thrive in a fast, high-ownership environment.

 - You see management as a way to have more impact, not as a title: you're happy to own a stream and write code.

 - You are autonomous and pragmatic: done beats perfect at this stage.

 - You are French-speaking.

HIRING PROCESS

 1. A quick call with our recruiter (30 min)

 2. A conversation with Chris, our CTO (30 min)

 3. A case study at our Paris office, covering both management and technical judgment. combined with a meeting with Paul, our CEO. (2h in total + preperation)

 4. Reference checks

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?

 - Real traction: Seed and Series A closed in under a year, with Index Ventures on the cap table.

 - A problem worth solving: cutting hospital admin gives time back to care teams.

 - A different technical approach: agents that work on existing systems without heavy integration.

 - A team that has done it before: the founders built and scaled Hublo, and worked at Meta and McKinsey. High standards, low ego.

 - Real ownership: you'll be our first Engineering Manager and shape how the tech team scales from 10 to 20+.

 - Competitive salary and equity, premium health insurance (Alan), Swile meal vouchers, latest Apple equipment, and an office in Paris (Strasbourg Saint-Denis).

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.
