 - A team of 17 and growing.

 - Based in San Francisco at 650 5th Street.

 

BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k).

 - Unlimited PTO and sick days, plus company-observed US holidays.

 - Daily lunch and a fully stocked kitchen.

 - Commuter benefits.

 - Team offsites and events.

jobs.title: Field CTO, US
jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

 - A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

 - You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

 - You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

 - Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

 - 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

 - Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

 - Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

 - Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Senior Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Applied Intuition is seeking a Senior Accounts Payable Manager to own and scale our global accounts payable function as we continue to grow. Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will oversee end-to-end procure-to-pay operations, employee expense and corporate card programs, and the systems and controls that support them. You'll lead and develop the AP team, partner cross-functionally with key stakeholders, and drive automation and process improvements to build scalable, efficient operations. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to shape and optimize a critical finance function in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

 - Own and scale the end-to-end accounts payable (AP) and procure-to-pay process across global entities, from vendor onboarding and invoice processing through payment execution. Partner with Procurement, Legal, IT, FP&A, and business stakeholders to streamline workflows and support new entities, acquisitions, and integrations.

 - Oversee corporate credit card and expense reimbursement programs, ensuring effective spend controls, policy compliance, accurate reconciliation, and timely reimbursements across entities and currencies.

 - Lead, coach, and develop the AP team, establishing priorities, performance goals, and scalable processes to support continued business growth.

 - Develop and maintain global AP policies, procedures, and internal controls, ensuring consistent practices, audit readiness, and compliance with tax and regulatory requirements in partnership with Tax and internal stakeholders.

 - Own month-, quarter-, and year-end AP close activities, including accruals, reconciliations, aging reviews, and variance analysis, ensuring accuracy and timely reporting.

 - Oversee vendor master data, payment operations, and vendor-related inquiries and escalations. Partner with Procurement and business owners to execute negotiated payment terms, identify early-payment discounts, and optimize working capital.

 - Drive AP systems strategy, automation, and continuous process improvement across NetSuite, Zip, and expense management platforms. Establish KPIs to measure operational performance and lead system implementations, integrations, and enhancements from planning through adoption.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

 - 10+ years of progressive experience in accounts payable, procure-to-pay, and employee expense management, including 3+ years of team leadership, ideally within a high-growth hardware or technology company.

 - Proven experience scaling AP operations and leading end-to-end process improvements and system implementations, from requirements gathering and vendor selection through deployment and adoption.

 - Deep, hands-on expertise with NetSuite, AP automation platforms, and corporate card and expense management systems, including spend controls, policy development, and compliance.

 - Experience managing multi-entity, multi-currency AP operations, with a strong understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, international payments, and applicable tax regulations.

 - Strong analytical and technical skills, including advanced Excel proficiency, reporting tools, and experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, LLMs, Cursor) to automate workflows and improve efficiency while maintaining financial accuracy.

 - Experience operating in or preparing for a SOX-compliant, public-company control environment.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with Brex, FloQast, Workday, or Ramp.

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

 - Define the TPM function at Sierra as we scale & establish the playbooks, operating rhythms, and standards that future TPMs and customer teams will build on.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product
jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist who is deeply product-minded and highly proactive.

This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly defined questions or works in isolation. We are looking for someone who actively looks at our data, understands our customers’ pain points, identifies opportunities, and pushes ideas forward.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

Summary of role:

All of Mercor’s AI work, from training and serving models to building agents, runs on GPUs. Your job is to make that compute fast, fault-tolerant and fully utilized.

You’ll own the accelerator platform end to end. That means the clusters and schedulers across AWS, GCP, neoclouds and on-prem, the training and LLM serving on top, and the observability and cost data that show where every GPU-hour goes.

This is a software engineering role, not an ops role. You’ll write production code every day, own systems from design through on-call, and build the platform that sets how fast Mercor can move.

Representative projects

 - Stand up a multi-cloud GPU fleet spanning hyperscalers, neoclouds and on-prem, orchestrated through custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators so researchers never have to think about where their job lands.

 - Build a scheduling layer with gang scheduling, bin-packing and fair-share quotas that measurably raises accelerator utilization across teams.

 - Ship a high-throughput vLLM serving stack with prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload and FP8/FP4 quantization. Back it with a benchmarking and traffic-replay harness that tracks TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles against per-config baselines.

 - Build a self-healing health-check and remediation system that rides out fault storms across hardware, network and software without paging a human.

 - Build an end-to-end cost-attribution pipeline. It ingests utilization, occupancy and billing data into the warehouse, attributes every GPU-hour to a team and workload, and drives capacity planning.

 - Build internal tools and dashboards that researchers and non-engineers use every day.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Design, deploy and operate GPU clusters across AWS, GCP, and other hyperscalers/neoclouds/on-premise data centers, including custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators and the metadata services behind them.

 - Build scheduling that keeps accelerators busy: gang scheduling for distributed jobs, bin-packing to reduce fragmentation, and quotas and fair share for multi-tenant teams.

 - Run distributed training infrastructure on PyTorch Distributed, Ray, or Megatron, with fast checkpointing and model loading.

 - Deploy and tune high-throughput LLM serving with vLLM or similar: tensor and model/expert parallelism, prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload, FP8/FP4 quantization.

 - Build benchmarking and traffic-replay tools that measure TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles, and set per-config performance baselines.

 - Build health checks across hardware, network and software layers, and automated remediation that handles fault storms without human intervention.

 - Instrument fleet utilization with DCGM, Prometheus and Grafana. Write recording rules and alerts that teams rely on.

 - Ingest utilization, occupancy and billing data into a warehouse, attribute spend to teams and workloads, and support capacity planning.

 - Drive autoscaling, rightsizing and idle-capacity recovery programs with measurable cost results.

 - Write clear runbooks and documentation, and explain infrastructure tradeoffs to researchers, finance and leadership.

 - Build internal tools or dashboards that researchers and non-engineers use daily.

You may be a good fit if you

 - Have 5+ years building and operating production distributed systems or ML infrastructure 

 - Write production-quality Python plus Go or C++, and are fluent in shell scripting for system administration.

 - Have deep hands-on Kubernetes and container experience, plus working knowledge of Slurm or another HPC resource manager.

 - Have run GPU workloads at scale, including scheduling, orchestration and troubleshooting.

 - Have hands-on experience with at least one distributed training or serving stack: PyTorch Distributed, Ray, vLLM or Megatron-LM.

 - Have deep experience with at least one major cloud provider.

 - Know observability tools like DataDog, Prometheus, PromQL and Grafana, and are comfortable on-call for critical systems.

 - Own projects end to end and gather your own requirements with little direction.

Strong candidates may also have experience with (or a strong desire to learn deeply)

 - LLM inference optimization: KV cache systems, disaggregated serving, quantization, speculative decoding

 - High-performance networking: RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, NVLink

 - GPU profiling with Nsight or similar, and CUDA or Triton kernel work

 - Accelerators beyond NVIDIA: AMD MI-series, TPU, Trainium

 - Capacity planning, billing normalization or cost attribution across providers

 - Automated fault diagnosis, log mining or AIOps at fleet scale

 - Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and secure or air-gapped deployments

Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free

jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor is defining the future of work. We partner with leading AI labs and enterprises to provide the human intelligence essential to AI development.

Our vast talent network trains frontier AI models in the same way teachers teach students: by sharing knowledge, experience, and context that can't be captured in code alone. Today, more than 30,000 experts in our network collectively earn over $2 million a day.

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society.

Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our new San Francisco headquarters.

About the Role
Frontier AI companies are increasingly bottlenecked on expert judgment and high-quality data workflows. This team builds the production systems that capture, coordinate, and validate that work at scale — directly between a customer request and the output that ships.
These are long-running, stateful systems. A single job can stay live for days, interleaving automated steps, model inference, and expert review. A step marked "done" can be reopened, re-reviewed, and redone — so "completed" is not always final, state has to tolerate late mutation, and correctness has to survive humans and models disagreeing with each other.
This is a backend systems and orchestration problem: distributed state machines, not pipelines. The architecture is not set. Early engineers will decide what it becomes, and the loop between "I shipped this" and "this mattered" is short.
What You'll Do

 - Design services and state models for multi-stage workflows that fan out across automated processing and expert reviewers, then reconcile results into a coherent whole

 - Build orchestration primitives — retries, failure recovery, idempotency, auditable state transitions — for jobs that run far longer than a request and can be partially redone after the fact

 - Integrate model inference into production workflows without sacrificing debuggability or human oversight

 - Build the APIs and tooling that let product, operations, and ML teams operate, debug, and trust these systems at scale

 - Own reliability and observability for workflows where a silent failure means a corrupted result, not just a 500
 What Makes This Role Different

 - You are building the core infrastructure that sits directly between customer requests and the outputs that ship — not internal tooling, not a support system

 - This product area is young and strategically central; early engineers are deciding the architecture, not inheriting it

 - The inputs are non-deterministic by nature — you are building durable orchestration over humans and models that can disagree with each other on hour 40 of a multi-stage job
 Day-to-Day

 - Moving fast on genuinely hard systems problems — ambiguity is the default, not the exception

 - Working closely with product, operations, and ML teams to translate a tangle of constraints into clean system design

 - Debugging complex stateful workflows where the failure surface spans automated steps, model calls, and human reviewers

 - Owning your systems end-to-end: design, ship, operate, improve
 What We're Looking For

 - Production backend experience with strong opinions about what ages well and why

 - Sharp instincts for system design, service boundaries, and where to put complexity — and where to refuse it

 - Fluency with the distributed systems toolkit: async workflows, queues, idempotency, retries, and long-running jobs as practice, not resume line items

 - Ability to take ambiguous product, operational, and ML constraints and turn them into a system that is clean and debuggable

 - Comfort working in Python on AWS with Postgres; experience with Temporal or similar workflow engines is a plus
 You're likely someone who:

 - Gets frustrated by systems that are hard to debug and takes that personally enough to fix it

 - Has strong opinions about where state should live and can defend them in a design review

 - Moves fast but doesn't treat reliability as someone else's problem

 - Wants your work to have a short, visible line to outcomes that actually matter to customers
 Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.title: Corporate Paralegal
jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

 - Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

 - Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

 - Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

 - Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

 - Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

 - Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

 - Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

 - Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We’re looking for a Systems Engineer with strong robotics and software skills to join the team building Applied Intuition’s autonomous trucking system. You’ll own requirements, architecture and verification for parts of the system, from what the customer needs down to the pass/fail checks that run in simulation and on the vehicle. You’ll work closely with software, hardware, safety and test engineers, and with OEM partners, to take an L4 product into production.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

 - Turn customer, operational and regulatory needs into system, subsystem and component requirements, and keep them in Polarion as the single source of truth

 - Define subsystems: their functions, inputs and outputs, interfaces and P-diagrams. Get them reviewed and approved by software and hardware leads

 - Help write the system architecture as code (SysML v2) through a PR-based workflow, with clear owners for each component. Keep Cameo models in sync where certification and customer deliverables require them

 - Write diagnostic and fault-management requirements, covering fault detection thresholds, fault-tolerant time intervals (FTTI), degradation strategy and minimal-risk maneuvers

 - Run safety analyses such as STPA. Turn unsafe control actions into requirements, test cases and safety performance indicators

 - Own the pass/fail criteria (observers and metrics) that turn requirements into machine-readable checks for simulation and in-vehicle testing. Make sure they are precise enough to trust

 - Keep traceability end to end, from capability to requirement, test case, scenario, observer and result. When something escapes testing, find which layer missed it and close the gap

 - Produce ASPICE work products and evidence (SYS.1–SYS.5, plus support for SWE.1/5/6) and get the team ready for assessments

 - Represent systems engineering to OEM partners and regulators, including requirement reviews, validation plans and homologation deliverables

 - Use and build AI-assisted tools (LLM agents, MCP integrations, scripts) to automate traceability, triage and requirement authoring

We’re looking for someone who has:

 - 2+ years of systems engineering experience covering requirements, functional decomposition and allocation, interface definition, and verification and validation

 - Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles or ADAS software systems

 - Hands-on experience with a requirements tool (Polarion, DOORS, Jama) and with MBSE / SysML (Cameo or SysML v2)

 - Comfort working in a codebase: Git, pull requests, Python, YAML

 - Experience with at least one safety analysis method (STPA, FMEA, FTA, HARA)

 - Clear written communication, and the ability to drive alignment across engineering teams and with external customers

Nice to have:

 - Experience with ASPICE, ISO 26262 or ISO 21448 (SOTIF)

 - Experience defining metrics or pass/fail criteria for simulation-based verification

 - Experience with commercial vehicles or trucking

 - Experience building LLM-based tools or agents for engineering workflows

 - Japanese language skills

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
👋 HEY! WE'RE CONVEO.AI http://Conveo.ai

Conveo helps the world's biggest brands understand the people who buy from them. Our AI interviewer holds real video conversations with consumers, hundreds at a time, in any language, and turns what people say, show, and feel into insight that teams act on. Research that used to be possible only in small, occasional doses is now something brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange run continuously, at a depth and scale that was out of reach before. We are YC-backed, closed a $50M Series A, and growing fast.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Before anyone reads a word we write, they have already formed an opinion of us from how we look.

Every month, Conveo ships hundreds of pieces of visual work: the website, landing pages, sales decks, films, social posts, event booths, reports that land on the desks of executives at Unilever, Google, and Orange. That work is made by many hands, internal people, external partners, freelancers, and increasingly AI agents. What is missing is the one person who owns what it all adds up to.

That is this role. You hold the visual language of the entire company: what Conveo looks like, why it looks that way, and how every team, from marketing to sales to events to the founders themselves, produces work that looks like it came from the same brain. When a buyer decides in three seconds whether we look like a company they can trust with their biggest questions, they are judging your work.

The timing is the once-in-a-career part. We are rebuilding the entire brand this year, with a funded rebrand agency, a funded freelance bench, and a green field behind them. Most Head of Brand inherit an identity and spend years defending it. You arrive at the moment ours gets created, and you decide what it becomes.

There is one more thing that makes this seat unusual. Conveo runs on AI agents: they draft, produce, and publish across marketing and sales every day. Your design system will be executed by people and by machines. When you encode a rule well, our agents apply it on every asset, at any hour, at a volume no design team could match. You may be the first Head of Brand anywhere whose taste ships through an agent workforce. If teaching machines your eye excites you rather than threatens you, keep reading.

THE CONTEXT

Marketing here runs as a film-studio. A small senior core holds taste, project teams are cast from a funded freelance network, and AI agents carry production volume. Design work also flows through external partners: one for content visuals, one for the product design system, and the incoming rebrand agency. The seam between all of them needs a single owner. You are that owner, and you own it the way the best do: from the work.

You report to the CMO, who is the single approver for marketing, so decisions happen in one conversation. You partner daily with the Head of Video Content, the Product Marketing Manager, our events lead, sales, and the external design partners.

YOUR MISSION

1. BE THE VISUAL BRAIN OF THE COMPANY

One cohesive, distinctive vision, originating from the brand system, applied everywhere by everyone.

 - Shape the visual vision for Conveo and hold it across web, landing pages, decks, social, events, video, sales collateral, and product marketing

 - Make the vision legible: anyone in the company should be able to say what Conveo looks like and why

 - Govern the seam between our content partner, the product design system partner, and the rebrand agency so one language survives across product and brand

 - Review inbound work against the system and send back what misses, with reasons

 - Keep the character intact as volume grows: warm stone ground, single accent, serif headlines, real photography, generous whitespace

2. STEWARD THE VISUAL IDENTITY, HANDS ON

An identity is only as strong as the weakest asset that ships under it, so the steward works from inside the work: tightening the hierarchy of a deck an hour before it lands in a Fortune 500 room, rebuilding a landing page hero, redrawing a diagram until it explains itself, fixing the template so the mistake never happens again. You will do this daily, across every surface, and it is where your taste becomes the company's taste.

 - Own the bar on everything that ships. In practice that means daily hands-on work: an asset lifted from fine to excellent, a deck rebuilt, a crop fixed, a page tightened

 - Fix things at the source. When you correct something twice, the third fix goes into the template, the component, or the rule, so the whole system inherits it

 - Take the ad hoc work that keeps a fast company moving. When sales needs something tonight and the bench is busy, you build it, fast and at full quality, and enjoy that this is part of the job rather than an interruption to it

 - Make the references. The fastest way to communicate taste to a freelancer or an agent is an example you made yourself

 - Stay in the tools weekly. Figma, Framer, decks, motion direction, claude code, whatever the surface demands

3. TURN YOUR TASTE INTO A SYSTEM THAT SCALES THROUGH PEOPLE AND AI AGENTS

This is the multiplier, and the part of the role that makes it new. Your eye, encoded, executed by humans and machines.

 - Build and maintain the marketing design system: tokens, components, templates, asset library, usage rules

 - Encode the rules so agents can execute them: prompts, skills, and machine-readable guidelines for Claude and Claude Code, so on-brand assets get produced without your hands on the file

 - Treat the system as a product with users: marketing, sales, agents, freelancers. Ship it, version it, improve it from how it gets used

 - Write briefs and rules precise enough that a freelancer you have never met, or an agent, returns something usable on the first pass

 - Measure yourself on leverage: how much on-bran

jobs.title: AI Automation Intern (Sustainability)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Join our global sustainability reporting team and help reinvent how we use technology and AI to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and accountability to ESG reporting. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence.

We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting.

Who You Are

You’re passionate about sustainability and innovation, always exploring how emerging tech—like AI—can drive real-world ESG impact. You enjoy coding, structuring data, and building automated solutions that solve complex problems.

You thrive in global, cross-functional teams, communicate inclusively, and navigate diverse work cultures with ease. Analytical and solution-oriented, you turn regulatory complexity into clear, tech-driven actions.

An entrepreneurial self-starter, you’re adaptable, results-focused, and eager to work on cutting-edge sustainability projects.

You’re a recent graduate with a background in tech, strategy, data, economics or sustainability, based in the Netherlands (with the right to work here), passionate about using technology to solve sustainability challenges—and ready to grow in an international, dynamic setting.

What you bring

 - Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus.

 - Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems.

 - Experience with data analysis, coding, building AI bots, or automating systems is a plus.

 - Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

 - Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus.

 - Bachelor’s degree or higher.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page https://prosusbenefits.com/.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

 Lead complex, cross-functional technical initiatives from conception to deployment. 
 Work closely with product managers, designers, customers, and other engineers to ensure we deliver a high-quality experience. 
 Drive the team's engineering standards, championing best practices in system design, code quality, testing, observability, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure we scale reliably. 
 Solve complex, mission-critical system problems with solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and resilient. 
 Mentor and guide more junior team members, coordinate with other stakeholders and contribute to process improvements, raising the technical bar across the team. 
 Communicate complex technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, including their impact on system performance, reliability, and business outcomes. 
 Partner cross-functionally with teams including Sales, Marketing, and G&A to support product delivery and customer success. 
 
 Your experience: 
 
 Strong understanding of and hands-on experience with distributed systems and cloud services. 
 5+ years of experience developing and debugging system-level software in languages similar to Golang or TypeScript. 
 Track record of leading non-trivial projects from design through production rollout, navigating ambiguity along the way. 
 Strong communication skills with a passion for mentoring peers, fostering a collaborative team culture, and executing efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 
 Passion for building high-quality products that are robust and easy to maintain in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience building cloud-native SaaS platforms. 
 Experience working with frontend web frameworks like React. 
 Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading technical projects.

They should be comfortable operating across organizational boundaries, driving technical decisions, improving reliability, and identifying adjacent problems that need ownership rather than limiting themselves strictly to a predefined scope.

jobs.title: Events and Experiences Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. Our AI agents help financial institutions originate loans, process payments, and support customers through some of their most important financial decisions. We’ve processed more than $2 billion in transactions and raised a $24M Series A, with backing from Insight Partners and Y Combinator.

We’re building a global company, and bringing our customers and future customers together will be a major part of how we grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Kastle will run 50+ events across North America in 2027. We’re looking for an Events & Experiences Lead to own the program and make every event exceptional.

You’ll build experiences that senior banking and lending executives make time for, remember, and tell their peers about. From a private dinner for twelve to a major industry conference, you’ll own the idea, the audience, the execution, and the results.

You’ll work directly with our founders, sales team, and customers. This is a hands-on role for someone with excellent taste, operational discipline, and the energy to run an ambitious international calendar.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the global events calendar. Decide where we show up, what we host, and how each event supports our target accounts and markets. Manage overlapping schedules, budgets, and deadlines across regions.
 

 - Create experiences worth attending. Develop executive dinners, customer gatherings, roadshows, conference activations, and distinctive experiences that give people a compelling reason to join us.
 

 - Get the right people in the room. Partner with sales on account lists, personal invitations, outreach, and meeting bookings. Own registration and attendance.
 

 - Set the quality bar. Make thoughtful choices about venues, food, programming, design, and hospitality. Carry that standard through invitations, arrival, introductions, and departure.
 

 - Make customers central to the experience. Bring customers and prospects together for honest conversations. Prepare customer speakers and create space for people to learn from one another.
 

 - Run production from start to finish. Source venues, negotiate vendor agreements, manage agencies and local crews, coordinate shipping and travel, and own on-site execution.
 

 - Prepare for everything. Build detailed event schedules, brief every team member, rehearse presentations and demos, and have workable backup plans. Stay calm and make decisions when circumstances change.
 

 - Turn events into business. Agree on goals and follow-up owners before each event. Track target-account attendance, qualified meetings, opportunities created, deal progression, and spend.
 

 - Build a program that scales. Create repeatable formats, reliable vendor relationships, and clear operating processes. Review every event and use what you learn to improve the next one.
 

 - Extend the impact. Work with marketing to turn event conversations, customer stories, and approved photography and video into content that keeps reaching people afterward.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You’ve owned the work. You have 4+ years in B2B events field marketing, or experiential marketing specifically in a SaaS company, with examples of programs you personally delivered.
 

 - You have excellent taste. You can create an experience that feels distinctive and appropriate for a senior audience.
 

 - You’re exceptionally organized. You can manage dozens of moving parts across multiple events without losing details or deadlines.
 

 - You’re commercially minded. You understand how events build relationships and help enterprise sales teams win business.
 

 - You’re a natural host. You notice who needs an introduction, who has been left out, and what would make a guest feel welcome.
 

 - You’re resourceful and decisive. You negotiate well, hold vendors accountable, and solve problems quickly.
 

 - You take full ownership. You can build the plan, rally the team, and stay through the final breakdown.
 

 - You enjoy being in the field. You’re comfortable with frequent domestic and international travel and evening or weekend work around events.
 

Experience delivering international events, working with executive audiences, or building an events program at a growing technology company is especially valuable.

WHY JOIN KASTLE

 - Build Kastle’s global events and experiences program from an early stage.

 - Work directly with founders and leaders shaping the future of financial services.

 - Have meaningful creative ownership and clear responsibility for results.

 - Work with some of the most talented people on the planet. 

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, health and wellness membership support, company meals, and team offsites. At Kastle, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace. Our team typically works around 60 hours per week, beginning at 8:00 AM, with five days spent collaborating in person at our San Francisco office.

jobs.title: Compliance and Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. Our AI agents help financial institutions originate loans, process payments, and support customers through some of their most important financial decisions. We’ve processed more than $2 billion in transactions and raised a $24M Series A, with backing from Insight Partners and Y Combinator.

We’re building AI for environments where accuracy, reliability, and compliance matter every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Compliance Counsel to help build the regulatory foundation behind Kastle’s AI agents.

You’ll work directly with our founders, product and engineering teams, and customers to translate financial services regulations into practical product requirements, compliance tests, and operating controls. You’ll also handle commercial contract reviews and help customers understand how our agents fit into their compliance programs.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad ownership. You should be as comfortable writing a test case for a borrower interaction as you are redlining a customer agreement or discussing a regulatory question with a bank’s compliance team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build our AI compliance program. Establish the policies, controls, review processes, and documentation that support responsible deployment of AI agents across consumer lending, commercial lending, and banking workflows.

 - Turn regulations into test cases. Work with product and engineering to define compliant agent behavior, build realistic testing scenarios, set clear pass/fail criteria, and investigate failures before and after deployment.

 - Own our compliance library. Maintain a current, usable source of regulatory requirements and interpretations. Track changes in laws, rules, and regulatory guidance, and turn them into updates to our products, tests, and customer guidance.

 - Advise product development. Review agent scripts, disclosures, communication flows, and new capabilities. Identify risks early and help the team find practical ways to ship.

 - Work directly with customers. Partner with bank and lender legal and compliance teams on deployment reviews, control requirements, and ongoing compliance questions.

 - Review and negotiate contracts. Draft and redline customer and vendor agreements, including confidentiality, data protection, and compliance provisions. Coordinate specialized matters with outside counsel.

 - Shape our compliance positioning. Help sales and leadership explain our controls accurately in customer conversations, diligence responses, and external materials.

Your work will cover ECOA, FCRA, FDCPA, UDAAP, TCPA, SCRA, RFPA, CAN-SPAM, privacy requirements, BSA/AML, and E-SIGN, along with applicable implementing regulations and state laws.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - A JD and active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar, with eligibility to practice as in-house counsel in California.

 - 4+ years of relevant legal or regulatory compliance experience, including hands-on work within a lender, bank, or fintech.

 - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams at a technology company to bring regulated products to market.

 - Strong knowledge of lending and banking compliance, with the judgment to research unfamiliar issues and know when to involve specialist counsel.

 - Experience translating regulatory requirements into policies, controls, monitoring, or compliance testing.

 - Ability to independently review, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements.

 - Clear writing and practical advice. You can explain a complex requirement and tell the team what to do next.

 - High ownership, attention to detail, and comfort working through ambiguity.

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate and work from our office.
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience spanning both a lending business and a technology company.

 - Familiarity with loan origination, servicing, and collections operations audit requirements.

 - Experience evaluating AI systems, reviewing automated customer interactions, or building compliance monitoring programs.
 

WHY JOIN KASTLE

 - Be a thought leader for how AI gets deployed in one of the most demanding regulated industries.

 - Work directly with founders and influence product decisions from the start.

 - Build systems that impact the lives of millions of consumers through major banks and lenders.

 - Work with some of the most talented people on the planet.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, health and wellness membership support, company meals, and team offsites. At Kastle, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace. Our team typically works around 60 hours per week, beginning at 8:00 AM, with five days spent collaborating in person at our San Francisco office

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking highly experienced Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) to shape the reliability, scalability and performance of our platform and customer facing applications. You will work closely with our software engineers and research teams to ensure our systems meet and exceed our internal and external customers' expectations.

 
 

What You Will Do

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you balance the day-to-day operations on production systems with long-term software engineering improvements to reduce operational toil and foster the reliability, availability, and performance of these systems.

 

Operations

• Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available and fault-tolerant infrastructures to support our web services and ML workloads

• Make sure our platform, inference and model training environments are always highly available and enable seamless replication of work environments across several HPC clusters

• Operate systems and troubleshoot issues in production environments (interrupts, on-call responses, users admin, data extraction, infrastructure scaling, etc.)

• Implement and improve monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems to ensure optimal system performance and minimize downtime

• Implement and maintain workflows and tools (CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, monitoring, logging and alerting systems) for both our client-facing APIs and large training runs

• Participate occasionally in on-call rotations to respond to incidents and perform root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences

 

Development

• Drive continuous improvement in infrastructure automation, deployment, and orchestration using tools like Kubernetes, Flux, Terraform

• Collaborate with AI/ML researchers to develop and implement solutions that enable safe and reproducible model-training experiments

• Build a cloud-agnostic platform offering an abstraction layer between science and infrastructure

• Design and develop new workflows and tooling to improve to the reliability, availability and performance of our systems (automation scripts, refactoring, new API-based features, web apps, dashboards, etc.)

• Collaborate with the security team to ensure infrastructure adheres to best security practices and compliance requirements

• Document processes and procedures to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing across the team

• Contribute to open-source projects, research publications, blog articles and conferences

 

What We're Looking For

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field

• 7+ years of experience in a DevOps/SRE role

• Strong experience with cloud computing and highly available distributed systems

• Exposure to site reliability issues in critical environments (issue root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...)

• Experience working against reliability KPIs (observability, alerting, SLAs)

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes...)

• Knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog...)

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation

• Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Go, Bash...) and knowledge of software development best practices

• Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration concepts

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

• Self-motivated and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment

 

Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have:

• experience in an AI/ML environment

• experience of high-performance computing (HPC) systems and workload managers (Slurm)

• worked with modern AI-oriented solutions (Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast...)

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. jobs.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

 

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

 

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - AI & Automation

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

 

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 

 

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Traffic Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE:

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Traffic Infrastructure team, you will own the traffic layer behind our generative AI platform: the proxies, load balancers, service mesh, and routing systems that move every request reliably across regions and cloud providers. This is a highly technical role that calls for depth in distributed systems, cloud networking, and infrastructure, along with the judgment to balance latency, cost, and operational simplicity. You will partner closely with ML, product, and platform teams, and help set the technical direction for the team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Architect and build scalable, fault-tolerant traffic and networking services, including ingress and egress, load balancing, routing, and quality-of-service controls.

 - Lead technical design discussions, mentor other engineers, and establish best practices for operating large-scale infrastructure.

 - Drive network optimization both inside and outside data centers, including cost reduction, performance tuning, and removing scaling bottlenecks.

 - Evaluate and integrate cloud-native and open-source technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Envoy, Istio) to strengthen platform capabilities and reliability.

 - Own systems end to end, from design through deployment and observability, with an emphasis on high availability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.

 - Develop and maintain comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing to give deep insight into system health and performance.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

 - 5+ years of experience building backend or network infrastructure in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

 - Strong software development skills in languages such as Go, C++, Rust, Java, or Python.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals, including performance optimization.

 - Full product lifecycle ownership, from design through implementation to production.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Master's or PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

 - Hands-on experience with traffic or edge engineering, service mesh, or cloud networking (e.g., Envoy, Istio, DPDK).

 - Deep Kubernetes experience, including ingress, network policy, and custom controllers.

 - Track record of improving performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency on high-throughput systems.

 - Experience leading projects across teams and coaching distributed engineers.

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are hiring an IT Support Engineer to own the employee technology experience end to end — from day-one device readiness through the full asset lifecycle. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable resolving a Tier 3 macOS escalation, standing up device management infrastructure from scratch, and turning repetitive support work into documented, self-service processes.

You will be the technical escalation point for our Windows and macOS fleet, administer our identity and endpoint management platforms, and partner with security to keep the fleet patched and compliant. You will also mentor junior support staff and set the standard for white-glove service across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Management

 - Be the front line supporting MDM platforms across the fleet in collaboration with our Technical Engineer — Supporting Windows & macOS — including enrollment, configuration profiles, group policies, and software distribution.

 - Serve as the Tier 1/2 escalation point for macOS and Windows device management issues, including configuration drift, update failures, and security policy conflicts.

 - Work with Technical Engineers to standardized OS images and deployment workflows on a quarterly cadence.

 - Monitor endpoint performance and digital employee experience to identify emerging issues before they scale, and drive proactive remediation across the fleet.

 - Execute workstation imaging, setup, and deployment for new hires and internal transfers, scaling to 100+ builds per month during peak hiring.

Identity & Access Management

 - Tier 1 /2 — provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and application access requests.

 - Tier 1 /2 supporting authentication methods including FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, and biometric authentication.

 - Troubleshoot via remote sessions with Slack Huddle, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Security & Compliance

 - Partner with the IT Engineering team on patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint compliance using tools such as BigFix, SentinelOne, or Automox.

 - Exposure in supporting security-driven remediation tickets within SLA and maintaining fleet compliance against internal and regulatory standards.

Service Delivery & Support

 - Own a high-volume ticket queue in ServiceNow or Jira, consistently meeting or beating SLA targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

 - Provide in-person and remote support to a globally distributed workforce across North America and EMEA time zones.

 - Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace issues including sync failures, authentication errors, mail flow, and collaboration tooling (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint).

 - Support conferencing and telephony systems for internal and executive-level meetings.

Asset Lifecycle & Vendor Management

 - Provide asset management support to help track and manage our computer hardware and software.

 - Asset shipping and recovery for our new joiners and leavers.

Enablement

 - Lead new-hire IT onboarding sessions covering workstation setup, security protocols, and support procedures.

 - Author and maintain runbooks and self-service documentation in Confluence or SharePoint to reduce repeat ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

 - 5+ years of progressive experience in IT support, end user services, or systems administration.

 - Strong hands-on expertise troubleshooting both Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

 - Production experience administering at least one major MDM platform (JAMF Pro, Microsoft Intune, Addigy, or equivalent), including building configuration profiles and policies from scratch.

 - Working knowledge of identity platforms — Okta, Active Directory, or Entra ID — including SSO and MFA administration.

 - Experience with endpoint security and patch management tooling (BigFix, SentinelOne, Automox, Zscaler, or similar).

 - Proficiency with an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and a track record of meeting SLA commitments at volume.

 - Strong administration skills in Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal process and high ambiguity, and to build structure where none exists.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with a white-glove approach to customer service across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

 - JAMF Certified Tech (JAMF 200) or higher; Microsoft, Okta, or CompTIA certifications.

 - Linux fundamentals and experience administering virtual machines (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V).

 - Experience supporting file share, print, or application servers on Windows Server.

 - Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

 - Reporting and dashboarding experience with Power BI or equivalent.

 - Experience supporting users across multiple international regions.

Success in the First 6 Months

 - Fully ramped on the fleet and operating independently as the Tier 3 escalation point for Windows and macOS.

 - Measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution and repeat ticket volume through documentation and automation.

 - Onboarding and imaging workflows standardized, documented, and consistently delivering day-one readiness.

 - Endpoint compliance sustained at or above target across the fleet.

Physical & Work Requirements

 - Ability
