jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

As a Recruiting Coordinator on the Talent Acquisition team, you will help deliver a smooth, consistent hiring experience for candidates and hiring teams. You will coordinate interviews, keep recruitment processes running efficiently, and ensure every interaction reflects a high standard of care.

You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to improve how we hire as we grow. Beyond day-to-day coordination, you will identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, and support projects that make our recruiting operations more effective and scalable.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Coordinate end-to-end interview scheduling across global teams and time zones, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and interviewers.

 - Own candidate experience initiatives by managing feedback surveys, reporting on insights, and driving continuous improvements.

 - Maintain job postings, recruitment pipelines, and ATS data accuracy while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows.

 - Support employer branding through LinkedIn campaigns, hiring announcements, and recruitment content.

 - Manage the employee referral program, ensuring timely follow-up, tracking, and recognition.

 - Improve recruiting processes by documenting best practices, supporting tooling initiatives, and helping automate workflows.

 - Lead or contribute to cross-functional talent operations projects that improve the efficiency and scalability of recruitment.
 
 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Around 4–5 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruitment operations, HR coordination, or a similar role.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 - Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

 - Confidence working with spreadsheets, applicant tracking systems such as Greenhouse or Ashby, and recruitment data.

 - A proactive, solution-oriented approach with a focus on improving processes rather than simply maintaining them.

 - A collaborative working style and the ability to build effective relationships with hiring managers, recruiters, HR, and external partners.

 - Adaptability, ownership, and the ability to work effectively in a changing environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

As a member of the Teleport Customer Solutions Team, you will own the full post-sales lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic customers: implementation, technical support, ongoing business reviews, and identifying expansion opportunities. You will be responsible for implementing, supporting, evangelizing, and expanding Teleport at our top customers, and dedicated to proactively driving adoption so that they achieve the maximum value from all Teleport products and solutions.

This is a deeply technical role. Many of our customers run Teleport on Kubernetes, and you will be expected to operate comfortably at the cluster level: designing and deploying Teleport in customer environments, troubleshooting failing workloads, and debugging access, networking, and certificate issues alongside customer engineers.

 - Outstanding soft skills and excellent verbal and written communication

 - Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously

 - Work closely with Sales and Product to identify customer needs tied to tangible upsell and cross-sell opportunities

 - Plan and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews for customers, drive adoption within the customer organization, and plan and assist with enterprise-wide rollouts of Teleport

 - Develop, maintain, and deliver customized training, and evangelize the solution to a wider customer organization

 - Maintain strong working relationships with key client stakeholders and expand those relationships into other parts of the organization

 - Document each customer’s business goals and challenges to align Teleport with the most value possible

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on existing and upcoming Teleport solutions for customers and teammates, staying up to date on the latest releases

 - Collaborate with Sales and Product to provide valuable feedback for product improvement

 - Support our broader customer base seeking new solutions and best practice recommendations

Our interview process

Our interview process includes a hands-on technical assessment. You will build a kubeadm Kubernetes cluster, configure RBAC with certificate-based user access, deploy an application, present your design and its tradeoffs, and work through live Kubernetes troubleshooting scenarios. Candidates should be comfortable operating Kubernetes at this level without relying on managed-service abstractions. VP of Communications, Replit

jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPERBOUND

Sales runs on conversations. At Hyperbound, we’re building the AI Agent that turns those conversations into action, helping sales teams sharpen their skills, make better decisions, and move deals forward.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

THE TEAM YOU'LL BUILD WITH

We’re assembling a team of builders and operators who do their best work together. You’ll work alongside people who’ve built companies, scaled teams, and joined Hyperbound after experiencing the product as customers. We value curiosity, strong opinions, and a shared commitment to solving customer problems.

We pair ownership with close collaboration. You’ll have room to shape your approach, with the expectation that you share your reasoning, discuss tradeoffs, and align with teammates before moving forward. We want people who bring recommendations, invite feedback, and understand how their decisions affect the broader team.

We have each other’s backs. We share context, give direct feedback, and work through disagreements openly. When something goes wrong, we take responsibility, solve it together, and use what we learn to improve.

We move quickly through clear priorities and coordinated action. We take ambitious swings, stay close to customers, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll turn Hyperbound’s marketing priorities into campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified demand, and grow pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines paid advertising expertise with sound judgment, brings clear recommendations, and works closely with the team to turn plans into measurable results.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 - Growth experience: You bring 4+ years of marketing experience at a Series A–C startup, including hands-on B2B SaaS demand generation and paid advertising experience.

 - Paid advertising expertise: You have directly managed Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, owning campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, creative testing, conversion tracking, and ongoing optimization against CAC, ROAS, and qualified pipeline.

 - Content and conversion: You partner with Product Marketing on SEO/AEO and website optimization strategies, create and update ads, articles, landing pages, and customer stories, and build campaigns around agreed messaging and audience priorities.

 - Campaign collaboration: You work with Sales, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, and executive leadership to turn business priorities into targeted campaigns, with clear plans for promotion, lead capture, and follow-up.

 - Measurement and execution: You use CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, and pipeline contribution to improve performance, explain your recommendations, and align with teammates before launching or making material changes.

HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - B2B SaaS experience: We strongly prefer someone who has built and optimized growth campaigns in a B2B SaaS company, with experience navigating complex buying journeys, multiple stakeholders, and longer sales cycles.

 - Integrated campaigns: Experience connecting paid advertising, content, field activations, and executive programs to qualified pipeline, with close collaboration across Product Marketing and Sales.

WHAT YOUR REGULAR THURSDAY LOOKS LIKE:

 - Dig into Google and LinkedIn performance, trace a drop in demo conversions, and check lead quality and pipeline impact. Bring a recommendation on budget or targeting changes, align with the team, and put the next creative test live.

 - Work through an upcoming campaign with Marketing leadership, aligning on the audience, offer, messaging, channel mix, and launch timing. Build the ads, emails, and landing page, keeping the team informed as the campaign takes shape.

 - Prepare promotion and lead capture for a field activation or executive program. Coordinate target accounts and meeting goals with Sales and Field Marketing, test the registration and booking flows, and have follow-up ready before launch.

 - Review search and website performance with Product Marketing, refresh content for SEO/AEO, and check forms, tracking, and conversion paths. Close the loop with Sales on recent leads, share what’s driving pipeline, and recommend what to improve next.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - A remote role. You’ll work from our San Francisco office five days a week.

 - A strategy-only position. You’ll build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns yourself and execute the work in house.

 - A role measured only by lead volume. You’ll stay close to lead quality, Sales follow-up, and pipeline contribution across paid advertising, content, field activations, and executive programs.

INTERVIEW PLAN

 - Intro call with James, Founding Recruiter (30 minutes)

 - Conversation with Garrett Moedl (Head of Product Marketing)

 - Take-home exercise (1–2 hours)

 - Take-home exercise review with the GTM team (45 minutes)

 - Final onsite with founders and leadership team (60 minutes)

We move fast, from first conversation to decision in 1–2 weeks.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $150K-$175K base salary + equity package

 - Medical, dental, and vision

 - Commuter benefits

 - Lunch and dinner in the office

 - 401k and HSA options

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hyperbound is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression,

jobs.description:

Operating across the US and Canada brings a steady flow of regulatory, consumer protection, and product questions that need clear legal answers fast. As our Legal Researcher, you’ll work closely with our Legal Counsel and partner with teams across Jerry to research hard questions and turn your findings into decisions the business can act on.

This role is built for high-performing law graduates who want a rigorous in-house legal career outside the law firm path. It’s highly hands-on: you’ll draft and negotiate agreements with partners and vendors, research licensing and regulatory requirements, support product and compliance reviews, and help solve new legal questions as the business grows. If you succeed, Jerry’s leaders make faster, better-informed decisions on legal risk, and you’ll have owned work that shapes how the company grows.

You’ll need to be comfortable developing a point of view, explaining your reasoning, and incorporating feedback.

 - Judgement that grows with experience: Many of the questions you’ll take on have no clear precedent. You’ll dig into the facts and law, develop a thoughtful recommendation, and bring a clear point of view for discussion and review.

 - Escalations and regulatory inquiries: Investigate complex consumer escalations and regulatory inquiries, identify root causes and potential legal issues, propose scalable fixes, and turn recurring issues into company-wide compliance training.

ABOUT GREENBOARD

At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Greenboard has product market fit and is growing week over week. The category is moving our way, and a big share of that demand comes from smaller firms: independent RIAs, emerging fund managers, and early-stage fintechs that need real compliance infrastructure without a large compliance team.

This seat is built for velocity. You'll run a high volume of shorter cycles, usually with one or two decision makers, often the CCO or a founder who also owns compliance. Deals close in weeks, and the number gets hit through consistency, not one big signature.

Good inbound lands every week and you'll be fast on all of it. Past that are thousands of small firms that will never raise their hand on their own, and you'll go get them.

You'll join a proven motion and a new revenue leader sharpening it for scale. You'll also talk to more prospects than anyone on the team, so what you hear on your calls will move messaging, packaging, and what we build next.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The full sales cycle. First call through close across SMB accounts, with the number in your name

 - Pipeline, inbound and outbound. Inbound is a meaningful part of our growth today, and you'll respond quickly and thoroughly to every lead that comes in. You'll also build pipeline through cold calls, email, social, partnerships, and industry events.

 - Velocity. Tight discovery, a sharp demo, and a clean close on a short cycle, with a full book of deals moving at once and none of them going quiet

 - Fast handoffs. Get new customers through security questions and paperwork quickly, and partner with customer success so they go live fast

 - Feedback into the playbook. Test talk tracks, sharpen objection handling, and bring market signal back to sales leadership and product

WHO ARE YOU?

 - Hungry. You work every lead thoroughly, you do the outbound when nobody is checking, and you do not need the process to exist before you start.

 - Accountable. You own the number and the forecast, you call the misses early, and you do not need to be managed to either

 - A learner. You take coaching directly, run the experiment, and incorporate changes quickly

 - Fast and organized. You can run a full calendar of calls, follow up the same day, and keep the next step on every deal clear

 - A clear, concise communicator who builds trust quickly with founders, CCOs, and operators

 - Curious about financial infrastructure, compliance, and how modern businesses manage operational risk

 - Located in NYC

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 6 years carrying a quota, closing a high volume of $5k to $45k ACV B2B SaaS deals

 - Have built your own pipeline from cold and sustained it weekly, through list building, cold calls, cold email, and social, rather than only working inbound or a BDR list

 - Run short sales cycles from first call to signature in a few weeks, with a consistent monthly close rate

 - Forecast accurately, keep CRM hygiene without being asked, and work from data

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Based in NYC or willing to relocate to work from our New York office

NICE TO HAVE

 - Sold into financial services, especially RIAs, broker-dealers, or private funds

 - Sold to founders or small teams where the buyer is also the day-to-day user

 - Early-stage experience where the playbook did not exist yet

BENEFITS

 - 401(k) with 5% company match

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time

 - 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)

 - 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays

 - Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats

 - Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance

THE ROLE

We're looking for an independent, hands-on, and forward-thinking Head of Internal Audit to establish and lead Ziina's Internal Audit function.

As our first dedicated Internal Audit hire, you'll have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up, define its approach, and deliver independent assurance across our existing regulated operations and future regulated entities as Ziina expands.

You'll operate with significant autonomy and direct access to the Board of Directors, owning audit planning, execution, and reporting while working closely with teams across the business and maintaining the independence required of the function.

We're looking for someone who combines strong fintech audit experience with a pragmatic, technology-driven mindset. Someone who understands regulatory expectations, identifies meaningful risks, leverages data and automation, and builds effective audit practices without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

This is an opportunity to shape a modern Internal Audit function within a fast-growing fintech, with broad business exposure and meaningful influence over the Company's governance and control environment.

AS A HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDIT AT ZIINA, YOU WILL:

 - Build and lead the Internal Audit function from the ground up, establishing its charter, methodology, policies, procedures, and governance framework in line with CBUAE requirements and applicable professional standards.

 - Develop and execute a risk-based Internal Audit Plan, independently assessing the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls across Ziina's regulated activities.

 - Conduct end-to-end audits, including planning, risk assessment, control testing, evidence evaluation, reporting, and remediation follow-up, initially operating as a standalone function.

 - Provide independent assurance across financial, operational, regulatory, and technology risks, including payments, AML/CFT, consumer protection, safeguarding of customer funds, outsourcing, cybersecurity, and data protection.

 - Leverage data analytics and automation to enhance audit testing, identify anomalies, assess controls at scale, and reduce manual processes, collaborating with Engineering and Data teams where relevant.

 - Provide independent reporting and insights to the Board, highlighting material risks, control deficiencies, audit findings, and remediation progress through clear, objective, and actionable recommendations.

 - Challenge stakeholders constructively, identifying root causes and recommending practical improvements while maintaining independence from management and operational decision-making.

 - Oversee audit findings and remediation, establishing appropriate tracking mechanisms, monitoring management's corrective actions, and independently validating their effectiveness.

 - Coordinate regulatory and external assurance activities with CBUAE, external auditors, and independent reviewers on matters within the Internal Audit function's remit.

 - Extend audit coverage to new regulated entities, adapting the audit approach to evolving business activities, products, jurisdictions, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 - Continuously improve audit effectiveness, introducing scalable processes, technology-enabled testing, and proportionate governance practices that support Ziina's growth.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU LIKELY:

 - Have 7+ years of Internal Audit experience, including direct, hands-on experience auditing fintech companies, preferably within payments, digital financial services, or technology-driven regulated financial institutions.

 - Have a strong understanding of risk-based auditing, internal controls, corporate governance, and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.

 - Have experience operating within CBUAE-regulated environments or comparable financial regulatory frameworks, with the ability to understand and apply UAE regulatory requirements.

 - Hold a relevant professional qualification such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent recognized certification.

 - Have demonstrated experience developing audit plans, executing control testing, identifying findings, and communicating results to senior leadership or Board-level stakeholders.

 - Are comfortable establishing and operating a function independently, taking ownership of both strategic priorities and hands-on execution.

 - Understand technology-driven financial services and can assess risks across operational processes, financial crime controls, IT systems, and regulatory obligations.

 - Bring strong analytical skills and an interest in leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve audit effectiveness.

 - Exercise sound professional judgment, prioritize material risks, and deliver practical recommendations without unnecessary complexity.

 - Communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and build effective relationships across teams while maintaining professional independence.

 - You're known for combining independent judgment, strong technical expertise, and a practical, solutions-oriented approach.

jobs.title: Strategic Fixer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

Our largest customers run complex operations, and when something isn’t working, the problem rarely sits neatly within one team. A customer may be implementing a new product, dealing with a complicated integration, or facing an operational issue with no obvious owner or solution. That’s where you come in!

We’re looking for a Strategic Fixer who wants exposure to a wide range of problems and is ready to own outcomes. You will take ambiguous problems, structure them, dig into the details, align senior stakeholders, and drive execution across teams that don’t report to you.

This isn’t a role where you make a recommendation and hand it off. One week you might be diagnosing a failing payroll integration, the next coordinating an engineering fix, and the next working with a customer’s VP of Operations to get an implementation back on track. The problems might vary, but your job stays the same: figure it out, get the right people moving, and own the problem until it’s solved. This role opens doors to a range of growth paths across Clipboard!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that guide business decisions.

 - Research and evaluate new tools, including AI, automation, and internal systems, and drive their adoption to make operations more effective.

 - Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience

 - Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2–6 years of experience in a problem-solving role, such as strategy or management consulting, operations, strategy & operations, implementation, customer strategy, or program management.

 - Experience solving operational problems by improving processes, designing workflows, or building scalable systems, while juggling multiple priorities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data (e.g., SQL, Python) to diagnose problems and support decisions.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex problems simply and align stakeholders across teams, from frontline operators to senior leaders.

 - A high level of ownership. You don’t stop at the recommendation; you stay with the problem until it’s solved.

 - A deep curiosity that drives you to reason from first principles and dig until you find the root cause.

 - A habit of going to the source: testing the feature, listening to the agent call, calling the customer, or running the workflow.

WHY JOIN CLIPBOARD?

 - We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

 - Fast-paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

 - A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

 - Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

At Clipboard, we don't believe proxies are a reliable way to measure ability. We prefer to evaluate candidates by having them do work that closely resembles the actual job. We are hiring for several teams through this one posting, so the process also helps us find the team where you’ll fit best. Here is how it works:

 1. Application Review

 2. Case Study

 3. Case Study Interview

 4. Hiring Manager Interview (s)

 5. Culture Interview

 6. Offer!

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

ROLE SUMMARY

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

This is not a research role. Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

ABOUT THE ROLE

 - Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

 - Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

 - Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

 - Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

 - Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

 - Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

 - Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

 - Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

 - Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.
 

ABOUT YOU

 - You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

 - You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

 - You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

 - You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

 - You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

 - You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

 - You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

 - You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

 - You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary + meaningful equity

 - Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000

 - MacBook Pro and full home office setup

 - 30 days annual leave

 - Private healthcare

 - Regular company off-sites and team retreats

 - International English-speaking team

 - Language lessons in English and French
 

HIRING PROCESS

 1. Screening with an ML Researcher / Engineer

 2. Home technical assignment and review with the team

 3. Culture fit interview and meet the team

 4. Reference check and offer

Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND BELONGING

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

From paywalls to pricing experiments and onboarding and discovery flows, you'll partner closely with User Acquisition on the handoff from paid to product, and with the core SMB product team on what gets built next.

Location: Paris, we offer relocation support (Hybrid

ABOUT THE ROLE

 - Own a real slice of the growth funnel. Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end-to-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.

 - Move the metric, not just the backlog. Run a high-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

 - Find the insight, then build the feature. The best growth work is spotting why users drop off and shipping the change that fixes it. You'll do both.

 - Work across web and mobile. Mobile and web funnels behave differently (App Store vs. card-on-file, push vs. email). You'll own both, and partner closely with the User Acquisition team on the handoff from paid to product.

 - Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

ABOUT YOU

 - You've moved real numbers on a subscription product. Five to eight years as a PM, with concrete activation, monetization, or retention wins you can name with the KPI, the change, and the percentage impact, owned by you, not by a team you sat on.

 - You've worked on something with recurring revenue. Whether B2B SaaS, B2C subscription, or B2B2C, as long as your work was tied directly to revenue your experience will give you a leg up. Pure marketplace or pure free-product backgrounds will struggle here.

 - You know how SMB sellers buy. You understand how SMB e-commerce sellers discover, evaluate, and adopt utility SaaS, the kind of motion behind Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo, Stripe, Klarna, Gorgias, Recharge, Loop, Wix, or Squarespace.

 - You think in funnels. You understand activation curves, paywall psychology, trial design, and the difference between credit-based, feature-gated, and seat-based pricing, and you have opinions on which works where.

 - You build with AI. You use Claude or equivalent to automate recurring tasks, and can explain how you set it up to help you ship faster.

 - You're data-fluent. Comfortable with SQL and an analytics platform like Amplitude or Mixpanel; you build and interpret your own funnel without waiting for a data scientist, and you've shipped a high volume of A/B tests personally in the last 12 months.

 - You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience on both web and mobile funnels; familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem (app store, connect flows, merchant personas) or a comparable e-commerce platform; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND BELONGING

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Ops Associate
jobs.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

The role

At Parallel, we work with a team of 25+ freelance TIMs (medical information technicians) on different tasks, in particular retrieving medical documents from our partner facilities’ software. This is a core part of Parallel. With fast, secure access to our partner facilities’ data, we code the first hospital stays within a few days and prove Parallel’s ROI. Then we automate document extraction so we can scale.

As Ops Associate, you support the Ops team on managing freelancers and on cross-functional Ops projects. You take ownership of critical operational topics end to end and contribute directly to Parallel’s growth. You work daily with our Head of Ops, the Deployment Strategists, Customer Care and our freelance TIMs.

You’re in charge of staffing and managing our network of freelance TIMs and become their main point of contact, working directly with our Head of Ops. You also work on cross-functional projects that structure Ops as Parallel scales. It’s a chance to see first-hand how a generative AI solution is deployed in hospitals, and to experience a startup’s scale-up from the inside.

What you’ll do

Staffing and management of freelance TIMs

You’re responsible for the network of freelance TIMs who support our clients. You make sure the right person is on the right assignment, at the right time, within a compliant framework.

 - Sourcing and recruiting: identify, qualify and recruit new TIMs based on needs (specialties, facilities, volume).

 - Staffing assignments: assign TIMs to client accounts, anticipate workload peaks and manage priorities.

 - Onboarding: train new TIMs on the Parallel tool and our ways of working.

 - Monitoring: centralize assignment tracking and manage the team’s performance.

 - Contracts and compliance: keep freelance contracts up to date, in line with our ISO 27001 and HDS requirements (data access, confidentiality).

Cross-functional Ops projects

You support the Ops team on cross-functional projects to make processes more robust and scalable. For example, you could:

 - Compliance and security: contribute to the ISO 27001 and HDS certification project on the Ops side (registers, evidence, access reviews, contracts).

 - Processes and documentation: keep client training notes up to date and improve internal playbooks (deployment, support).
 
 

Who we’re looking for

 - You’re looking for your first permanent job, or possibly an end-of-studies internship (with the goal of staying with us on a permanent contract).

 - You’re rigorous: you organize yourself, prioritize, and follow your topics through to the end.

 - You have strong people skills: you can adapt to profiles very different from yours, explain technical topics and bring a team along.

 - You’re comfortable in a tech environment and like understanding how software works so you can help others use it.

 - You’re autonomous: when you’re given an assignment, you figure out how to set up the right processes and resources to get it done.
 
 

Why join us?

 - Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

 - A central role: you work with Ops, Product, Tech and the field teams.

 - Room to grow: we’re hiring for this role to help someone grow with us over time.

 - The right time: Series A closed, product already used by ~100 hospitals, a fast-growing team.

 - The package: Alan health insurance, Swile, Apple equipment, 50% of transport covered, a team event every month and two off-sites a year.

 - Our offices: Paris 2nd arrondissement, boulevard de Sébastopol.
 
 

 - Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year.

The process

 1. Call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min)

 2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

 3. Case study with Clémentine and Jules and meeting with Paul, CEO

 4. Offer

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer(Java)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

 - Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

 - Our technology stack is based predominantly on Java 25 on the backend with Postgres database

 - We rely on Spring Boot for quick and quality delivery

 - We have a pragmatic approach to develop our business logic, focusing on clean code, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and continuous integration & delivery

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

 - Bachelor's Degree (or above) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or other Engineering / Science disciplines

 - Quick learner with an ambitious and results driven personality, with excellent communication skills (english fluency, verbal and written)

 - Track record of building complex products that millions of people use in hypergrowth startups

BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits 

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

 - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

jobs.title: Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
Start date: ASAP

Help get Spherecast in front of the people who run the world’s consumer goods supply chains.

The Spherecast Platform is the real-time operating system for consumer goods supply chains. Agnes, our AI Supply Chain Manager, runs on top of it, helping brands decide what to produce, where to make it, and how to move it. Your job is to help us reach the brands that need it.

You’ll work directly with the founding team to research prospects, pick up the phone, send thoughtful gifts, and turn creative outreach into real conversations. One day, you might put together a personalized package for a supply chain executive. The next, you’ll call them, learn about their challenges, and book a meeting.

You’ll own the details from the first touch to the follow-up. Success means opening doors and creating qualified sales opportunities.

What you’ll do

 - Run personalized gifting campaigns. Research prospects, come up with thoughtful gift ideas, source and package them, coordinate shipping, and follow up when they arrive.

 - Cold call prospective customers. Reach supply chain and operations leaders, introduce Spherecast, handle initial objections, and book qualified meetings.

 - Find the right people. Research consumer brands, identify relevant decision-makers, and build targeted prospect lists.

 - Write outreach that gets a response. Create personalized emails, LinkedIn messages, and handwritten notes that give prospects a reason to engage.

 - Own the follow-up. Keep track of conversations, deliveries, and next steps in our CRM. Make sure promising opportunities keep moving.

 - Test and improve. Try different messages, gifts, and outreach approaches. Track which ones generate conversations and meetings, then build on what works.

 - Support events and campaigns. Help get the right people into the room and turn introductions into ongoing conversations.

What we’re looking for

 - You’re comfortable picking up the phone and starting conversations with people you’ve never met.

 - You’re persistent and resilient. You can hear “no,” learn from it, and make the next call.

 - You’re organized and reliable. You keep track of shipping details, contact information, and follow-up dates.

 - You’re resourceful and creative. You can find a relevant angle or thoughtful gift that makes someone pay attention.

 - You communicate clearly, both in writing and in conversation.

 - You take ownership, move quickly, and ask for feedback to improve.

 - You’re curious about startups, sales, and how consumer brands operate.

 - You’re excited to work on-site with our team in New York City.

 - Bonus: Strong experience in sales (especially cold calling), video editing/cinematography, fundraising, hospitality, student organizations, or building something of your own. Previous business development experience is welcome but not required.

About Spherecast

Spherecast is building the AI-native operating system for consumer goods supply chains, trusted by brands such as AG1, Feastables, and HOLY.

Our platform brings demand, inventory, materials, capacity, and costs into one real-time operating context. Agnes uses this foundation to evaluate production, purchasing, and inventory decisions, then turn approved decisions into actions in customers’ systems.

Our ambition is to connect brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in one network, making the physical flow of goods as programmable as code.

Join us in New York City. Pick up the phone, open doors, and help bring Spherecast to the next generation of customers.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com http://amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The UK is the fastest growing region in EMEA, and this year we are seeing bigger, more complex and more marquee logos being won than ever before! 

We offer a flexible work with beautiful office space by Borough Market for days to connect, as well as time at home and of course in the field meeting customers and partners. You'd join a close knit team of 7 hugely successful Account Executives who are taking this market by storm. 

Everyone who works at Amplitude has ownership; with complete autonomy to own your book of business with creativity and confidence. We're looking for a driver, an expert story-teller and uses AI to accelerate their impact. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it.

What you'll be doing

 - Manage a mix of customers and prospects who are high growth enterprises (around 2k - 10k employees with a turnover of roughly 250 - 500m).

 - Running full enterprise sales cycles with a value-first mindset — discovery, demos, and exec presentations tailored to what you heard.

 - Evangelise and sell all components of our platform but also understand the dynamics of selling a complex platform solution. 

 - Educate customers on their AI product development maturity and journey, providing customer centric support and guidance. 

 - Building pipeline through outbound, AI-assisted tools, SDR partnership, marketing programmes, and the partner ecosystem

 - Driving wins with net new logos that will help you grow your territory for next year and beyond. 

 - Applying MEDDPICC with real rigour — qualifying hard, building Champions, getting to Economic Buyers early, and forecasting with confidence

 - Becoming a product evangelist across Marketing, Product, and Engineering personas — selling technical and commercial value at every level

 - Working the full internal village: SDRs, Solutions Consultants, Partners, Customer Success, Legal — everyone aligned around customer value

What we're looking for

 - Enterprise SaaS or AI sales experience, ideally with deals $50k - $400k ARR 

 - A genuine hunter — consistent pipeline generation and a land-and-expand mindset

 - MEDDPICC (or equivalent) applied in how you run deals, not just how you update your CRM

 - Strong C-suite presence — able to uncover business value beyond features and build relationships that last

 - Naturally curious and empathetic; someone who experiments with the sales process rather than just running the same play

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

THE MISSION

At Lucis https://lucis.life/?utm_source=career_job_desc&utm_medium=content, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here https://lucis.life/careers?utm_source=career_job_desc&utm_medium=content.

 

THE ROLE

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

 - Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

 - Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

 - NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

 - Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

 - Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

ABOUT YOU

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

YOU’LL FIT IN WELL IF

NICE TO HAVE

THE PROCESS

 - Reference calls

HOW WE WORK

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: VP of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT JIGA

Jiga is an AI-native manufacturing supplier that helps aerospace, defense and robotics companies get complex machined parts made by committed machine shops working as one. Teams at NASA, Collins Aerospace, Archer, Leidos and Siemens use Jiga for the parts their programs are waiting on. We're Series A, backed by Aleph and Y Combinator, and growing fast on a model with no bidding and no black box - the buyer sees, messages and audits the shop making their part.

WHY THIS MATTERS

AI is moving into the physical world. Every major program right now, in defense, aerospace and robotics, comes down to hardware, and getting the right part made is still one of the hardest, riskiest problems in manufacturing. A late or out-of-spec part can hold up a satellite launch or a drone program for months.

The US has the shops to do this work. Thousands of small machine shops, many of them excellent, sit underutilized, because there's no way for a 15-person shop and a satellite program to work together without someone in the middle chasing quotes and revisions by hand. The common answers are a black box with a bidding war behind it, or build megafactories. Our bet is that the capacity already exists and the missing piece is the layer that orchestrates it.

That's what Jiga is building: the AI infrastructure for the companies building the future to get the parts they need, and for the US to bring manufacturing back to the small shops that can do the work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

BUILD THE PROCESS AND COACH TO IT

 - Turn how our best reps win an account into one process every rep runs

 - Call reviews and coaching

SCALE THE TEAM

 - Hire the sales team on a proven profile

OWN THE NUMBER

 - Revenue plan, quota and forecast

 - The operating cadence: pipeline reviews, per-rep metrics and the comp plan, with our growth lead on revops.

SET THE GO-TO-MARKET

 - Who we sell to, who we don't, and how an account expands from a first order into a program.

 - Voice of the customer to product, marketing and supply chain, so what customers say shapes what we build and who we source.

OUR CULTURE

Remote-first. We don't count hours, we measure performance. We hate micromanagement and unproductive meetings. We play online games together, encourage hard questions, and fly everyone out once a year for a week-long offsite (Spain, Greece and Albania so far).

YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

 - Built a sales system once already, as the leader accountable for it, in a business where the sale depended on fulfillment people had to trust. You can draw the funnel you inherited, what you changed and what you learned.

 - Coached reps up. You can name a rep who went from bottom half to quota under you and what you changed in how they sell.

 - Think in systems. You see the sales motion as one machine with feedback loops and lags. You look for the one change that moves every number downstream, build mechanisms rather than ask for more effort.

 - Have strong opinions on hiring. How to spot a great rep, what the first 90 days look like, what you fire for. And probably two or three people who'd follow you.

 - Think big and thoughtful on the sequence. You have a picture of the $1B revenue org and the next actions to get there.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You've only run sales where marketing built the pipeline and the product carried the sale.

 - Your last three roles were running established teams at $50M+ and you'd be inheriting a working machine.

 - You'd rather manage the cadence than write the process.

HOW TO APPLY

Tell us about the sales system you built, with numbers.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

📍 Remote Global - Non U.S. 

Want to sit at the intersection of Support, Engineering, and Product? Clipboard is hiring Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to act as the primary escalation layer for technical issues across our platform. You'll own the investigation, reproduction, and - where applicable- agent-assisted fix implementation that turns noisy customer reports into validated, high-signal work, so Engineering only receives production-ready problems for final review.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for people who love digging into hard problems with real diagnostic tools, who care about getting to the root cause rather than just clearing a queue, and who want their investigations to directly protect platform reliability for hundreds of thousands of healthcare workers and the facilities that depend on them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor escalation channels and the Technical Support queue in Zendesk, catching early signals of systemic problems before they reach customers

 - Investigate complex product, platform, and data-layer issues using tools like Datadog, internal dashboards, and SQL, reproducing bugs and producing evidence-backed escalations to Engineering.

 - Handle live incidents end-to-end, from detection to closure: React to an incident with urgency, coordinate across Support, Engineering, and Product, and keep stakeholders updated with clear, structured communication

 - Implement fixes where appropriate, testing your changes before handing off to Engineering for final review and sign-off

 - Perform Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews, translating each issue into learnings that reduce recurrence and improve monitoring

 - Maintain operational workflows (geofence, facility quizzes, NFC) accurately and quickly while spotting trends for prevention

 - Capture investigative learnings in clear troubleshooting guides and documentation, and submit structured proposals that turn recurring patterns into actionable improvements

 - Uphold our values such as unreasonably fast, ownership, and uncomfortably high standards in every interaction

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Technical Fluency - You're comfortable investigating issues with observability tools (e.g., Datadog), writing SQL to interrogate data, and reasoning about APIs, backend configurations, and feature toggles. You can tell the difference between a UI, data, and code-level problem.

 - Diagnostic Rigor - Every investigation you produce is thorough, evidence-based, and reproducible. You rule out config and data causes before escalating, and your write-ups are clear enough for another engineer to pick up without rework.

 - End-to-End Ownership - You own problems from first report to confirmed resolution, including stakeholder updates and follow-through, with no gaps between hand-offs.

 - Composure Under Pressure - You stay structured and calm during live incidents, balancing speed with accuracy and communicating clearly when stakes are high.

 - Adaptability & Prioritization - You juggle structured work (incidents, bugs, workflows) with unplanned high-priority requests without letting SLAs slip.

 - Systems & Prevention Thinking - You treat every issue as a chance to learn, identifying gaps in monitoring, tooling, or process and proposing fixes that prevent recurrence.

 - Fluent, professional-level English communication, both written and verbal.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Datadog, Sentry, Snowflake, or similar)

 - Familiarity with SQL and reading application logs

 - Background in technical support, SRE, incident response, or a related engineering-adjacent function

 - Exposure to AI-assisted coding/agent tooling

 - Experience in Ops, Support, or CX environments at scale

HIRING PROCESS

 - Application Review

 - Skills Assessment via Case Study

 - Case Interview with Tech Support Team Lead

 - Interview with Head of Worker Experience

Important Note: Clipboard operates 24/7. Team members work 5 days within a 7-day schedule, including weekend availability. Shifts are assigned based on business needs.

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence.

You’ll join our go-to-market team, reporting to our Head of GTM, and help customers evaluate, implement, and get the most out of Momentic across pre- and post-sales. We’re looking for a customer-minded engineer who enjoys talking to people, gets hands-on with technical problems, and earns trust through clear explanations and follow-through.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead technical discovery and demos with engineers, QA teams, and engineering leaders.

 - Own technical POCs alongside AEs: define success criteria, refine technical requirements, resolve blockers, and help customers reach an informed decision.

 - Run customer onboarding and implementations, from initial test coverage through CI/CD integration.

 - Own the technical customer relationship from evaluation through implementation and ongoing adoption, helping teams resolve blockers and make sound testing decisions. Partner with engineering when deeper investigation is needed.

 - Bring customer feedback and implementation lessons into product and engineering.

YOU’RE PERFECT FOR THIS ROLE IF…

 - You have 2+ years of technical experience in software engineering.

 - You can read and write code, debug unfamiliar systems, and reason through applications, APIs, environments, and CI/CD pipelines.

 - You have hands-on experience with CI/CD setups and providers such as GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Buildkite, or Bitrise, source control, the terminal and command line, and agentic coding tools such as Cursor, Claude, or Codex.

 - You enjoy working with customers, asking thoughtful questions, and helping them solve technical problems.

 - You earn engineers’ trust through clear written and live communication, sound technical judgment, and follow-through.

 - You’re organized and can keep multiple evaluations and implementations moving. You can break technical work into clear steps, coordinate with AEs and customer teams, and follow through on blockers.

 

You don’t need to have held a Solutions Engineer title before. We welcome engineers who enjoy working directly with customers.

 

NICE TO HAVES

jobs.description:
Momentic is building the definitive verification layer for software: an AI-native testing platform that helps engineering teams catch bugs before they ship. As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero, and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence.

You’ll join our engineering team and work closely with our CTO to improve the models and agents behind Momentic. We’re looking for a hands-on AI engineer who can fine-tune models, build evaluations, and turn production data into more reliable, efficient agents. Momentic executes more than 1 million tests daily and processes more than 1 billion tokens per hour at peak, giving your improvements a direct impact on the product.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Fine-tune models for long-running agents, including agents that investigate whether test failures come from infrastructure, recent code changes, or test authorship.

 - Build and curate training and evaluation datasets from production workflows, using failure patterns to identify opportunities for improvement.

 - Develop LLM evaluations and observability that connect offline results with production behavior and help the team verify improvements.

 - Tune prompts, context, and model behavior to improve task success, reliability, latency, token usage, and cost.

 - Design repeatable experiments and help publish benchmarks that demonstrate our core agents’ performance on testing and browser workflows.

 - Own technical projects from problem definition through delivery, working with the engineering team to make practical tradeoffs and ship improvements.

 

YOU’RE PERFECT FOR THIS ROLE IF…

 - You have relevant software engineering experience, typically 3+ years, including hands-on contributions to AI-powered capabilities used in production.

 - You have hands-on experience with supervised fine-tuning, including preparing training data and evaluating model behavior.

 - You’ve worked with prompt and context tuning, evaluation datasets, and LLM observability to diagnose failures and measure improvements.

 - You have strong engineering fundamentals, code efficiently, and know what you’re great at and where you have room to grow.

We are continuing to look for experienced and motivated talents across the world to come join our Tokyo team! We are open to considering anyone interested in pursuing a career at Applied Intuition Tokyo office.

As a bridge between our engineering teams and the contractors who run day-to-day operations, you will make sure that what engineering needs gets executed on the ground. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
HELP BUILD THE NEXT CATEGORY-DEFINING AI COMPANY

AI has transformed how we write, communicate, and build software. The next frontier is even bigger: transforming how businesses actually operate. That's what we're building at Sola.

Sola is an AI-native platform reinventing enterprise process automation and disrupting legacy RPA tools. Our AI agents can execute complex workflows across any application, browser, desktop, or legacy system—free from the limitations and fragility of traditional automation tools. Users simply record their screen, and Sola creates a custom agent to run that process at scale.

The opportunity at hand is enormous. Nearly every enterprise, across every industry, runs on processes that are still painfully manual. We're building the technology to change that. And we're just getting started.

We're hiring a small group of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bring Sola to the world's largest enterprises and rewrite the playbook for how automation is built in the enterprise.

 

WHY SOLA? WHY NOW?

 

A MASSIVE MARKET READY FOR REINVENTION.

Enterprise automation is one of the biggest opportunities in AI. Legacy automation platforms have been constrained by rigid rules, complex implementations, and brittle workflows.. Sola is changing that with AI agents that can reason, adapt, and execute work across enterprise systems: the next generation of a massive software category.

 

REAL TRACTION. SERIOUS MOMENTUM.

Sola today powers enterprise workflows across healthcare, finance, legal, logistics, and more, including at Fortune 500 companies. We've closed seven-figure enterprise deals with a lean team. The product is proven. The market is responding. Now we're building the team to scale it.

 

BUILD ALONGSIDE LEADERS WHO'VE DONE IT BEFORE.

Work alongside David Fullerton, formerly CTO of Heap (Series C to acquisition) and Stack Overflow (Series A to E), as well as Sola's founders Neil Deshmukh and Jessica Wu. You'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional engineers and help shape how the company grows.

 

EARLY-STAGE OWNERSHIP. EXCEPTIONAL UPSIDE.

Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Conviction, and Y Combinator, Sola has raised more than $20M to build the future of enterprise automation.

We’re still early enough that individual contributions can meaningfully influence the company’s trajectory, and you’ll have a direct influence on how the FDE role evolves over time.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Sola, you'll combine hands-on technical execution with customer-facing communication and partnership.

 - Dive deep on customer workflow failures using logs, browser tools, APIs, and code, then implement and verify fixes

 - Build custom integrations and contribute production code to Sola's platform, turning recurring customer needs into reusable improvements

 - Join customer calls alongside Customer Success, ask questions that clarify the problem, and own the solution through resolution

 - Help customers onboard and adapt their workflows to Sola, including occasional travel for customer onboarding and key projects as needed

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're open to early-career engineers, new graduates with demonstrated programming ability, or strong customer-facing engineers who are comfortable writing production code.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

 - Strong technical foundations, whether from a CS degree with demonstrated coding abilities, or hands-on experience in a strong technical environment

 - Flexibility to move across different customer environments, with a solid understanding of how core web technologies work and the ability to dive into complex desktop or legacy systems

 - A strong sense of curiosity and a drive to go anywhere needed to solve tricky customer problems

 - Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical findings into clear non-technical explanations

You'll work 5 days a week out of our office in NYC (we'll cover relocation!) and occasionally travel to customers as needed.

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Sola offers competitive salary plus meaningful equity at Series A stage. Exact compensation is based on experience and level.

We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, daily meals together in the office, flexible PTO (4 weeks per year), and relocation support for candidates not already based in NYC.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Software Engineer on Sierra’s Cloud Infrastructure team, you’ll own the foundation that every Sierra customer runs on. That includes our multi-tenant environments, where most of our customers and data live, and our isolated single-tenant environments for highly regulated enterprises. Sierra is expanding quickly across AWS and GCP, in regions across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We expect to roughly double our number of deployments over the next year.

The work is very visible. Our deployments support the relationship with major customers, so you’ll see directly how your infrastructure affects customers and the business. Our challenges keep evolving, from scaling, reliability, and new compliance and regulations.

ON THIS TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Design, build, and operate Sierra’s cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP (and soon Azure) using Terraform and Kubernetes.

 - Simplify and standardize our deployments so that adding a new region or environment is repeatable and predictable. We want to treat deployments like cattle, not pets.

 - Stand up and operate new multi-tenant regions and single-tenant environments for customers with strict regulatory or isolation needs.

 - Own and improve deploys and releases across our fleet, investing in tooling and developer experience so engineers can ship quickly and safely.

 - Build security guardrails that give enterprise customers confidence in our shared multi-tenant environment.

 - Write production code, mostly in Go, to automate infrastructure and replace manual work with durable systems.

 - 6+ years of hands-on software or infrastructure engineering experience, including building and operating production systems at scale.

 - Broad infrastructure experience on at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Breadth and fundamentals matter more than expertise in one specific cloud.

 - Deep expertise in at least one layer of the stack, such as compute, orchestration, networking, or deploys, plus a real interest in owning the layers next to it.

 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

 - Strong coding skills and a bias toward automation and tooling. Go experience is a plus.

 - A pragmatic, scrappy approach. You can start with a rough prototype and evolve it into production ready.

 - Curiosity and flexibility. You adapt to new clouds, tools, and customer requirements instead of forcing every problem into one familiar pattern.

 - A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

EVEN BETTER

 - Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and many regions or environments.

 - Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA, or financial services).

 - Experience building deploy systems, CI/CD, or internal developer platforms.

 - Experience deploying software into customer-managed cloud environments.

 - An SRE background, or experience leading reliability and incident management programs.

 - Experience with distributed databases such as DynamoDB or Spanner.

 - Experience at a fast-paced startup or on a small infrastructure team with broad scope.

OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
