jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Sr. People Generalist builds the operational backbone of the People team: the processes, systems, data, and policies that let us scale without adding complexity. This is a builder role, not an administrator role. You will turn work that runs on tribal knowledge and one-off fixes into documented, measured, repeatable programs with clear owners and controls.

You will be helping define the center of excellence model on the People team: the escalation point for employee matters, a data connoisseur that owns data fidelity , and the person who decides where work should live as the team matures from reactive support to a proactive shared-services model. You will lead cross-functional projects and use AI to shape the employee experience.

 

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

 - Define the People Ops operating model: what is standardized and centralized, what stays with People Partners or other COEs, and how work transitions with continuity and measurement built in

 - Assess the maturity of each core People process (onboarding, offboarding, job changes, comp cycles, leaves, time off, rotations) and run a roadmap to move each from ad hoc to documented, measured, and automated

 - Be the operational partner to People Business Partners: execute reorgs, promotions, performance actions, and exits they drive; supply the data and process support behind their work

 - Set standards for process design, documentation, SLAs, and handoffs; own the SOP library and knowledge base so answers live in a system

 - Support the build of audit-ready controls (recurring data audits, approval trails, segregation of duties) for SOX

 - Define service-quality metrics (ticket volume, resolution time, error rate, employee satisfaction) and use them to decide what to fix next

 - Run proactive audits across Workday and connected systems to catch errors before they reach payroll, equity, or board reporting

 - Serve as a functional Workday owner: business process design from requirements through configuration, testing, and post-launch iteration

 - Use AI and low-code tools to prototype and ship People Ops automations; know when a gap needs a lightweight internal tool versus a technical build with IT or Systems

 - Resolve the hardest cases in benefits, leaves, time off, rotations, and sensitive org changes with precision, empathy, and clear written communication

 - Partner with Finance, Legal, IT, Recruiting, and Payroll on projects that mature processes and policies for the business

 - Lead change management for process redesigns and new tools: communication, training, adoption tracking, and feedback loops

 - Identify gaps in our operational cadence before they're pointed out to you, and drive the fixes

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - Bachelor's Degree and 5+ years of practical experience experience in a People or HR-related role

 - Hands-on use of AI and low-code tools (Claude, Lovable, Zapier, Apps Script, SQL) to build People Ops automations or lightweight internal tools

 - Experience with Carta, Ashby, and Jira help desk, or comparable equity, ATS, and ticketing systems

 - Experience partnering with IT or HRIS teams on integrations and translating business needs into requirements and test plans

 - Background in Lean, Six Sigma, or service design applied to HR processes

 - Experience supporting compliance audits (SOX, EEO-1, benefits-plan) and immigration programs

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in high-growth technology companies, particularly automotive or autonomous vehicle industries

 - Direct experience scaling People Ops functions from early-stage to larger organizational structures

 - Experience with HRIS systems, people analytics tools, and large datasets

 - Prior experience informally leading or mentoring teammates in an Ops or HR function

Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
WHY WE EXIST

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

WHY WE’RE HIRING

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

 - Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

 - Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

 - Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

 - Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

 - Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

 - Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

 - Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

 - Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

 - Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

 - Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

 - Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

WHO YOU ARE

 - Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

 - Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

 - Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

 - Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

 - Owner: You take ownership of outcomes and are comfortable building process where none exists yet.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining 2+ years at a reputable investment bank, corporate development group, or private equity firm with 2+ years in strategic finance or FP&A at a high-growth company.

 - A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a similarly quantitative field.

 - Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based operating models, three-statement mechanics, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and a working command of accounting concepts and GAAP.

 - Experience with unit economics in a consumer or marketplace business, including CAC, LTV, payback, cohort retention, and contribution margin.

 - A track record of translating complex analysis into a clear narrative for an executive or investor audience.

 - Startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred, including building financial processes from scratch.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI tools for analysis, research, and workflow automation.

Nice to have:

 - Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or marketplace experience;

 - CFA certification;

 - vendor negotiation or procurement exposure;

 - finance tech stack experience (NetSuite, Ramp, planning tools).

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

As a Research Engineer at David AI, you'll build algorithms and systems that turn large-scale speech and audio collections into high-quality datasets. You'll tackle questions like: What makes a recording useful? How do we measure and improve dataset quality?

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We are seeking a PCBA Design for Manufacturing (DFM) Engineer to ensure our next generation of hardware is designed for reliable, scalable manufacturing. You will bring manufacturing expertise into the design process, resolve risks before boards are released, and establish the design rules, documentation, and review practices that support successful production ramps.

You will work closely with Electrical Engineering, PCB Layout, Mechanical, Thermal, Power, Test, and Manufacturing teams to prepare products for production across our internal SMT operation and external manufacturing partners. The ideal candidate combines strong PCBA manufacturing knowledge with disciplined documentation, clear technical communication, and practical experience using AI tools to improve engineering workflows.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own PCBA DFM reviews: Lead manufacturability reviews from early design through production release, evaluating component placement, footprints, spacing, solderability, assembly access, inspection coverage, and rework feasibility.

 - Establish manufacturing guidelines: Develop and maintain DFM rules, checklists, and review milestones that reflect the capabilities of internal SMT operations and external manufacturing partners.

 - Maintain engineering documentation: Keep review records, issue trackers, design decisions, manufacturing requirements, and lessons learned accurate, version-controlled, and easy to retrieve.

 - Support manufacturing readiness: Partner with design and process engineering teams to identify assembly challenges early, distinguish design limitations from process development needs, and prepare products for repeatable production at volume.

 - Collaborate with manufacturing partners: Evaluate supplier DFM feedback, resolve technical questions, and align manufacturing requirements across internal operations and contract manufacturers.

 - Support prototype and NPI builds: Investigate design-related assembly issues and incorporate findings into subsequent board revisions, manufacturing guidelines, and future products.

 - Improve yield and manufacturing cost: Use build results, inspection data, and failure analysis to reduce recurring defects, late design changes, board respins, scrap, and rework.

 - Improve testability and inspection coverage: Partner with Test Engineering to address test access, design-for-test requirements, and inspection limitations before production release.

 - Apply AI and automation to engineering workflows: Use AI tools to develop technical reports, summarize DFM and build findings, and create lightweight applications for documentation, issue tracking, and data analysis. Validate outputs for technical accuracy and protect sensitive engineering information.

 - A degree in electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, or materials engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Experience reviewing PCB layouts, component footprints, assembly drawings, bills of materials, and manufacturing release packages.

 - Knowledge of manufacturability challenges associated with high-density assemblies, fine-pitch components, and large BGA packages.

 - The ability to distinguish issues that require design changes from those that can be addressed through manufacturing process development.

 - Strong documentation and organizational skills, including managing revision history, tracking reviews and action items through closure, and producing clear technical reports for engineering and business stakeholders.

 - Practical experience using AI tools for technical reporting, analysis, automation, or application development, with sound judgment when reviewing generated outputs.

 - Experience working directly with design engineers and contract manufacturers to resolve technical issues.

 - Familiarity with IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and relevant PCB design and fabrication standards.

 - Strong ownership, clear communication, and the ability to prioritize manufacturing risks across concurrent programs.

Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

Hours: Part-time, 4 hours a day or full-time (9:00-6:00pm).

ABOUT SOLIDROAD

Building something great is addictive. It’s like discovering your favorite TV show mid-season, except you're helping write the next episode. It’s like unboxing a new gadget, except you’re the one designing it. You shape how it feels, how it works, and how people react when they use it.

At Solidroad we're solving a big, messy, exciting problem: how do you scale your customer teams without losing what makes humans amazing? Warmth, empathy, intuition. We’re using AI, generative tech, and real-time simulations to make this happen. It's ambitious, difficult, and genuinely new.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Solidroad is a fast-growing startup and our Dublin office moves quickly. We're looking for a part-time or full-time Operations Specialist to help keep things running day to day- taking care of the traveling, scheduling, event planning, ordering, and general errands that keep an office humming. It's a hands-on, varied role and a great way to get real exposure to how a high-growth startup operates from the inside.

This is perfect for someone looking to get stuck in, and learn the ops side of a startup.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO DAY-TO-DAY

 - Handle day-to-day office errands and operational tasks as they come up

 - Help coordinate team socials, office events

 - Keep the office stocked and tidy: order and restock supplies, snacks, drinks, and equipment

 - Book and schedule things- meetings, meeting rooms, travel, deliveries, and appointments

 - Manage incoming and outgoing post and deliveries

 - Be the day-to-day point of contact for office suppliers, vendors, and building/facilities (maintenance, cleaning, repairs)

 - Greet and host visitors, candidates, guests so they have a great first impression

 - Pitch in on ad hoc admin and ops tasks across the office

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We're a small, focused group working full-time in our Dublin & San Francisco offices. We're here five days a week because building something ambitious means collaborating closely, solving problems together, sharing ideas spontaneously. We're intentional about creating a culture that's mature, supportive, and fun. You'll be joining experienced founders who've done this before, alongside a tight-knit team genuinely excited about building something impactful.

WE HOPE YOU

 - Have 2+ years of experience in operations, office management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing company.

 - Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented — you keep things running smoothly and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Are naturally proactive — you spot problems before they happen, take initiative, and get things done without being asked.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days look the same and priorities can change quickly.

 - Are a natural people person — friendly, approachable, and someone the whole team enjoys working with.

 - Take real ownership of your work, whether it's managing the office, organizing events, or supporting the wider team.

 - Are resourceful and solutions-oriented — you figure things out, even when there's no playbook to follow.

 - Think like a founder — you care about the little details, take pride in creating a great place to work, and are excited to help build something special.

 - Are based in Dublin and excited to be a hands-on presence in our office.

THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE HONEST TRUTH

The highs are real: you’ll play a big part in shaping the culture of a fast-growing startup, work closely with the leaders, and help create an office where people genuinely love coming to work. You’ll have the freedom to take ownership, bring new ideas to life, and make a real impact on how we operate day to day.

The lows? Things move fast, priorities change, and sometimes you’ll need to figure things out without a playbook. You’ll juggle everything from the little details to big team initiatives, and no two days will look the same. This isn’t a place to sit back and wait for instructions — it’s a place to take initiative, solve problems, and grow with the company.

If that sounds exciting, don’t overthink it. Reach out. Tell us a little about yourself, what you've done, and why you'd be great at making Solidroad an amazing place to work. We care more about attitude, initiative, and a willingness to get stuck in than a perfect CV.

jobs.title: Medical Illustrator/Animator
jobs.description:
At BioRender, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s ability to learn, discover, and communicate science – transforming how knowledge is shared and making science open, collaborative, and easily understandable by all.

 

We’re shaping the future of science communication and are looking for talented individuals to help bring this vision to life! 🚀

ABOUT BIORENDER

BioRender is the world's leading visual science communication platform, used by over a million scientists to create figures, presentations, and visual content that moves research forward. We exist because how science is communicated visually matters — it shapes understanding, drives discovery, and determines whether research reaches the people who need it. Every product decision we make is grounded in that belief.

 

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're building a dedicated team of formally trained medical illustrators and animators — a new function at BioRender that will serve as the company's subject matter experts on scientific visual communication. This team will have direct impact across product, marketing, sales, and education, and will own the quality standard for how science is represented across everything we build.

 

This is not a production role. You'll be expected to think critically about how science is represented visually, contribute perspective on product and design decisions, and set the bar for what scientists see when they use BioRender.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Motion graphics and animation for feature launches, product marketing, social media, and sales enablement

 - Scientific figures, templates, and visual content that define BioRender's quality standard

 - Live product demos for sales calls, conferences, and webinars — building figures in real time while articulating the design reasoning behind them

 - Educational content including tutorials, learning modules, and onboarding materials for researchers at every level

 - Icon design and visual systems — creating new icons, defining style direction, and maintaining quality during library-wide updates

 - Visual QA and scientific accuracy reviews across templates, AI-generated outputs, and library content

 - Identifying patterns in how scientists build figures — breaking down what makes a great figure in each discipline so we can standardize and productize that knowledge, making it easier for every researcher to create work they're proud of

 - Contributing to product decisions where illustration expertise matters — including how AI-generated scientific visuals should look and behave

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Graduate degree in Medical Illustration, Biomedical Visualization, or a closely related program

 - Strong foundation in anatomy, molecular biology, or a relevant scientific discipline

 - Demonstrated skill in both static illustration and motion graphics / animation

 - Ability to look at a scientific figure and know whether it tells the right story — not just whether it's technically correct

 - A formed point of view on design decisions, with the ability to articulate your reasoning

 - Instinct for how a scientist or researcher would perceive and use visual content — you think like the audience before the audience thinks

 - Comfort with ambiguity — you can break down a problem you've never seen and find an approach without a playbook

 - Ability to explain complex visual and scientific concepts to non-experts clearly and compellingly

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE

BioRender was founded by a medical illustrator because scientific visual communication deserves better tools. This team is an extension of that conviction. You'll be joining at a foundational moment — this function is new, and you'll have real influence over how it takes shape.

 

In the first several months, you'll work across multiple areas — animation, demos, education, visual systems — before the team evolves based on individual strengths and company needs. There is significant room to grow into specialized or leadership roles as the team matures.

 

If you care about the impact that clear, accurate, and beautiful scientific visuals can have on research and education, this is the role.

 

DETAILS

 - Remote-first, with the team coming together in person at least once per quarter

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Opportunity to define a new function at a high-growth company

Why join us?

 - We are mission-driven: we work collaboratively towards our shared vision of improving scientific communication and accelerating scientific discovery. BioRender figures have appeared in more than 54,000 publications!

 - BioRender is loved by millions! We have a world-class NPS and a community of loyal fans and users in 200+ countries!

 - Our company is backed by top investors and accelerators like Y Combinator, and we are on a growth trajectory comparable to many top-performing SaaS companies

 - We’re remote-first with team members across Canada and the U.S., offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere.

 

BioRender is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. By submitting this application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BioRender in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

This analyst turns Outset's own data into decisions faster than a traditional analytics hire would, by using AI tools as a core part of the workflow rather than bolting them on afterward. They're as comfortable writing a SQL query to understand critical business data accurately, as they are building a small internal tool, script, or AI skill that answers a recurring question without a human re-running it every week. 

The job is part analysis, part automation - someone who'd rather build the dashboard-that-builds-itself than ship the same report by hand twice. Improving processes and workflows across the company excites them and they love to build tools to help internal teams across the business move, manage and understand data.

Responsibilities

 - Answer recurring business questions across GTM, People, Product and Engineering using SQL, Python, and whatever AI tooling gets there fastest.

 - Build small internal tools - vibe coded apps, Slack bots, scripts, lightweight dashboards, AI skills - that eliminate a manual report or a repeated ad hoc request.

 - Partner with stakeholders to figure out what they actually need before building anything.

 - Maintain and improve data pipelines so the underlying numbers are trustworthy, not just the tools on top of them.

 - Evaluate new AI tools and workflows as they come out, and decide which are actually worth adopting internally vs. hype.

 - Document what you build well enough that someone else can run it without you in the room.

 - Flag data quality issues and inconsistent definitions before they turn into bad decisions.

Qualifications

 - 3+ years in a data analyst, analytics engineer, or BI role, with real SQL and Python fluency.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to build something real - a script, an agent, an automation - not just to summarize text.

 - A builder's instinct: when a manual process repeats twice, the next step is automating it, not doing it a third time.

 - Able to go from a vague stakeholder ask to a specific, well-scoped answer without heavy hand-holding.

 - Clear written communication - can explain a finding or a tool to someone non-technical in a few sentences.

 - Experience at a startup where the data stack and tooling were still being built, not inherited mature.

 - Exposure to building or prompting AI agents/workflows (not just using chat interfaces).

 - Familiarity with modern BI/data tools (dbt, Looker, Hex, or similar).

jobs.description:

BioRender is seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to join our Security team – an engineer first, who contributes directly to the codebase rather than managing security from the sidelines. You'll help define how security is built into our engineering organization, contributing production code across our application (Node.js/React/Python) and infrastructure (Python, Terraform, AWS, Cloudflare) while shaping secure-by-design patterns, CI/CD automation, and engineering workflows that let the company move quickly and safely.

 

You'll work AI-natively, using AI coding assistants and agentic tooling to accelerate your own work while helping secure the AI-powered capabilities we're building. If you're excited by building developer-friendly security systems, solving meaningful engineering problems, and focusing on the threats that actually matter, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Hands-on engineering & codebase contribution

 - Contribute production-quality code directly to the application (Node.js/React) and infrastructure (Python, Terraform) – you ship fixes and hardening yourself, not just findings for others to action.

 - Build and maintain security and CI/CD tooling for automation, keeping the secure path the default path.

 - Define secure-by-design patterns and drive standards for authentication, authorization, and API security.

 - Lead threat modeling on new and existing systems and turn those models into shipped controls.

 - Work AI-natively: use AI coding assistants and agentic tooling to accelerate code review, triage, and tooling development.

 - Secure AI-integrated product features – reasoning about prompt injection, data leakage, and over-scoped tool, token, and data access.

 - Automate recurring security work so the team scales through leverage, not headcount.

Web & product security (active defense)

 - Perform penetration testing and code reviews (Node.js/React) using OWASP methodology.

 - Drive identification and remediation of application security vulnerabilities (SAST/DAST/HackerOne).

 - Hands-on experience securing cloud workloads on AWS and comfort with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent); familiarity with Cloudflare a plus.

 - Threat-modeling experience and command of common code and network vulnerability types, their impact, and remediation.

 - Applied knowledge of cryptography, PKI, and TLS and their practical implementation.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're looking for an experienced product designer to join our small team and own meaningful parts of the Outset product. A significant part of your purview will be our Digital Twins / Simulations Lab—a new 0→1 product we're building alongside the core platform—though the work will reach across the product as the team's needs evolve.

Simulations are deep tech. Underneath the product are models, data pipelines, and research methods built by our scientists, and presenting a complex product with simplicity and intuitiveness is critical. You'll need to be curious about what's happening under the hood, patient enough to understand it, and sharp enough to translate it into product experiences that a researcher can grasp quickly.

You'll work closely with our Head of Design, PMs, Sales, and Engineering to understand what we're building and how we're selling it, and to make sure the product reflects both.

Newer parts of the product, Simulations especially, are being actively shaped by customer feedback and competitive dynamics. We're looking for someone who holds a high bar for craft without being precious about their own work as we iterate.

So much has changed about what it means to do "design work." The toolkit has expanded to include tools like Codex and Claude Design, and our team spends as much time generating and molding prototypes as organizing canvases in Figma. Technical fluency is a major plus here, but strong opinions, taste, and a track record of shipping are what matter most.

You'll join a small design team and own projects from the kernel of an idea to a feature customers use every day, working directly with our founders and, on simulations work, the scientists building the lab.

Responsibilities

 - Own product surfaces end to end. Take projects from early concepts through launch and iteration, including a central role in our Simulations work.

 - Simplify technical complexity. Dig into how our simulations and other systems actually work, then design experiences that make the output legible and trustworthy to researchers.

 - Stay close to customers. Sit in on customer conversations, read the feedback, and turn it into design decisions quickly.

 - Hold a high bar for craft. Produce wireframes, interaction designs and high-fidelity visuals, and sweat the details in the shipped product.

 - Know what not to build. Question features that add complexity without adding much value, and help the team cut scope down to what matters most.

Qualifications

 - We don't have many explicit requirements, and exceptional candidates might bend these rules.

 - 5+ years of product design industry experience, ideally including time as the lead or founding designer on a product or major product area.

 - Experience taking a product from 0 to 1, or working in an early-stage environment where the direction changed often.

 - Genuine curiosity about technically complex systems, and a track record of designing clear products on top of them.

 - Comfort working directly with customers and treating their feedback as a primary input to design.

 - Exceptional communication skills.

 - Strong but loosely held opinions on design and product.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Comfort designing in code—building prototypes with real data, or shipping frontend changes alongside engineers.

 - Experience building enterprise software.

 - Experience building in the research industry.

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable https://bookable.health/?utm_source=ashby Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

 1. 💙 Care deeply

 2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

 3. 🤝 Be your word

 4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you’ll own the tooling and data that let’s Healthtech-1 scale across the NHS.

jobs.title: Head of Growth - Argentina
jobs.description:
About ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role

We are looking for a Head of Growth for Argentina to lead our growth in the country.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for representing ARQ locally, driving growth, and owning the country’s acquisition and branding P&L. You will act as the bridge between our global teams and the Argentinian market - bringing local insights to inform strategy and product roadmap, while executing campaigns that resonate with the local audience.

What you'll be doing

 - Act as ARQ’s primary representative in Argentina and build and strengthen ARQ’s presence and brand in the market, including ARQ's PR and earned media presence in the country.

 - Own local marketing P&L, driving user and revenue growth, margin optimization, and improved unit economics

 - Build and maintain relationships with local partners, brand ambassadors, influencers, and affiliates

 - Drive Above-The-Line (ATL) efforts, including TV, OTT, OOH, radio, and other mass media to maximize brand reach and efficiency

 - Act as the voice of the local market, collaborate with global performance marketing and creative teams to ensure brand consistency and localisation across every channel

 - Build scalable processes to support long-term growth, and hire, develop, and lead the local team over time

 - Influence the local product roadmap by identifying products or features that could unlock growth in the local market

What you’ll need to succeed

 - 7+ years of professional experience, including top-tier management consulting (e.g., BCG, Bain, McKinsey, OW) or a bulge bracket investment bank, combined with senior operating roles at a high-growth VC-backed tech company.

 - Deep understanding of the Argentinian market and consumer behavior is a must

 - Structured problem-solving: you break down ambiguous challenges into clear frameworks, move fast, and communicate findings with precision

 - Ability to coordinate external partners: media, celebrities, influencers, or affiliates, and manage multiple relationships simultaneously

 - A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, takes full ownership, and can lead projects end to end without hand-holding

 - Track record of building and leading high-performing teams

 - Proficiency in English and Spanish

Why join us?

 - Lead our growing Buenos Aires hub, working alongside the founders and senior leaders and a world-class team where you’ll learn fast and grow even faster

 - Pivotal role in the fastest growing FinTech in LATAM, backed by the best investors in the world (Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, YC, Kaszek)

 - Manage a significant budget with the autonomy and tools required to deliver meaningful results

 - Work directly with ARQ’s founders, senior leaders, and global growth teams

 - Highly competitive salary

 - Sign-on stock options bonus, so you become a big part of the success of the company

 - Discretionary performance bonus (stock options) every year

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
SingleStore engineers build the real-time data platform powering some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our cloud-native architecture enables high-performance transactional and analytical workloads at scale, and our teams ship production code continuously throughout the year. 
 We operate in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where engineers own their work end-to-end and partner closely across Product, Sales, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver meaningful business impact. 
 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the Engineering team and play a critical role in designing and delivering core capabilities for SingleStore’s. This is a senior technical role with end-to-end ownership of large, release-defining projects at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and database technology. 
 As a Software Engineer, you will set technical direction, solve complex system-level problems, and act as a force multiplier across the organization. You will work closely with Product and customer-facing teams to ensure our platform meets the needs of both long-standing enterprise customers and new adopters. 
 This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives on deep technical challenges, takes pride in building durable systems, and enjoys mentoring others while remaining hands-on. 
 Note: This role is open across multiple levels. Final leveling (Senior, Staff, or Principal) will be determined based on experience, scope of impact, and demonstrated technical leadership throughout the interview process. 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
 Lead technical design and decision-making for large, release-defining projects impacting SingleStore’s cloud platform. 
 Design and implement new capabilities across networking, control plane, and managed service infrastructure, with main focus on our billing systems 
 Solve complex, mission-critical system problems with solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and resilient. 
 Collaborate closely with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 Investigate and resolve difficult issues in production and development environments while balancing multiple responsibilities. 
 Investigate, debug and fix issues with billing data synchronization. 
 Contribute to data visualization dashboards. 
 Mentor and guide engineers on system design, coding standards, and architectural best practices, raising the technical bar across the team. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 
 6+ years of experience developing and debugging system-level software in Golang or similar language 
 Familiarity with distributed systems managed via Kubernetes. 
 Demonstrated ability to design and build highly reliable, high-performance system software. 
 Experience working in environments where performance, scalability, and reliability are critical. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience building cloud-native SaaS platforms. 
 Experience working with frontend web frameworks like React. 
 Background with cloud based metering and billing and generally accepted account practices. 
 
 SingleStore delivers our cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. 
 Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. 
 To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company. 
 SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses. 
 For candidates residing in California, please see our California Recruitment Privacy Notice . For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic

 - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication

 - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows

 - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes

 - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time

 - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results

 - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems

 - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems

 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems

 - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

 - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD

 - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus

 - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards

 - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders

 - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

 - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics

 - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications

 - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack

 - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning

 - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring

 - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection

 - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT TOKYO

Applied Intuition entered the Japan market in 2019. The company has rapidly grown and established strategic relationships with major Japanese automotive OEM customers. Based in Otemachi area, the Tokyo site consists of more than 60 employees who previously come from Google, Mobileye, TIER IV, Woven by Toyota, Tesla and other renowned companies.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a System Test Engineer to drive Verification & Validation (V&V) efforts for Autonomous Driving. Your role will focus on ensuring execution and managing the test campaigns that ensure systems and components meet all required specifications, standards, and customer expectations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to define testing criteria, develop test plans, and oversee the execution of both verification and validation processes. Your work will be critical to enable our development of a production-ready software for on-road vehicles.

In addition to your testing contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the automotive industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making automotive systems a reality, Applied Intuition is the place for you!

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

 - Set up Test Management for Autonomous Driving and lead efforts for test execution

 - Collaborate with system development teams to understand system requirements and define appropriate verification and validation plans

 - Utilize various testing methodologies and Applied’s tools to conduct functional, non-functional, regression, and performance testing in simulation and on-road

 - Analyze test results, identify issues and trends, and work with engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve problems

 - Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and quality management systems.

 - Document all V&V activities and provide comprehensive reports to stakeholders

 - Provide release recommendation based on test results

 - Contribute to the overall safety case of the product

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - Strong understanding of automotive systems and components, particularly in areas such as ADAS, infotainment, powertrain, and vehicle control systems

 - Proficiency in testing methodologies, tools, and processes related to automotive systems.

 - Experience with HIL and SIL testing environments

 - Experience in in-vehicle testing

 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities, with experience working in cross-functional teams

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Minimum of 5 years of experience in V&V testing in the automotive industry

 - Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., ISO 26262, ASPICE) and regulatory requirements

BENEFITS AND PERKS: 

 - Lunch and dinner allowance

 - Equity (RSU) offering

 - English / Japanese language allowance

 - Company sponsored housing program

 - Pension plan (確定拠出年金)

 - Fitness & Learning allowance

jobs.title: Deal Desk Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai

ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

We’re hiring our a Deal Desk Coordinator on a 1099 contract to work on deals. You’ll work directly with the founder and daily with Sales, Finance, and Legal. Our usage-based pricing is still taking shape, and the deals you structure will shape it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role has fast, profitable deal approvals from quote to cash.

 - Structure and approve non-standard deals (discounts, usage commits, per-minute pricing, payment terms) in hours, not days

 - Build the discount approval matrix and pricing guardrails, and model deal margin before every approval

 - Run quote-to-cash across CRM, CPQ, Legal handoff, and billing

 - Report weekly on cycle time, discount levels, and win rate, and automate approvals where possible

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 4+ years in deal desk, pricing, or sales/revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company

 - Experience owning an end-to-end enterprise process for deals

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce or HubSpot and a CPQ tool

 - Experience at a VC-backed SaaS/AI company or a big tech/large SaaS company

 - Availability for overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers

Nice to have:

 - Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing

 - Built a deal desk function from scratch

 - SQL or scripting skills to automate reporting and approvals

HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Commercial judgment on real deal scenarios

 - Accuracy in pricing and margin models

 - Calm, clear decisions under end-of-quarter pressure

 - Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Legal

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You’d rather say “here’s how we can do it” than “no”

 - You enjoy a spreadsheet model as much as a live deal call

 - You want to build the playbook, not follow one

JOB DETAILS

 - Employment Type: Full-Time 1099 Contractor

 - Compensation: $4,200 USD monthly, based on experience

 - Location: Remote

 - Hours: Must be open to working some overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Strategic, Retail
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

ABOUT THE RETAIL TEAM

 - Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

 - Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

 - Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Go deep on a few accounts. Learn each customer's business well enough that you could be wearing their badge in their hallways

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Decide when to bring in Agent Development, Product, Security, Legal, and Sierra leaders, and what each of them needs to do. You keep everyone aimed at the same goal

 - Raise the bar for the SE team: mentor others, set standards for demos and pilots, and write the playbooks for Strategic deals and GTM processes

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Share what you see across your largest accounts with Product leadership and inform roadmap

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with Strategic customers with deal sizes of $1M+ consistently

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Strong experience in relationship-building with prospect stakeholders, including C-suite executives and technical leaders

 - Experience leading architecture, integration, and security discussions with enterprise architects, engineering leaders, and security teams

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale and defining customer roadmaps to facilitate growth

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience

EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product

OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time em

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Developers decide what infrastructure wins. They try three platforms in an afternoon, keep the one that got them to a working inference call fastest, and tell everyone else about it. As a Developer Advocate at Fireworks, you own a piece of that decision: you make Fireworks the platform developers reach for first when they want to build, fine-tune, and serve frontier open models in production. You do that by building things worth showing, not by talking about things other people built.

This role has a dual bar, and we mean both halves of it. You are a working engineer: you ship code, read diffs, deploy models, and can hold your own in a conversation about batching, quantization, or why a fine-tune regressed. You are also a public technical communicator: you write clearly enough that a senior engineer forwards it, you're good on a stage, and you have or want a real presence in the places developers actually argue about this stuff. Most people are strong at one and passable at the other. We're looking for the rarer profile who is genuinely credible at both, because in AI infrastructure the audience can tell within one paragraph whether you've actually run the thing.

The field moves weekly. A major open-weights model drops and the window to be the definitive resource on it is measured in days. Your job is to be one step ahead of that cadence, consistently, and to make it look repeatable rather than heroic.

This is one of the first advocate seats on the team, which means you'll help set the standards: for content, for launch response, and for how we show up. We're hiring at either the Senior or Staff level and will determine level through the interview process based on your experience.

This role is based in San Mateo, CA or London. You'll travel regularly to the conferences, hackathons, meetups, and partner events where the developer community shows up. Expect roughly 20% to 25% travel in a typical quarter, concentrated around major events and launches.

If you're based in London, you'll anchor our presence in the European developer community, work across time zones with a primarily US-based team, and travel periodically to our San Mateo HQ for onsites and planning.

Build things developers can run. Ship cookbooks, quickstarts, reference applications, and end-to-end tutorials that take a developer from zero to a working inference call and then to something production-shaped. Everything you publish is code someone can fork and run, not a screenshot of code that worked once on your machine. The bar is content a senior engineer respects and a new developer can follow, ideally both in the same artifact.

Own the launch response. When a significant model or technique lands, you're among the first credible voices with a working demo, an honest benchmark, and a "how to actually use this today" guide. You'll help build the internal loop (model access, eval harnesses, publishing paths) that makes day-one content a process rather than an all-nighter.

Show up where developers are, owned and unowned. On our properties, that's docs, blog, examples, cookbooks, Discord, and the developer newsletter. On properties we don't own, that's GitHub, X, Reddit, YouTube, Hacker News, and the open-source projects our developers depend on, including contributing code and reviewing PRs where it matters. You answer real questions in public and turn the recurring ones into permanent content.

Speak, teach, and run the room. Conference talks, hands-on workshops, hackathon mentoring, and developer dinners. You'll help decide where Fireworks shows up and what we say when we get there, and you'll build the material so the next person can deliver it without starting over.

Be the developer's voice inside Fireworks. Bring friction, feature gaps, and unmet needs back to product and engineering with evidence: a failing repro, a thread of five people hitting the same wall, a competitor's ergonomics that are simply better. Then close the loop publicly when we ship the fix.

Measure what you do. You'll instrument your own work: what content drove signups, which events produced developers who actually built something, where people fall out between first call and production. We care about adoption, activation, and time to first successful build. We do not care about impressions, booth scans, or attendance counts, and we won't ask you to report them.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR

jobs.title: Content Marketer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

You'll script, shoot and edit content clinic owners actually watch.

Your job is simple: get clinic owners to stop, watch, and want to talk to us.

That means turning what we're building, what our clinics are achieving, and what's changing in aesthetics and wellness into content people actually want to watch.

You'll script it, shoot it, edit it, post it, then look hard at what happened so the next piece is better.

Content is the core of this job, and most of your week.

The rest is helping Decoda show up everywhere else clinic owners are paying attention: industry conferences, press, and the moments that put us in front of the right people.

You'll get to know how clinic owners think, what frustrates them, and what makes them hit follow.

You'll use that to make content that feels like it was made for them, not for an algorithm.

When clinic owners are sharing our content, our ads are pulling in demos, and sales calls start with "I saw your video," you'll know you're doing great work.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Ship every week. We move fast and our content should too. You'll publish multiple pieces of short form video and social content every week across multiple channels. Live and learning beats perfect and sitting in drafts.

Make ads that earn the click. You'll build the creative behind our paid social: the hooks, the angles, the variants. You'll test them, read the results, and work with the team to scale what works and cut what doesn't. A good ad isn't one that looks nice; it's one that brings in clinics.

Turn what we build into stories. We ship products quickly, and you'll make sure the market feels it. When something launches, you'll turn demos and founder takes into content that makes clinic owners want it. A launch isn't real to the market until someone has made it worth watching.

Put our customers on camera. Hundreds of clinics run on Decoda, and their results are our best marketing. You'll find the stories worth telling and make them worth watching.

Know what's working. You'll track performance every week and form your own point of view from the numbers. Instinct gets you started; data tells you where to go next.

Own the calendar. You'll plan content around launches, customer wins and industry moments so we're never scrambling for what to post next.

Make Decoda show up in the room. You'll help us prepare for and run industry conferences, from booth content and materials to capturing everything on the ground. You'll also help pitch stories, support PR moments, and make sure every launch and customer win gets seen beyond our own channels. An event isn't done when the booth comes down; it's done when the content from it is live and working.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - A portfolio of content real people watched. Share it with your application

 - 1 to 3 years making content for a brand, startup or agency

 - Range. You can write the script, hold the camera, and cut the edit

 - Comfort on camera, or the willingness to get there fast

 - Experience with paid social creative, or a real hunger to learn how performance creative works

 - You check what worked and adjust

 - A bias for shipping. You publish, take feedback, and get better quickly

 - You're up for a mix. You'll go from editing a reel to packing for a conference to drafting a press pitch in the same week

 - You want to work hard. This is a small team moving fast, and the pace is high on purpose

 - Experience in aesthetics, wellness or healthcare is a plus, not a requirement

LOGISTICS

This role is based in Toronto and is in person. Some travel for conferences.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:

Make data a solved problem for every GPU workload at Fireworks. We own how data is stored, cached and moved across clouds, so that training and inference teams never have to think about where their data lives or how it gets to them, and no GPU ever waits on it.

In practice, that means building a unified, high-performance data layer that spans parallel file systems, object storage, distributed caches and key-value stores across multiple clouds. Datasets, checkpoints, model weights and KV cache should be in the right place at the right time, at whatever scale the GPUs need. Training jobs start without a data-staging step, inference replicas cold-start without waiting on weight downloads, and the system handles placement, replication and movement on its own.

Key Technical Archetypes:

 - We expect strong candidates to have gone deep in at least one of these areas and to be comfortable in the others:

 - The Storage Systems Builder: Has designed and shipped a storage system: a distributed file system, a blob/object store, a KV store, or a storage engine. They can explain the tradeoffs they made in consistency models, replication, erasure coding, metadata scaling, compaction and failure recovery, and why they made them.

 - The Caching Architect: Has built a distributed or tiered cache across memory, NVMe and remote storage. They think in hit rates, eviction policies, cache coherence, prefetching and tail latency. Bonus if they've worked on caching for model weights, datasets, checkpoints, or LLM KV cache offload.

 - The Linux Power User: Knows the system under the hood: kernel I/O paths, POSIX semantics, page cache behavior, io_uring/SPDK, and OS-level tuning (sysctl, I/O schedulers, NUMA).

 - The Network-As-Code Expert: Understands RDMA, RoCE v2, InfiniBand and GPUDirect Storage from a software and configuration perspective, because neoclouds often need manual plumbing.

Minimum qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

 - 5+ years of experience designing, building and operating storage, caching or data infrastructure in production at scale.

 - Strong software development skills in C/C++, Rust or Go, with experience writing performance-critical data path code. Python or Go for automation.

 - Deep understanding of distributed storage fundamentals: consistency models, replication and consensus (e.g., Raft/Paxos), metadata scaling, caching, and failure recovery.

 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including CSI, to mount high-performance volumes into ephemeral GPU pods.

 - Experience deploying and operating storage clusters (e.g., WEKA, VAST, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO) across clouds using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.

 - Proficiency with performance benchmarking and profiling tools (e.g., fio, iperf3, NCCL tests, perf, eBPF) to identify and resolve bottlenecks across the kernel, network, cache and storage backend.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience as a core contributor or owner of a storage, caching or KV system, either in-house or open source (e.g., Ceph, Alluxio, JuiceFS, RocksDB, FoundationDB, TiKV, Redis/Dragonfly, SeaweedFS, MinIO).

 - Experience with high-performance computing or large-scale AI clusters (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes GPU pools) and familiarity with AI I/O patterns such as checkpoint bursts, random dataset reads, and model-weight loading for inference cold starts.

 - Familiarity with Linux internals, including kernel I/O paths, POSIX semantics, page cache behavior, io_uring/SPDK, and OS-level tuning (sysctl, I/O schedulers, NUMA).
