jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Scientist works directly with and reports to the Head Scientist. Together you will choose what to study, design the studies, define how results are measured, interpret the findings, and write them up for internal decision-making and, where appropriate, for academic publication. You will bring current methodological training in computational social science, data science, survey-methodology, human-computation interaction, and experiment design.

Responsibilities 

 - Co-design and run studies that compare system-generated responses with responses from humans, using both qualitative and quantitative measures.

 - Design, justify, and hone measures of performance.

 - Apply and adapt state-of-the-art statistical techniques common to survey methodology and large-scale social data analysis, to benchmark and improve sample- and population-level simulation performance.

 - Design evaluations and experiments with pre-specified analysis plans.

 - Design and oversee human rating studies, including rater training, coding rubrics, and inter-rater agreement measurement.

 - Design data collection from third-party data sources and directly from human participants, including longitudinal and repeated-measures studies.

 - Contribute to the research agenda for new modeling approaches, including evaluation of fine-tuned models and of model calibration.

 - Specify analyses precisely enough for an engineer to implement.

 - Co-author papers, preprints, and presentations.

Qualifications

 - A completed or nearly completed PhD in computational social science, communication, HCI, sociology, political science, psychology, statistics, or a related field.

 - Peer-reviewed publications on which you were a primary author.

 - Working command of graduate-level statistical methodology common to social science, including the assumptions behind each.

 - Experience analyzing large-scale telemetry and behavioral datasets, with attention to the validity of the resulting inference.

 - Familiarity with machine learning, spanning classical, nonparametric, and LLM-based approaches, including how transformer-based language models work, what fine-tuning does, and how the major model families differ.

 - Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, and tabular data.

 - Ability to work in an environment where most code is produced through agentic coding tools, and to read and check that code.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on survey, experimental, or behavioral data.

 - Experience building or evaluating calibrated confidence or error-prediction models, including deriving decision thresholds from human judgments.

 - Experience measuring similarity of open-ended text, for example with embedding-based methods.

 - Experience designing or running panel-based data collection with human participants.

 - Experience presenting research at academic and/or industry conferences.

 - Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

 - Familiarity with the startup ecosystem

 - Familiarity with qualitative interviews and ethnographic methods

 - Familiarity with topics in computational linguistics

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right.

Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent-dense team where everyone is enabled to do the best work of their careers. No one can predict the future of insurance, so we're building it.

THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer. You'll build the platform that lets insurance teams put AI to work on real operations, and trust it when it matters. Your job is to find what the platform needs next and build it.

Our forward-deployed engineers run customer deployments on top of the platform. You build the platform itself. Working closely with them, design, and customers, you'll spot the hard problems that keep coming up and turn them into product: the smallest version that creates value now and extends cleanly later.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Shape the product from the start. You come in early, working with customers, design, and product strategy to decide what gets built and why, not picking up tickets after the decisions are made.

 - Build the rails insurance will run on. From public chat interfaces where claimants report and follow their claims, to branded portals our largest carrier customers host on Avallon, you build the surfaces the industry will soon run on.

 - Help teams confidently automate more. Build clear, auditable claim context and the experiences that let people review and approve agent work, giving teams control where it matters and letting them expand automation with confidence.

 - Own it end to end, in production. Build the whole flow yourself, from data model to backend to interface, then own how it performs: instrument it, watch how real users move through it in Datadog RUM, and keep pushing it as more teams rely on it.

The work is broad, and your impact will grow wherever the platform needs you most. You will take on a meaningful challenge, ship it quickly, watch what changes in production, and go again.

YOU

 - You have 3+ years building and owning meaningful software in production. You can point to a difficult challenge you solved or a system you built that changed what was possible, explain the judgment behind it, and answer for the outcome once it was live.

 - You are a full-stack product engineer who builds whole flows yourself. TypeScript and SQL are your working tools; you design the data model and backend as readily as the interface on top of it. You work closely with design and product strategy, have opinions about what to build, and can explain them clearly. This is not a frontend-only role.

 - You have built and operated LLM- or agent-powered products in production, and understand the challenges of making them reliable at scale.

 - You want to be in the room. This role is in person in New York.
 
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - You know insurance, claims, or another regulated operational domain where reliability and traceability matter.

 - You have worked as a product manager, or owned product decisions and roadmap in a similar role.

 - You have worked at an early-stage company.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FINNY

FINNY is a growth platform for financial advisors. We are on a mission to make great financial advice easier to find. Today, access to quality financial guidance is limited, not because advisors don't exist, but because the right connections are hard to make when it matters. We're fixing that with AI-powered tools that help advisors find, engage, and retain the clients they can genuinely help.

 

We've raised a $4.5M Seed from Y-Combinator in S24 and now $17M Series A led by Venrock. We work with over 1,000 firms across the wealth management ecosystem, and have been recognized as the leader in fintech innovation—winning #1 at the Morningstar Fintech Showcase, #1 at 2026 Wealthies, and being featured across the industry.

 

We're based in Chelsea, NYC, building fast and ambitious systems at the intersection of data, AI, and real-world wealth services.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

 

You'll join FINNY Engineering and report to our VP of Engineering. The team today is product and backend engineers and a data team. You'll be our first analytics engineer, building the foundation of the company's analytics warehouse on dbt Core and Snowflake.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

FINNY is a metrics-driven company. Until now, our analytics warehouse has been a shared role, divided across several teams. We're bringing it together in a new structure, on a new foundation, and we're hiring a senior Analytics Engineer to own it end to end: the models, the definitions of the metrics the company runs on, and the reports people trust.

 

You'll work directly with operations, sales, marketing, growth strategy, finance, product and engineering. Success looks like: the metrics the company runs on have tested definitions, a small set of reports is the first place people look, AI tools answer questions about those metrics correctly, and every key business area is covered to the same standard. As the data team grows, you'll help hire and lead it.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the analytics warehouse day to day: staging and core models, dimensions, facts and identity resolution across our systems

 - Define the metrics FINNY runs on, with tests and documentation, so every team works from the same numbers

 - Partner with internal stakeholders across the company to turn their questions into models and reports they use

 - Own the BI layer: choose the tool and semantic layer, and keep a small set of authoritative reports

 - Make the warehouse something AI tools can answer from correctly

 - Run the dbt project like software: version control, code review, CI, tests and documentation

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Typically 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or analytics, including owning models that other teams relied on

 - Strong SQL and dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, conformed keys, and a clear grain for every table

 - dbt (or an equivalent tool) in production, with git, tests and CI

 - You've defined business metrics people used to make decisions, and fixed the cause when two numbers disagreed

 - You work directly with non-technical partners and turn vague questions into clear answers—and say "not yet" with a reason

 - Scrappy, with ownership: you jump in where help is needed, including work outside your job description

 - You're excited to work in person, 5 days a week, in our Chelsea, NYC office

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - First or early data hire at a startup

 - Modeled complex pricing, billing, subscription or usage data

 - Made data usable by AI agents: documentation, a semantic layer, guardrails

 - Event analytics (PostHog or similar) and CRM data

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

FINNY offers a competitive compensation package including:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexible paid time off

 - 401(k)

 - Food and meals provided in our NYC office

 - Team offsites and events

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

FINNY is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

TECH PROFILE

 - Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

 - Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

 - Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

 - Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
 experiment and iterate.

 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
 cause of issues.

MUST HAVE

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
 technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
 tight deadlines.

 - Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
 propose solutions.

 - Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
 action.

 - Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

WHY JOIN US?

 - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re looking for an Account Executive, CPG / Food & Beverage to lead Outset’s growth with consumer packaged goods and food & beverage companies.

Your primary buyers are Market Research and Consumer Insights teams. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer teams, and you’ll bring a deep understanding of how CPG companies operate, plan, and buy research. Depending on your expertise, there’s also an opportunity to focus on multiple verticals—for example, pairing CPG with Retail.

Responsibilities

 - Land new logos and grow existing customers across brands, categories, and regions—turning a single team’s adoption into a portfolio-wide relationship.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager,  Core Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT OVERVIEW

Overview.ai http://Overview.ai is transforming manufacturing quality control with an advanced edge-enabled AI vision system that combines cutting-edge deep learning with ease of use and quick setup. Our system handles a wide array of inspection tasks—from subtle assembly verification to defect detection and orientation checks—delivering real-time, high-accuracy inspections that seamlessly integrate into existing production lines.

Trusted by leading manufacturers like SpaceX, Tesla, Toyota, Ford, and Honda, our cameras enable faster throughput, reduced scrap, and lower inspection costs—without the complexity and expense of traditional vision systems.

As our engineering organization continues to grow, we are seeking Engineering Managers to lead teams that build the core product platform. You will oversee execution of the technical roadmap for core products and manage the team to deliver world-class industrial AI products. This is a hands-on leadership role with high visibility and significant impact on the future of our products and engineering organization. To be effective in this role, you should have a strong technical background and be comfortable diving deeply into technical details and understanding complex systems, while effectively managing a team of engineers to drive towards goals.

ABOUT THE TEAM

This team owns everything the customer sees and touches: from the frontend application that is the entire user interface of the product, to the backend business logic that runs the inspections behind it. The full stack of the user's experience, end to end. This team builds how an operator sets up an inspection, how a quality engineer reads the result, and how the interfaces work reliably in a 24/7 mission-critical manufacturing environment. Taipei is our product engineering hub and you will be working alongside embedded engineering teams and AI/ML teams.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

The roadmap for your layer. Work with product and engineering leadership to turn company priorities into a sequenced plan your team can execute, and push back when the sequence does not hold up.

Releases people can trust. Own the release process for your components: sprint cadence, branch and release structure, test gates in GitHub Actions, and the discipline that keeps a regression from reaching a customer's line.

Performance and robustness as standing work. Memory behavior, startup time, long-run stability and graceful degradation. You will define what good looks like here and build the practices that hold it.

The field loop. Talk to customers directly and turn what you learn into engineering priorities. You will triage them, protect your engineers' focus, and turn recurring field problems into product fixes.

Hiring and growing the team. Set the hiring standard, run the interview loop, and develop the engineers on your team.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Have led software engineering teams — hiring, coaching, performance management — on top of a strong record shipping product-oriented software

 - Deep experience in one area of our stack, React, Python, Go, and fluent enough in the others to review work in both

 - Care about reliability in a way that shows up in process rather than in principle, and have chased down the failure that only appears after days of continuous runtime.

 - Have built release structure and sprint cadence rather than inherited someone else's.

 - Have real instincts about interfaces, and can tell in review when a screen will confuse an operator standing on a factory floor.

 - Want to work on physical AI, where the output of your software is a decision about a real part on a real line, right now.

 - Work in Mandarin and English at a professional level

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience working on applications and software that runs on edge hardware

 - Experience working with AI/ML pipelines

LOGISTICS

Location. Taipei

Compensation. Competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Work authorization. We sponsor work authorization in Taiwan, and support Employment Gold Card applications for candidates relocating here.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; there is no deadline.

jobs.title: Content Lead - Kraken Pro
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions. We offer spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, built for individual investors and institutions alike.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. Our audience is skeptical, technical, and quick to tune out anything that feels like marketing, so our content has to earn its attention.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Content Lead who can write the script, nail the headline, and shape the email in the same week. This is a broad, hands-on role across Kraken Pro: organic posts, organic and paid video, campaign copy, and email. You'll set the voice for how we talk to traders and make sure everything we put out sounds like it was made by people who trade.

 - Write for every format. Scripts for organic and paid video, copy for organic posts, and the occasional longer piece when an idea needs room.

 - Own the idea, not just the words. Turn a brief into a concept traders would actually watch or read, then carry it through to the final cut or the send button.

 - Run campaign copy end to end. Headlines, ad copy, landing pages, and email campaigns, from product launches to trader lifecycle journeys.

 - Translate the Kraken Pro voice into words and dialogue. Sharp, credible, never salesy. Make order types, funding rates, and liquidity clear without dumbing them down.

 - Move at market speed. Turn around reactive content for volatility, listings, and launches, with clear sign-off so speed never costs accuracy.

 - Partner across the business. Work with Social, Community, Video, Design, Product, and Marketing, plus the traders and product experts who know the platform best.

 - Increase and improve output by actively integrating AI wherever it helps. Ideation, drafts, repurposing. Faster output, same voice.

 - Learn from the numbers. Track what gets watched, opened, clicked, and converted. Double down on what works and drop what doesn't.

 - Ship responsibly. Work with Legal and Compliance so everything we publish is accurate and compliant across regions.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Receipts. A portfolio of scripts, campaigns, and emails that performed. We care more about what the work did than who it was for.

 - 4+ years in content, copywriting, or social-first marketing in fintech, crypto, or trading, and comfortable owning the work end to end.

 - You speak market. Funding rates, order types, liquidity, volatility. You can make them watchable and readable without dumbing them down.

 - Range. You know a punchy video hook, a scroll-stopping post, and a high-performing email are different crafts, and you can do all three well.

 - A campaign brain. You can go from brief to concept to execution, and explain why an idea works in two sentences.

 - Channel fluency. You know how YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and the inbox each reward content, and you write for them, not around them.

 - Speed and judgment. Markets don't wait. You know when something can ship now and when it needs a second pair of eyes.

 - High AI competency. You use it to move faster and make better work, not just more of it.

 - Thick skin. You've made content for traders who are quick to call out anything that feels like marketing.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

Role Overview

At its core, this role is about deploying our vision inspection systems onto customer production lines, commissioning them, and keeping them running reliably, while guiding customers on how to use them correctly. The work is primarily on the factory floor. Under the guidance of senior engineers, you will take part in on-site installation and debugging, handle image capture, lighting and lens adjustment, AI model data collection and optimization, and solution validation, and support customer training and project delivery. As you gain experience, you will gradually take independent ownership of on-site projects.

We are looking for someone with a solid engineering foundation and some working knowledge of vision inspection and automation, a strong ability to learn, and the initiative to analyze and resolve issues on site. Candidates who already have some advanced knowledge and want to keep growing in a real production-line environment are especially welcome.

Key Responsibilities

 - Handle on-site installation, debugging, and maintenance of vision systems at customer factories.

 - Adjust cameras, lenses, and lighting, capture images, and tune inspection performance to a production-ready level.

 - Support AI model data collection and optimization, and complete system deployment following standard processes.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve on-site vision, networking, and automation issues, working independently and escalating promptly when needed.

 - Train the customer's operations and quality staff on daily use and basic troubleshooting.

 - Keep thorough on-site records and organize each project's configuration and know-how into reusable references.

Requirements

 - Associate degree (大专) or above in Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, Robotics & Automation, or a related field.

 - Some understanding of machine vision or automation (basic to intermediate); relevant internship or project experience is a plus.

 - Strong hands-on ability, willing to be based at factory sites and travel as needed, and comfortable working in an on-site environment.

 - Strong ability to learn, proactive in working through problems, and open to asking questions and learning.

 - Strong sense of responsibility, well-organized, and able to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.

 - Mandarin is the working language; willingness to gradually learn and improve English (English is used frequently in team collaboration and technical materials).

Nice to Have

 - Experience with industrial cameras, lighting, or lens setup, or exposure to PLCs, sensors, and industrial networking.

 - Production-line experience in industries such as electronics, automotive, connectors, batteries, or packaging.

 - Able to read English technical documentation and hold a basic conversation.

What We Offer

 - Structured onboarding training, followed by one-on-one mentorship from a senior engineer to help you get up to speed quickly.

 - Hands-on experience on real production lines, taking part in complete projects and building solid field expertise.

 - A clear growth path: from contributing to projects, to independently owning on-site deployments, to handling more complex solutions.

jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description:
CAN YOU HELP US FIX THE WORLD'S MOST BROKEN SUPPLY CHAIN?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the role:

An indispensable component of Clipboard's marketplace is its workplace customers. The Account Manager ensures the continued success of the partnership between Clipboard and its workplace partners, working to deliver an optimal experience at every level of their organizations. The job encompasses being a resource to workplaces when issues arise, liaising with building- and corporate-level contacts, and keeping abreast of a litany of important business metrics for each account. 

Your week will be balanced between high-touch customer engagement and internal account strategy, with a laser focus on net revenue retention. You are an avid problem-solver, a strategic communicator, and a diligent executor who can navigate complex relationships to sharpen your business acumen.

Responsibilities:

 - Manage & grow your portfolio: Own a book of business with accountability for "Same-Store Shift Postings" (SSSP, which measures utilization) and "Same-Store Net Revenue" (SSNR, which measures profitability). In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion.

 - Strategic account planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability.

 - Drive executive value: Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.

 - Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.

 - Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.

Beyond the basics, what will make you successful:

 - Extreme ownership: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.

 - Extreme curiosity: You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause.

 - Scrappiness: You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress. You bring solutions instead of asking ‘what should I do?’

 - Fast-paced: You thrive on moving quickly and are highly adaptable to a market that evolves quickly.

Our interview process:

 1. Application (where you are now!)

 2. Case study

 3. Interview 1 with a hiring manager

 4. Interview 2 with Head of Account Management

 5. Culture chat with a partner on our People Team

Why a case study first? 

Since this role is remote and requires a high degree of autonomy, the case study helps us understand how you operate in an asynchronous environment. Specifically, we’re looking at how you interpret written context, navigate ambiguity, and identify opportunities independently. This ensures our first conversation is grounded in your actual work style rather than just a resume walkthrough.

Qualifications:

 - Relationship management experience not required but strongly preferred

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 - Willingness to try / lack of fear

 - Bachelor's Degree

Benefits:

 - Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

 - Competitive pay

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Fully Remote

#LI-DNI

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US · 50% travel

ABOUT FLAI

AI has transformed B2B SaaS, but it has struggled to reach the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native service CRM for car dealerships.

Auto dealerships are a $1.3 trillion industry and sell 96% of the 16 million new cars sold each year. Yet they still run on outdated systems and manual processes, and they spend $36B a year on operations. That’s our opportunity.

Flai is live in many hundreds of dealerships across the U.S., including more than 20% of the top 50 dealer groups. We work closely with OEMs and distributors too, and Toyota Ventures is one of our largest investors. We’ve raised over $33M from leading VCs, including First Round Capital, Toyota Ventures, Y Combinator, Innovation Endeavors, SV Angel and Liquid 2.

We’ve grown very fast with a small, scrappy team, and we keep moving at that pace.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring an Implementation Manager to own the moment a dealership goes from signed to live on Flai. You’ll be in stores more weeks than not. You’ll connect Flai to the DMS, configure our AI for how each service department actually runs, train advisors, techs, and BDC teams, and stand on the service drive on launch day. You’ll work directly with the founding team. Each launch you run will feed into how we roll out across hundreds of new rooftops and OEM programs.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own launches end to end: Run every go-live from kickoff to hand-off, across single rooftops and multi-store groups. You own the timeline, the integrations, the configuration, the training and launch day itself.

 - Be on-site when it matters: Travel to dealerships for go-lives, training and post-launch tune-ups. Get to know the service drive, the BDC and the people who run them.

 - Make the integrations work: Coordinate DMS and scheduler connections (Tekion, CDK, Reynolds, Dealertrack, Xtime, Dealer-FX, myKaarma and others), along with phone systems and data mapping. Troubleshoot alongside engineering until everything runs cleanly.

 - Configure Flai for each store: Turn each dealership’s hours, menus, op codes, routing rules and appointment workflow into a setup that works on day one.

 - Train for adoption, not attendance: Train service advisors, BDC agents, service managers and fixed ops directors until Flai is part of how they work every day.

 - Hit launch metrics: Own time-to-live, early adoption, and first-30-day results.

 - Hand off cleanly: Pass healthy, live accounts to Customer Success with clear notes, open items and a baseline of results.

 - Scale group and OEM rollouts: Plan and run phased rollouts across dealer groups and OEM-backed programs. Sequence stores, coordinate stakeholders and keep a dozen launches moving at once.

 - Sharpen the playbook: Follow Flai’s implementation process rigorously, and help improve it based on what you learn in each store.

 - Feed the product team: Bring back what you see in dealerships, such as integration gaps, workflow edge cases and recurring requests, so it shapes what we build next.

MUST HAVE

 - Dealer implementation experience: 3+ years launching software in dealerships, ideally service-side: schedulers, DMS, or service lane tools.

 - Fixed ops fluency: You know how a service department runs, from the appointment to the write-up to the RO, and you can speak advisors’ language. Dealership experience is a big plus.

 - Willing to travel: You’re comfortable traveling >50% of the time, often on short notice, to dealerships across the U.S.

 - Technical comfort: You’re at ease with integrations, data mapping, configuration and troubleshooting, and you can work productively with engineers.

 - Project discipline: You keep timelines tight, track every open item and manage several launches at once without anything slipping.

 - Strong trainer and communicator: You can command a room of advisors at 7am, run a clean kickoff with a GM, and write follow-ups people actually read.

 - High ownership: A launch isn’t done until the store is using Flai and seeing results. You stay on it until then.

 - Excited to be early: You want to help build something at its earliest stage and are energized by a process that’s still evolving.

WHY FLAI

This is about as early as it gets. We have real traction, customers who love the product, and investors who’ve backed some of the best companies in the world betting big on us. You’ll be part of one of the most exciting build-outs in AI right now, in an industry that’s about to look completely different because of what we’re building. The launches you run over the next 12 months will set the standard for how Flai goes live in every store after them. We move fast and we have fun doing it. Come be part of the story while it’s still being written.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - $80k-130k OTE depending on experience

 - Equity

 - Travel expenses covered

 - Full benefits including medical, dental and vision

 - Flexible PTO

 - A small, high-trust, fast-moving team that has a good time building something real

jobs.title: Deal Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAMPFIRE

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

THE ROLE

You'll own how Campfire makes money on every deal. Pricing strategy, deal structuring, partner economics, and the systems that make it all repeatable. You'll model a deal like you're underwriting it, then write the code that makes the next hundred deals faster.

You'll work directly with sales leadership, legal, finance, and business operations, and you'll have real authority to say yes, no, and "here's a better structure."

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Crack the hard deals. Structure and approve non-standard deals: multi-year ramps, discounts, buyouts, swaps, implementation fees, and payment terms. Turn messy asks from AEs into clean, defensible structures fast.

 - Own pricing strategy. Build and evolve our packaging and price book. Move us toward value-based pricing grounded in the outcomes customers actually get.

 - Price what we ship next. Own unit economics for each product, and build the business case and pricing for new products and AI features before they launch.

 - Write the rules. Own the discount and approval policy: who can approve what, which exceptions escalate, and the playbook that lets AEs move fast without giving away margin.

 - Price partnerships. Model the economics of channel and platform deals, like fund administrators running their clients on Campfire, and make sure we capture our share of the value we create.

 - Underwrite every deal. Build models for margin, payback, LTV, and the downstream impact on ARR, bookings, and quota credit. Know which deals to fight for and which to walk from.

 - Build the machine. Build the systems and automations that power quoting, approvals, and deal analytics across our CRM and our internal tools. If it's manual twice, you automate it.

 - Be the commercial brain in the room. Partner with sales on contract terms and live negotiations.

WHO YOU ARE

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've built impressive things from an unusual starting point, we want to hear from you.

 - Investor-trained. 2-4 years in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, strategic finance, or a related finance function, with experience at a high-growth technology company a plus. You think in returns, downside cases, and term sheets.

 - AI-native in how you work. You already use tools like Claude Code to build models, automate analysis, and get more done than a team twice your size. You're comfortable building and have shipped something real: a model, a pipeline, a tool people used.

 - Intellectually sharp. You find the flaw in a structure before anyone else does, and you can explain it in one sentence.

 - A clear communicator. You can walk leadership or the board through a complex deal or pricing change and leave them with a decision, not a spreadsheet.

 - Extreme ownership. You treat Campfire's revenue like your own money. You're the person who stays on the deal until it's right, and who people trust with the hardest calls.

 - Fast and decisive. You'd rather make a good call today than a perfect one next week, and you own the outcome either way.

 - Precise. Fast doesn’t mean sloppy. Pricing mistakes compound across every renewal, so you check the math and get the details right.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook yet. You'll write it.

WHY THIS ROLE

 - Direct line to leadership. You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.

 - Real leverage. Your code and your judgment compound across every deal we sign.

 4. If your challenge solution meets our bar, you'll receive an offer to join Teleport.
 
 

Why Teleport

You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

jobs.title: Research Fellow
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABUNDANT

AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data. NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience.

 

Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers.

 

Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience.

 

What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. What’s missing? The data necessary to move from general knowledge to domain expertise; from chatbots to agents; and from text to multimodal and physical AI. Ask any AI researcher or roboticist: the core bottleneck to progress is the availability of data, hence “abundant data”.

 

Abundant works with a majority of the top AI labs, as well as frontier startups and F500 enterprises.

 

THE ROLE

As a Research Intern you will work directly with Abundant's founding team to architect the next generation of model reasoning and intelligence. Over the course of 12 weeks, you will be paired with a mentor who will work with you on your proposal. Your fellowship will culminate in submitting your research to a major conference for review. You should be able to commit at least 20 hours a week to this program.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive Foundational Research & Execution: Architect and execute a core research agenda to discover simple, generalizable ideas that advance model reasoning and intelligence at scale. This includes owning the full research-to-production lifecycle and ensuring rapid deployment of your work in live systems.

 - Build life-long friendships: Meet other researchers who share your interests, both within the program and at our weekly meetups exclusively for Abundant Fellows.

 - Model Alignment & Data Strategy: Partner with the world's most advanced AI research teams to design, engineer, and iterate on high-impact datasets and large-scale benchmarking efforts that shape how frontier models behave, specifically focusing on critical alignment, safety, and defining optimal reward signals.

 - Autonomous Problem Selection: Autonomously identify, scope, and manage long-running research projects, choosing the most impactful problems that are critical to scaling data for AGI/ASI.

 - System Infrastructure: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on data pipelines, internal tooling, and high-performance deep learning algorithm implementations.

WHO YOU ARE

 - Exceptional Research Depth & Strategic Vision: Research expertise in a related field (e.g., CS, ML, NLP) ideally with that work published at a major conference (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). You must possess the velocity to master complex fields and a proven track record in the productization of research, encompassing high-stakes evaluation, large-scale benchmarking, and product feature development.
 
 - Proven experience shipping research directly to production and live systems, specifically focusing on advanced post-training, distillation, and high-stakes evaluation methodologies.
 
 - Large-scale agent systems: orchestration frameworks, tool APIs, distributed execution, observability, and logging infrastructure.

 - Strategic & Ethical Leadership: You possess a thoughtful, strategic perspective on the societal and safety impacts of deploying general-purpose AI systems. Experience advising on or shaping governmental policy related to AI safety and governance (e.g., House of Lords or Online Safety Bill initiatives) is required.
 
 

COMPENSATION

Base Salary

$7500/month

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Deployment Strategist, your mission is to connect the dots between user needs, data insights, and product capabilities to help our customers unlock value. You’ll dive deep into our customer operations, partner directly with end users and decision-makers, and shape how HappyRobot’s technology is applied to their most critical challenges.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You Will Do

 - Partnering with customers to understand their workflows, goals, and pain points—often embedding directly with their teams.

 - Collaborating with Forward Deployment Engineers to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions powered by HappyRobot’s platform.

 - Identifying and interpreting key datasets that drive customer decision-making, and working to integrate them into robust, scalable pipelines.

 - Designing and refining user workflows that solve meaningful problems and scale across teams and functions.

 - Leading training and onboarding sessions, ensuring new users are set up for success and our tools have lasting impact.

 - Presenting findings and strategy to stakeholders at all levels—from frontline operators to executives.

 - Driving customer expansion by scoping new use cases and shaping how we grow our footprint within organizations.
 
 

WHY JOIN US?

 - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

WHO WE ARE:

We're a team of hardcore engineers who live and breathe aerospace. We’re generalists who each have subject matter expertise and operate in a flat organizational structure. We move fast and build world-changing technology in a pragmatic and competent workplace culture.

WHO YOU ARE:

You’re a mechanical design engineer who takes full ownership of hardware from concept to production, and you understand how your designs affect the systems around them. You solve technical problems from first principles, and you’d rather build and test than theorize. You might come from aerospace, automotive, motorsport, robotics, energy, industrial machinery, or another field where hardware has to perform under real loads, temperatures, and pressures. Prior propulsion experience is a plus but not required. We’ll teach you the engine; we’re hiring for design judgment and hands-on rigor.

At Astro Mechanica, you’ll design hardware for Duality™, our jet engine built to be efficient from takeoff through supersonic flight. WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the mechanical design of engine components and subsystems, from trade studies through detailed design and release

 - Weigh system-level impacts in your design trades, working closely with the propulsion, aircraft, and test teams

 - Complete detailed design and support structural, thermal, and fluid analyses

 - Present design reviews and use feedback from stakeholders to strengthen your designs

 - Assemble prototypes firsthand, design supporting tooling, and write work instructions

 - Test hardware and analyze the data to verify requirements and performance

 - Diagnose hardware problems quickly and drive corrective actions
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 3+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, taking hardware from concept through build and test

 - Proficiency in solid, surface, and sheet metal CAD modeling in a major CAD package (Siemens NX preferred; we’ll support your transition from CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks)

 - Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, including machining, additive, and sheet metal, along with precision measurement and GD&T

 - A working understanding of structural analysis, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics

 - A track record of designing parts that got built, tested, and improved based on what the tests showed

 - Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities change as test results come in

 - High standards for detail and quality in your work
 
 

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with propulsion systems, such as gas turbines, rocket engines, or other turbomachinery

 - Experience with high-temperature, high-speed rotating, or pressurized hardware

 - Familiarity with data acquisition and instrumentation

 - Exposure to electromechanical systems or power electronics integration

 - Experience with flight hardware or qualification testing

PERKS AND BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment 

 - Company-funded perks, including weekly team lunches and Astro Mechanica swag

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken is on a mission to build the most trusted bridge between crypto and traditional finance. The Financial Systems Engineering team connects activity across products, payments, banking, and digital assets to the data, ledgers, controls, and applications Finance relies on. Our engineers bring expertise in data engineering, complex transaction flows, financial systems, and reconciliation. We partner with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Product, Risk, Security, Compliance, and platform engineering to make financial data reliable, explainable, and auditable.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Report to the CFO and lead the engineering vision for Kraken’s financial systems, translating Finance priorities into a clear technical strategy and delivery roadmap

 - Assess the current landscape, including fragmented data, processes, and technical debt. Define a target architecture and phased transformation plan based on evidence, business needs, and sound engineering judgment

 - Lead, coach, and grow a team of specialists across financial systems, data engineering, integrations, and ledger-related services. Establish clear ownership and develop technical leaders

 - Set standards for the completeness, quality, lineage, and ownership of financial data, from source events through transaction and balance records, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting

 - Contribute to architecture decisions for ledgers, subledgers, financial data models, APIs, and integrations across fiat and crypto activity. Determine what should be standardized and where distinct product flows need governed treatment

 - Partner with Accounting and Treasury to improve account and legal entity attribution, financial controls, reconciliation, exception handling, and the traceability of records across internal and external systems

 - Lead modernization and migration without disrupting close, reporting, fund movements, or other critical Finance operations. Define validation checkpoints and criteria for retiring legacy processes and systems

 - Establish end-to-end testing, documentation, observability, release controls, and incident response practices that account for the financial impact of upstream changes

 - Partner with Product, platform engineering, Risk, Security, Compliance, Tax, and Legal on system boundaries, access controls, resilience, regulatory needs, and auditability

 - Evaluate build, buy, and integration options; review consequential designs; and communicate architectural decisions, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to Finance and Engineering leaders

WHAT YOU WILL TACKLE FIRST

In your first year, you’ll build the foundations for a more reliable, scalable Finance architecture:

 - Move key reconciliations from a monthly to a daily cadence, with clear ownership and a process for resolving exceptions

 - Reduce the time needed to find the root cause of reconciliation breaks from weeks to days

 - Map and validate the source tables and transformations that actually feed financial statements, establishing lineage and ownership

 - Complete the UAT data lake connections needed to test financial data flows end to end before changes reach production

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Significant software engineering and technical leadership experience, including leading experienced teams through complex financial systems or data architecture change

 - A strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing specialists while creating clear ownership, high engineering standards, and effective cross-functional partnerships

 - Deep understanding of ledgers, subledgers, double-entry concepts, reconciliation, settlement, and the path from an operational event to an auditable financial record

 - Experience with crypto or digital asset infrastructure and the challenges of connecting on-chain activity, internal balances, custody or wallet flows, and traditional financial systems

 - Strong technical judgment in distributed systems, data engineering, APIs, event-driven processing, and integrations across complex platforms

 - Experience defining a target architecture and delivering a transformation roadmap across fragmented or legacy systems while sustaining production reliability

 - Experience designing for data completeness, accuracy, lineage, reconciliation, access control, and auditability

 - Sound judgment in production operations, including incident response, monitoring, debugging, change management, and reliability improvements

 - Ability to partner with senior Finance and Engineering leaders and translate financial, operational, and control needs into a practical engineering roadmap

 - Ability to lead experts and make informed architecture decisions without needing to be the deepest specialist in every domain; clear communication of priorities and tradeoffs to executives and technical teams

 - Experience with Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, or Python; finance applications such as NetSuite, Kyriba, or BlackLine; and SOX or SOC control environments is valuable

jobs.title: Director, Text-to-Speech Synthesis Research
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.

 - Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.

 - Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.

 - Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains why models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.

 - Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.

 - Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.
 

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.

 - Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.

 - Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.

 - Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.
 

YOU MUST HAVE

 - Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.

 - Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.

 - A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.

 - Experience leading researchers and research engineers through other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.

 - AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.

 - The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.
 

IT'D BE GREAT IF YOU HAD

 - TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.

 - Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.

 - Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.

 - Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.

 - Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

As we have continued to expand, we want to meet the industry where it gathers. As a Field Marketer, you'll be Clipboard's face on the conference circuit in 2027. That means attending nearly every major Post Acute conference, trade show, and association event in the country. You'll work the floor, start conversations with agency owners and operators, qualify opportunities, and turn those conversations into pipeline and revenue.

This is a travel role. Expect to be on the road about 80% of the time. If living out of a suitcase sounds like a burden, this isn't the right role for you. If it sounds like an adventure and a big advantage in building a sales career, read on.

What You’ll Do
