jobs.title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast in a highly complex environment, with international exposure and constant learning.

What you’ll be doing

 - Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries and support the monthly close of the group’s entities across more than one geography, following the calendar and routines defined by the team.

 - Reconciliations: Perform bank, general ledger, and customer balance reconciliations, identifying differences and supporting the investigation and resolution of open items.

 - Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and validation of documents and reports to local regulators (such as CADOCs to the Central Bank in Brazil), together with the senior team.

 - Financial Statements: Support the preparation of trial balances and financial statements for the group’s entities, including notes to the financial statements, and assist with requests from the local external audits and the consolidated audit.

 - Tax Obligations & Intercompany: Support accounting-to-tax reconciliations, tax and withholding tracking, and the recording of intercompany transactions between group entities.

 - Local Accounting Standards & Consolidation: Support the understanding of differences between each country’s accounting practices (such as Brazilian GAAP/CPC, US GAAP, and IFRS) and the preparation of information for the group consolidation.

 - Process Improvement: Help document routines and identify automation opportunities, working with Finance, Product, and Data.

What you’ll need

 - Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (final year or completed)

 - 1 to 2 years of experience in accounting or controllership (internships count)

 - Basic knowledge of statutory accounting and Brazilian accounting practices (CPC)

 - Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

 - Organization, attention to detail, and commitment to deadlines

 - Eagerness to learn and to work at a fast pace

 - Intermediate English

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience in a financial institution, fintech, consulting, or audit

 - Familiarity with COSIF, CADOC, and Central Bank regulation

 - Familiarity with US GAAP, IFRS, or accounting in other Latin American countries

 - Familiarity with accounting ERPs and data tools (SQL, Power BI)

 - Knowledge of payments, FX, or digital asset products

 - Postgraduate degree, MBA, or certifications in progress (CRC, IFRS)

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAMPFIRE

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

THE ROLE

You'll own the business behind the business. You'll be the person leadership sends in on Campfire's highest-stakes problems, including ones nobody here has solved before. You'll get problems, not tasks, and you'll be expected to take them from "this is a mess" to "this runs itself." You'll work directly with every team at Campfire, and you'll have the authority to make decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The operating rhythm. Help build and run the planning, goal-setting, and metrics cadence the company runs on. Make sure every team knows the number they own and whether they're hitting it.

 - The numbers leadership trusts. Set the definitions for every core metric, then own the reporting for ARR, pipeline, bookings, retention, and spend. When the founders or the board ask a question, you have the answer, pulled straight from the raw data yourself.

 - Commercial contracts and vendors. Run vendor negotiations and renewals, manage the contract lifecycle with legal, and make sure we never auto-renew something we don't need.

 - Sales and GTM operations. Own CRM configuration, territory and quota planning, and the mechanics of how reps get paid. Make the sales team faster without letting the data get messy.

 - The company's infrastructure. Insurance, office and real estate, compliance, and the systems that keep a growing company running. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

 - Special projects that matter. New market launches, partnerships, monetization and packaging work alongside our pricing lead, board prep. You'll take new initiatives from zero to one. When something important doesn't have an owner yet, it lands with you.

 - Automation over headcount. If a process runs on spreadsheets and goodwill, rebuild it with code, AI, and the right tools so it scales without adding people.

WHO YOU ARE

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've owned hard problems end to end and have the results to show for it, we want to hear from you.

 - An owner, not a coordinator. 2-4 years in business operations, top-tier consulting, banking, VC or PE, or founding a startup. You've been the person things roll up to.

 - Analytical to the core. You're excellent in spreadsheets and you build models that hold up to scrutiny - you can tell the story behind the numbers.

 - AI-native in how you work. You already use tools like Claude Code to automate work, build internal tools, and get more done than a team twice your size.

 - Commercially sharp. You can read a contract, spot the bad clause, and negotiate a better deal with a vendor.

 - A clear communicator. You can walk leadership or the board through a messy problem and leave them with a decision, and you're just as effective working alongside an AE or a support rep.

 - Relentless follow-through. You close loops. When you say something will get done, it gets done, and people stop checking.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. Half of this job doesn't exist yet. You'll define it.

WHY THIS ROLE

 - Direct line to leadership. You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.

 - Breadth you won't find elsewhere. Finance, sales, legal, and operations all cross your desk. It's a launchpad into leadership and the fastest path to running a business yourself.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLEARLY AI

Most security teams review what they can, triaging a backlog by urgency and headcount while products ship without review. Clearly AI is the continuous threat modeling platform that gives security, privacy, and GRC teams the capacity to cover more, with accurate, source-cited assessments that enterprise teams trust.

We're live with Fortune 500s and global brands including Rivian, Ericsson, HID Global, PayPal, and others. We've reviewed thousands of security-critical products, from badge scanners to stablecoin platforms to autonomous driving features.

Backed by Y Combinator, Basis Set Ventures, Crosspoint Capital, Argon Ventures, and Ritual Capital. Selected as a Top 10 Finalist for the RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox Contest. Advised by former CISOs of Disney, Costco, Amplitude, Chevron, the former CEO of Reddit, and the former CPO of Brex.

We are early. We are deeply technical. We are building alongside real practitioners, and we want a real practitioner who can stand in front of our buyers and be believed.

LOCATION

Seattle/SF preferred, remote OK. We meet in person 1-2x per quarter. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Our buyers are security, AppSec, GRC, and privacy leaders at Fortune 500s who will stress-test the product and then stress-test us. They need someone who can:

 - Understand how their reviews actually run across threat modeling, privacy, and vendor risk

 - Demo Clearly AI against their own artifacts and processes, not a generic sandbox

 - Design and run proofs of value against written success criteria

 - Answer architecture and data-handling questions live, in front of people who will check the answer
 

This role exists to own the technical case, paired with Sales, who runs the deal.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

1. Technical discovery and demos

 - Go deep on how a prospect runs reviews today, and spot which part will break before they do

 - Push on the stated request to find the real goal. Often the right answer is smaller than what they asked for

 - Build demos on their own use case and artifacts, not a generic sandbox
 

2. Proof of value

 - Turn vague asks like "less effort" or "reasonable quality" into criteria a POV can pass or fail

 - Stand up tenants, load their knowledge, queue historical and live cases

 - Run the midpoint check and the technical readout against what the customer signed
 

3. The technical conversation

 - Own the architecture questions that decide enterprise deals: tenancy and data isolation, SSO/SAML/SCIM, deployment patterns, model providers, data residency, audit defensibility

 - Answer accuracy and hallucination objections with evidence, and carry our security posture through their vendor review

 - Explain honestly where we fit against threat modeling tools, scanners, GRC platforms, and building it in-house
 

4. The reusable layer

 - Turn evaluation friction into specific, reproducible feedback for engineering

 - Build the demo environments, POV templates, and technical answers the team can use without you

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not our Forward Deployed Security Engineer role; you hand off at signature rather than running production onboarding

 - Not a product management role

 - Not a role where you read someone else's demo script

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

 - 5+ years either running security and privacy reviews for large enterprises, or in a sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical pre-sales role selling to security teams

 - Command of enterprise security architecture: tenancy and data isolation, data residency, AI governance

 - Ability to speak the language of security practitioners (STRIDE, DPIA, TPRM, CVE, SSDLC)

 - Experience running a multi-week technical engagement to a deadline without it drifting

 - Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, Confluence, or OneTrust, and how review workflows live inside them

 - Clear writing. Success criteria, test plans, and readouts are the deliverables here
 

Strongly preferred

 - Hands-on experience with threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, or vendor risk assessments

 - Working knowledge of enterprise identity and deployment plumbing: SSO/SAML/SCIM, IP allowlisting, model providers

 - Experience working in early-stage startups
 

You do not need to have carried a quota or held a sales title. If this role fits you and you don't check every box, tell us what you'd bring instead.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED (FIRST 12 MONTHS)

 - POVs passing against criteria you wrote

 - Technical objections resolved in the room rather than escalated

 - Time to run a full technical evaluation without a founder present

 - Demo environments, templates, and answers the team uses every week

WHY JOIN CLEARLY AI

 - Build the technical function from the ground up, with the team that follows built around what you establish

 - See your impact directly in the product, and in the customers we win

 - Join an RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox Top 10 Finalist backed by $8.4M in seed funding

 - YC alum with proven, technical founders and strong growth momentum with minimal funding taken to date

 - Competitive salary, equity, and benefits
 

Salary ranges are a guideline; actual base salary may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

In addition, compensation packages may include additional components such as equity and benefits. Benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own custo

OUR VALUES

jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Working closely with HappyRobot's COO and founders, this Strategic Relationship role will focus on developing and expanding our network to deepen connections with our top 100 accounts. You will leverage key relationships with Investors, Advisors and VCs to identify the most critical and relevant Use Cases for HappyRobot and the best path to navigate within these customers to connect directly with the most relevant stakeholders and decision makers.

This team is composed of builders, comfortable with constant iteration and building new and customized systems. We are looking for someone that aligns with this dynamic, brings strong experience mapping and prioritizing their network and success in turning those network connections into measurable and meaningful business outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain relationships with advisors and other strategic partners who act as lead sources for the business

 - Identify key decision makers at HappyRobot's top 100 accounts and leverage network relationships to build connections

 - Develop deep fluency in our top client verticals — understanding the operational pressures, buying dynamics, and decision-makers specific to each

 - Represent HappyRobot at industry events, investor gatherings, and executive forums to build the company's network and reputation

 - Partner closely with founders to prioritize relationships and introductions against company goals

 - Track and report on relationship activity and pipeline impact, and refine strategy based on what's working

MUST-HAVE

 - Bachelor's degree from a top-tier institution, with a strong academic record

 - 5+ years of experience beginning in a rigorous, quantitative environment — investment banking, private equity/VC, management consulting, or corporate law — followed by a transition into growth, GTM, or business development at a high-growth company

 - An existing, credible network across enterprise decision-makers and/or the private equity, venture capital, and advisor community

 - A track record of converting relationships and introductions into measurable business outcomes (pipeline, partnerships, or otherwise)

 - Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with sharp business judgment

 - Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders

 - Comfort operating with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, early-stage environment

 - Advanced degree (MBA, JD, or equivalent) from a top program

 - Direct experience working inside a VC or PE firm (as an investor, platform team member, or portfolio company operator)

 - International GTM or business development experience, particularly EMEA or LATAM; multilingual a plus

 - Existing relationships with advisors, investors, or executives relevant to HappyRobot's target markets and verticals

WHY JOIN US?

 - Opportunity - Work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.

 - Fast Growth - Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10, rapidly growing.

 - Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of a high-impact, highly visible relationship function and ship fast.

 - Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 - Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Work With the Best - Join a world-class team where the best argument wins regardless of seniority.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest ac

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Boston, USA
jobs.description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling. 
 As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities. 
 This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title. 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
 Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition. 
 Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity. 
 Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer. 
 Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders. 
 Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. 
 Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome. 
 Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close. 
 Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload. 
 Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance. 
 Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses. 
 Travel within the assigned territory as required. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 
 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus. 
 Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline. 
 Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners. 
 Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. 
 Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software. 
 Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills. 
 Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences. 
 Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills. 
 B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field. 
 Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred. 
 
 (SLS00334)Remote-US 
 To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company. 
 SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses. 
 SingleStore’s base salary range for this role is $90,000 to $150,000 with annual target earnings of $180,000 to $300,000 at quota with significant accelerators for overperformance. 
 For candidates residing in California, please see our California Recruitment Privacy Notice . For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Internship/Research Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYGALDRY

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to superintelligence, and addressing the problem of rising compute costs and energy bottlenecks. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a hands-on research engineer to build, integrate, and operate the experimental systems behind our quantum program. You will work on real hardware: building advanced scientific machines and developing devices across the boundaries between electronics, optics, timing, firmware, and software.

A Ph.D. is not required; we care about what you have built.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Build, test, and commission electronic, optical, vacuum, and cryogenic subsystems.

 - Integrate lasers, rf and microwave hardware, control electronics, and data acquisition into systems.

 - Debug failures spanning electronics, optics, timing, firmware, and software.

 - Write automation, calibration, and analysis tooling that makes measurements repeatable.

 - Improve lab infrastructure and procedures so systems stay reliable and usable.

 - Produce documentation that allows other team members to operate, maintain, and reproduce your work

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Hands-on experience building, aligning, integrating, or repairing real instruments and experimental setups.

 - Practical depth in one or more of: optics and photonics; electronics; RF, microwave, and controls; embedded or FPGA development; vacuum and cryogenics; scientific software and automation; device fabrication and characterization.

 - A track record of making something work reliably, and of finding the real cause of a stubborn failure.

 - Python or similar for instrument control, data acquisition, and analysis. Experience integrating tools across hardware control interfaces and software systems.

 - A B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in physics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Especially practical experience in a hardware development or production industry.

 - Comfort working across disciplines, and clear reporting of what worked, what failed, and what you fixed.

HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to to contribute to our mission, please reach out at [email in original advert]

jobs.title: Account Executive - Healthcare & Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re looking for an Account Executive, Healthcare & Life Sciences to lead Outset’s growth with health plans and payer organizations.

This is a quota-carrying individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales, responsible for selling Outset into healthcare organizations and growing those accounts over time. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pipeline development through closing and expansion—across a named set of accounts, working with both net new logos and existing customers.

Your primary buyers are Market Research and Insights & Analytics teams at pharmaceutical, biotech, and life sciences companies, as well as health insurers. Life sciences companies need to understand patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals across the product lifecycle, from early concept and messaging work through launch and brand tracking. Health insurers need to understand why members choose, stay, and leave, and how to improve the experience scores that drive ratings and revenue. Outset gives both groups that depth at a speed and scale traditional research can’t match. Your job is to make Outset the standard for how these teams understand their customers, landing with one brand, therapeutic area, or line of business and expanding across the organization. There’s also a significant opportunity to expand into UX Research, Product, CX, and Patient and Member Experience teams.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, Security, and Customer Success teams, and you’ll bring a deep understanding of how life sciences companies and health insurers operate, govern patient, HCP, and member data, and buy.

Responsibilities

 - Own the full sales cycle for a named set of healthcare and life sciences accounts, from prospecting to close.

 - Land new logos and grow existing customers across brands, therapeutic areas, and markets in life sciences, and across lines of business at health insurers (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial, and individual).

 - Build trusted relationships with Market Research and Insights & Analytics leaders as your primary buyers, and expand into UX Research, Product, CX, and Patient and Member Experience teams within each account.

 - Lead discovery and demos that connect Outset to healthcare research workflows. In life sciences, that means HCP and patient research, patient journey mapping, concept and message testing, launch readiness, and brand tracking. At insurers, it means member research, plan selection and switching, retention, benefit design, and enrollment marketing. For UX, Product, and CX teams, it means digital and experience research.

 - Build account plans that map brands, therapeutic areas, lines of business, regions, buying centers, research budgets, and whitespace across each account.

 - Navigate complex enterprise sales processes, including HIPAA, GDPR, PHI handling, adverse event reporting, HCP compliance, information security, and vendor risk reviews, in partnership with our Security and Legal teams.

 - Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility in Salesforce.

 - Partner with Marketing and outbound teams to build targeted healthcare and life sciences plays (events, content, and references that resonate with each segment).

 - Collaborate with Customer Success and Research teams to drive adoption and identify expansion opportunities post-sale.

 - Bring healthcare and life sciences market feedback back to Product and GTM, and become Outset’s go-to expert on the vertical.

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of exceeding quota.

 - Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing Healthcare accounts—you’ve owned commercial relationships with these customers and know how they buy.

 - An established network across Market Research and Insights & Analytics leadership at health firms; relationships with UX Research, Product, or CX leaders are a plus.

 - Proven ability to run full-cycle enterprise sales, including prospecting, managing complex multi-stakeholder deals, and closing new business.

 - A track record of growing existing accounts through expansion and cross-sell across lines of business.

 - Working knowledge of healthcare and life sciences research, from HCP and patient research in pharma to member experience and plan ratings at insurers, and the privacy and compliance requirements (HIPAA, adverse event reporting) that govern it.

 - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and relationship-building skills.

 - Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and industry events.

 - Bonus: experience selling research, CX, analytics, or AI solutions into healthcare.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.

 - Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.

 - Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.

 - Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.

 - Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.

 - Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.

 - Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.

 - Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.

 - Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.

 - Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.

 - Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.

jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

About the Role

As Technical Recruiter, you’ll partner directly with the founders and hiring managers to attract and hire top-tier talent across engineering and operations teams. 

What You'll Do

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles — from sourcing to close

 - Build and manage strong pipelines of high-quality candidates

 - Partner closely with founders and hiring managers to define role needs and scorecards

 - Craft great candidate experiences — from first touch to offer

 - Iterate quickly on recruiting strategies and sourcing channels

 - Build scalable processes, systems, and reporting to support hiring at scale

 - Help build our employer brand across LinkedIn, events, and referrals
 
 

What We're Looking For

 - 4+ years of experience in technical recruiting, ideally in a high-growth startup

 - Strong sourcing skills and creative approach to finding top talent

 - Experience recruiting for roles like software engineers, product managers, and data scientists

 - Ability to own roles end-to-end with minimal oversight

 - Great communication, judgment, and candidate closing skills

 - Deep interest in AI, technology, and building early-stage teams

 - Organized, fast-moving, and excited about making hiring a strategic advantage

Why join us?

 - Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.

 - Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10.

 - Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.

 - Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 - Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. 

Craftsmanship 

 Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Engineering Lead, Data Acquisition
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reflection's Data team builds the training corpora our frontier models learn from. Before a model can learn anything, the data has to be found, fetched, extracted, and delivered reliably, responsibly, and at enormous scale. The ingestion layer is the machinery that turns the open web, licensed corpora, and other large-scale sources into well-structured, versioned, auditable datasets for pre-training.

As Data Acquisition Lead, you'll provide front-line leadership of the team that builds this layer, spanning all three of its pillars web crawl, data ingestion pipelines, and data lakes. You'll build, mentor, and grow a team of data ingestion engineers, guide the technical and architectural decisions across crawling, extraction, and corpus storage/delivery, and work closely with the pre-training research, data quality, and data partnerships teams that depend on what you ship. You'll stay close enough to the stack to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor and to maintain a deep understanding of the team's technical work. Subtle decisions at the ingestion layer what we crawl, how we extract, what we keep ripple through training and directly affect where our models are strong, safe, and where they fail.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of data ingestion engineers. Coach and support your reports in understanding, and pursuing, their professional growth.

 - Provide front-line leadership across the full ingestion stack — web crawling and acquisition, extraction and normalization pipelines, and the data lakes that version and deliver training corpora and the campaigns that run across all three.

 - Stay hands-on: become familiar with the team's technical stack enough to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor.

 - Manage day-to-day execution: prioritize the team's work and run data acquisition and ingestion campaigns in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 - Guide technical and architectural decisions, emphasizing scalability, reliability, auditability, and cost crawler architecture and politeness/scheduling, distributed processing (Ray/Beam/Spark), orchestration (Airflow/Prefect), storage formats and layout (Parquet, JSONL, WARC; object stores and lakehouse formats), deduplication, and dataset versioning and delivery.

 - Close the loop with research: partner with pre-training and data quality teams to tie ingestion decisions to measurable downstream model impact, and run experiments to evaluate crawling strategies, extraction methods, and ingestion tradeoffs.

 - Work across the wider data effort data partnerships, digitization operations, and external vendors to onboard new sources within legal, licensing, and robots.txt constraints.

 - Raise the bar for technical judgment, prioritization, communication, and execution in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience building, mentoring, and growing data or infrastructure engineering teams while staying technically hands-on. (Comfortable growing into leading a larger team quickly if you haven't managed at that scale before.)

 - Deep experience building web-scale data acquisition or ingestion systems, with real ownership of production-grade pipelines at multi-TB to PB scale.

 - Strong coding ability and the credibility to earn the technical trust of a strong team.

 - Deep expertise in at least one of: web crawling & acquisition, large-scale extraction & ingestion pipelines, or data lakes / corpus storage & delivery with working knowledge across the others, and the ability to learn the rest.

 - Fluency with the modern large-scale data toolkit: distributed compute (Ray, Beam, Spark), orchestration (Airflow, Prefect), formats (Parquet, JSONL, WARC), and object-store / data-lake architectures.

 - Familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated, and an intuition for what makes data useful for training; comfortable designing experiments and using proxy quality signals to guide system improvements.

 - Ability to guide strategy and drive execution across concurrent data campaigns, and to partner effectively with research teams, external data vendors, and partnerships/legal on acquisition.
 
 

WHAT WE OFFER:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

 - Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.

 - Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

 - Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.

 - Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.

 - Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.

 - Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.

 - Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.

 - Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com http://amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Data Infrastructure team within Statsig Experiment at Amplitude. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, data engineers, and data scientists responsible for the systems that power experimentation at scale.

The team owns three critical areas:

 - Data ingestion: Collecting and importing experiment exposures, custom events, OpenTelemetry data, and real user monitoring data across SDKs, streaming systems, cloud storage, and customer data warehouses.

 - Data computation: Building distributed computation systems that transform raw data into accurate, timely experiment results.

 - Stats engine: Developing and productionizing the statistical methods that help customers make trustworthy decisions from their experiments.
 
 

You will help set our technical and scientific direction, translating new statistical methods and machine learning research into capabilities that customers can use reliably at scale.

You’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and customers to advance the state of experimentation. The ideal candidate is well versed in distributed computation architectures with familiarity using or building experimentation platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead and grow the team responsible for Statsig’s data ingestion, experiment computation, and stats engine.

 - Define the technical and scientific strategy for advancing experimentation across both Statsig Cloud and warehouse-native deployments.

 - Partner with data scientists and engineers to turn new statistical and causal inference methods into scalable, reliable product capabilities.

 - Evolve our data and computation architecture to support increasingly complex experiment designs, metrics, and customer datasets.

 - Engage with customers to understand their experimentation challenges and translate them into platform and methodology improvements.
 
 

YOU’LL BE A GREAT ADDITION TO THE TEAM IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience leading teams (5-10 team members) that build and productionize statistically rigorous, data-intensive products.

 - Familiarity with experimentation methods such as variance reduction, sequential testing, Bayesian inference, causal effects modeling, or heterogeneous treatment effects.

 - Experience building large-scale data ingestion and distributed computation systems across cloud and data warehouse environments.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did.

You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send.

 - Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up.

 - QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off.

 - Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign.

 - Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day.

 - Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth.

 - Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product.

 - Hands-on with a marketing automation platform (Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself.

 - Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content.

 - An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does.

 - Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel.

 - Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief.

 - Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better.

 - Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili.

 - Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.title: Risk Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSCRIBE

At Inscribe, we're on a mission to catch fraud with confidence. In 2017, we set out to build the first document fraud detection product. Today, we process millions of applications each year and work with many of the leading fintechs and banks across the U.S. We believe the game of cat-and-mouse in fraud requires a fundamentally new approach. With care for our customers, attention to detail, and grounded execution, we’re reimagining how fraud is detected and prevented.

Inscribe is trusted by leading banks and fintechs, including Coinbase, Plaid, Bluevine, and Ramp. Inscribe is backed by Threshold Ventures, Uncork Capital, Y Combinator, Crosslink Capital, and Foundry, and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a detail-oriented, customer-focused Risk Operations Analyst to join our team. You will be responsible for monitoring, assessing and improving fraud detection on behalf of our customers. You will also have the opportunity to recommend and implement best practices to detect and prevent fraud. This role requires a self-starter with strong analytical skills and a passion for fighting fraud.

This is a hybrid role, working 2 days from our office near Stephen's Green in Dublin and 3 days from home. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Investigate high-risk accounts, documents and transactions to identify fraud such as fake or synthetic identities, account takeover and document forgery

 - Analyse large datasets to detect patterns, trends and anomalies, including retrospective analysis to uncover new fraud patterns and new ways of catching fraud

 - Use fraud detection software and tools to strengthen our monitoring and investigations

 - Run regular check-ins with customers on risk, performance and the reasoning behind our decisions

 - Prepare clear reports for leadership and customers on fraud incidents, findings and recommended improvements and generate activity reports for internal reviews and customer check-ins

 - Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn your findings into better rules, tooling and detection systems

 - Respond quickly as new fraud trends and incidents emerge, adjusting priorities alongside the team

 - Help design and scale the processes, workflows and automation that keep our risk operations efficient as we grow

 - Spot gaps in our systems, policies and detection strategies and work with stakeholders across the business to recommend and deliver improvements that address emerging risks

 - Contribute to ad hoc cross-functional projects that strengthen our fraud prevention strategies

ABOUT YOU

 - 3+ years of experience in fraud, risk operations, trust & safety, a related investigative field or equivalent experience

 - Hands-on SQL for investigations and analysis alongside other data tools (e.g., Excel, Google Workspace)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on ambiguous cases

 - Experience working across teams, ideally with Product or Engineering and explaining complex findings simply

 - Comfortable speaking and presenting to customers and leadership

 - Able to work independently as well as part of a team, and to prioritise multiple tasks and change direction in a very fast-paced environment

 - Takes ownership and brings energy and urgency to solving problems, with a willingness to dig deep to find the answer

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Familiarity with risk management frameworks and relevant standards

 - Experience with fraud and risk tools

 - Fintech, payments, marketplace or startup experience is a plus

 - Experience improving or automating workflows is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial Screen with the Hiring Manager to share your experience (30 minutes)

 2. Check In Call with HR to understand and align on your motivations and expectations (30 minutes)

 3. Take Home Technical Exercise followed by a discussion with 1-2 peers to review the test and assess your technical ability (1 hour)

 4. Meet our Leadership Team to discuss Inscribe’s vision and align on values (45 minutes)

BENEFITS

At Inscribe, we are building a company and culture where everyone can produce their best work. Here are a few of our benefits and perks: 

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Comprehensive healthcare

 - Unlimited vacation policy 

 - 401(k) and pension plans

 - Complete work setup

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases.. 

You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control.

The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.

What You Bring

 - Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services

 - Hands-on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native services at scale

 - Experience integrating LLMs, AI models or tool-calling systems into production applications

 - Familiarity with agentic architectures and protocols such as MCP, A2A

 - A systems mindset, with attention to reliability, scalability, performance and security

 - Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and production observability

 - A record of working across product and platform teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end

 - Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools as part of your development workflow

Nice to haves

 - Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems that use tools and execute multi-step workflows

 - Experience building or maintaining event-sourced systems

 - Python programming skills

 - Experience with AI or ML infrastructure and developer productivity tooling

Your Typical Day

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence.

What We Offer

 - Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

 - Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

 - Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

 - Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace.

 - Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

 - Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

jobs.title: Research Engineer, RL Frontiers
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Etched is building AI systems that accelerate its own development. As a Research Engineer on the RL Frontiers team, you will train our proprietary frontier models to automate kernel development, ASIC engineering, production pipelines, and 3-D hardware operating systems.

You will use our proprietary simulators and environments to create custom data mixes and post-train models to SOTA performance on our hardest engineering tasks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the post-training stack completely end to end.

 - Build RL environments with ASIC, kernel, and supercomputing engineers, rewarded by simulation, formal tools, tests, and hardware measurements.

 - Create custom data mixes that unlock frontier performance on relevant tasks.

 - Create benchmarks that drive real productivity in the models and avoid reward hacking

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have hands-on post-training experience, including SFT and RL (e.g., PPO, GRPO), and have shipped models people used.

 - Have taken a model from bad to good on a task it wasn’t built for, ideally with scarce data, for example as an early post-training hire at an applied AI company.

 - Are a strong PyTorch and distributed-training engineer who reads the rollouts and checks the numbers before trusting a result.

 - Understand the systems side of RL well enough to make the loop faster and cheaper, not just better.

 - Are entrepreneurial and make good calls under compute and data constraints. Former founders are a plus.

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH

 - RL or post-training frameworks (e.g., verl, OpenRLHF, TRL, prime-rl) or inference engines (vLLM, SGLang).

 - Agentic, multi-turn RL with verifiable rewards.

 - Distillation and training small, specialized models for production.

 - ASIC design or verification, accelerator kernels, or large-scale compute infrastructure.

BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
 
 - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

BASE COMPENSATION RANGE

 - $400K+

 - Plus Significant Equity

HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

ABOUT ETCHED

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto.

ROLE OVERVIEW

HappyRobot is hiring a Revenue Accounting Lead, a builder who will help stand up our revenue accounting function from scratch, reporting to the Head of Accounting. Our revenue model is genuinely technical: platform fees, compute credits, professional services, and usage overages, each with its own recognition pattern, which will need to be automated.

This is a 0-to-1 job. You and the Head of Accounting will design the process and the system flow at the same time together, and you'll be expected to automate the tasks and processes using AI finance tools (including our own platform). If you think like a finance engineer, someone who builds scalable systems, not just someone who processes transactions, this role is built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design & Scale Revenue Close: Architect and execute monthly and quarterly revenue close processes across platform fees, credit consumption, professional services, and usage overages, systematically automating steps to ensure speed and accuracy.

 - Drive Process Automation: Identify manual, repetitive accounting tasks and deploy AI agents and automated workflows, exercising strategic judgment on optimal human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

 - Configure Sub-Ledger Systems: Partner in setting up the revenue sub-ledger for our new ERP from the ground up, establishing robust methodologies for credit-pool breakage and monthly true-ups.

 - Advise Deal Strategy & ASC 606: Collaborate with Sales and RevOps Deal Desk on complex, non-standard contracts and value-based pricing, embedding compliant ASC 606 treatment pre-execution.

 - Manage Order-to-Cash (OTC): Oversee end-to-end OTC operations, from billing and collections to account reconciliations, aging analysis, and allowance for doubtful accounts reserves.

 - Establish Accounting Policies: Draft foundational revenue policy memos, establish technical accounting standards, and lead key ad-hoc strategic initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4–6+ years of progressive revenue accounting experience, with demonstrated expertise in consumption, usage-based, or SaaS revenue models.

 - Systems-focused mindset with an appetite for automation, efficiency, and building scalable financial architecture.

 - Proven, hands-on experience leveraging modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and standard finance automation software in workflows.

 - Strong operational judgment to balance automated efficiencies with critical human-in-the-loop review.

 - Deep technical command of ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, performance obligations, and variable consideration.

 - Exceptional cross-functional communicator capable of translating technical accounting principles clearly for sales, engineering, and executive leaders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA active or in progress strongly preferred.

WHY JOIN US

 - Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, operators, and builders.

 - Backing from premier investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.

 - High degree of ownership, autonomy, and execution speed in a high-growth environment.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Competitive base compensation and meaningful equity upside.

OUR OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We're running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don't copy-paste solutions.
