 - Ability to build trust with candidates and our Founders

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

What You’ll Do

 - Structure, negotiate, and close enterprise sales and partnership agreements, along with supporting a range of other commercial deals (including vendor and services agreements, data licenses, and marketing arrangements)

 - Serve as a trusted partner to our sales and business development teams, helping them move faster and smarter

 - Bring customer empathy to every negotiation, understanding the businesses we serve well enough to craft agreements that close faster and hold up longer

 - Design and implement scalable legal processes — standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

 - Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

 - Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

 - Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

 - Roll up your sleeves on the full breadth of legal issues that come with being a fast-growing startup

You’ll Love This Role If You

 - Value working with leadership that has tenure and a track record of success, along with A Players as cross-functional partners

 - Get energized by building systems from scratch and establishing foundational practices

 - Are very practical in addressing legal issues and allergic to unnecessary friction

 - Have an abiding spirit of idealism about your chosen profession — you’re not just closing deals, you’re building something that matters

 - Have a point of view on what good lawyering looks like and a healthy sense of humor about everything else

It’s Important To Us That You Have

 - JD, LLM, or equivalent law degree/qualification from an accredited institution and 5–12 years of experience in legal practice (or more), in-house, at a firm, or both

 - Demonstrated strength in commercial transactions internationally, particularly across UK/EU and APAC markets, across enterprise deals, partnerships, and other strategic relationships

 - Fluency in the issues that matter most to us: IP, privacy, data security, and data licensing. A successful candidate will have depth of experience in at least some of these areas, and a willingness to learn the rest.

 - Practical experience with data protection regimes relevant to our footprint and with structuring cross-border transfer mechanisms

 - Recognize that law is about the grey areas, and are comfortable living in them, while giving clear and actionable advice.

 - Exceptional writing — precise, plain, and compelling

It Would Be Great if You Had

 - Experience helping a high-growth startup scale its sales motion — you know what good looks like and how to build legal infrastructure that accelerates rather than slows the business.

 - Hands-on experience with commercial and legal issues in the AI space

 - Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company’s commercial expansion into the UK/EU

jobs.title: Human Data Operations Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Data Acquisition Team is responsible for ensuring that Reflection has all the data it needs to train the world’s best models. We're looking for a Human Data Operations Manager to own the pipelines that turn human expertise into better AI models. You will partner closely with researchers, deeply understand their needs, and source from vendors the data that improves our models’ usefulness and performance.

This role combines program ownership with hands-on work on task design, contributor workflows, data quality frameworks, and success metrics. The ideal candidate brings organizational rigor, technical curiosity, and sound judgment about when to move quickly and when to investigate the details.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Collaborate with research: Translate critical model capabilities, and researchers’ plans for developing them, into executable data acquisition strategies.

 - Orchestrate providers: Assess vendors’ capabilities, forecast capacity, define task instructions, acceptance criteria and then hold vendors accountable for quality, delivery, and cost.

 - Track and optimize campaigns: Build dashboards tracking throughput, turnaround time, acceptance rates, rework, and cost per accepted task. Leverage data analytics to investigate bottlenecks and guide improvements.

 - Ensure alignment: Experiments and priorities evolve. You will surface vulnerabilities early and turn feedback into concrete changes to subsequent sourcing. Work with research to close the loop; tracking how our data acquisitions improve model capabilities

 - 4+ years of experience delivering a portfolio of complex programs and prioritizing across changing research needs.

 - An understanding of LLM training, evaluation, and prompt design, with the ability to learn unfamiliar research concepts quickly.

ABOUT BITSTACK

It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started!

The Role

Bitstack is a crypto-asset service provider authorised under the MiCA Regulation. As such, we are subject to strict requirements relating to anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF) and fraud prevention.

As part of the Compliance team, you will contribute to the day-to-day implementation of our compliance framework. You will review alerts and customer cases across three key areas: transaction monitoring, screening and KYC.

What You'll Be Doing

1. Transaction Monitoring (Fiat & Crypto)

 - Analyse and investigate transaction monitoring alerts across euro payment flows (card payments and SEPA transfers) and crypto flows (on-chain deposits and withdrawals).

 - Examine transaction patterns, counterparties and wallet exposure to assess each alert and determine whether it is a false positive or should be escalated.

 - Detect fraudulent activity, including payment fraud, account takeovers and scams targeting our users.

 - Document your findings and, where appropriate, prepare the supporting information for a suspicious activity report to TRACFIN, the French financial intelligence unit.

 - Contribute to improving detection scenarios and monitoring alert metrics.

2. Screening: PEPs, Sanctions & Adverse Media

 - Review screening alerts and determine whether a match is genuine or a false positive.

 - Implement enhanced due diligence measures for politically exposed persons (PEPs), including checks on the source of funds and source of wealth.

 - Escalate confirmed matches against sanctions lists or adverse media findings in accordance with internal procedures.

3. KYC (Know Your Customer)

 - Review and validate customer supporting documents, including proof of identity, proof of address, proof of income, source of funds and source of wealth.

 - Detect identity theft attempts and forged documents.

 - Assess consistency between the customer's profile, declared information and observed activity.

 - Request additional documentation and follow up on cases through to their final decision.

You will also contribute to updating internal procedures and monitoring emerging fraud and money laundering typologies within the crypto ecosystem.

You will gain hands-on experience with an AML/CFT framework at a regulated crypto-asset service provider. You will learn how alerts are handled from initial detection through to the final decision, how a risk-based approach is applied, how blockchain analytics tools are used, and how the Compliance team collaborates with Product, Operations and Customer Support.

What We're Looking For

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Compliance, Law, Finance, Risk Management or a related field, and looking for an internship or work-study placement.

 - Previous exposure to AML/CFT, KYC or fraud prevention through an internship, coursework or certification is a plus, but not required.

 - Highly organised, rigorous and detail-oriented.

 - Able to draw well-reasoned conclusions and clearly document findings in writing.

 - Comfortable using spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets), with a strong interest in crypto-assets and blockchain technology.

 - Discreet and meticulous when handling sensitive personal data.

 - Fluent in French and comfortable working in English.

Perks & Benefits
💻 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely

🕑 Flexible working hours

🏄Team activities and annual offsites

🍉 Swile meal vouchers

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We hire talented and passionate people from all kinds of backgrounds, we don’t care about your age or where you studied. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t match every bullet point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. What matters most is that you’re a builder at heart, you share our values, and you’re enthusiastic about our mission.

#LI-TT1

AfterQuery https://www.afterquery.com/ is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it. 

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

WHY APPLY

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

 - Track candidate progress, feedback status, interviewer availability, and process bottlenecks.

 - Ensure every candidate has a high-touch, professional, and responsive experience.

 - Help improve recruiting workflows, templates, systems, and internal coordination processes.

 - Support the talent team with ad hoc projects as AfterQuery scales.

 - Help prepare interviewers with the right context, scorecards, resumes, and scheduling details.

 - Support recruiting operations, including:
 
 - Calendar management
 
 - Interview loop setup
 
 - Candidate follow-ups
 
 - Offer process coordination
 
 - Recruiting reports
 
 - Process documentation
 
 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 1+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, people operations, executive assistance, operations, or another highly organized coordination-heavy role.

 - Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Ability to manage many moving pieces at once without dropping details.

 - Comfort working with calendars, scheduling, spreadsheets, ATS systems, and recruiting tools.

 - High responsiveness and strong follow-through.

 - Strong judgment when communicating with candidates, interviewers, and internal teams.

 - Ability to operate in a fast-moving startup environment.

 - Excitement to help build processes from scratch.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience coordinating technical recruiting processes.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, tech company, or recruiting agency.

 - Familiarity with technical interview loops and hiring workflows.

 - Experience using tools like Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, LinkedIn Recruiter, Google Calendar, Notion, Linear, or similar systems.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
MEET METHOD

Method has built the most modern way to connect to consumer financial accounts. Combining real-time liability connectivity with instant payment execution, Method’s API is designed to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use.

We have helped 45+ million users connect 350+ million liability accounts credential-less and processed over $2.5B in payments, helping users save millions in interest. One in every three credit cards in the United States is in the Method ecosystem and leading financial institutions like SoFi, Bilt, Cleo, Sezzle, Figure & Aven rely on our APIs to build magical experiences for millions of consumers.

We’re a team of 50+ people spread across offices in Austin, SF, New York City, and Washington D.C! We’re excited to continue the momentum working alongside our investors and advisors from Andreessen Horowitz, Emergence Capital, Y Combinator, Avra, and Ardent. To learn more about us, check out our blog https://methodfi.com/resources/company-updates!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring Method's first Design Engineer. This is someone who spends most of their time in the code, but with an elite eye and talent for product, visual, and motion design. You'll partner with our Head of Design to own the craft layer across all of Method's web properties: website, design system, demos, and product. You'll work as a duo to set the aesthetic direction, make the technical calls, and ship the work.

Method is a developer-first financial connectivity platform, and our visual identity should feel like it. We want our products to feel precise, technically credible, and genuinely interesting to look at.

We're rebuilding our entire visual and interactive layer at once: a token system covering color (built on perceptual color science), typography, and spacing, a design system from the ground up, a new marketing site, a dashboard with generative UI and charting, and the embedded experience our partners put in front of their own users. Because the embedded product runs inside our partners' apps, it needs to adapt to match their brand, automatically.

You'll work closely with engineers and our Head of Design to bring a level of frontend craft to Method that the current team can't fully own, and oversee a ton of green-space to up-level how customers and end-users interact with Method. Open source is part of this role. We want to build things worth sharing and give Method a point of view the design and creative-coding communities respect.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the visual and interactive quality of Method's design system including component states, motion, and consistency across surfaces.

 - Build shader-based experiences for the website using Three.js and WebGL: hero sections, ambient motion, branded interactive moments.

 - Redesign and elevate the dashboard beyond a reskin; considered transitions, polished data visualization, generative UI components driven by JSON.

 - Architect a component library that supports dynamic, on-the-fly UI construction (charts, layouts, elements assembled from structured data).

 - Make judgment calls on when to invest in bespoke work versus leveraging existing tooling, and communicate those tradeoffs clearly.

 - Reduce reliance on contractors for production design and front-end UI work.

 - Collaborate with engineers and Head of Design on design direction; eventually help scope and hire adjacent design talent as the team grows.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have shipped interactive web work that required writing shaders; Three.js, WebGL, GLSL. Your portfolio shows it!

 - You understand the full stack from GPU rendering to React component architecture; you know why it matters that this runs in-browser and not as a video.

 - You have strong aesthetic opinions and the technical range to execute them without a dedicated designer handing you comps.

 - You've built production design systems and component libraries that others actually use.

 - You're an individual contributor by nature and default to building.

 - You've worked at or contributed to places with genuine design craft: design studios, developer tooling companies, creative agencies, or strong indie dev work.

 - You're comfortable being the only person in this specialty for a while; you don't need structure to make progress.

 - Depth and quality of your experience matter more than years. Apply even if you've never carried the Design Engineer title.

EXTRA AWESOME

 - Background in creative coding, gaming, or CGI; you understand shaders from multiple angles.

 - Open source contributions to Three.js, shader communities, or creative coding libraries.

 - Experience with motion design tooling (Rive, Framer, Lottie) and opinions on when to use it versus roll your own.

 - Experience at companies or studios known for frontend craft

 - Familiarity with generative UI patterns and JSON-driven component rendering.

--

The annual US base salary range for this role is: $150,000-$200,000.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO FULL TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, Dental, Vision; basic medical plans 100% covered

 - Flexible PTO

 - $30/day Lunch allowance when working from the office

 - 12 weeks parental leave

 - Commuter benefits; employer-sponsored

 - Phone/internet stipend 

 - WFH stipend 

 - Student loan repayment contribution 

 - Lifestyle Spending stipend 

 - Learning & Development stipend 

 - Hybrid-office stocked with snacks

 - Quarterly team off-sites

IN-OFFICE POLICY 

For most roles are Method, we expect a regular in-person presence at one of our hubs in NYC, Austin, SF or DC. We have embedded flexibility to work remotely for a week here and there, but the general expectation is a minimum 2-3 days/week in office on average. What does not work is full-time remote.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Legal team

We're building the infrastructure that democratizes access to intelligence. By serving state-of-the-art models to enterprises and advancing open source, we enable organizations to truly own their own intelligence. Our legal team exists to make that mission possible, responsibly and at scale, because we believe broad access to AI is one of the most consequential things we can build for society. Our legal team is defined by high integrity, high character, and high trust. We're low-ego, collaborative, kind, and supportive people who are genuinely excited to be part of a team. We win together or not at all.

About the role

As Employment Counsel, you'll be a foundational member of our growing legal team, owning the employment and labor matters that come with building and scaling a fast-growing company. You'll join at a pivotal moment as we rapidly scale our team and serve as the go-to legal partner for our People and HR organization. This is a build-from-the-ground-up role for someone who's navigated hypergrowth before and knows how to keep a scaling workforce both well-supported and well-protected. This role reports to the General Counsel.

What you'll do.

 - Advise on the full range of employment and labor matters: hiring, terminations, classifications, leaves, accommodations, investigations, and policy.

 - Partner closely with HR and People Operations as a trusted, day-to-day legal advisor.

 - Counsel on employee equity and compensation considerations.

 - Build scalable employment policies, templates, and processes suited to a rapidly growing, multi-state workforce.

 - Support international expansion and advise on cross-border employment and global labor law compliance as we grow our footprint beyond the US.

 - Manage employment-related disputes and coordinate specialist outside counsel where needed.

 - Keep us ahead of the compliance obligations that come with fast headcount growth.

What we're looking for.

 - 9+ years of in-house employment and labor law experience.

 - A JD and membership in at least one US state bar.

 - Prior startup experience, ideally in a hypergrowth environment.

 - A track record of close collaboration and strong partnership with HR and People Operations teams.

 - Familiarity with employee equity and compensation considerations.

 - Experience supporting international expansion and navigating global employment laws.

 - A pragmatic, build-from-scratch mindset and the judgment to balance risk with business velocity.

 - AI-forward, builder’s mindset, with a demonstrated ability to use AI tools to streamline daily workflows and accelerate efficiency.
 
 

Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast-growing startup, along with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, market data, and work location.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer.

WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

THE PROBLEM YOU'LL SOLVE

Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.

As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.

You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.

And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.

You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.

You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.

You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.

You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.

You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

 - Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

 - Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and the model lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring) in production environments.

 - Track record of defining and executing multi-year product strategies in fast-moving, high-scale environments.

Technical Depth

 - Ability to engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on architectural decisions, infrastructure trade-offs, and AI system design.

 - Familiarity with agentic workflows, agent frameworks, and the operational patterns that make AI agents reliable at scale.

 - Strong data-driven decision-making: comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, defining and tracking KPIs, and using metrics to measure adoption, accuracy, latency, and ROI.

 - Experience with modern product and engineering tooling (e.g., Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma) and agile methodologies.

Leadership & Influence

 - Proven ability to mentor and grow product managers, instilling PM best practices and building talent pipelines.

 - Stakeholder management across functions and geographies

jobs.description:

Ambient.ai is the category creator and leader in Agentic Physical Security. Powered by Ambient Pulsar, the first reasoning Vision-Language Model purpose-built for physical security, our platform seamlessly integrates with existing security cameras and physical access control systems to unify monitoring, access control, threat assessment, response, and investigations through an always-on reasoning layer that augments security operators with superhuman capabilities. The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response.

The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked #71 out of 500 on the Forbes best startup employers list https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/.

Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible.

Ready to learn more? Connect with us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ambient-ai/?viewAsMember=true and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@ambient-ai-inc

THE ROLE

You'll lead the Ecosystems team: the engineers who connect Ambient.ai http://Ambient.ai to the Physical Access Control Systems (PACS) our customers run, and who are extending into new access control capabilities. You'll own both the team and the partner relationships behind it.

The team's work ranges from building and maintaining PACS integrations that customers depend on every day to developing new access control products from an early, ambiguous starting point. You'll set direction and priorities across all of it.

Every alarm Ambient Access Intelligence verifies depends on this team's integrations, so reliability is part of the job, alongside building what comes next.

This is a player-coach role. You'll manage and grow a small team, stay close enough to the code to make sound architecture calls, and represent Ambient.ai http://Ambient.ai credibly with partner engineering and product leaders. You'll report into EPD leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Split the team's capacity between integration delivery and new product development, and rebalance as priorities shift.

 - Stay hands-on: review designs, unblock hard debugging, and write code where it moves the team fastest.

 - Own the PACS integration roadmap with product: which partners to add, which capabilities to deepen, and what it takes to keep existing integrations reliable.

 - Set up the operating model for integrations in production: monitoring, on-call, partner escalation paths, and regression testing against partner releases.

 - Define the architecture and milestones for new access control capabilities, from device communication and credential management to the cloud services and APIs behind them.

Run partner relationships

 - Be the primary engineering contact for PACS and hardware partners, from technical scoping through joint roadmap planning.

 - Negotiate API access, SDK support, test hardware, and escalation commitments, and hold partners to them.

 - Represent Ambient.ai http://Ambient.ai in partner technical reviews and joint customer escalations, and bring what you learn back into our product strategy.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deep experience with access control systems, from the software side (a PACS vendor, a cloud access control company, or an integrator's engineering team) or the hardware side (locks, readers, controllers, credentials).

 - 6+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years managing engineers or leading a team as a tech lead with people responsibilities.

 - A track record of shipping and operating integrations with third-party systems, and of building something new from an early, ambiguous starting point.

 - Experience owning technical relationships with external partners: you've scoped joint work, negotiated access and support, and resolved escalations without losing the relationship.

 - Strong backend and distributed systems judgment, including systems that span customer-site hardware and the cloud.

 - Clear communication with engineers, product leaders, partner executives, and customers alike.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience with PACS, lock, or credential platforms such as LenelS2, C-CURE 9000, Genetec, Brivo, or similar.

 - Built or led a cloud-managed access control product end-to-end, including controllers, credentials, and mobile access.

 - Working knowledge of access control protocols and standards: OSDP, Wiegand, BLE and NFC mobile credentials.

 - IoT platform experience: device provisioning, fleet management, firmware updates, MQTT.

 - Familiarity with enterprise security buyers and the compliance expectations that come with them (SOC 2, audit trails, role-based access)

Why join us:

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
MEET METHOD

Method has built the most modern way to connect to consumer financial accounts. Combining real-time liability connectivity with instant payment execution, Method’s API is designed to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use.

We have helped 45+ million users connect 350+ million liability accounts credential-less and processed over $2.5B in payments, helping users save millions in interest. One in every three credit cards in the United States is in the Method ecosystem and leading financial institutions like SoFi, Bilt, Cleo, Sezzle, Figure & Aven rely on our APIs to build magical experiences for millions of consumers.

We’re a team of 50+ people spread across offices in Austin, SF, New York City, and Washington D.C! We’re excited to continue the momentum working alongside our investors and advisors from Andreessen Horowitz, Emergence Capital, Y Combinator, Avra, and Ardent. To learn more about us, check out our blog https://methodfi.com/resources/company-updates!

HI I’M COLIN http://linkedin.com/in/colinhanavanmurphy, I LEAD TALENT AT METHOD, AND I WROTE EVERY WORD OF THIS JOB DESCRIPTION BELOW.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

I’m hiring a Senior Technical Recruiter to own how we find, engage, and close the engineers and product people who build Method’s technology. The people we want rarely apply (though, there is a huge opportunity to optimize this channel!) They are weighing offers from the fastest-growing companies in the world, and bringing them to Method takes an outbound-savvy recruiter who can spot exceptional talent early then curate a candidate experience that both reflects our culture and demonstrates it is no-brainer why Method is a place worth working for.

You will own individual contributor hiring across Engineering, Product, and Design, as a true partner to our engineering and product leaders. Method operates lean: at just ~70 headcount total, each hire we make has a significant impact on Method’s trajectory, so our bar for talent is very high.

This is a role for someone energized by building from scratch, navigating ambiguity, and applying both recruiting fundamentals and AI-driven workflows to deliver outsized impact.

This role is based out of our NYC office and we have a flexible (but not full-time remote) hybrid policy that typically manifests as 2-4 days/week in office on average where you'll collaborate live and go on caffeine and lunch runs covered by the company.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for all individual contributor roles across Engineering, Product, and Data.

 - Design, launch, and run Method's a repeatable software engineering internship program end to end, from sourcing channels to interview design and selection.

 - Spot gaps in the funnel, propose new tools or process changes, and make the case for them with data.

 - Raise the bar on candidate experience across Talent and sharpen how Method tells its story to technical talent.

 - Proactively introduce AI optimizations where it makes sense in the recruiting lifecycle
 
 

WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years in a full cycle technical recruiting role with closing/negotiating experience

 - You know this level of talent intuitively. You’ve hired engineers that have significantly impacted business and technology outcomes.

 - You have a pulse on the tech scene and generally know what shops have top talent.

 - You care deeply about candidate experience and have experience curating an excellent and high-touch process for candidates.

 - You are outbound first. The best people will not apply, and you have the sourcing habits to find them. - ideally AI native.

 - You are a strong closer who has won candidates for companies whose name did not do the selling.

 - You are resilient. A low accept rate or a string of no's does not slow you down.

 - You are fluent with modern, AI-enabled sourcing and recruiting tools, and you keep testing new ones.

 - You are a builder. When you see a problem, you come back with a solution and the reasoning behind it.
 
 

EXTRA AWESOME

 - Agency recruiting experience, especially placing engineers.

 - Experience building or running a university recruiting or internship program.

 - A record of strong engineering hires at an early-stage startup.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Call with me (30min)

 2. Call with a peer (30min)

 3. Call with hiring manager in EPD (30min)

 4. Onsite
 
 1. Live case (60min)
 
 2. 1:1 with other EPD hiring manager (30min)

 5. Sign off with a Co-Founder (30min)

---

The annual US base salary range for this role is approximately $150,000 - $180,000 based on experience. We also offer an equity package and have a suite of excellent benefits.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO FULL TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, Dental, Vision; basic medical plans 100% covered

 - Flexible PTO

 - $30/day Lunch allowance when working from the office

 - 12 weeks parental leave

 - Commuter benefits; employer-sponsored

 - Phone/internet stipend 

 - WFH stipend 

 - Student loan repayment contribution 

 - Lifestyle Spending stipend 

 - Learning & Development stipend 

 - Hybrid-office stocked with snacks

 - Quarterly team off-sites

IN-OFFICE POLICY 

For most roles are Method, we expect a regular in-person presence at one of our hubs in NYC, Austin, SF or DC. We have embedded flexibility to work remotely for a week here and there, but the general expectation is a minimum 2-3 days/week in office on average. What does not work is full-time remote. 

ACCOMMODATIONS

Method provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance with your application due to a disability, please contact us at [email in original advert] to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Internal Acceleration, Research Engineer (Production)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Our Internal Acceleration team’s mandate is to build agents to accelerate the production of frontier tokens.

You’ll work directly with our founders and embed with our production team to build new agentic harnesses and operating systems to transform the way hardware is built in an AI native world. You’ll work on harnesses, tool use, context, and memory, execution environments, and evals that let agents conduct long-running engineering work that is useful.

This role is for engineers who thrive on ambiguity, have real product sense, and want to own problems end to end. It’s a whiteboard for future founders. The problems we solve are time-sensitive and business-critical. This role will not be a 9-5, and the ideal candidate is excited about that.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have at least 1-5+ years of experience building and shipping software end to end, ideally at a fast-moving startup

 - Have built agents for complex, multi-step tasks that people depend on, beyond calling an API: tool design, long-context management, evals, and failure analysis.

 - Are a strong software engineer who has built reliable systems others depend on, such as distributed systems, experiment infrastructure, or developer tooling.

 - Use coding agents heavily, read their transcripts closely, and change the system when an agent is confidently wrong.

 - Have high agency in unfamiliar domains. You find the real problem and drive it forward.

 - Have product sense, design taste, and extreme attention to detail

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Embed with our production team to find the highest-leverage bottlenecks, and own each one from first idea to a tool engineers rely on every day.

 - Build and deploy LLM agents wired into our engineering workflows via tool-calling and MCP.

 - Build execution environments where agents can verify their own work, with sandboxed access to simulators, EDA flows, compilers, profilers, and real hardware.

 - Ship full-stack internal products from zero to one: the interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure that define how Etched builds.

 - Measure what works. Design evals and track adoption so we double down on the tools that matter and kill the ones that don’t.

 - Take on special projects directly with the founders, surfacing problems across the company and doing whatever it takes to hit critical milestones.

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

 - Exposure to chip development, kernels, hardware, or manufacturing.

 - Infrastructure, data engineering, or DevOps experience

 - Fine-tuning, RAG over proprietary technical data, or multi-agent orchestration

 - Startup experience, especially through hypergrowth

BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
 
 - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

BASE COMPENSATION RANGE

 - $150K – $400K+

 - Plus Significant Equity

HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

ABOUT ETCHED

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

jobs.title: PLM Administrator
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

WHO YOU ARE:

Astro Mechanica is seeking a PLM Administrator to build the digital backbone that enables our team to design, manufacture, and deliver aircraft. As our first dedicated PLM hire, you'll own how product data flows through the company, from the first CAD model to released hardware on the factory floor. You'll architect, implement, and continuously improve our engineering systems, including Teamcenter, NX, automation, enterprise applications, and the infrastructure that supports them. You'll spend part of your time helping users solve immediate problems and the rest designing scalable systems, automation, and processes that enable engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain to move faster as the company grows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the architecture, implementation, and operation of Teamcenter, NX, and the engineering systems that support product development

 - Architect scalable workflows, standards, and automation that improve engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain velocity

 - Evaluate make-versus-buy decisions for engineering tools and workflows, then implement or administer the resulting solutions

 - Configure and extend Teamcenter using BMIDE, APIs, scripting, and custom development

 - Build and integrate the tools that enable a seamless flow of product data across the company

 - Troubleshoot engineering systems and user workflows to keep product development moving

 - Define the long-term roadmap for Astro Mechanica's engineering systems while remaining hands-on in day-to-day execution
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field

 - 2+ years of experience administering, developing, or architecting PLM systems in a product development environment

 - Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, NX, and BMIDE

 - Experience developing automation using Python, APIs, or other scripting languages

 - Experience implementing or integrating ERP and other enterprise engineering systems

 - Demonstrated experience with product lifecycle management, engineering change management, configuration management, and product data management principles

 - Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain organizations

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

THE ROLE:

A developer is getting ready to launch their first subscription app. A growth team wants to improve its paywalls. A founder has heard about Daily Payouts and wants to understand whether it could help. They all reach out to RevenueCat, and they all deserve a useful conversation. You’re that conversation.

As a Product Expert, your job is to understand what someone is trying to accomplish, explain and demo the relevant parts of RevenueCat, and help them take a sensible next step. jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
jobs.description:
A little bit about us:

We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

You can read more about our company here https://belvo.com/about/ and about our team and culture here https://belvo.com/careers/. Also, head to our blog https://belvo.com/blog/ for more news about what we’re building and how we work https://belvo.com/blog/category/working-belvo/.

About the team:

 - We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. 

 - Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do. 

 - We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback. 

 - We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.

 - While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up for at least 3 hours per day.

 - Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.
 
 
 

The challenge

The Intelligence Squad is Belvo's AI enabler team. One part of the squad builds the platforms and patterns that let every team at Belvo ship AI. This role sits in the other part: turning the financial data and payments we aggregate across Latin America into models that make real decisions, who looks creditworthy, which transaction is fraudulent, what category a payment belongs to, whether an income statement checks out. That data drives real financial outcomes for the people and businesses on the other end, so the bar for rigor is high.

You'll be the data science reference in the squad. We're not hiring someone to execute a modeling backlog someone else wrote. We want someone who decides which problems are worth modeling, defines how we know a model is good enough, and raises the data science bar for everyone they work with. You'll be deep enough in statistics and ML to defend a modeling choice to anyone, whether this is a set of rules to simplify a problem or a complex model that you build. You'll be close enough to the business to turn a commercial problem into a modeling roadmap and a business case. And you'll be a strong enough engineer to take your models from notebook to production and own them there.

Responsibilities

 - Model development and selection: Lead the design of statistical and ML models (classification, regression, ranking, NLP or LLM-based) for problems like risk scoring, fraud detection and transaction categorization. Choose approaches on their merits and defend those choices with data, not habit.

 - AI-leveraged delivery: Use agentic coding and research tooling as a core part of how you work: exploring data, generating and testing feature hypotheses, scaffolding pipelines, writing the service around the model. We care about the decisions you ship, not hours at the keyboard, and we expect you to keep compressing the gap between the two.

 - Feature engineering with business context: Work with Product and the business teams to figure out which signals in Belvo's financial data actually explain the outcome you're modeling, and translate an ambiguous business question into a well-scoped modeling problem.

 - Productionization and ownership: Take models past the notebook. Build or shape the pipelines, APIs and services that run them reliably in production, and own them once they're live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and retirement when the evidence says so.

 - Experimentation: Design and run experiments (A/B tests and offline evaluation) to confirm that a model change actually moves the metric it's meant to move.

 - Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Engineering, Data Research, Product, and the rest of the Intelligence Squad to ship end to end, and with stakeholders across the business to keep your models grounded in what actually matters to them.

 - Business and customer partnership: Work directly with stakeholders and, when needed, customers. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-scoped problems, and explain trade-offs and impact clearly to non-technical audiences, executives included.

 - Staying current: GenAI moves weekly. We expect you to be genuinely plugged in: model releases, papers, and tooling, to hold an opinion on what's real versus hype, and to bring the useful parts back to the squad as a demo, a doc, or a session for our company-wide AI Chapter.

 - Framing the problem: Decide what's worth modeling. Push back when a rule, a heuristic, or a better data pipeline solves the problem without a model, and be willing to kill or retire your own model when the evidence says so.
 
 

This position may be for you if

 - 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Sc

jobs.title: Founding Growth Marketer
jobs.description:

Ploy is the marketing platform that turns a company’s website into its growth engine.

We help everyone from early-stage founders to growth agencies (Tonik, TNT Growth) and growth-stage marketing teams (Clay, Hex) run their digital marketing channels, managing everything from SEO/AEO, paid acquisition, conversion rate optimization, and ABM, with the flexibility to build custom marketing workflows around their own data, tools, and goals.

We work in person, with teams in San Francisco and New York. Two principles guide how we work: build momentum and build trust. We keep things simple and ship quickly, while taking seriously the responsibility of running a customer’s website and marketing.

Our founding Growth Marketer will use Ploy to grow Ploy. You’ll become a true power user: building creative marketing workflows, connecting tools and data, and pushing the product to its limits. You’ll own the digital marketing channels that build awareness and bring in new customers. You’ll work closely with our founder and go-to-market team to run campaigns, improve acquisition, and grow both self-serve signups and qualified sales pipeline.

 - Own acquisition across paid search, paid social, and SEO/AEO. Set channel goals, manage budgets, and grow qualified traffic, signups, and demo requests.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

About Tempo 
 Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C. 
 Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures. 
 For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com . Job Description

You will take ownership of the end-to-end development of mission-critical mechanical and thermal systems, from blank-page concept through analysis, fabrication, and final testing. You will tackle extreme engineering challenges, including high-temperature systems with complex power electronic interfaces —while mentoring junior engineers and driving projects across the finish line.

 Lead the design, analysis, and manufacturing of complex mechanical and thermal hardware.

 Sitting and standing: Extended periods at a desk performing computer-based design, simulation, and documentation work.

 Travel: Occasional travel (estimated 
 
 Working at Tempo 
 Tempo is a lean organization working on exciting challenges, and the people who thrive here share a few things in common beyond their technical skills. 
 
 Clear, direct communication: You professionally say what you mean, lead with empathy, use tact, ask when you're unsure, and keep the people around you informed without being asked. At a company our size, communication gaps are expensive, and good communicators add to success and efficiency! 
 Low-ego helpfulness: You're willing to jump in on work that isn't strictly yours, whether that's helping a teammate debug something, lending a hand in the shop, or flagging an issue you noticed outside your lane. No one here succeeds in a silo.

 Business awareness: You understand that your work exists in a business context. You think about cost, timeline, and tradeoffs—not just technical elegance—and you make decisions accordingly.

 Accountability: You own your outcomes, including the misses. When something goes sideways, the instinct here is to fix it and learn from it, not to explain why it wasn't your fault.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

ABOUT THE ROLE

LemFi is building the financial home for the world's immigrants - multi-currency accounts, remittances, savings, credit and eSIMs across 21 countries and growing. Strategic Finance sits at the centre of that growth: we hold the forecast, challenge the numbers and make sure leadership and investors see a clear, honest picture of the business.

This is the first hire into the FP&A function, reporting directly to the Head of Strategic Finance and FP&A. You will own the full engine: the integrated model, the monthly forecast and BvA cycle, the management pack, and investor and lender reporting. Your numbers go in front of the Board, our investors and our lenders. You will work hand-in-hand with department heads across Growth, Product, Operations and Risk, and have direct exposure to the executive team on commercial and strategic decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Run the monthly forecast and integrated three-statement model - cash runway, revenue, headcount and provider costs - keeping every model reconciled to actuals and documented to a standard anyone can follow.

 - Own the BvA cycle end to end: gather commentary, challenge variances, and hold budget owners accountable for their numbers every single month.

 - Produce the monthly management pack and KPI reporting for the executive team and Board, and prepare investor and lender reporting including covenant and facility tracking.

 - Partner with budget owners across Growth, Product, Operations and Risk on their plans, forecasts and spend - be the finance voice that pushes back with data, not just a service desk.

 - Build robust business cases for new products, corridors, markets and partnerships, including scenario and sensitivity analysis for leadership and the Board.

 - Support fundraising, M&A modelling and diligence as needed - your models will be in the data room.

 - Pull, structure and automate recurring data from NetSuite, the data warehouse and operational systems, using AI where it saves you time and improves accuracy.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - 3-5 years in FP&A, strategic finance, transaction services or a modelling-heavy consultancy role (Big 4, strategy or deals).

 - Excellent three-statement modelling skills: driver-based forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, built cleanly and to best-practice standards.

 - Solid accounting foundations: you can link P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and reconcile a forecast to the ledger without hand-holding.

 - Strong data skills and confidence with large datasets; comfortable pulling and structuring data independently.

 - Clear, direct communicator: you can explain the numbers to non-finance stakeholders and push back where the numbers do not support a decision.

 - High ownership and attention to detail - you do not wait to be asked and you do not let things fall through the cracks in a fast-moving environment.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Capital markets exposure: equity fundraising, debt facilities, investor reporting or M&A diligence.

 - Experience in payments, remittance, lending or another regulated financial services business.

 - NetSuite, BI tools, SQL or automation experience (Python or similar); professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA).

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.description:
Qu'est-ce que Finary ?

Notre mission est de transformer la façon dont l'argent peut travailler pour vous. Nous construisons le one-stop-shop de l'investissement, où vous pouvez suivre votre patrimoine, gérer votre budget, investir et apprendre, afin de redonner le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Mounir https://www.linkedin.com/in/mounirlaggoune/ a lancé Finary en 2021, et nous avons depuis franchi le cap du million d'utilisateurs. Nous livrons des produits à la pointe, avec ces petites attentions qui font la différence, et nous accordons une grande importance à l'expérience, à la performance et à la simplicité d'usage.

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse et impliquée. L'argent n'est plus tabou, et le système de retraite est soumis à une pression énorme. Nous imaginons un monde dans lequel investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour porter cette ambition, nous avons levé 25 M€ en Série B en septembre 2025, soutenue par PayPal Ventures, Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs de classe mondiale comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise). Il n'y a jamais eu de moment plus stimulant pour nous rejoindre.

Ce que nous offrons

Nous recrutons des personnes qui élèvent le niveau de l'équipe : des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants. Nous avançons vite, nous visons haut et nous considérons l'ownership comme une évidence. Notre culture est directe, transparente et fondée sur les principes de radical candor et du lean management. Cet environnement correspond aux personnes qui aiment repousser leurs limites chaque jour.

Nous sommes convaincus que la maîtrise de l'IA est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie à venir, et c'est une véritable exigence ici, pas un simple mot à la mode. Chez Finary, chacun a repensé sa façon de travailler autour de l'IA. C'est le premier réflexe, pas une expérimentation annexe.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

Context
We've closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures and we're deployed in 40+ hospitals across France, with international expansion underway. Our product works, our clients are happy, and the pipeline is growing. What we don't have yet is a marketing function.

You'll be our first marketing hire. You'll own marketing end to end, report directly to Paul (CEO), and work hand in hand with Victoire (Sales Lead) on everything that drives revenue.

Your mission
Define how Parallel is positioned and perceived in the hospital market, own product marketing end to end, then build the engine that turns it into visibility, pipeline and deals. You'll set the strategy and execute it yourself: this role is as much about thinking as it is about shipping.

Outcomes

In your first 3 months

 - You've spoken with our clients, lost prospects and Sales team, and you know exactly why hospitals buy (or don't buy) Parallel

 - You've nailed our positioning and messaging: who we serve, which problem we solve for each decision-maker (CFO, management control, IT, hospital leadership), and why us over the alternatives

 - You've mapped our competitive landscape and turned it into a sales narrative the team actually uses

 - Sales has the assets that follow from it: deck, one-pager, objection handling

 - Parallel and its founders have a consistent, credible voice on LinkedIn

In your first 6 months

 - You own product launches with the Product team: from messaging to Sales enablement to client communication

 - A marketing plan is running with clear priorities, budget and metrics

 - We're visible where our buyers are: 2 to 3 key healthcare events (SantExpo or equivalent)

 - A content engine is live: case studies, op-eds, newsletter

 - The client journey is structured: onboarding, release communication, an upsell narrative

In your first 12 months

 - Parallel is a recognized voice in hospital finance and digital transformation: prospects know us before the first Sales call

 - Marketing sources a meaningful and measurable share of the pipeline

 - Our positioning and go-to-market are adapted for our first international markets

 - You've defined what the marketing team should look like next, and started building it
 
 

This role is for you if

 - You've owned positioning and product marketing in B2B SaaS, ideally with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

 - You can build a strategy and execute it yourself: you're as comfortable writing the messaging framework as the LinkedIn post that comes out of it

 - You write exceptionally well in French and English and get straight to the point

 - You work closely with Sales and measure your impact in pipeline, not likes

 - You know how to prioritize in a fast-moving, still-unstructured environment

 - You're curious about healthcare and keen to understand how hospitals buy

 - Non-negotiable: sharp writing, sharp synthesis, and real ownership
 
 

Hiring process

 1. Chat with Wallerand, our recruiter (30')

 2. Victoire, our Sales Lead (30')

 3. Case study on-site + chat with Paul (1h30)

 4. Reference calls

 5. Offer
 
 

Why join us

 - You build the function from scratch: positioning, strategy, processes and, as we scale, the team

 - Direct line to the CEO and a real seat at the table on go-to-market decisions

 - A product that already works, real clients, and a market (hospital finance) where the upside is enormous

 - Competitive salary + equity, Alan, Swile, Apple equipment

 - Flexibility: on average one day of remote work per week, and one remote week per year

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Research
jobs.description:
ABOUT HILLCLIMB

Hillclimb's mission is to improve agent capabilities towards recursive self-improvement. To do so, we work on creating environments and evals that test and push frontier models' ability to ideate, experiment, and produce impactful research.

We're a founding team of former DeepMind & quant researchers, backed by Tier 1 VCs, Jeff Dean, Paul Graham, Amjad Masad, and angel investors from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, xAI & Meta Superintelligence Labs. 

 

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

Your work will consist of the following and many more:

 - Turn ML research problems into environments that reward a model for real progress and good research taste

 - Test whether each environment's reward is repeatable and tracks the quality of the work it scores

ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. ROLE OVERVIEW

MUST HAVE

WHY JOIN US?

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

OUR OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.
