jobs.title: Pricing and Monetization Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

THE ROLE

Mercor produces all sorts of data of data types, for AI labs and enterprise customers. We're hiring someone to own pricing structures across our data types.

This person will build the pricing models, rate cards, and margin frameworks to ensure pricing is consistent and defensible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisition pricing & cost modeling (buy side)

 - Establish fair market value for the data we buy — by data type, domain, and end buyer — and set the acquisition cost ceilings that bound what we'll pay

 - Track competitor bidding behavior and maintain the cost curves that tell us when to pay up to win a corpus and when to walk

 - Model fully-loaded cost to serve: acquisition price, extraction, human QC, anonymization/PII, and LLM inference — not just what we pay the vendor

 - Define the priceable unit for each data type — per repo, per file, per video minute, per audio hour — and the quality attributes that move price within a unit

Monetization & margin strategy (sell side)

 - Design pricing and packaging frameworks for data by data type, volume, format, and customer segment

 - Build rate cards and tiered pricing for recurring, repeatable data products

 - Own unit economics per deal and per data product, including transfer pricing, internal chargeback, and direct vs. indirect revenue attribution across account P&Ls

 - Build the pricing/forecasting toolkit Finance and leadership use to evaluate new data products before launch

 - Continuously test and refine pricing using win/loss data, renewal behavior, and market feedback

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, revenue operations, or a related analytical/strategy role — ideally at a data, marketplace, or B2B SaaS company

 - Strong financial/quantitative modeling skills — fluent in Excel/Sheets; SQL a strong plus

 - Track record of building pricing models from scratch, not just tuning ones already in place

 - Comfortable operating with real ambiguity — public benchmarks for pricing data assets are thin, so structured judgment matters as much as data

 - Sharp cross-functional communicator — this person works daily with Sourcing, Sales, Finance, and Product

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience pricing a two-sided marketplace (a cost/supply side and a demand/sell side), not just a single-sided product

 - Background in AI training data, or market data

BENEFITS

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - Deep understanding of the East African community in the UK. You're culturally fluent and comfortable immersing yourself in new cultural environments.

 - Proven ability to work against targets and deliver measurable results. You're motivated by ambitious goals and comfortable being measured against clear KPIs.

 - Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. You're a persuasive communicator who can influence partners and leaders.

 - Entrepreneurial and tenacious. You take ownership, push through obstacles and find ways to win. Biased to action, you think critically and move quickly.

 - Self-motivated and effective working independently and in remote environments. You're willing to travel extensively and work occasional weekends to support market growth

NICE TO HAVE

 - Prior experience launching or scaling ventures in new markets.

 - You have run growth, community, or field marketing campaigns that drove measurable acquisition.

 - Background in fintech, payments or diaspora-focused products.

 - Existing relationships within East African diaspora networks or associations in the UK.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

jobs.title: Creative Video Producer / Motion Designer
jobs.description:
About Hyperbound

Sales is messy. Closing deals is hard. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

The team you'll build with

We’re assembling a cracked team of builders and operators. You’ll be working alongside former founders, early customers that loved the product so much they decided to join, and folks that worked for our competition before joining us. We like hard problems, strong opinions, and getting something into customers’ hands while the idea is still fresh.

We work with high trust and real autonomy. 

You’ll have the context to make decisions, the freedom to choose your approach. We trust you to spot problems, challenge assumptions, and move things forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.

We have each other’s backs. When something goes wrong, we focus on fixing it and learning, not pointing fingers. You’ll have teammates who share what they know, tell you what they think, and jump in to help. We move quickly because we trust each other, give direct feedback, and make decisions together.

We’re optimistic enough to take ambitious swings and willing to change our minds when the evidence comes back. We ship quickly, learn from customers, and keep improving.

About the role

We're hiring our first dedicated Creative Video Producer and Motion Designer to bring Hyperbound's products, customers, and stories to life through video. You'll own the creative process from concept to final cut, working closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Leadership to create videos that make complex technology easy to understand and hard to ignore. This is a hands-on opportunity to build our video production capability from the ground up, with flexibility for a part-time or full-time arrangement.

What we need from you

 - Storytelling instinct: You know how to turn a complex product, customer conversation, or rough idea into a compelling story. You have a strong creative point of view and a portfolio that shows you can make videos people actually want to watch.

 - End-to-end production skills: You're comfortable owning the entire process, from creative concepts, scripts, and storyboards to filming, editing, sound, color, and motion graphics. You're proficient with tools like Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or and modern AI tooling

 - Technical craft: You know your way around cameras, lighting, audio, and on-location production. You can direct interviews, make people comfortable on camera, and capture high-quality footage.

 - Motion and design craft: You can animate product UI, build titles, lower thirds, end cards, and explainer graphics, and design static assets (thumbnails, ad variants, social graphics) that match our brand. You’re comfortable in After Effects and Figma or Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Ownership and resourcefulness: You can take a brief and run with it, manage multiple projects, and deliver polished work without someone managing every step. You know when to do things yourself and when to bring in outside help.

 - Creative collaboration: You can work with marketers, founders, and product teams to turn feedback into better work without losing the creative vision. You communicate clearly, move quickly, and care about getting the details right.

Highly preferred

 - Experience producing video content for B2B SaaS, technology companies, or startups, particularly product demos, customer stories, founder content, and marketing campaigns.

 - Experience animating SaaS product interfaces or building reusable motion templates and brand systems.

 - Experience building video production workflows from scratch and managing freelance creatives, agencies, or production partners.

What your regular Thursday looks like:

 - You're on set filming a customer interview or working with our founders to capture a story worth sharing. You're directing the conversation, managing the equipment, and making sure you get the shots you need.

 - You’re creating short & long form content for LinkedIn, X, YouTube (ads), and Meta (ads) that people actually want to watch and share.

 - You're turning raw footage into a sharp, engaging video for an upcoming product launch. 

 - You're collaborating with Marketing and Product on the next campaign, turning a rough brief into a creative concept, storyboard, and production plan.

 - You're delivering final edits and shorter cuts for social, web, and sales, incorporating feedback and making sure everything is polished, accurate, and ready to ship.

What this role is not

 - A role where you just execute someone else's vision. We want someone who brings creative ideas, challenges briefs, and helps shape how Hyperbound tells its stories.

 - A role where you only do one part of production. You'll be hands-on from planning and filming through editing and delivery, especially as our first dedicated video hire.

 - A role with a big production team behind you. You'll be building the function from scratch, figuring out how to create great work efficiently and bringing in external partners when it makes sense.

Interview Plan

 - Portfolio review

 - Intro call with James, Founding Recruiter (30 min)

 - Conversation with Garrett, Marketing Lead (45 min)

 - Final onsite with marketing team and Co Founders (90 min)

We move fast, from first conversation to decision in 1-2 weeks.

Compe

jobs.title: Offensive Security RL Researcher
jobs.description:
ABOUT IDLER

idler is a frontier data research lab. We build the evals and environments that the world's leading frontier labs use to measure and train their models.

After raising a $9m seed round led by Paradigm, we spent the last year developing coding evals for top coding models you know and love. At the same time, we've expanded into other domains besides coding: RSI & Auto-Research, Law, Enterprise Business, Cybersecurity, and others. Now, we are facing more lab demand for our data than we can serve, and are rapidly scaling the team to grow the business.

Our approach to creating training data scales using technology, and all of our data products are built on a unified self-reinforcing platform that learns through experience.

You would be joining a close-knit team that has reached product market fit, and your work would directly help to multiply our revenue.

You can see some of our work here: https://idler.ai/collections

About the role

idler is looking for an elite security researcher who can also build. You'll lead idler's cybersecurity work: deciding which environments we build, building and running the systems that produce them, recruiting and managing the part-time experts who review them, and working directly with researchers at frontier AI labs to understand what they need and sell them what we build.

You're a security researcher first. We need someone whose judgment about what counts as a real vulnerability, what makes a task fair, and where the field's genuine skill hierarchy actually sits, we can trust without double-checking. Software development is the tool you use to put that judgment into a production pipeline — it's not a second, parallel discipline we're hiring for separately.

One note on scope: if idler stops investing in cybersecurity, you'd move to a different project inside the company rather than leave — we want to say that plainly now rather than have it be a surprise later.

What you'll do

 - Drive the roadmap for idler's cybersecurity evals and environments, and decide — using our cybersecurity capability map — which environments we build next and where we put engineering resources.

 - Build and run the systems that produce those environments yourself; you'll write production code where it matters, not just spec it out for someone else to build.

 - Recruit, onboard, and manage the part-time cybersecurity experts who review our environments for fairness, correctness, and quality.

 - Work directly with researchers at frontier AI labs to understand what cybersecurity capabilities and data they want, and sell them the environments that meet it.

Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience in a professional cybersecurity role, with a track record that puts you in the top 5% of your peers by reputation.

 - Deep hands-on experience in at least one of: web app pentesting, bug bounty hunting, vulnerability/zero-day research, hacking agents, or AI security.

 - Well-connected within the security community — this makes recruiting and evaluating the part-time experts you'll manage far easier.

 - Comfortable writing and shipping production code (Python, TypeScript, or similar). You don't need a decade of software engineering experience, but you need to build and maintain the systems your research depends on, not hand that off entirely.

 - Strong written communication — you'll justify prioritization calls to researchers and explain findings to people who didn't do the work themselves.

You might excel if you…

 - Have a public bug bounty track record, live-hacking-event invitations, Pwn2Own placements, or published original research — send us a writeup of some of the best bugs you've ever found.

 - Have managed or mentored other security researchers or hackers before.

 - Have thought seriously about how to measure or grade security work that isn't simply pass/fail.

 - Have built tools or automation to support your own research, even if you wouldn't call yourself a software engineer.

Details

 - In-person in San Francisco

 - $200K–$500K base salary + meaningful equity.

 - We'd sponsor and co-publish AI security research under your name.

 - Healthcare, 401(k), 15 days of PTO per year.

 - Relocation assistance

 - Small, ambitious team.

We're a tight-knit founding team and we play to win. Join us if you like to win too.

jobs.title: SDR Manager
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are adding a Senior Financial Analyst to the Strategic Finance team to expand our FP&A capacity and give us deeper coverage across the business. You will be responsible for corporate FP&A functions, including 3 financial statement forecasting and consolidations, business partnering, and GTM optimizations. You will also help us stress-test the assumptions behind our plans and key metrics.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Corporate FP&A: Own the three-statement financial consolidation (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), including forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis. Sync the long-range plan with the detailed financial operating plan and monthly actuals load.

 - Monthly close: Participate in and review the monthly close, working with Accounting to make sure the numbers tie out and the story behind them is clear.

 - Business partnering: Serve as the finance partner to functional areas supporting budget owners with planning, headcount, spend tracking, and decision support to optimize the core metrics they influence.

 - Board and investor reporting: Build and maintain board decks, investor updates, and other leadership deliverables.

 - Equity plan forecasting: Forecast equity plan usage and dilution, and support related analysis.

 - Corporate valuation support: Support valuation work, including model inputs and analysis.

 - Team coverage: Provide backup and redundancy across the team's workstreams so that no process depends on a single person.

 - Tools and process improvement: Help implement and optimize FP&A and AI tools, and look for ways to automate and improve how the team works.

 - Executive partnership: Work directly with senior leadership and budget owners as a trusted, independent finance voice.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - 8+ years of progressive finance experience, most recently with 5+ years in FP&A and 2+ years owning P&L forecasting and executive reporting at a growth-stage SaaS start-up.

 - 3-statement financial planning, including integrated P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow forecasting.

 - Deep understanding of the SaaS GTM motion, including how pipeline, bookings, and IARR/ARR connect.

 - Pricing and margin analysis, such as modeling how pricing and packaging changes affect bookings, gross margin, and unit economics.

 - Lead-to-cash process, including how billing, collections, and revenue recognition flow into ARR, deferred revenue, and cash forecasts.

 - CFA charterholder, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or Big 4 audit experience is a plus but not required.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

 - Deep working knowledge of standard SaaS metrics (CAC payback, burn multiple, magic number, Rule of 40, net and gross retention), including how to calculate them, what drives them, and how plan assumptions move them.

 - Advanced financial modeling skills, ideally in Google Sheets as well as Excel. You design driver-based models from scratch, with assumptions you can trace and defend, rather than only updating existing ones.

 - Hands-on experience pulling and reconciling data across systems (ERP, CRM, planning tools), and a track record of using or testing AI tools to speed up finance work.

HOW YOU WORK

 - You possess a strong sense of intellectual curiosity and professional ethics.

 - Demonstrated self-initiative: you spot problems and fix them without being asked.

 - You operate independently, with a continuous improvement mindset.

 - You communicate clearly with non-finance partners and senior leaders.

 - You fit Teleport's culture and behaviors, and you do well in a fast-moving startup environment.

Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Professional development opportunities

jobs.title: A&P Mechanic
jobs.description:

We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

 

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

 

WHO YOU ARE:

Astro Mechanica is looking for an Aviation Engine Technician to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in crafting precise, high-performance components that push the boundaries of aerospace engineering. Your work at Astro Mechanica will keep manufacturing and test operations running smoothly, while constantly expanding and improving overall program cadence and workflows.

In this role, your mission will be building an engine repair station for innovative engine applications from the ground up. As the first certified jet mechanic at a jet engine company, you will have firsthand responsibility to develop internal processes on engine inspection and alterations alongside engineering with heavy influence on technical direction. This will enable a rapid program development and validation, with transition to manufacturing in production quantities. You embody the test-like-you-fly philosophy.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Inspect engines after regular use for corrosion, wear, and prior damage, determine approach for restoration, and implement solution

 - Establish inspection criteria and acceptance standards where no prior process exists, and refine over time

 - Frequent collaboration with engineering, review and approve any deviation from planned procedure during unprecedented build configurations

 - Train and calibrate other technicians on inspection standards as the program scales

 - Conduct test facility and equipment maintenance, and site cleanliness

 - Conduct work efficiently while in a safe and professional manner

 - FAA A&P or repairman certificate, with experience complying to 14 CFR Part 145 class 3 powerplant rating

 - FAA Inspection Authorization (IA), regularly conducting major repairs and alterations

 - Direct hands-on experience with IAE V2500, GE CFM56, or comparable turbofan engines

 - Experience troubleshooting technical problems across many applications, translating into a versatile tool kit

 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, maintenance manuals, OEM documentation, and wiring pinout diagrams

 - Flexibility to work in fast-paced environment and takes initiative for continuous improvement

 - Capable of lifting 35 pounds, stand for long periods, maneuver in restricted spaces, work low to ground and on raised platforms

 - A mechanical life outside the job is a real plus: hot rodding, motorsports, or other hands-on builds where you've had to solve problems without a finished manual

 

PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
 
 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We are looking for an experienced Platform Security Engineer to harden the security of the systems that power our business and products.

You will help us secure both our AWS infrastructure and our code base, partnering directly with engineering and other security teams to identify risk, improve architecture, investigate incidents, and build practical security controls. The role combines application, cloud and infrastructure security, detection engineering, and incident investigation.

During security and privacy incidents, you will serve as the lead technical investigator for the platform. You will work closely with the Incident Commander (Head of Security), to determine what happened, understand the impact, preserve relevant evidence, and guide containment and remediation.

Responsibilities 

 - Identify, assess, and help remediate security risks across our AWS infrastructure, Terraform code, application architecture, and product code.

 - Partner with engineering teams to design secure systems and incorporate security into normal development and operational workflows.

 - Participate in security reviews of RFC and PRR documentation, providing clear, actionable feedback on architecture, data flows, access controls, abuse cases, and technical risk.

 - Review application and infrastructure changes where additional security scrutiny is warranted.

 - Participate in external penetration tests, including preparation, technical coordination, analysis of findings, remediation planning, and validation of fixes.

 - Help improve the effectiveness and repeatability of the penetration-testing program, with the opportunity to assume ownership of the program over time.

 - Serve as the lead platform investigator during security and privacy incidents, working within the incident-response process led by the Head of Security.

 - Analyze application, cloud, identity, network, audit, and infrastructure telemetry to determine the scope, impact, and root cause of incidents.

 - Translate investigation findings into containment actions, durable remediations, improved detections, and clear technical documentation.

 - Contribute to the design, implementation, tuning, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules that monitor our platform.

 - Investigate and respond to alerts involving AWS infrastructure, application behavior, access patterns, data movement, and other platform activity.

 - Improve logging and telemetry where existing data is insufficient to detect threats or investigate incidents.

 - Develop security tooling and automation that help engineers identify and address vulnerabilities earlier.

 - Partner with SRE and engineering teams on cloud configuration, identity and access management, secrets management, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.

 - Help establish practical security standards that reduce risk without unnecessarily slowing product development.

Qualifications

 - Hands-on experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, or security-focused site reliability engineering.

 - Experience securing production systems in AWS, including familiarity with identity, networking, logging, data protection, and common cloud attack paths.

 - Strong working knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure-as-code security practices.

 - The ability to assess security across both infrastructure and application layers rather than treating them as separate environments.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will build the evaluation infrastructure that researchers use to understand model capabilities, guide training decisions, and assess readiness for release. The role spans evaluation authoring, distributed execution, and results analysis, with a particular focus on pre-training. You will work directly with researchers to make evaluations faster, more reliable, and easier to use, ensuring that the results accurately reflect the models being evaluated.

 - Design and evolve evaluation abstractions. Build clear APIs and data models for evaluation tasks, datasets, configurations, model outputs, and scores, making it straightforward to add new evaluations and extend existing workflows.

 - Build scalable, reliable execution infrastructure. Develop distributed systems for evaluating model checkpoints throughout training and ahead of release, with robust orchestration, observability, and recovery from failures.

 - Optimize evaluation and inference performance. Profile inference servers and distributed execution to improve throughput, GPU utilization, and time to results.

 - Establish evaluation correctness and reproducibility. Build validation and regression tests, version datasets and configurations, and preserve the provenance needed to reproduce results and investigate discrepancies.

 - Build researcher-facing tools. Create intuitive interfaces and dashboards for inspecting model outputs, comparing checkpoints and experiments, and debugging unexpected behavior.

 - Operate and monitor evaluations as training progresses. Track evaluation workloads and results, triage failures, and develop alerts and diagnostics that help distinguish changes in model quality from inference or evaluation issues.

 - Turn research needs into reusable systems. Partner directly with researchers to identify bottlenecks, prioritize high-impact improvements, and turn bespoke workflows into self-service tools that work across teams.
 

ABOUT YOU

 - Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or Rust, with the ability to reason deeply about concurrency, memory behavior, and performance.

 - Experience designing, building, and operating reliable, maintainable distributed systems, with sound judgment about interfaces, failure modes, and architectural tradeoffs.

 - Working knowledge of model inference and evaluation, including how implementation and configuration choices can affect measured model quality.

 - Ability to investigate complex problems across system boundaries, follow evidence, and identify root causes rather than just address symptoms.

 - Strong product judgment and experience translating the needs of researchers or other technical users into clear APIs and usable tools.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end, prioritizing competing research needs, and balancing rapid delivery with long-term reliability and maintainability.

 - Attention to detail and the persistence to investigate subtle discrepancies in model outputs, evaluation results, and system behavior.

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Ledger
jobs.description:
New York (SoHo) · Hybrid, 3 days/week onsite · Full-time

ABOUT FORMANCE

Formance builds open-source financial infrastructure. Our core product is a programmable double-entry ledger. Fintechs, crypto platforms, and financial institutions use it as the source of truth for their balances: every movement of money is recorded as a transaction between accounts, and every balance can be traced back to the postings that produced it.

Around the ledger, we connect to banks and payment providers and reconcile what the ledger records against what actually moved.

We are a team of 30+ people, mostly engineers, working across New York and Paris. Our systems support real money movement, so correctness is not optional.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

Our customers are engineering teams building financial products. They come to us with questions like “how do we track user wallets, pending funds, and fees so that every cent is accounted for?” or “what happens to our balances when a payment fails halfway through?”

You help them answer those questions, from the first technical conversation through proof of concept and into a successful transition to implementation.

 - Design money flows. Turn a customer's product into a ledger model: which accounts exist, how funds move between them, and how balances are queried. Typical use cases include user wallets, pending vs. settled funds, fees and revenue sharing, refunds and chargebacks, and multi-currency.

 - Lead the technical sale. Partner closely with our NYC sales team to run technical discovery and architecture sessions with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of Payments. Build proofs of concept around real customer use cases and explain architectural trade-offs clearly, including what the ledger guarantees and what remains the customer's responsibility.

 - Build trust with technical buyers. Challenge assumptions, answer complex engineering questions, and help prospective customers evaluate how Formance fits into their existing infrastructure. You are comfortable engaging directly with senior technical decision-makers.

 - Support the transition to production. Work with our implementation team to ensure a smooth handover, sharing technical context, architectural decisions, and customer requirements. Stay involved when your expertise is needed to resolve complex technical questions.

 - Bring the field back to the product. Turn recurring customer patterns into reference models, examples, and documentation, and share structured feedback with our engineering team in Paris.

 - Support customers beyond the initial sale, helping with technical onboarding, implementation, and a smooth transition to ongoing customer support.

You will join a small Solutions Engineering team and work closely with our founders, NYC sales team, and engineers.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or technical implementation, ideally within payments, banking, fintech infrastructure, or digital assets.

 - A strong understanding of how money is tracked in software. You know what double-entry means in practice, or you have worked on systems where balances, transactions, and reconciliation matter.

 - Familiarity with real payment flows, including settlement delays, returns, partial failures, and mismatches between internal records and external providers.

 - Hands-on technical experience with APIs, databases, and at least one programming language.

 - Confidence working with technical buyers. You are comfortable leading technical conversations with engineering leaders, challenging architectural assumptions, and building credibility with highly technical stakeholders.

 - The ability to explain complex systems clearly to engineering, finance, and product stakeholders, and an interest in working directly with customers.

 - An independent approach to problem-solving. You learn unfamiliar systems quickly and use modern development tools, including AI, where they improve your work.

STRONG SIGNALS

 - You have built or maintained a ledger, wallet system, or reconciliation process.

 - You have worked with a banking-as-a-service provider, card issuer, or core banking system.

 - You have supported technical evaluations, proofs of concept, or architecture discussions with prospective customers.

 - You have moved from a software engineering role into a customer-facing technical position.

HOW WE INTERVIEW

Part of the process is a working session in which you walk us through how you would track money for a simple product, such as a marketplace with fees, refunds, and delayed payouts.

We look at how you reason about accounts, edge cases, and architectural decisions, as well as how clearly you communicate your approach.

No prior knowledge of Formance is expected.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - $165–175k OTE 

 - Equity

 - 401(k) with 4% employer match

 - Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Annual team offsite in Europe

Building something great is addictive. It's like discovering your favorite TV show mid-season, except you're helping write the next episode. It's like unboxing a new gadget, except you're the one designing it. You shape how it feels, how it works, and how people react when they use it.

At Solidroad we're solving a big, messy, exciting problem: how do you scale customer support without losing what makes humans amazing? Warmth, empathy, intuition. We're using AI, generative tech, and real-time simulations to make this happen. It's ambitious, difficult, and genuinely new.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for BDRs who want to do more than just hit quota — someone who wants to shape the way we sell and grow the company from the ground up. You'll be one of the first hires on our sales team and will work directly with the founders. Your day-to-day will revolve around personalized email outreach, LinkedIn social selling, and cold calling to book meetings with CX and support leaders at fast-growing companies.

This is a role for someone who loves the thrill of getting a response from that cold prospect, who geeks out on subject lines, and who sees rejection as part of the game. If you want to break into SaaS sales, make a name for yourself, and grow into an AE or manager role fast — this is the place.

 

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO DAY-TO-DAY

 - Drive top-of-funnel activity: personalized email outreach, LinkedIn messaging, and cold calls.

 - Book qualified meetings with CX leaders — think Heads of Support, VP of Ops, Directors of Enablement.

 - Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams on outbound campaigns and messaging experiments.

 - Keep HubSpot updated and clean — pipeline discipline matters.

 - Work closely with the founders to refine our ICP and sales process.

 - Learn what it takes to take a startup from $1M to $10M ARR.

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We're a small, focused group working full-time in our Dublin & San Francisco offices. ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 

This role is open to nurses!

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Trust & Safety Analyst protects the integrity of our platform by expertly managing incident reports from start to finish. This role focuses on two core outcomes: providing an exceptional, empathetic experience for customers during high-stakes situations, and decisively removing bad actors when appropriate to keep our platform safe.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Investigate safety incidents end-to-end and deliver timely, customer-focused resolutions.

 - Accurately classify incidents, assess severity, and make fair, well-reasoned deactivation decisions.

 - Develop and implement safety initiatives, tools, and processes that reduce incidents and strengthen platform integrity.

 - Shape and uphold marketplace safety norms through clear policy development/recommendations.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Support, Product, Legal, and other teams to drive safety outcomes.

 - Assess safety and compliance risks; design strategies to close gaps and prevent recurrence.

 - Serve as a subject-matter expert on Trust & Safety policies, providing guidance internally and externally.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Ability to resolve customer incidents with empathy and action

 - Possess an “I can handle anything” mentality and extremely sound judgement in ambiguous situations

 - Preferred:
 
 - 3+ years in a customer-facing role.

 - LVN or RN is a big plus

WHY JOIN CLIPBOARD?

 - We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

 - Fast-paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

 - A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

 - Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.
 
 

HIRING PROCESS

 1. Application

 2. Case Study 

 3. Case Study Interview

 4. Interview with Head of Trust and Safety

 5. Interview with Head of Operations

 6. Culture Interview (People Ops)

jobs.description:
ABOUT INSCRIBE

At Inscribe, we're on a mission to catch fraud with confidence. In 2017, we set out to build the first document fraud detection product. Today, we process millions of applications each year and work with many of the leading fintechs and banks across the U.S. We believe the game of cat-and-mouse in fraud requires a fundamentally new approach. With care for our customers, attention to detail, and grounded execution, we’re reimagining how fraud is detected and prevented.

Inscribe is trusted by leading banks and fintechs, including Coinbase, Plaid, Bluevine, and Ramp. Inscribe is backed by Threshold Ventures, Uncork Capital, Y Combinator, Crosslink Capital, and Foundry, and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Inscribe is scaling quickly, and our platform sits at the heart of our customers’ fraud workflows. We’re hiring a Staff Systems Engineer to take ownership of the systems and infrastructure that support our real-time API product and internal services.

This role blends DevOps, site reliability, cloud architecture, backend engineering, and datastore optimization. You'll work across the entire stack to drive performance, observability, scalability, and operational rigor. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that as our customer base and data volumes grow, our systems stay fast, stable, and cost-efficient.

We’re looking for a high-agency engineer who can evaluate what exists today, identify what won’t scale, and execute improvements aligned with our business goals. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks in systems, builds with urgency, and raises the engineering bar across the company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead design, implementation, and scaling of core infrastructure across compute (ECS), data (Postgres, Redis), observability (Datadog, Grafana), and networking layers

 - Optimize deployment pipelines, test environments, and release automation to improve developer efficiency and reduce operational risk

 - Monitor and improve production system uptime, latency, and cost performance

 - Collaborate with engineers to tune service performance, database access patterns, and caching strategies

 - Own capacity planning, system reliability, and on-call best practices — proactively preventing incidents, not just reacting to them

 - Drive architectural decisions for high-throughput API services, balancing long-term scalability with short-term velocity

 - Contribute to tooling and processes that foster operational excellence across the engineering organization

 - Lead infrastructure projects from roadmap through rollout, always anchored in business impact and product goals

 - Mentor teammates and model a high standard for engineering quality, documentation, and decision-making

TECH STACK

We don't expect candidates to know everything, but experience in most of these areas will be helpful:

 - Cloud: AWS (ECS, S3, Bedrock, etc.)

 - Infrastructure: Terraform, Docker

 - Observability: Datadog, Grafana

 - Datastores: Postgres, Redis

 - Languages: Python (Django), VueJS

 - AI Platforms: Anthropic, AWS Bedrock

ABOUT YOU

 - 4+ years of hands-on experience across systems engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud architecture

 - Proven ability to scale production systems and infrastructure in high-growth environments

 - Deep familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-heavy backend systems

 - Strong backend development skills in Python, with an ability to get deep into the codebase

 - Passion for reducing toil, automating operational tasks, and improving engineering velocity

 - Business-aware mindset: You can align infrastructure decisions with product goals and growth strategy

 - Pragmatic, high-agency problem solver — able to balance short-term delivery with long-term vision

 - You’re energized by wearing many hats, pushing technical boundaries, and leading by example
 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial Screen with the Hiring Manager to talk through the role and your experience (30 min)

 2. Check In Call with HR to understand and align motivations and expectations (30 minutes)

 3. Take Home Technical Exercise followed by a live discussion with 1-2 team members to review the test and assess your technical ability (1 hour)

 4. Meet our CTO to discuss Inscribe’s vision and align on values (30 minutes)

BENEFITS

At Inscribe, we are building a company and culture where everyone can produce their best work. Here are a few of our benefits and perks: 

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Comprehensive healthcare

 - Unlimited vacation policy 

 - 401(k) and pension plans

 - Complete work setup 

 - Monthly wellness stipend
 

Inscribe provides equity employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regards to race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, genetics, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by company policy.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
About Campfire

Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid-market finance teams. We’re building the future of ERP by replacing outdated systems and manual accounting processes with an AI-native platform that helps finance teams move faster and operate more efficiently.

The role

Campfire is hiring its first full-time CISO to own security, compliance and customer trust as we sell to larger enterprises.

 - Campfire is an AI-native ERP and financial automation platform. We raised a $65M Series B led by Accel and Ribbit Capital.

 - Customers trust us with their general ledger, bank details, payroll and vendor data.

 - Today, security is run by a fractional vCISO firm plus a few engineers. Deals are increasingly gated on security reviews.

 - You will turn that into an in-house program that closes deals faster and keeps us safe.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Customer security reviews and deal support

 - Answer security questionnaires, TPRMs and RFPs (SIG, CAIQ, custom) with a fast, predictable turnaround.

 - Join customer and prospect calls with CIOs and IT security teams, including implementation kickoffs.

 - Maintain a trust center and security collateral pack: policies, pentest reports, network architecture, insurance certificate.

Compliance and audits

 - Own SOC 1 and SOC 2 (Type I and II): scope, auditor management, bridge letters, and customer follow-up questions.

 - Decide and lead the path to ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and other frameworks customers ask about.

 - Run Vanta as the system of record for controls and evidence.

Privacy and contracts

 - Partner with Legal on DPAs, BAAs, GDPR transfer mechanisms (SCCs / DPF), DORA and non-US privacy laws.

 - Review security and audit-cooperation clauses in customer contracts.

 - Own data retention, export and residency answers, including new-region or GovCloud requests.

Security operations and incident response

 - Own the incident response plan, run tabletop tests, and lead response when incidents happen.

 - Own customer breach notification decisions and post-incident write-ups.

 - Own detection and email security: SIEM, EDR, email protection, identity alerting.

Identity and access

 - Own Okta (SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, SCIM), MDM and least-privilege access to production.

 - Support customer-facing SSO/SCIM setups.

Resilience and policy

 - Own BCDR plans, RTO/RPO targets, backup and restore testing.

 - Maintain information security, responsible AI and vendor management policies.

 - Run background and sanctions screening for employees and vendors.

AI security

 - Answer customer questions on our AI assistant: underlying models, prompt and response retention, logging, and opt-out.

 - Govern AI vendors and subprocessors.

FIRST 90 DAYS

 1. Take over customer security reviews from the vCISO firm and set a clear intake and turnaround process for Sales.

 2. Finish the Vanta migration and publish a trust center with standard collateral.

 3. Finalize and test the BCDR and incident response plans.

 4. Close out post-incident hardening: email security, Okta alerting, MDM and EDR coverage.

 5. Present a 12-month security and certification roadmap to the CTO.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years in security, with 3+ leading a program at a B2B SaaS company.

 - Has owned SOC 1 / SOC 2 audits end to end. ISO 27001 experience a plus.

 - Comfortable on calls with enterprise CIOs and auditors, and enjoys helping close deals.

 - Hands-on with AWS, Okta, Google Workspace, EDR and SIEM tooling.

 - Working knowledge of GDPR, DPAs and contract security terms.

 - Has led real incident response, including customer communication.

 - Fintech, ERP or accounting software background a strong plus.

 - Pragmatic builder: starts as a team of one, hires as we grow.

REPORTING AND LOGISTICS

 - Reports to the CEO. Works closely with Sales, Legal and Engineering.

 - Location: Bay Area preferred.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance & Business Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto

About the Role

We are hiring our first Strategic Finance & Business Operations hire to help build the finance function from the ground up and drive high-impact projects across the business. This is a foundational role equal parts strategic finance leader and operator, splitting time between strategic finance (50%) and project-based business operations (50%).

You will report directly to the Head of Finance and work alongside the founders and leadership team. We are looking for someone who combines the analytical rigor of investment banking or private equity with the scrappiness and speed of an early-stage operator. You should be the kind of person who can build a three-statement model on Monday and negotiate a vendor contract on Thursday.

This is not a back-office role. You will be in the room where decisions are made, armed with the data and frameworks to shape them.

What You Will Do

Strategic Finance (50%)

 - Build dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into revenue, burn, unit economics, and key operating metrics

 - Own financial planning and analysis including annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount modeling

 - Support fundraising, investor relations, and strategic transactions such as M&A and partnerships with data-driven analysis and materials

 - Develop and maintain the financial infrastructure needed to operate efficiently as we scale from Series B toward growth stage

Business Operations (50%)

 - Take on high-priority, ambiguous projects that move the needle: pricing strategy, market analysis, new market entry, partnership evaluation, sales compensation design, or whatever the business needs most

 - Build operational infrastructure and processes as the company scales: the systems, workflows, and playbooks that do not exist yet

 - Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to bring financial and analytical rigor to business decisions

 - Drive procurement, vendor evaluation, and cost optimization across the company

 - Identify and solve operational bottlenecks before they become problems

Who You Are

 - 2 to 5 years of experience with a strong foundation in investment banking, private equity, or consulting, followed by experience at a high-growth technology company (Series A to D preferred)

 - You have built financial models extensively. Excel and Google Sheets are extensions of your brain

 - You thrive in ambiguity. You do not need a playbook. You write the playbook

 - High agency, low ego. You will build a board deck in the morning and chase down a missing invoice in the afternoon. No task is beneath you

 - Exceptional judgment and prioritization. You know the difference between what is important and what is urgent

 - Strong communicator who can distill complexity into clear, actionable recommendations for founders and leadership

 - SQL proficiency required. Python or BI tools are a plus

 - Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making decisions at speed

 - You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. When you see a problem, you fix it

Why This Role

 - First strategic finance hire: you will define how this function operates and set the foundation for the team you will eventually build

 - Direct access to founders and the leadership team. Your work will directly influence company strategy

 - High-trust, low-ego environment where impact matters more than titles

 - Join a category-defining company in a massive, underserved market at exactly the right moment: post-Series B, enterprise traction proven, and scaling rapidly

 - Competitive compensation including base salary, equity, and benefits

Why join us?

 - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human.

jobs.title: Developer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco / Remote Okay

AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. We’re looking for a Developer Success Engineer to own the front line between developers using AgentMail and the team building it.

This isn’t a role where success means closing as many tickets as possible. We want someone who can solve technical problems independently, understand what a developer is actually trying to do, and recognize when the same problem keeps showing up.

Your job is to answer the question, figure out why it had to be asked, and make sure we learn from it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own technical support for developers building with AgentMail.

 - Debug API requests, webhooks, product issues, and integrations.

 - Reproduce issues and determine whether something is expected behavior, developer error, a documentation gap, or a product bug.

 - Resolve the large majority of issues independently without needing to pull in another engineer.

 - When something is broken, isolate the problem and give engineering a high-quality reproduction - or open a PR and fix it yourself.

 - Notice recurring questions and friction across support conversations and surface those patterns to the team.

 - Identify inconsistencies and confusing behavior across our API, documentation, and developer experience.

 - Jump on calls with developers when async debugging isn’t enough.

 - Write concise, technically precise responses that make developers feel like they’re talking to someone who actually understands their problem.

YOU WILL BE A FIT IF

 - You have 2-6 years of experience in technical support, developer experience, solutions engineering, or engineering, ideally working with a developer-facing or API-first product.

 - You’re comfortable reading API documentation, inspecting requests and responses, working with logs, and reproducing technical issues.

 - You can distinguish between a bug, expected behavior, and incorrect API usage without immediately escalating to engineering.

 - You can write code to investigate issues and ship small fixes.

 - You’re an unusually clear and concise communicator.

 - You’re resourceful. When you don’t know the answer, your instinct is to investigate rather than hand the problem to someone else.

 - You have strong interpersonal instincts and genuinely care about understanding why a customer is frustrated or confused.

 - You notice patterns. Answering the same question for the fifth time makes you want to fix the underlying problem.

WHAT THIS ROLE ISN’T

This isn’t traditional customer success or account management. You won’t spend your day running check-in calls or forwarding technical questions to engineers.

You’ll be expected to understand the product deeply enough to investigate most problems yourself - and to turn what you learn from customers into signal for the people building AgentMail.

jobs.title: GL Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto https://www.happyrobot.ai/blog/manifesto.

ROLE OVERVIEW

HappyRobot is hiring an Accounting Manager, General Ledger & OPEX — an owner who will stand up our core close, multi-entity consolidation, and operating-expense accounting from scratch, reporting to the Head of Accounting, as we scale globally across different entities.

This is a 0-to-1 job with real autonomy attached. You're not inheriting a close calendar or a team structure, you're designing both, and you're expected to be a genuine thought partner to the Head of Accounting on GL and close policy, not just an executor of decisions made elsewhere. We expect you to actively hunt down repetitive, manual close work and eliminate it using AI finance tools (including our own platform).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - End-to-End Month-End Close: Design and execute a scalable close process from the ground up, including reconciliations, accruals, and balance sheet flux review on a calendar optimized to tighten every quarter as automation matures.

 - Strategic GL Partnership: Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Head of Accounting on general ledger and operational policy decisions.

 - Automation & Efficiency: Actively eliminate manual, repetitive close tasks by leveraging system automations and AI finance tools, exercising sound judgment on where automation is appropriate.

 - Multi-Entity Consolidation: Build and systematize multi-entity consolidation and intercompany elimination processes across US, UK, Spain, and Brazil entities (covering transfer pricing, FX translation, and CTA calculation) to replace manual quarterly rebuilds.

 - OPEX Accounting Ownership: Manage end-to-end OPEX accounting, including unbilled accruals, prepaid amortization, and budget-to-actual variance analysis in partnership with FP&A.

 - Feed & GL Reconciliation: Own reconciliation between AP (Ramp) and payroll (Rippling) feeds and the general ledger, seamlessly closing gaps left by automated integrations.

 - Audit Readiness & Controls: Establish rigorous internal controls and reconciliation documentation standards from scratch to prepare for the company's first external audit, owning auditor relationships on GL requests.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6-8 years of progressive general ledger / OPEX experience, ideally including multi-entity or international consolidation.

 - A finance engineer's mindset: you build scalable systems that reduce manual work and increase accuracy, not just process what's in front of you.

 - Proven, hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your actual day-to-day work, and comfort picking up new automation tools quickly.

 - Strong judgment about which accounting activities should be automated and which genuinely require human review.

 - Solid understanding of foreign currency translation (ASC 830), intercompany accounting, and consolidation mechanics.

 - Comfort operating with real autonomy; you'll be trusted to make GL policy calls, not just execute someone else's.

 - A clear communicator who can explain close mechanics to non-finance stakeholders without jargon.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field; CPA a plus, but not required.

 - Comfortable with our operating principles (below) — this is a hands-on, no-task-too-small environment, regardless of title.

WHY JOIN US

 - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

 - Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.

 - Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

 - Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

 - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

OUR OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We're running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles

jobs.title: Part-time BDR
jobs.description:
About Proof of Human
Proof of Human is building the global standard for human verification across the internet. As the line between human and machine behavior becomes harder to discern, establishing who or what is behind every interaction is becoming foundational to the integrity of a digital world. Founded by Princeton PhD Scientists, Mayank Agrawal and Matt Hardy, Proof of Human is a research and technology company developing the science, products, and infrastructure required to meet this challenge at global scale.

About the role

We’re looking for a part-time Business Development Representative (BDR) who loves selling and wants a flexible work role. You’ll work directly with the founders and staff to win new customers for Proof of Human, owning the sales process from finding prospects and starting conversations to negotiating and closing deals.

With a flexible 20-hour workweek and uncapped commission, this role offers the opportunity to build something yourself and grow our business. You’ll have agency to develop your own approach, build repeatable sales systems, and use automation to keep your pipeline moving so each hour becomes more productive. We’re looking for someone who gets a thrill from closing a deal, takes ownership of their results, and sees the opportunity to help shape Proof of Human’s growth.

What you’ll do:

 - New Business Generation: Find and pursue customers who have a real need for Proof of Human. Build prospect lists, pick up the phone, run outbound campaigns, and use your network to create opportunities. Take responsibility for keeping your pipeline full.

 - Customer Conversations: Lead discovery calls and demos that move prospects toward a purchase. Understand what matters to the buyer, make a compelling case for Proof of Human, handle objections, and ask for the business.

 - Deal Execution: Own the sale from first contact to signed agreement. Navigate decision-makers, negotiate commercial terms, follow up with purpose, and work through the obstacles that stand between interest and commitment. Bring in the founders and technical team when their involvement helps you close.

 - Sales Systems & Automation: Build a sales operation that makes every hour more productive. Use prospecting tools, automated outreach sequences, CRM workflows, and follow-up systems to consistently generate opportunities and give yourself more time to sell.

 - Pipeline & Revenue Ownership: Know where every deal stands, what it could be worth, and what needs to happen to win it. Prioritize the opportunities most likely to convert, reengage stalled conversations, and hold yourself accountable for bringing in revenue.

You’ll be a good fit if:

 - You love the sale. You enjoy opening doors, earning someone’s trust, and getting a deal across the finish line. Winning business is satisfying to you, and you’re motivated by the financial rewards that come with doing it well.

 - You create your own momentum. You can find a starting point, take initiative, and keep moving without someone directing every step. You’re resourceful when an approach stalls and persistent about finding one that works.

 - You’re curious and persuasive. You ask good questions, listen closely, and understand what matters to the person across from you. You can explain an unfamiliar product clearly and connect its value to a customer’s specific needs.

 - You make every hour count. You’re organized about your pipeline, disciplined about follow-up, and thoughtful about where you spend your time. You look for ways to improve your results and build systems that make you more effective.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, GenAI & Web Tools
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Overview.ai http://Overview.ai is transforming manufacturing quality control with an advanced edge-enabled AI vision system that combines cutting-edge deep learning with ease of use and quick setup. Our system handles a wide array of inspection tasks—from subtle assembly verification to defect detection and orientation checks—delivering real-time, high-accuracy inspections that seamlessly integrate into existing production lines.

Trusted by leading manufacturers like Ford, Honda, Toyota, SpaceX, Milliken, and Flex-N-Gate, our cameras enable faster throughput, reduced scrap, and lower inspection costs—without the complexity and expense of traditional vision systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the web tools and GenAI applications that turn our edge-AI vision platform into products people use every day—both the customer-facing tool suite and the internal tooling that lets our teams move faster.

This is a hands-on, full-stack role. You'll own tools end-to-end, from a React/TypeScript interface down to the Python services behind it, and you'll be building on the frontier: LLM-powered assistants, synthetic data generation, and agent-style workflow builders that sit on top of our vision system. Think products like Auto-Defect Creator Studio, and Device Management Platform—plus the utilities that make the platform easier to run.

You'll operate with high autonomy in a small, fast team: you pick the approach, ship quickly, and iterate with real users.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

GenAI Application Development: Design and build LLM-powered tools—AI copilots and expert assistants (documentation search, guided consultation), synthetic training-data generation, and agent-style flow builders—that make our vision platform smarter and easier to use.

Full-Stack Web Tools: Own web tools end-to-end, from React/TypeScript frontends to Python backends and APIs, spanning both customer-facing products and internal utilities (e.g., optics calculators, recipe analysis, log/telemetry tooling).

0→1 Product Building: Rapidly prototype new tools, get them in front of users, and iterate. You'll turn rough ideas into shipped products, then sharpen them based on real usage.

Platform Integration: Connect the tools to our edge-AI stack—camera fleet, inference outputs, recipes, and firmware—so they work against real inspection data, not toy examples.

Quality & Craft: Sweat performance, reliability, and UX. These tools are how customers and colleagues experience Overview; they should feel fast, clear, and trustworthy.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years building full-stack web applications, with a proven track record of shipping products end-to-end at a Senior or Staff level.

 - Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript for building modern, polished web interfaces.

 - Strong proficiency in Python for backend services, APIs, and data/tooling work.

 - Experience building LLM-powered / GenAI product features—calling LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or agent workflows—or a strong passion and demonstrated aptitude for it.

 - A product mindset: you care about the user, make good judgment calls under ambiguity, and can drive a tool from idea to shipped without a detailed spec.

 - Professional experience with (or a strong passion for) using AI agent tools to architect solutions and solve difficult problems efficiently.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience with RAG infrastructure, vector databases, or agent-orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with node-based / flow-builder UIs (e.g., React Flow), data visualization, or design systems.

 - Familiarity with computer vision, manufacturing, or industrial automation domains.

 - Docker and cloud deployment experience.

WHY JOIN

 - High Agency, Zero Bureaucracy: You come in as a senior builder, not a ticket-taker. You define the tools, pick the stack, and decide how they get built. We hire smart people and get out of their way.

 - Build on the Frontier: GenAI is core to what we're building, not a bolt-on. You'll ship real LLM-powered products to real manufacturers—and see them used on the factory floor.

 - Work Smarter, Not Harder: We don't just build AI; we use it. If you can lean on an AI agent to automate the grunt work, we'll high-five you, not ask why you aren't typing. We measure leverage, not hours.

 - Growth: Join a fast-growing, fast-moving, and profitable startup.
