jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our vision is to become the marketplace for everything expensive, specialized, and difficult to move. We’re building the infrastructure that powers the procurement and disposition of assets across America’s essential industries, automating everything from discovery and payments to freight, warranty, and financing. Today, Garage operates in cities and towns across all 50 states and has surpassed $100M+ in annualized transaction volume on the platform.

Our mission is to save local governments and essential services businesses time and money. We started with fire departments two years ago and have since expanded into EMS and heavy-duty, launching new verticals while growing revenue >10x last year.

If you move fast, hold a high bar, and want meaningful ownership in building a category-defining company, Garage is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Business Operations Associate, you’ll help make Garage run. You’ll work across nearly every part of the company, jumping in wherever there is an important problem to solve, process to build, or initiative that needs an owner.

This is a true operator role. You’ll build processes from scratch, fix things that aren’t working, coordinate across teams, and own the many things required to keep a fast-growing startup moving. Some projects will be highly visible; others will happen behind the scenes but be just as critical to the company’s success.

Along the way, you’ll get unusual exposure to how a startup operates — from People and Finance to GTM, Product, company planning, and leadership decision-making. As you build context and earn trust, you’ll take on increasingly strategic projects, making this an ideal role for someone who wants to learn how to run a company from the inside out and ultimately grow into a startup leader or Chief of Staff.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Own the systems, processes, and recurring workstreams that keep Garage running smoothly, including core internal operations like People Ops, benefits, compliance, and insurance.

 - Step into ambiguous problems without clear owners, create structure, and drive them from open question to completed outcome.

 - Identify inefficiencies and build scalable, repeatable processes that make the company faster and more effective.

 - Work cross-functionally to coordinate priorities, unblock execution, and drive important company-wide initiatives forward.
 

WHAT YOU NEED

 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

 - 2+ years of experience at a startup in an execution-focused role, investment banking, consulting, ex-Founders, working at a startup, business development, or related roles

 - A natural operator mindset with a strong bias toward action — you see something that needs to get done and take ownership of figuring it out

 - A willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever the company needs, from building a new process to handling the small but important details that keep things running

 - Exceptional organization and reliability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without letting things fall through the cracks

 - Comfort with ambiguity, a steep learning curve, and the ability to bring structure to problems you may have never encountered before

 - Intellectual curiosity and strategic thinking, paired with a strong desire to turn ideas into action and make the people around you more effective

OUR VALUES

 - Take Big Swings. We are here to transform an overlooked industry—not make small improvements around the edges. We set ambitious goals, take calculated risks, and push through setbacks. We never trade lasting impact for short-term comfort.

 - Customers Come First. Our customers operate in an industry burdened by slow, expensive, and outdated processes. We attack the problems that cost them the most and measure our success by the time and money we give back to them.

 - Play For the Front of the Jersey. We put the mission ahead of ourselves. We challenge each other directly, support each other relentlessly, and step up whenever the team needs us. We win together, and we have fun doing it.

 - All Gas, No Ego. Building something that matters takes relentless effort. We move fast, take ownership, and see hard problems through. When we fall short, we own it, learn quickly, and come back stronger.

WHY JOIN GARAGE?

 - Do work that matters. Our platform helps people buy the assets that local communities rely on to keep their communities safe, clean, and operating every day.

 - Help shape the company. Join as one of our first 45 employees and work directly alongside the founders.

 - Make an outsized impact. You’ll join a talent-dense, high-performance team where every person moves the company forward.

 - Build from a strong foundation. We’ve raised $18M, including a $13.5M Series A, from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and stock options

 - 100% medical, dental and vision insurance coverage

 - Unlimited PTO (in addition to company observed holidays)

 - Daily lunch & dinner (for employees based in NYC)

 - $100/month wellness stipend

 - 401(k) w/ employer match

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Annual team offsite

 - Relocation assistance

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. We don’t expect you to check all the qualification boxes and encourage you to apply if you have experience in some of the areas.

Equal Opportunity

As an equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, natural origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

FOUNDATIONS

VISION: 

Build and operate a company-wide foundations platform that accelerates every team by providing reliable, scalable developer infrastructure, SRE capabilities, and high-throughput data ingestion tooling enabling Reflection to move faster as we scale.

WHAT THIS TEAM DOES

Build and operate the core shared services that power our research, training, and production environments. These systems form the foundational platform that multiple teams depend on for model development, deployment, and evaluation, unifying data, compute, and workflow management across the stack while enabling rapid experimentation and reliable production systems.

 - Build and operate shared services that multiple teams rely on across research and production workflows.

 - Define and uphold reliability targets through SLIs, SLOs, and healthy on-call practices.

 - Maintain strong operational readiness with runbooks, incident playbooks, and capacity planning.

 - Ensure correctness and performance under load, addressing consistency, tail latency, and failure modes.

 - Develop APIs, SDKs, and internal platforms that enable high-velocity experimentation and iteration.

 - Reduce operational burden through better tooling, standardization, and platform patterns that scale across teams.
 
 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH

 - Container Abstractions: Containers-as-a-Service, Kubernetes abstraction layers, container orchestration, reproducible environments, multi-tenant isolation.

 - Distributed Systems Architecture: Sharding, replication, coordination services, high-concurrency systems, concurrency control.

 - Service Development Stack: gRPC, Protobuf, Go, Rust, C++.

 - Reliability & Performance: Idempotency, retries, backpressure, SLI/SLO design, tail latency optimization, service reliability engineering.

ABOUT YOU

 - Strong software engineering background with experience shipping production-grade systems.

 - Experience designing APIs, services, or developer platforms that handle large-scale data or compute.

 - Comfortable navigating complex codebases, debugging hard problems, and optimizing for reliability and speed.

 - Thrive in a high-agency, fast-paced startup environment; bias toward action and impact.

 - Excited about zero to one challenges, building new systems rather than maintaining legacy ones.

 - Collaborative, clear communicator, and comfortable working across research and infra boundaries.

 - Motivated by creating the software backbone for the world’s most capable open-weight AI systems.
 
 

WHAT WE OFFER:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

 - Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.

 - Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

 - Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.

 - Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.

 - Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.

 - Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.

 - Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.

 - Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

jobs.title: Growth Operations
jobs.description:
About Uplane (YC F25)

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building an AI marketing operating system. Our software supports marketing teams with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, budget allocation, and more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native marketers and need an ambitious growth operator who will do whatever it takes to grow the company and build the operations behind it.

 

About The Role

We're seeking a highly motivated, German- and English-speaking growth operator to join our team full-time (on-site in San Francisco or Berlin). In this role, you work directly with the founders on everything that makes Uplane grow. You build the structures, processes and team behind a company that is scaling fast across Germany and the US, and you take on whatever is most important right now.

 

Why Join

 - Learn how a company gets built, from the people building it. You work directly with the founders and see every decision from the inside: what works, what breaks, and why.

 - You build the company. Every process, tool and team you set up changes what Uplane can do next.

 - Learn how an AI-native company runs. Tech-savvy team, high leverage, AI in every workflow.

 - Take ownership and grow quickly.

 - Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

 - Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble.

 

Responsibilities

 - Growth Projects: You work directly with the founders on whatever moves Uplane forward right now: scaling the team internationally, launching new projects.

 - Build AI-Native Operations: AI in every workflow, no manual work that a machine does better.

 - Build the Team: You help us find and onboard the people who build the marketing agency of the future, and you make sure new hires get up to speed in days, not months.

 

Requirements

 - Passion for building, you love growth, people and getting things done

 - At least 1 year of work experience, e.g. in business development, consulting, startups or operations

 - Strong social skills, you win people over

 - Structured and organised, you run many things in parallel without dropping any

 - Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant; you solve whatever problem comes up

 - Exceptional achievements during and beyond academic studies

 - Fluent German and English

 

Nice to Have

 - Experience building teams or processes from scratch

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Ownership mindset: you get customers live, not just unblocked

 - Accounting knowledge: GL, close process, revenue recognition (ASC 606)

 - Experience with enterprise security and compliance reviews

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST YEAR

 - Enterprise customers go live on time

 - Onboarding time drops through tooling you built

 - Field feedback ships as product improvements

 - Customers name you as a reason they chose to expand

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Behind every healthcare provider is a mountain of admin that gets in the way of getting paid for the care they deliver.

Ember AI is building advanced agents to take that work off their plate, and help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver, without all the admin. We’re growing very fast, at 200% month on month which is why we need you!

We’re backed by YC, Nexus Venture Partners and already working with physician groups and healthcare systems across the US.

A bit about the founders: Charlene, was a Product Lead at Google focusing on Healthcare AI, and Warren an MIT AI researcher with experience at NVIDIA and MIT CSAIL.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an exceptional Product Manager to own major areas of Ember’s AI agent platform.

You’ll become the SME for the product surfaces you own: understanding the customer problem deeply, defining what the agent should do, and working with engineering and operations to turn that understanding into a reliable product.

Our teams operate in fluid pods organized around the problem at hand. Depending on the initiative, you might work closely with engineers, agent operators, healthcare experts, customer-facing teams, or the founders.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own meaningful areas of Ember’s agent platform, from problem definition and product strategy through launch and continuous improvement.

 - Talk directly with customers and users to understand how their work happens today, where it breaks down, and which problems are most valuable to solve.

 - Translate complex workflows, customer needs, and business goals into clear product requirements, agent behavior, edge cases, and success criteria.

 - Partner closely with engineering to design and ship AI-native products that are useful, reliable, and trusted in real healthcare environments.

 - Define how agent quality should be measured, including accuracy, reliability, coverage, efficiency, adoption, and customer outcomes.

 - Review agent behavior, production failures, customer feedback, and product data to decide what to improve next.

 - Make thoughtful prioritization decisions across customer value, business impact, product quality, and engineering effort.

 - Help shape Ember’s broader product strategy, roadmap, and product-development practices as the company grows.

 - Use modern AI tools to research, prototype, analyze data, and communicate ideas more quickly.

 - Work alongside agent operators and other customer-facing teammates, while maintaining clear ownership of product direction and long-term product quality.

ABOUT YOU

 - ~2 - 4 years of product management experience and have owned meaningful product areas or complex features.

 - Demonstrate exceptional product judgment, structured thinking, and learning speed.

 - Experience taking an ambiguous problem, understand it deeply, and give a team clear direction.

 - Customer-oriented and want to understand how users work.

 - Ability to move between strategic thinking and detailed execution without losing sight of the outcome.

 - You are analytical and comfortable using product data, customer evidence, and first-principles reasoning to make decisions.

 - You communicate clearly in writing and conversation and can create alignment across technical and non-technical teams.

 - You thrive in a fast-moving environment where teams and responsibilities flex around the most important problem.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

 - Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, automation, or other products with probabilistic behavior.

 - Familiarity with healthcare revenue-cycle management, claims, coding, prior authorization, denials, or payer-provider workflows.

 - Experience working closely with operations or customer-facing teams on complex deployments.

 - Comfort using SQL, analytics tools, logs, or lightweight prototypes to answer your own questions.

 - Experience defining product-quality metrics or evaluation frameworks.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT Clearly AI

Most security teams review what they can, triaging a backlog by urgency and headcount while products ship without review. Clearly AI is the continuous threat modeling platform that gives security, privacy, and GRC teams the capacity to cover more, with accurate, source-cited assessments that enterprise teams trust.

We're live with Fortune 500s and global brands including Rivian, Ericsson, HID Global, PayPal, and others. We've reviewed thousands of security-critical products, from badge scanners to stablecoin platforms to autonomous driving features.

Backed by Y Combinator, Basis Set Ventures, Crosspoint Capital, Argon Ventures, and Ritual Capital. Selected as a Top 10 Finalist for the RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox Contest. Advised by former CISOs of Disney, Costco, Amplitude, Chevron, the former CEO of Reddit, and the former CPO of Brex.

We are early. We are deeply technical. We are building alongside real practitioners, and we want someone who can speak their language to help us reach more of them.

Location

Seattle/SFO/Bend, OR preferred, remote OK. We meet in person 1-2x per quarter, and this role will travel for industry conferences and events. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why this role exists

Our buyers are security, AppSec, GRC, and privacy leaders at Fortune 500s and large enterprises. They're busy, skeptical, and hear from a dozen vendors a week. Reaching them takes someone who can:

 - Research an account deeply enough to know where security reviews are breaking down and how to navigate that organization in a sales and customer context

 - Engage senior security leaders with relevant, credible outreach instead of volume

 - Turn event conversations, inbound interest, and target account engagement into qualified meetings

 - Hand off opportunities to sales with the context and account research needed to move quickly

This role exists to build a predictable pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities and to sharpen how we go to market along the way.

What you’ll own

 1. Outbound prospecting & ABM

 - This role’s performance and commission is primarily based on SQLs generation

 - Design and run outbound campaigns into target enterprise accounts (5,000+ employees, Fortune 500, mature security programs)

 - Partner with Account Executives to build account plans: key stakeholders, pain points, entry points, and engagement strategy

 - Map buying committees primarily across security, AppSec, product security

 - Craft tailored messaging across email, phone, LinkedIn, events, and partner channels

 - Execute multi-threaded outreach until an opportunity is qualified.

 2. Inbound lead management

 - Own follow-up on inbound MQLs from the website, content, and campaigns

 - Qualify quickly, nurture where timing isn't right, and advance ready leads to SQL

 - Make sure no inbound interest goes cold

 3. Events & conferences

 - Set meetings ahead of key industry events (RSAC, Black Hat, IAPP, regional security events, and more)

 - Work booth and event conversations alongside the team

 - Own post-event follow-up on badge scans, dinners, and speaking engagements, and turn them into first conversations

 4. Qualification & sales handoff

 - Confirm interest, pain, and timing, and document why this, why now, and why Clearly AI

 - Schedule discovery calls and demos with Account Executives and founders

 - Hand off SQLs with complete context so sales can pick up without re-asking questions

 - Stay informed on deal progression and contribute account context as needed

 5. Engaging our influential network
 
 1. Strategize and drive regular cadences of communication and enablement with advisors, investors, partners, customers, and other friendlies that can support account entry and nurture
 
 2. Maintain and grow roster of our relationships, and other supporting activities of internal leaders and subject matter experts in service of GTM initiatives

 6. Market insights & data hygiene

 - Share what you're hearing from prospects with Marketing, Product, and Sales to refine messaging and targeting

 - Track which channels, messages, and personas convert best

 - Keep prospect, account, and activity data accurate and complete in Attio

 - Use tooling and automation (Clay, Amplemarket, and similar) to enrich data and scale research without losing quality

What this role is not

 - Not a high-volume, spray-and-pray SDR seat

 - Not a closing role; you'll hand qualified opportunities to sales to carry forward

 - Not a marketing campaign manager, though you'll work closely within the Marketing organization

 - Not a role where you wait for leads to show up

What we’re looking for

Required

 - 3-5 years in business development, account development, or sales roles within enterprise software

 - Experience selling into security buyers (CISOs, Security and Product Security Engineers, AppSec and/or risk teams)

 - Comfort with technical security concepts and the ability to hold a credible conversation with security practitioners

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales or account management goals

 - Experience engaging senior stakeholders and navigating complex enterprise organizations

 - Proficiency with CRM and sales engagement tools; experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar

 - Highly organized, self-motivated, and disciplined about follow-up and data quality

 - Self-driven learner with technical aptitude and curiosity toward AI-first tooling and workflows

Strongly Preferred

 - Familiarity with threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, vendor risk management, or AppSec review workflows

 - Experience running enterprise ABM plays alongside Account Executives

 - Experience generating pipeline from conferences and field events

 - Hands-on experience with Clay, Amplemarket, Attio, and/or similar modern GTM tooling

 - Experience working in early-stage star

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER

Location: NYC (In-Person)

Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity

Stage: YC-backed, early-stage

 

ABOUT CLAIM HEALTH

Claim Health is the AI Revenue Platform for Post-Acute Care.

With the US population aging and preference for care moving to the home, post-acute care (home health, skilled nursing, home care, hospice) is one of the fastest growing verticals within healthcare. Post-acute providers operate across fragmented systems, manual workflows, and reactive processes that create operational drag and financial uncertainty. Claim Health replaces this fragmentation with an intelligent, software-driven platform that unifies data, automates execution, and enables real-time decision-making across revenue-critical operations.

We’re building an adaptive platform that brings clarity, predictability, and scale to environments where reliability matters.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Customer Success Manager to partner with our agencies after they go live and take each one to the next level.

Our platform powers a large share of each agency's revenue cycle: referral intake, eligibility and benefits verification, insurance mapping, prior authorization, and admit decisions. As agencies grow with us, there's always more value to unlock, whether that's new referral sources, new branches, new service lines, or more of their workflow running on Claim Health. You'll own that growth.

You'll be a strategic partner to agency leadership, backed by data. You'll bring each agency a clear picture of its performance, a plan for where to go next, and the follow-through to get there. You'll work side by side with our operations, product, and engineering team, and what you learn from customers will directly shape what we build.

This role is ideal for someone with 2 to 5 years in customer success, account management, or revenue cycle operations who wants real ownership over customer outcomes at an early-stage company.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own Agency Partnerships

 - Serve as the strategic partner to home health and hospice agency leadership, from intake directors to executives

 - Build trusted, long-term relationships and be each agency's advocate inside Claim Health

 - Own renewals, expansion, and references, all of which follow from delivering results

Drive Performance & Growth

 - Build a growth plan for each agency with clear goals to help them increase admissions and revenue.

 - Run monthly and quarterly business reviews that show the impact we've delivered and agree on what's next

 - Find opportunities to deliver more value: new referral sources and portals, more automated workflows, and new ways of working for intake teams

 - Lead expansion to new branches, service lines, and products

Shape the Product

 - Bring customer insight directly into product priorities, backed by data

 - Partner with engineering to turn what agencies need next into shipped features

 - Keep customers informed about what's coming on the roadmap

Build the Customer Success Function

 - Define how Claim Health does customer success, including account health, business reviews, and playbooks

 - Use AI and internal tooling to deliver a high-touch experience at scale
 
 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2–5 years of experience in either:
 
 - Customer success, account management, or implementation at a healthcare SaaS, RCM, or early-stage startup, or
 
 - Revenue cycle or intake operations at a home health, hospice, or post-acute provider

 - A track record of growing accounts, with the numbers to prove it

 - Analytical mindset, with comfort pulling, interpreting, and presenting data to executives

 - Ability to build rapport with a wide range of stakeholders, from intake coordinators to agency executives

 - Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

 - High ownership mentality and bias toward action

 - Willingness to travel for onsite agency visits
 
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with the home health and hospice revenue cycle, including payer mix, eligibility, and authorizations

 - Experience with EMRs like HCHB, KanTime, WellSky, or Axxess

 - Comfort working with data and tools such as SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, or dashboards

 - Experience working closely with product and engineering teams

 - A habit of automating your own work, whether with scripts or spreadsheets, so you never do something twice
 
 

WHY JOIN CLAIM HEALTH

 - Real impact: Your work affects mission-critical operations and financial outcomes.

 - Ownership: Meaningful equity and influence over the platform's direction.

 - Hard problems: Complex systems, real constraints.

 - Speed: Small team, fast feedback loops, high leverage work. We have a bias towards moving as fast as possible.

 - Culture: Low ego, high standards, deep respect for craft.

jobs.title: Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At some point in the future, every business will answer their phone with voice AI. We are building the platform that makes it possible.
Phonely builds conversational voice AI agents for high volume phone workflows. Our customers use us to qualify leads, book appointments, route calls, and resolve real customer conversations in production. We are growing fast and just getting started, which means our operations are being built in real time, and we need someone to own the systems, data, and day-to-day execution that make them run.

About the Role
This role splits roughly in half. One half is revenue and business operations: the systems, reporting, and analysis behind our go-to-market motion. The other half is Pay Per Call operations, where you'll be the person who keeps our publisher and buyer marketplace running, from billing and partner onboarding through the voice AI agents that handle the calls. Pay per call experience preferred but not needed; you can learn the marketplace side from us.
You will be wearing a lot of hats. Some weeks you're deep in HubSpot workflows or running a funnel analysis for leadership. Other weeks you're reconciling end-of-month publisher payouts, launching a new buyer in Phonely Link, or tuning a PPC agent that isn't converting the way it should. It's not a fixed lane, and it's not a traditional RevOps role.
You'll report directly to the Chief of Staff and have real visibility into how the business actually works. This is a role for someone hungry and looking to grow fast, who wants a front-row seat to the decisions that move the company. You'll get real ownership and real exposure to impactful, cross-functional work from day one, ideally paired with a foundation in structured problem-solving and a real appetite for startup speed and ambiguity. This role is in office 5 days a week in San Francisco.

What You'll Do
Revenue & Business Operations (roughly half your time)

 - Own HubSpot end-to-end: pipeline stages, deal properties, lead routing, and workflow automation

 - Build and maintain reporting and dashboards for pipeline, forecasting, and funnel conversion

 - Support the forecasting cadence, pipeline reviews, and revenue/metric reporting leadership relies on

 - Run ad hoc analyses (win/loss trends, funnel bottlenecks, campaign ROI) that shape leadership decisions

 - Document processes as the team scales and propose improvements: lead qualification, handoffs, deal desk basics

 - Partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to keep systems and processes aligned as we grow

 - Take on undefined, high-priority work as it lands, and help drive cross-functional initiatives that don't have an obvious owner yet

 - Pick up anything else the business needs, whether or not it fits neatly into a job description

Pay Per Call Operations (the other half)

 - Own end-of-month billing for publishers and buyers: run reconciliations, send invoices, and make sure we get paid and pay out on time and accurately

 - Onboard new buyers and publishers into Phonely Link, including building out campaigns, setting up reporting, and creating publisher API keys

 - Work with engineering on the system and product changes needed to launch new buyers and partners

 - Monitor launches from both the buyer and publisher side, and flag issues before they cost us revenue

 - Suggest and make changes to campaigns based on how they're actually performing

 - Run compliance checks and keep required partner details accurate in our CRM systems

 - Be the go-to person for building new voice AI agents for Pay Per Call

 - Monitor live calls to confirm agents are performing as expected, and tune them when they aren't

What You'll Bring

OVERVIEW

Formance https://www.formance.com builds programmable financial infrastructure. Our open-source ledger helps engineering teams model, track, and reconcile money movements across financial products, from payment platforms to fintech applications and digital-asset businesses.

Financial infrastructure requires precision. Teams need to understand where money is, how it moves, and whether their systems reflect what actually happened. We build the tools to help them answer those questions.

YOUR ROLE 

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with a strong technical foundation and experience in fintech or payments to join our team.

You’ll work with prospective customers to understand their architecture, map their financial flows, and demonstrate how Formance fits their requirements. You’ll partner closely with our sales, product, and engineering teams throughout the evaluation process.

This role combines technical depth with commercial judgment. You should be comfortable building a proof of concept, discussing architectural tradeoffs with an engineer, and explaining the business implications to a founder.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead technical discovery with engineering and product teams to understand their financial workflows, constraints, and evaluation criteria.

 - Build tailored demos and proofs of concept using Formance’s APIs and tooling.

 - Guide technical evaluations, investigate questions, and help prospects assess product fit.

 - Partner with sales to connect technical capabilities to business needs and move opportunities forward.

 - Bring customer feedback to product and engineering, with concrete examples of gaps and recurring needs.

REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience in fintech, payments, banking infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure. You understand how money moves through a financial product and the operational challenges involved.

 - A strong technical foundation. You can work with APIs, read and write code, debug integrations, and reason about data models and system architecture.

 - Experience working directly with customers, through solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or an engineering role with significant customer exposure.

 - The ability to ask precise questions, uncover requirements, and explain complex concepts clearly.

 - Commercial judgment: you understand how a technical evaluation contributes to a buying decision.

 - A hands-on approach and the ability to work independently in a small team.

 - Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to lead technical conversations with international customers.

USEFUL ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

 - Working with ledgers, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, or payment orchestration.

 - Supporting technical evaluations for API-first or developer-facing products.

 - Building financial workflows involving multiple currencies, payment providers, or digital assets.

 - Turning recurring customer questions into reusable demos, documentation, or tools.

WHY JOIN FORMANCE?

You’ll work directly with teams building financial products and help them make consequential infrastructure decisions.

You’ll have ownership of technical evaluations, close access to product and engineering, and the opportunity to shape how we demonstrate and explain Formance. Your work will influence both customer decisions and the product we build.

jobs.title: Purchasing/Material Planner - Contractor
jobs.description:
About Tempo 
 Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C. 
 Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures. 
 For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com . Job Description 
 The Purchasing / Material Planner sits at the center of Tempo's supply chain execution — turning quotes into purchase orders, keeping the master tracker current across every program, and making sure the right materials get to the right place at the right time. This role is highly cross-functional, working daily with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and finance to keep programs on schedule and cost targets on track. This role is classified as a 1099 Independent Contractor position. As a consultant, you will not be a W-2 employee of the company. You will be responsible for your own self-employment taxes, insurance, and equipment. This role does not include company-sponsored benefits, paid time off, or unemployment/workers' compensation coverage. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 RFQ and PO Execution 
 
 Prepare and issue RFQs to suppliers, collect and compare quotes, and support supplier selection. 
 Place purchase orders and track them through supplier acknowledgement, confirming pricing, lead times, and terms. 
 Follow up with suppliers to resolve discrepancies and keep POs moving. 
 
 Program Tracking 
 
 Maintain the master supplier/part tracker spanning tooling, manufacturing, testing, and shipments. 
 Flag schedule risks and supply constraints early, and keep stakeholders informed. 
 Keep tracker data accurate and current as programs evolve. 
 
 Sample and Material Logistics 
 
 Coordinate shipments of samples and materials between Tempo and its suppliers. 
 Arrange and track supplier-to-supplier shipments. 
 Troubleshoot logistics issues (customs, carriers, damaged or delayed shipments) to keep material flowing. 
 
 Cost/BOM Data Maintenance 
 
 Maintain supplier quotes and pricing history to support cost analysis. 
 Maintain accurate BOM inputs and ensure data ties out across systems. 
 Support cost roll-ups and should-cost comparisons. 
 
 Documentation 
 
 Keep RFQs, drawings/revisions, and supplier documentation current and organized. 
 Maintain commercial records (quotes, POs, terms, agreements) for audit and reference. 
 Ensure documentation aligns with the latest engineering revisions. 
 
 
 Requirements/Qualifications 
 
 2+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or materials planning (hardware or manufacturing environment preferred). 
 Strong organizational skills and comfort owning a high volume of moving pieces across multiple programs at once. 
 Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets); ERP or PLM system experience a plus. 
 Clear written and verbal communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders. 
 Comfortable reading engineering drawings and BOMs. 
 A proactive, detail-oriented approach — you catch problems before they become delays. 
 Experience in energy, hardware, or industrial manufacturing. 
 Familiarity with international shipping/logistics and customs documentation. 
 Exposure to cost modeling or should-cost analysis. 
 
 The pay range for this 1099 contract position is $45.00 to $57.00 per hour. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, location, and relevant education or training. Please note that as a 1099 independent contractor role, this position does not include company equity or traditional employee benefits. Physical Demands 
 
 Sitting and standing: Extended periods at a desk performing computer-based design, simulation, and documentation work. 
 Lifting and carrying : Lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs.; heavier items handled with mechanical assistance or team lift 
 Travel: Occasional travel (estimated 
 
 Working at Tempo 
 Tempo is a lean organization working on exciting challenges, and the people who thrive here share a few things in common beyond their technical skills. 
 
 Clear, direct communication: You professionally say what you mean, lead with empathy, use tact, ask when you're unsure, and keep the people around you informed without being asked. At a company our size, communication gaps are expensive, and good communicators add to success and efficiency! 
 Low-ego helpfulness: You're willing to jump in on work that isn't strictly yours, whether that's helping a teammate debug something, lending a hand in the shop, or flagging an issue you noticed outside your lane. No one here succeeds in a silo. 
 Intellectual curiosity: You're genuinely interested in how things work, not just your piece of it, but the broader system. Tempo sits at the intersection of chemistry, mechanical engineering, power electronics, and software; the more you understand about the whole, the more valuable you become. 
 Business awareness: You understand that your work exists in a business context. You think about cost, timeline, and tradeoffs—not just technical elegance—and you make decisions accordingly. 
 Comfort with ambiguity: Processes here are still being built. You can make progress without a perfect playbook, and you know when to ask for direction versus when to use your judgment and move forward. 
 Accountability: You own your outcomes, including the misses. When something goes sideways, the instinct here is to fix it and learn from it, not to explain why it wasn't your fault.

Reflection's Compute Platform team keeps our compute layer healthy and highly available. We run a Kubernetes-based platform distributed across multiple neo-clouds, where multi-cloud scheduling, node health, and performance debugging at scale present genuinely hard systems problems.

As Compute Platform Lead, you'll provide front-line leadership of the team that builds and operates this layer. You'll build, mentor, and grow a team of strong systems engineers, guide the technical and architectural decisions across multi-cloud scheduling, cluster management, and next-generation GPU deployments, and work closely with our training teams to co-design fault tolerance, node health checks, and remediation. You'll stay close enough to the systems to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor and to maintain a deep understanding of the compute fleet our largest training runs depend on. WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of systems engineers. Coach and support your reports in understanding, and pursuing, their professional growth.

 - Manage day-to-day execution: prioritize the team's work and manage projects in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 - Work closely with our training teams to co-design fault tolerance, node health checks, and remediation, and manage the vendor relationships and important deals the compute fleet depends on.

 - Prepare the fleet for what's next: next-generation GPUs and larger clusters, and — longer term — multi-cloud storage, petabyte-scale data replication, and GPU-to-GPU network performance.

 - Raise the bar for technical judgment, prioritization, communication, and execution in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong coding ability and the credibility to earn the technical trust of a strong team.

 - Depth in at least one of orchestration, storage, or GPU hardware — with the ability to learn the rest. Deep GPU knowledge beyond standard Kubernetes (e.g., NCCL) is a plus, not a prerequisite.

 - Alignment with a Kubernetes-first architecture.

 - Cloud storage expertise — managing high-performance data products (like VAST) across multiple data centers and handling datasets and checkpointing at scale — is a plus.

 - Experience managing vendors, including negotiating and operating important deals.

 - Ability to guide strategy and drive execution across a multi-cloud, large-fleet environment, and to partner effectively with research and training teams.

WHAT WE OFFER:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

jobs.title: Product Strategist | Aeromechanical Engineering
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

Role At A Glance

This role supports U.S. Navy manufacturing programs. Its essential functions require regular access to export-controlled technical data, U.S. Government information systems, and customer facilities subject to U.S.-person access requirements. To satisfy the U.S. Government contractual and customer-access requirements applicable to this role, the selected candidate must qualify as a “U.S. person," that is, a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual, including a refugee or asylee, as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). This requirement applies only to roles with these access needs and is not a general condition of employment at Gecko Robotics or its affiliates.

We're hiring a Product Strategist - Aeromechanical Engineering who combines hands-on aircraft engineering with customer-facing technical judgment. You'll work with customer engineers and Gecko's software and robotics teams to understand their engineering workflows, identify where our technology can help, and deliver practical solutions. You should be comfortable doing aerostructural engineering work yourself and representing Gecko as a peer to senior customer and stakeholder engineering leadership.

Your initial focus will be our work supporting a major defense aircraft program of record through reverse engineering, structural design, GD&T automation, and related workflows.

The planned initial mix is roughly two-thirds program execution and one-third broader aerospace product direction and go-to-market support.

Expect roughly 20% travel to customer and program sites. For team members based in cities where Gecko maintains an office, regular in-office presence is expected as part of our in-person operating culture.

What You Will Do

Engineering execution

 - Provide hands-on aircraft engineering support: support creation and review of CAD models, interpret drawings and scan data, and assess geometry, tolerances, materials, and design intent.

 - Translate customer requirements, technical standards, and work instructions into clear engineering and software requirements, with outputs suited to the customer's design-review, analysis, and data-management processes.

 - Own assigned technical work packages, including scope, schedule, risk, and quality. Coordinate with software and delivery leads, and pair with forward-deployed engineers to develop and validate useful tools and workflows.

Methods development & qualification

 - Develop and qualify novel analytical methodologies, design tools, and engineering toolchains, establishing their technical basis, validation approach, assumptions, and limits of applicability.

 - Build and defend the case for using these methods and tools with internal and external stakeholders, including chief engineering, quality, and airworthiness. Lead the technical reviews and develop the supporting evidence needed to gain acceptance for their intended use.

Customer engagement & technical leadership

 - Lead technical discussions with customer engineering and sustainment teams, engineering managers, primes, and program offices. Clarify needs and tradeoffs, resolve technical questions, and build confidence in Gecko's work.

 - Use customer feedback and delivery experience to shape product priorities and a technically credible path to follow-on work or renewal.

Product & GTM support

 - Support broader aerospace product and go-to-market efforts through technical discovery, early concepts, demonstrations, and proposals that connect customer needs to feasible solutions.

Coaching & enablement

 - Raise the team's fluency in aircraft structures, engineering toolchains, design reviews, and customer processes through hands-on collaboration and mentoring.

About You

Required Skills

 - B.S. in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent engineering experience.

 - 8+ years in aerospace mechanical design or structural engineering, including hands-on engineering responsibility on new-build or modification aircraft programs.

 - Strong hands-on CAD skills and fluency across mechanical engineering toolchains, including PLM/PDM and finite-element modeling; the toolchain family matters more than any specific vendor's tools. Strong command of aircraft structures, GD&T, metrology, tolerance stack-ups, and design conventions.

 - Experience developing new analytical methods, design tools, or engineering approaches and carrying them through validation and formal acceptance for program use.

 - Fluency in the aircraft development lifecycle, including requirements, design, and related reviews (e.g., SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR), and experience working across interrelated requirements, technical standards, and command media.

 - Demonstrated ability to scope technical work, make tradeoffs, and deliver to a schedule.

 - Practical software fluency and ability to work effectively with software engineers; deep software-development expertise is not required.

 - Eligibility to access export-controlled information.

Preferred Skills

 - Advanced degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.

 - Background at an aerospace prime, tier 1 supplier, or government customer.

 - Experience with applied R&D or technical proposals; familiarity with government contracting.

 - Eligibility for a security clearance.

 - Experience with aircraft materials and properties, manufacturing proces

ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

This is a critical role, supporting the CEO through exceptional growth (we grew 12x last year & have already grown another 20x so far in 2026).

You’ll own the logistics & keep things running in a way that enables the CEO to fully focus on the success of the business.

This is a no egos role; you’ll preempt the need & jump into every task, acting as the CEO’s right hand as we hit this next phase of growth. In return, you’ll be entrusted with the most critical insights into running our business, a front seat at a true hypergrowth startup.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

CALENDAR AND TIME

 - Own the CEO's calendar end to end - scheduling, sequencing, protecting focus time, and making the hard prioritization calls about what earns a slot.

 - Build and maintain a lightweight "CEO operating system": weekly priorities, open loops, follow-ups, reminders.

 - Prep the CEO for every meeting - context, pre-reads, agendas, who's in the room and why.

 - Capture action items and make sure nothing drops after the meeting ends.

CRITICAL COMMUNICATIONS

 - Serve as a trusted point of contact for investors, board members, design partners, customers, and press - with judgment about what needs the CEO and what you can handle yourself.

 - Coordinate with EAs and chiefs of staff at partner, customer, and investor organizations.

 - Handle sensitive information with complete discretion.

TRAVEL AND PERSONAL LOGISTICS (LESS THAN 10%)

 - Solve problems in real time when plans change.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven experience supporting c-suite executives in the fastest paced environments. You have either supported the CEO of another hypergrowth startup, or you have supported Partners at the most demanding investment banking, private equity or venture capital firms.

 - The ability to preempt a need and to fill that need, without explicit direction.

 - The highest sense of urgency to all tasks; you are relentlessly focused on delivery.

 - A no ego approach to your work. Whatever the task, you own it.

 - Strong judgment and prioritization instincts: you know what matters most, and why.

 - Exceptional written communication, including the ability to write clearly in someone else's voice.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and a company that looks different every quarter.

 - High EQ, real discretion, and obsessive attention to detail.

 - Fluency with modern tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Linear) and a strong understanding of how a tech startup operates.

 - Comfort supporting both professional and personal logistics.

 - You primarily think of an EA role as calendar management.

 - You need every task to be clearly defined before beginning.

 - You wait for direction when you can see that something needs to be done.

 - You don’t operate with a strong sense of urgency or move quickly when something matters.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure & Performance
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Dedalus Labs builds persistent computers for AI agents. Our flagship product, Dedalus Machines, gives agents an isolated environment where they can run software, keep files and state, and work over time.

We're looking for an infrastructure engineer who's bothered by a slow build, an unexplained latency spike, or a workflow that makes engineers do the same work twice. You want to understand where the time went. Then you want to fix it, measure the improvement, and make sure everyone who uses that system benefits from it.

At a small startup, those details affect how quickly the whole company can move. A build that wastes ten minutes wastes them repeatedly. A confusing API slows every product built on it. A deployment that needs someone to supervise it interrupts work elsewhere. You'll seek out these problems across our systems and codebase, including the ones people have learned to tolerate. Your work can bring product releases and customer commitments forward by weeks, and over time, months.

You'll work directly with our CTO and engineers, with substantial freedom to investigate, experiment, and choose an approach. We want someone who takes pride in the craft of software engineering and cares about the systems they'll leave for the next person. That means useful abstractions, clear failure behavior, tests that establish the right guarantees, and documentation that explains the decisions.

Your primary responsibility is the team's development speed: the systems that let engineers build, test, deploy, and operate their work. That includes production release pipelines and infrastructure when improving them helps the team deliver reliably.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Make the development loop faster. Profile builds, tests, CI queues, artifact transfers, and local workflows. Find repeated work, unnecessary dependencies, poor scheduling, and cache misses. Follow a bottleneck into a compiler, linker, filesystem, network, or upstream dependency when the evidence takes you there. Establish a baseline, make the change, and verify the result on a representative workload.

You'll use and improve our open-source tooling: Bessemer (BSMR) https://github.com/dedalus-labs/bsmr, our build system, and Hollywood https://github.com/dedalus-labs/hollywood, which generates GitHub Actions from typed TypeScript definitions and runs actions locally. This includes working on the tools themselves when their implementation limits what we can do. Experience with Buck2, Bazel, Blaze, remote execution, or build cache design is particularly relevant.

Build platforms other engineers can build on. Design APIs, controllers, CLIs, and services that support multiple internal products and consumers. Think through resource lifecycles, concurrency, cancellation, permissions, and failure reporting. Work with the engineers using those interfaces, understand their constraints, and make common operations straightforward without hiding important system behavior.

Make delivery reliable and understandable. Improve CI/CD, GitOps, environment provisioning, staging, production rollout, and recovery. Connect the source change, build inputs, artifact, and running software so engineers can trace a release and diagnose a failure. Instrument the path with useful metrics, logs, and traces. Use incidents and recurring manual work to identify what needs a software fix.

Build and operate fast infrastructure. Set up and improve Linux servers, containers, virtual machines, and Kubernetes environments. Work through capacity, networking, load balancing, resource limits, observability, and recovery. Measure throughput and tail latency under representative load, then follow the bottleneck until you understand it.

Work with hardware we control. We have an in-office homelab where we test and debug on real machines and networks we control. Depending on your strengths, you can help assemble, provision, and maintain machines, configure networking, and build test infrastructure so engineers can reproduce failures and measure changes under conditions we understand.

YOU'D BE A GOOD FIT IF

SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Decoda Health · Full-time · Toronto

ABOUT DECODA

Decoda is the all-in-one, AI-native operating system for modern elective-care clinics — med spas, wellness, longevity, and aesthetics practices. Most clinics run on 5–10 disconnected tools that don't talk to each other; we replace all of them with a single platform: scheduling, charting, billing, payments, memberships, inventory, and patient communication in one place, with AI built into every workflow — an AI front desk that books patients 24/7, an ambient scribe that writes clinical notes in real time, and automated follow-ups that keep calendars full.

We're a Y Combinator (S23) company. We're live in 200+ clinics, processing $150M+ in annual transactions, and we've grown more than ten-fold in the last six months. We're a small team that has consistently out-shipped incumbents many times our size. The team is small by design.

HOW WE BUILD

We believe AI should expand what one person can do, not just speed up what they already do. Every engineer here works with coding agents as a core part of the job: agents take on the implementation, and you bring the judgment: what to build, how it should be designed, and whether it's actually right. That's how a small team ships a platform this broad and keeps it trustworthy for clinics that depend on it every hour.

We want engineers who are excited by that leverage and take full ownership of what they ship, whoever or whatever typed it.

THE ROLE

As an early engineer at Decoda, you own meaningful surface area from day one. You'll work across the stack to ship product that clinic staff use every hour of every day — and that directly moves revenue, patient experience, and clinical efficiency for our customers. This is a build-and-own role: you'll scope problems, talk to users, write the code, ship it, and watch how it lands.

Because we're small and the platform is broad, the work spans real-time patient communication (voice, text, and document), payments and billing infrastructure, EMR workflows like charting and scheduling, and the AI agents that sit on top of all of it. You won't be boxed into one corner of the codebase.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end — from data model to API to UI — that clinics rely on daily.

 - Build and harden the infrastructure behind payments, patient messaging, and clinical documentation, where correctness and uptime are non-negotiable.

 - Integrate and productionize AI capabilities (agents, ambient scribing, automated follow-ups) into real clinical and front-desk workflows.

 - Work directly with customers and the founders to turn ambiguous problems into shipped product, often within days.

 - Own quality: write tests, instrument what you ship, and fix things fast when they break.

 - Help set the technical foundations — patterns, tooling, and standards — that the next 20 engineers will build on.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years building and shipping production software, ideally at a startup or on a small team where you owned features end-to-end.

 - Strong fundamentals in a modern backend language and a typed frontend stack; comfortable moving across the full stack.

 - Solid grasp of data modeling, APIs, and relational databases (SQL).

 - A bias for shipping — you'd rather get something real in front of users and iterate than polish in isolation.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a sense of ownership; you treat "is this someone's job?" as "this is my job."

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and a genuine interest in talking to the people who use what you build.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in healthcare, fintech/payments, or another regulated, high-trust domain.

 - Hands-on work integrating LLMs or AI agents into production products.

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD.

 - Real-time systems experience (voice, messaging, event-driven architectures).

 - Early-stage startup experience and a track record of high output with a small team.

WHY JOIN

 - Leverage. AI gives tiny teams massive reach. Your code ships to 200+ clinics and shows up in real revenue and saved hours.

 - Ownership. You'll have outsized influence on the product, the architecture, and the culture this early.

 - Momentum. A growing, profitable-trajectory business in a category we're positioned to define, backed by YC.

 - Real impact. You're freeing clinical teams from busywork so they can focus on patients.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Onsite — Austin, TX

Employment Type: Full‑Time

Job Title: Senior Robotics Engineer

 

Company Overview

9 Mothers Defense develops AI-enabled systems to counter unmanned aerial threats. Our first product, EDDA, is an autonomous counter-sUAS point-defense platform designed to detect, track, and neutralize Group 1 drone threats. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

 

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to join a small, fast‑moving team. You will design and implement the physical software control systems — the “body” — of our interceptor platforms. This role is critical, as the accuracy of our control theory dictates the success of every high‑speed maneuver in combat. You should be comfortable writing code and working with robotic components (actuators, controllers, compute, sensors, etc.).

 

Essential Duties

 - Design and implement high‑bandwidth software control loops and advanced control algorithms (e.g., PID control) to ensure vehicle stability and enable high‑speed, precise maneuvers under dynamic load.

 - Write high‑quality, efficient code (primarily Rust, C, or C++) to control and manage actuators, motor drivers (via CAN bus), and sensors on a real‑time operating system (RTOS).

 - Integrate and fuse sensor data from cameras and IMUs (using methods such as EKF/UKF) on embedded systems (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) to achieve reliable, real‑time state estimation.

 - Act as the final link in the autonomy chain, translating tracking output from the computer vision system into reliable motor commands that accurately steer the interceptor.

 - Define, build, and maintain Python tools for calibration, logging, and CI/CD, ensuring rapid iteration and deployment.

 

Requirements

 - Control theory & embedded systems: Strong grasp of PID control, motor drivers, CAN bus, and RTOS fundamentals. Expertise in designing control and performance for robotics applications.

 - Programming/frameworks: Hands‑on experience building embedded robotics systems. Proficiency in Rust, C, or C++ for speed and direct hardware interaction.

 - Hardware: Experience with embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and camera pipelines. Skilled in managing scopes, logic/CAN analyzers, and basic rework.

 - U.S. Citizenship and the ability to pass a background check

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with ROS2, DDS, or similar middleware

 - Model‑predictive or adaptive control expertise

 - PCB design and EMC awareness

 - Safety‑critical workflow experience

 - Prior defense startup experience

 - Security clearance or ability to obtain one

 - Passion for building robots or engineering projects as a hobby

 

Benefits

 - Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

 - Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

 - Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

 - The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

 - 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

 - Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

 - Zero Red Tape: You report to the founders. You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

 - Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

 - Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

 1. Initial Screening with recruiter - 30 min phone call

 2. 1st Round Virtual Interview - Peer Engineer + senior leader (45 min via MS Teams)

 3. 2nd Round Onsite Interview - CTO + Director + VP + peer(s) (~ 6 hours in-person) **will fly out candidates that are not local

 4. Reference checks & offer

9 Mothers Policy on the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) During the Interview Process

The interviewing process is a mutual opportunity for us to get to know each other better. Our goal is to understand your unique background, evaluate your problem-solving abilities, and ensure a strong mutual fit.

AI is a core part of how we work at 9 Mothers—we actively encourage and frequently leverage AI tools in our day-to-day operations. However, during the hiring process, we need to evaluate your fundamental skills and expertise, not the outputs of an AI model.

To ensure a fair and transparent process, we ask that you adhere to the following interview guidelines:

 - 1st-Round Interviews (No AI Allowed): The use of AI tools, assistants, code generation tools, or real-time copilots is strictly prohibited during all first-round interviews and assessments. The use of AI during this stage will result in immediate disqualification from the hiring process.

 - 2nd-Round Interviews (Guided AI Usage): The second-round process includes opportunities to utilize AI. Your interview team will provide explicit guidance on how, when, and which AI tools to leverage during this stage.

We appreciate your cooperation in helping us maintain an authentic and fair interview experience for everyone.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative - New York
jobs.description:
BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding GTM team and create a steady pipeline of qualified leads for our Strategic Account Executives (SAEs). You’ll be the first conversation most of our future customers have with ClaimSorted, finding the right people at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world and giving them a reason to listen.

You’ll be measured on two things:

 - Volume: a high level of prospecting across email, LinkedIn, phone and other channels

 - Conversion: a high prospect-to-qualified-meeting rate, so every meeting you hand to an SAE is worth their time
 
 

What you’ll do:

 - Research accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and build targeted lead lists at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies

 - Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and whatever else cuts through with people who get pitched constantly

 - Treat outreach as a structured process, using AI tools to research, personalize and scale your prospecting without losing quality

 - Qualify relentlessly, so every meeting you book is a real opportunity and not noise

 - Own top-of-funnel end to end, from first touch to a booked, qualified meeting handed to an SAE

 - Refine our outbound messaging as you go, feeding what you learn from hundreds of conversations back into how we message and target

 - Work directly with Claims and Product, so what you hear from prospects shapes how we position what we build next
 
 

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our New York City office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

WHO YOU ARE

You have at least a year in a communications-heavy role, ideally in sales or something adjacent (SDR/BDR, recruiting, customer success, account management or similar), and you’re ready to step up into a high-growth enterprise sales environment.

 - Great written and spoken communicator: you can get a stranger to reply to a cold email or pick up the phone, and you keep sharpening your messaging when the data says it isn’t landing

 - A sharp researcher: you can quickly work out who the relevant people are at a large organization and what would make them care

 - AI-fluent: you use AI tools to do better prospecting, and you treat outreach as a structured, repeatable process rather than ad hoc effort

 - Built for volume: you stay sharp and motivated through a lot of “no” on the way to “yes”

 - Coachable and fast-learning: you take feedback on your outreach and improve week over week, not quarter over quarter

 - Organized and process-driven: you keep a high-volume pipeline clean so nothing falls through the cracks

 - Ambitious: you want this to be the start of a sales career, not a one-year stop
 
 

OUR VALUES

 - Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

 - Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

 - Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

 - Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

 - Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.
 
 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - $150k OTE

 - Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with 4% company match

 - 20 Days annual PTO

 - 30 days work from anywhere annually

 - Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 

OVERVIEW

We are hiring an Applied AI Strategy & Ops Lead to own and evolve our internal tooling ecosystem across Ops. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You’ll work across a range of tools including support platforms, AI-driven systems, and internal automations to improve how our day-to-day operations function.

You'll act like a product manager, sitting at the intersection of Operations, Engineering, and our frontline teams. You’ll partner closely with Ops leadership to set priorities, then turn them into results: refining the systems we already have, introducing new tools where they’re needed, and making sure our stack scales with the business.

This is not a AI/MI engineer or developer role. You won’t be writing production code. If your background is primarily software development, this role probably isn’t the right fit.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the roadmap for Ops tooling: gather needs from Ops leadership and frontline teams, prioritize based on impact, and make clear trade-offs.

 - Design and improve workflows and automations across our support platform, AI tools, and internal systems, configuring them yourself where it makes sense.

 - Partner with engineers and developers to scope requirements, write technical specs, and prioritize tooling work that matters most to Ops.

 - Execute against high-priority tooling and automation initiatives across the operational stack.

 - Translate defined problems into practical, well-scoped technical solutions

 - Identify gaps or inefficiencies in current tooling and proactively address them

 - Troubleshoot issues, improve system reliability, and ensure tools perform effectively in production

 - Contribute to ongoing improvements in how our systems connect and operate together

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Product thinking: You’ve owned a tool, process, or internal product end to end, from defining the problem to measuring the result.

 - Technical Fluency - You’re comfortable working with APIs, integrations, and automation tooling. You can build and debug independently and hold your own in technical conversations with engineers.

 - Execution Discipline - You take defined problems and drive them through to completion. You manage multiple priorities effectively and maintain a high bar for quality and reliability.

 - Systems Thinking - You understand how tools, workflows, and dependencies connect. You look for ways to improve how systems operate together, not just individual components.

 - Problem Solving - You can take loosely defined or scoped problems and translate them into practical, well-structured solutions.

 - Ownership Mindset - You take responsibility for delivering high-quality work and improving the team’s day-to-day operations through better tooling and processes.

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working with support platforms such as Zendesk

 - Familiarity with AI-driven tools and automation workflows

 - Background in Ops, Support, or CX environments

 - Experience working with evolving or fragmented tooling stacks

 

HIRING PROCESS

 - Application

 - Case Study

 - Case Interview with a team member

 - Interview with Head of Core Services

 - Interview with Head of Operations

 - Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER

Location: San Francisco, CA

Do you want to be on the cutting edge of the AI transformation happening across the financial services industry, at a Y Combinator startup that gives you autonomy and room to run? Do you excel in a dynamic, customer-facing role on a driven, high-energy team? Read on! 

WHO ARE WE?

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.
