THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior SDK Engineer to join our team to help design, build, ship, and support end-to-end features and products that will help developers make more money. We want to bring somebody onboard that is product focused, customer focused, and passionate about building mobile SDKs with a great developer experience.

This role will primarily focus on either our iOS or Android SDK (depending on your core experience), but also requires contributions to our other platform + hybrid SDKs, from time to time. Experience in these other platforms is not a requirement but the desire and excitement to work on them is.

ABOUT YOU:

 - You have 8+ years of experience in software, and have shipped mobile apps to Apple App Store or Google Play Store

 - You are very experienced in Swift and Swift UI (iOS) or Java/Kotlin and Compose UI (Android)

 - You are not afraid of iOS, Android, cross platform, or hybrid platforms.

 - You love making products for developers.

 - You love shipping good products.

 - You have deep empathy for customers.

 - You know how to ship high quality code using good testing practices in iterative cycles.

 - You collaborate well with others and can communicate effectively in a fully-remote culture.

 - You are proactive. When you see something broken, you jump on it to fix it or suggest improvements.

 - You move fast, test, and iterate quickly.

 - You ask questions when you're stuck on something.

 - You are excited to be part of a growing team.

BONUS:

 - You have experience building SDKs.

 - You have experience in server driven user interfaces.

 - You have shipped your own app to Google Play or the App Store.

 - You have experience in Python or other backend development.

IN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:

 - Learn about our customers, our SDK, the in-app subscription ecosystem, the problems RevenueCat helps solve, and how our SDKs fit into that.

 - Open your first pull request and deploy changes to be used by 32,000+ apps.

 - Onboard into our codebase by working on your very first project and shipping it 😺

 - Learn how we maintain as much transparency as possible with our work in GitHub.

 - Begin reviewing code and add to our engineering culture.

WITHIN THE FIRST 3 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Be able to scope and work on projects self-sufficiently.

 - Participate in code reviews, and contribute in other ways (testing, visibility, etc.) to improve reliability and quality of the codebase.

 - Understand every product owned by your team.

 - Understand and improve many of the codebases that the team works with.

WITHIN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Be the most knowledgeable person on several key features.

 - Have your own initiatives for improving the code base and our infrastructure.

 - Contribute to the team roadmap and technical direction.

 - Have shipped a major product or feature.

WITHIN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL:

 - Know more about mobile subscriptions than anyone ever should.

 - Use your knowledge to contribute ideas to RevenueCat’s suite of solutions.

 - Be able to spec, architect and build any feature we might want to build.

 - Have experience in all areas of technology stack related to SDKs and be the primary expert/owner of at least one area.

 - Help mentor and onboard new engineers, shaping the RevenueCat engineering culture as we continue to expand the team.

 - Help prioritize the roadmap to provide maximum value to developers, while pushing the team and technology forward.

WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

 - 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

 - A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

 - 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

 - Paid desk at a co-working space

 - Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat https://www.revenuecat.com/blog/company/how-we-hire-at-revenuecat/, including tips to help you succeed.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

You own the post-sales relationship with our clinics.

Your job is simple: make sure every clinic gets more and more value from Decoda over time.

That means helping clinics discover the extent of what the product can do, turning new features into real-world results, spotting opportunities to help them grow, and building the kind of relationship where they see Decoda as an extension of their team - not just another piece of software.

You'll get to know how each clinic operates, what they care about, and where they're trying to go. You'll use that context to help them get the most out of Decoda today while continuously finding new ways we can make their business better tomorrow.

When a clinic is growing, adopting new features, excited about what we're building, and telling other clinics about Decoda, you'll know you're doing great work.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Help clinics get more out of Decoda. Your biggest focus is adoption. You'll help clinics discover the features that matter to them, understand how to use them, and turn them into meaningful results. You won't just measure whether a feature is switched on, you'll care whether it's actually making the clinic better.

Bring new features to life. We ship quickly, and you'll be the person who makes sure our customers feel that momentum. When something new launches, you'll help clinics understand why it matters, get excited about what it can do for them, and start using it. A launch isn't successful when we announce it; it's successful when clinics are getting value from it.

Drive expansion and upsell. Own growth across your clinics. As clinics get value from Decoda, you'll identify opportunities to expand their use of the platform and actively promote and sell new features, paid add-ons, and products. You'll build excitement around what's new, connect each offering to the clinic's goals, and turn that excitement into adoption and revenue. The best upsells should feel like the natural next step for a clinic, not a sales pitch.

Build relationships people genuinely value. You'll become a trusted partner to clinic owners and their teams. You'll know their business, understand what matters to them, celebrate their wins, and be someone they're comfortable turning to when something isn't working. We want clinics to feel that there are real people at Decoda who care deeply about their success.

Be the voice of your customers inside Decoda. You'll develop a deep understanding of what clinics love, what frustrates them, and what they wish Decoda could do next. You'll bring those insights back to Product and close the loop with customers so they know their feedback isn't disappearing into a black box.

Spot problems before they become problems. You'll use product and account data alongside what you know about each clinic to recognize when adoption is slowing or an account needs attention. Rather than waiting for a clinic to disengage, you'll proactively step in and help get them back on track.

Show clinics the impact Decoda is having. For key accounts, you'll lead thoughtful business reviews that connect what's happening inside Decoda to what clinic owners care about outside of it: more revenue, stronger patient retention, less administrative work, and happier teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 2 to 4 years in account management, customer success, or a similar post sales role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

 - A track record of owning retention, adoption, or expansion targets, not just responding to tickets

 - Comfort selling. You can spot an opportunity, make the case, and close it without it feeling like a pitch

 - Strong commercial instincts and the ability to hold a credible conversation with a business owner about their P&L

 - Comfort with data. You can pull usage and account metrics and form a point of view from them

 - Clear, direct written and verbal communication

 - Experience in healthcare, medical aesthetics, or wellness is a plus, not a requirement

LOGISTICS

This role is based in Toronto and is in person.

SALARY

$85K to $100K base

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

ABOUT THE ROLE

LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on.

 - Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction.

 - Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows.

 - Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness.

 - Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services.

 - Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions.

 - Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment.

 - A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not.

 - Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways.

 - Comfortable with the full lifecycle - design, build, operate, improve - with evidence of genuine end-to-end ownership rather than handing off to other teams.

 - Practical, demonstrable use of AI development tools in your daily engineering workflow; you validate AI output rather than blindly accepting it.

 - Strong opinions about system design, API contracts and service boundaries, backed by real examples you can walk us through.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to fintech, payments or identity/KYC systems.

 - Experience building SDKs or developer-facing platform services consumed by other engineering teams.

 - Prior work in a high-growth startup or scale-up (roughly 50-500 people) where you had to set standards, not just follow them.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.title: Product Growth Lead
jobs.description:
At Bolna, we’re building tools that change how businesses leverage voice AI.

We’re looking for a Product Growth Lead who will work closely with both our Marketing and Product teams to help more users get value from Bolna.

You’ll own lifecycle campaigns and email marketing, build and monitor user funnels, and study how different cohorts adopt the platform. When you find a drop-off, you’ll help address it -whether that means a better email journey, clearer product education, or an experiment with the product managers.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll work across user data, lifecycle campaigns, email, and product experiments: finding where different users get stuck, building ways to help them move forward, and measuring what changes.

Our team includes IIT alumni with experience at Bain, Atlassian, Uber, Zomato, and LinkedIn, and is backed by leading investors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 1. Own the user lifecycle: Build and improve journeys across signup, activation, repeat usage, paid conversion, retention, and reactivation.

 2. Find opportunities in the funnels: Track how users progress through Bolna and identify drop-offs by lifecycle stage, use case, cohort, and product capability.

 3. Drive product adoption: Help users discover and use the features relevant to them, whether they’re building their first agent or expanding an existing deployment.

 4. Run email and lifecycle campaigns: Own audience selection, copy, setup, testing, launch, and measurement for onboarding, product education, feature adoption, and reactivation campaigns.

 5. Turn insights into experiments: Work with engineering, and customer-facing teams to test changes to messaging, onboarding, and the product experience.

 6. Measure what works: Define clear success metrics for each initiative. Look beyond opens and clicks to understand whether users took the next step and continued getting value from Bolna.
 
 

REQUIRED SKILLS

 1. Hands-on growth experience: 3+ years of experience building and running growth or lifecycle programs, with examples of work you personally executed and measured.

 2. Funnel and cohort analysis: Ability to use product data to spot drop-offs, segment users meaningfully, and decide where to focus.

 3. Email marketing: Experience writing, building, testing, and improving automated journeys and targeted campaigns.

 4. Experimentation: Experience forming a hypothesis, launching an experiment, measuring its impact, and iterating based on the results.

 5. Clear writing: Ability to explain a product capability in a way that helps a user understand why and how to use it.

 6. Relevant background: Experience with self-serve SaaS, developer products, product-led growth, or tools like SQL and product analytics is a plus.

 7. Bias toward execution: You’re comfortable getting into the data, writing the email, setting up the campaign, checking the results, and fixing what isn’t working.

 8. Ownership in ambiguity: You can make progress when the problem, audience, or measurement approach hasn’t been fully defined for you.
 
 

WHY JOIN

Backed to build big: Bolna is backed by Y Combinator and leading investors, and we are on a mission to build a generational voice AI company from India.

Rocketship trajectory: We are profitable, growing rapidly, and handling more than 4 million minutes of real conversations every week. You’ll work on growth problems at meaningful scale.

Room to build: You’ll help shape how we understand our users and how we help them succeed, rather than inherit a fixed campaign calendar.

Real ownership: You’ll take ideas from an insight in the data through execution and measurement, with the freedom to improve what you build.

Strong customer feedback loop: You’ll see how developers and businesses use Bolna and turn those insights into better journeys across the product.

Work across the company: You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to improve the user experience.

BENEFITS

Competitive compensation, meaningful ESOP ownership, health insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own up leveling the design of our core experiences across our worker and workplace apps.

You'll partner closely with product and engineering to define vision, build roadmaps, and solve real problems for our customers. You'll talk to customers regularly and use what you learn to form a clear point of view on how to build solutions for their needs. You'll explore multiple directions, design user flows, visuals, and interactions, build detailed prototypes to test them with customers, and iterate until what ships is polished, intuitive, and impactful.

This is an opportunity to build products in an industry that delivers real impact for our workers and workplaces and, enables better care outcomes for their patients. Beyond the features you own, you'll be working with other designers to dramatically raise the craft of everything we build. Sharper visual design, tighter interactions, more consistency across surfaces, and more care in the details throughout the experiences our customers use every day.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own design for core features end to end across the worker and facility apps, from research and problem definition through specs and launch.

 - Serve as the primary experience voice for your team, framing ambiguous problems clearly enough that partners can see the vision and build from it.

 - Partner with PMs on planning and prioritization, using user needs and business context to decide what gets built and when.

 - Set a high bar for craft and push visual and interaction quality across everything you design in our products.

 - Build detailed, high-fidelity prototypes that show how an experience looks, moves, and feels.

 - Design within our design system and contribute back to it, working with other designers and engineers to get new components and patterns built into the codebase.

 - Talk to customers regularly to understand their problems, and use research and data to shape the experiences that solve them.

 - Integrate AI throughout your process, from synthesizing research and analyzing competitors to generating concepts, writing copy, and building working prototypes.

 - Take accountability for quality at every stage of a project, and above all for what ships.

SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

 - 5+ years of product design experience and a portfolio of shipped work that shows strong visual and interaction craft and clear end-to-end thinking.

 - Experience owning a product area with little oversight, taking ambiguous problems from definition through launch and iteration.

 - Deep attention to typography, layout, hierarchy, color, spacing, motion, and interaction detail.

 - Fluency in Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools, with experience designing for iOS, Android, and web.

 - Experience working within and contributing to a design system, including partnering with other designers and engineers to get changes built in code.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design for interconnected flows and complex existing systems.

 - Experience talking directly to customers, and using research and product data to inform design decisions.

 - Credibility with engineering and product partners, built on clear communication and the ability to explain design rationale and influence direction.

 - Clear, proactive written and verbal communication, with the ability to present work confidently and explain design rationale.

 - Fluency with AI tools and a track record of using them to speed up your design work.

 - Openness to feedback, with the ability to take critique, adjust, and keep work moving.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or products where both sides of a transaction depend on each other.

 - Experience designing for healthcare, operations-heavy, or other high-stakes real-world domains.
 
 
 

LOCATION

 - Preferred: San Francisco CA/Bay area

 - Open to: US remote

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

jobs.title: Static Ad Designer
jobs.description:
About Uplane

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative ad designers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-performing static ads for our customers.

About The Role

We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Static Ad Designer with experience in designing static ads for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI static ad engine to create and deliver static ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your creatives will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

Why Join

 - Uplane is the best place to learn how to design ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

 - AI does the grunt work, you do the creative work. Our engine handles the tedious stuff so your time goes into concept, taste and design.

 - Millions of people will see your ads.

 - Take ownership and grow quickly.

 - Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

 - Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble.

Responsibilities

 - AI Static Ad Design: You use our powerful, self-developed AI static ad engine to create and design beautiful static ads that will be seen by millions of people. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission.

 - Creative Testing: You develop new angles, hooks and visual concepts, test them in live campaigns and double down on what performs.

 - Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner.

 - Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our static ad engine will evolve and improve over time.

Requirements

 - Passion for designing ads, you love design and creative work

 - Years of experience in designing static ads

 - Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

 - Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

 - Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

 - Fluent English

Nice to Have

 - Work experience at a marketing agency

 - You have won awards for your creative work

 - You worked with big brands before

jobs.title: Regional Account Executive, Washington & Oregon
jobs.description:
Territory: Washington & Oregon

Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

This role is specifically responsible for building and growing Flai’s presence across Washington and Oregon. The Regional Account Executive will regularly meet with dealerships throughout both states and should be comfortable traveling across the territory.

ABOUT FLAI

AI has transformed B2B SaaS but has struggled to reach many of the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for automotive dealerships.

Auto retail is a $1.3 trillion industry. Dealerships sell 96% of the 16 million new vehicles purchased each year, yet many still rely on outdated systems and manual processes. Dealerships spend approximately $36 billion annually on operations, creating a significant opportunity for Flai.

We launched our first voice AI product a year ago. Since then, we have introduced multiple products across hundreds of dealerships throughout the United States. We have partnered with the country’s second-largest automaker and many leading dealership groups.

Flai is backed by Toyota Ventures, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Innovation Endeavors, SV Angel, and Liquid 2. We have grown rapidly with a small, scrappy team and continue to operate with that speed and ambition.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a Regional Account Executive to own and grow Flai’s go-to-market presence across Washington and Oregon.

You will develop the territory strategy, build the prospecting motion, establish an in-person presence, and drive revenue across both states. You will work directly with the founders and help shape how Flai wins the dealership market.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: Prospect, book meetings, pitch, and close dealerships and dealer groups across Washington and Oregon.

 - Build and manage pipeline: Map priority accounts, identify decision-makers, and keep opportunities organized and moving forward.

 - Sell in the field: Meet dealership leaders in person to build trust, understand their needs, and create momentum.

 - Build the go-to-market motion: Shape the territory strategy, outreach approach, and field sales playbook alongside the founders.

 - Strengthen the product feedback loop: Share market insights directly with Product and Leadership to influence our direction as we scale.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven sales execution: Experience owning and closing deals from prospecting through signature in a high-velocity or high-stakes environment.

 - Automotive experience: Direct experience selling to dealerships or working inside one. You understand dealership organizations and how purchasing decisions are made.

 - Strong communication skills: Clear, persuasive, and confident when presenting in person or remotely.

 - Solution-oriented thinking: Able to understand dealer pain points and recommend the right solution instead of simply pitching a product.

 - Comfort with field sales: Willing and able to travel throughout Washington and Oregon to meet customers and prospects.

 - A high-speed operating rhythm: Energized by a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

 - Operational discipline: Comfortable maintaining CRM hygiene, managing a clean pipeline, and following structured, repeatable processes.

 - A founder mindset: Self-directed, persistent, and motivated by ownership. You focus on outcomes and do not require extensive direction.

jobs.title: Head of GTM
jobs.description:
ABOUT DILIGENCESQUARED

DiligenceSquared is the AI-native consulting firm. We deliver investment-grade market research and commercial due diligence, powered by AI agents and led by experienced consultants. Our founding team brings deep experience from Blackstone and BCG, and we're backed by Y Combinator and Relentless. Our clients include 5 of the 10 largest private equity firms in the world and represent more than $3T in combined AUM.

THE ROLE

We're looking for our first commercial leader to build and lead go-to-market at DiligenceSquared. You'll work directly with the founders to define how we win new private equity clients, grow relationships across existing funds and build a repeatable commercial organization.

We build client relationships through high-value, project-based engagements. Success starts with earning the first mandate, delivering an exceptional client experience and expanding that trust across deal teams, strategies and offices to build a durable fund-wide relationship.

This is a hands-on builder role. You'll personally originate and close business before building the team and systems that make the approach repeatable.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Win new clients: Build and execute a targeted outbound strategy, create qualified pipeline and lead opportunities from first conversation through proposal and close.

 - Grow existing accounts: Develop relationships across sector teams, strategies and offices within the funds we already serve, turning strong delivery into repeat and expanded revenue.

 - Own strategic relationships: Build trust with deal professionals and senior decision-makers through relevant insights, thoughtful follow-up and a strong understanding of their work.

 - Shape solutions: Partner with founders and delivery leaders to understand client needs, scope engagements, develop proposals and price work appropriately.

 - Build the commercial system: Establish account planning, pipeline management, CRM discipline, forecasting, handoffs and performance measurement.

 - Partner with marketing: Turn content, events, partnerships and inbound interest into commercial conversations and measurable pipeline.

 - Build the team: Determine the next GTM hires, recruit and coach them, and create clear ownership across new business and account expansion.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Relevant leadership experience: You have at least eight years of relevant commercial experience, including experience selling to sophisticated institutional clients and leading commercial people.

 - Proven revenue ownership: You have personally originated and closed meaningful business and have been accountable for a team or company-level revenue target. Experience in private equity, consulting or investor relations is valuable, but does not substitute for demonstrated commercial results.

 - Experience building a commercial function: You have hired and coached commercial talent and established a repeatable approach to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, CRM discipline, handoffs and performance measurement.

 - Private equity fluency: You understand how PE deal teams work, what creates demand for commercial diligence and research, and how buying decisions are made.

 - Hands-on leadership: You're excited to originate and close business yourself before and while building the team. You are not looking simply to inherit an established organization.

 - Excellent judgment with senior clients: You can lead a substantive conversation with PE professionals, recognize a real opportunity and earn the next step.

 - Commercial discipline: You follow through, ask directly for business and know how to balance revenue growth with strong project economics and a high-quality client experience.

 - Close founder partnership: You can challenge assumptions, make decisions with incomplete information and work closely with founders and delivery leaders to build the function.

EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE A PLUS

 - Experience in commercial due diligence, private equity or strategy consulting

 - Experience selling research, expert-network, advisory or technology-enabled services to investment teams

 - A strong network across private equity deal teams

 - Previous startup experience

WHY DILIGENCESQUARED

 - Build the GTM function at a YC-backed company with real revenue and strong client traction

 - Work directly with founders who bought this research at Blackstone and delivered it at BCG

 - Serve some of the world's leading private equity firms and help turn early relationships into a category-defining business

 - Meaningful early-stage equity and the opportunity to build and lead the commercial organization

 - Intellectually demanding work across complex industries, sophisticated clients and high-stakes decisions

 - A small, senior team that enjoys working together, with regular offsites, team dinners and meals together at the office

 - Competitive compensation, high ownership and very little bureaucracy

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

Role At A Glance

We’re looking for an FP&A Manager to own financial planning and performance reporting and help Gecko decide where and how to invest. Reporting to the VP Finance, you will partner with business leaders to build forecasts, challenge assumptions, and turn analysis into clear recommendations on growth, profitability, and cash needs. You will also improve the planning and reporting processes that support our next stage of growth. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports, supporting a business that combines robotics, software, and field operations.

What You Will Do

 - Own the annual budget, rolling forecasts, and long-range plan, bringing together business inputs in an integrated model covering revenue, gross margin, headcount, spending, and cash flow.

 - Partner with commercial and operations teams to forecast revenue and cash from sales opportunities, signed contracts, deployment schedules, and delivery capacity, clearly explaining timing assumptions and risks.

 - Lead monthly financial reviews, explain results against plan, separate timing differences from underlying trends, and agree on actions with business owners.

 - Analyze profitability by customer, contract, and offering, including delivery costs, costs to complete remaining work, scope and schedule risks, and team and equipment utilization.

 - Build scenarios to guide hiring, pricing, spending, and capital investments, weighing returns, payback periods, and cash needs against growth and profitability goals.

 - Prepare financial analyses, KPI dashboards, and commentary for leadership, the board, and investors, explaining results, risks, and the outlook.

 - Partner with Accounting to reconcile actual results and understand revenue and cost treatment; improve planning tools and automate reporting while preserving financial controls and traceability.

 - Support the VP Finance on fundraising through funding scenarios, financial models, investor materials, data room preparation, and due diligence, keeping assumptions consistent across forecasts and investor communications.

 - Support M&A through valuations, acquisition models, and assessments of strategic and financial fit; review earnings quality, working capital, and integration costs, and track post-close results against the investment case.

About You

Required Skills

 - 7+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital, with the ability to own planning and reporting in an operating business.

 - A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong financial modeling and analysis skills and advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency, including building forecasts from operating drivers, connecting the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow, and clearly explaining assumptions.

 - A solid understanding of accounting and financial statements, including how bookings, recognized revenue, billing, and cash collection differ.

 - Experience working with business leaders to challenge assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and make decisions, with clear communication across financial and nonfinancial audiences.

 - Ability to work with incomplete data, build practical processes, and manage competing deadlines with accuracy and follow-through.

Preferred Skills 

 - Finance experience at a growing technology company, particularly one combining software, hardware, and services or delivering complex customer projects

 - Exposure to contract or project profitability, field operations, capacity planning, or government and industrial customers

 - Experience improving planning systems or using SQL, business intelligence, automation, or AI tools in finance, with appropriate checks for accuracy

 - Experience supporting fundraising, M&A, financial due diligence, or board and investor reporting

At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. 

Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve - and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact.

Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
In a world where products and software can be replicated overnight, intellectual property is one of the last durable moats. Stilta builds agentic AI for intellectual property, giving legal and IP teams software that can reason across massive document sets, surface evidence, and produce litigation-grade work faster and more reliably.

We recently raised a $10.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Y Combinator and operators from companies including OpenAI, Legora, and Lovable. We already work with major IP firms and Fortune 500 companies, and we’re at the very beginning of defining what great AI-native software for intellectual property looks like.

THE ROLE

You'll own the platform every Stilta agent runs on. Our customers hand us long-running, document-heavy work - agents reasoning for hours across millions of pages - and the infrastructure underneath must be fast, secure and invisible to the people relying on it.

You'll shape how we scale from hundreds to thousands of concurrent agent sessions, set the bar for reliability and security, and make the architectural calls the rest of engineering builds on for years to come.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and run the Kubernetes platform behind large-scale agent swarms - scheduling, autoscaling and isolation across customers

 - Build the systems that keep agent sessions fast and resilient under heavy, unpredictable load

 - Own our infrastructure as code and the path to production on Azure, with enterprise-grade security, compliance and data residency built in rather than bolted on

 - Make storage and data pipelines durable and performant for workloads spanning millions of documents

 - Build observability that tells us why something is failing, not just that it is

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've designed and scaled distributed systems in production, and you have well-earned opinions on what makes them reliable. You take ownership end to end and want to set the standard for the team that follows

 - Deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code. We run on Azure with Terraform; equivalent depth elsewhere counts

 - You're a software engineer first - strong in TypeScript and/or Python, and comfortable building the services that run the platform, not just configuring them

 - You treat reliability, performance and cost as product decisions, and you instrument before you guess

 - Bonus: experience running AI or inference-heavy workloads at scale, or with enterprise security and compliance

 
 

Stilta are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or background. Selection for this role will be based solely on suitability for the position and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

We are hiring a VP of Sales to build Photoroom's global sales-led business into one of the company's major growth engines. Sales-led revenue is still early, at roughly $5-6M today.

Lead from the front

 - Partner closely on enterprise product strategy

jobs.title: Quantum Architecture and Device Theorist
jobs.description:
About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

 

What You'll Work On:

 - Develop theoretical and numerical models of qubit devices, gate operations, and physical-layer processes to guide next-generation processor design

 - Design and evaluate system architectures under hardware-specific constraints and realistic noise models

 - Translate device-level physics into architecture-level requirements, and architecture-level goals into concrete device specifications

 - Determine error budgets and gate fidelity requirements from architecture-level targets

 - Build simulation and modeling tools for system design, performance analysis, and roadmap planning

 - Work directly with the hardware team to inform device design and validate models

 - Lead high-impact research projects with a multidisciplinary team of experimental and theoretical physicists, engineers, and computer scientists

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have:

 - A PhD in physics, applied physics, computer science, electrical engineering, or an equivalent degree in a similar field

 - 5–10 years of experience in the theory and modeling of quantum computing hardware

 - Publications in quantum device physics, quantum architecture, or related fields

 - Strong programming skills in a scientific computing environment

 - Proven track record of successful cross-team collaborative projects

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Strong Candidates May Have:

 - Experience translating cutting-edge R&D into commercial products or roadmap milestones

 - Experience with the modeling of multiple or heterogeneous qubit platforms

 - Experience translating abstract models into hardware-aware protocols

 - Experience bridging theory and experiment on real quantum hardware

 - Familiarity with quantum error correction and fault-tolerant architecture

Why This Matters

Your work accelerates the path to quantum super intelligence. Each quantum component integrated, each AI model enhanced, each instruction set optimized brings us closer to a future where intelligence and quantum mechanics are inextricably intertwined. We're not building incremental improvements—we're creating exponential transformations that will make AI more affordable, sustainable, personalized, and fundamentally more capable.

How We’re Different

We’re building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence and pioneering new domains at the intersection of physics, engineering, and AI. At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail.

 

Culture & Benefits

 - The Best of Both Worlds: Access to industrial-scale compute and hardware resources

 - while retaining the intellectual freedom of an academic environment.

 - Visa Sponsorship: We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation: We value your high-level expertise. This position offers a salary significantly above standard academic postdoctoral rates.

 - Benefits: Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection: Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off: We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

 

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at [email in original advert].

jobs.title: Member of Mathematical Staff
jobs.description:
AT SF TENSOR, WE'RE BUILDING THE FUTURE OF HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPUTE

We firmly believe that the future of AI depends on the unglamorous: rethinking and rebuilding the stack, all the way down. From the hardware underneath it to the compiler targeting it and the cloud running it. Right now those three things fight each other and that friction shows up as a tax on every researcher trying to build something ambitious. We're here to axe that tax and make compute faster, cheaper and more available. When we succeed, compute will be portable enough that "which cloud, which chip" stop being something you worry about.

To achieve this, we are building our Kernel Optimizer, which takes code and finds its fastest possible form for whatever vendor and cluster topology you point it at, automatically, as well as the Model Foundry which manages the runs, makes research easier and moves workloads across clouds and chips as prices and availability ship, instead of leaving you locked into whatever vendor you signed with first.

We're backed by Susa Ventures, Y Combinator, along with some great funds and angels including Max Mullen and Paul Graham, as well as founders and executives at Neuralink, Notion and AMD. We're looking for researchers, engineers and organizations who agree with the basic premise: you don't get the next leap in AI without a leap in compute first.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We build the fastest GPU compiler in the world. Most compilers have to preserve correctness at every transform, constraining how far they can search, while we prove correctness at the end instead, allowing us to search a far wider space, with agents, with RL, with anything that works and still guarantees the result. It's why we hold #1 on NVIDIA's own kernel benchmark across hundreds of production kernels.

Our core proof machinery is real and it works, but right now there are some rough edges that limit the number of kernels we can prove. With the rise of AI capabilities in mathematics combined with our bit-identical models and tools, such as our own model for large-scale Lean proof writing, things that were nearly impossible just a few months ago are now totally viable, but we need someone who figures out what theory we're missing, builds it and then coordinates with the engineering team to deploy it at scale, which is why we are hiring a Member of Mathematical Staff to own the math behind the proof engine and other surfaces for applying rigorous math to an increasingly wishy-washy domain.

This is not an advisory role and you'll have access to better tooling than anywhere else, such as bit-exact software models of hardware components like the tcgen05 https://github.com/sf-tensor/tcgen05, a compiler capable of emitting code at a lower level than publicly possible, and frontier models with capabilities tailored to what your work needs, trained with our team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - You'll own the proof engine end-to-end, ensuring we can prove kernels across all edge cases

 - You'll collaborate with the engineering team on building formal models of new hardware

 - You'll work on formalizing numeric stability and what drives model convergence across diverse architectures

 - You'll work on research around the extent to which we can predict training divergence during runs

 - You'll collaborate with the research team on our post-training efforts around formal proofs and program verification

 - You'll work on formalizing low-precision computation and its numerical stability

 - You'll collaborate with the engineering team on formally proving sandboxes safe

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A PhD in Math is strongly recommended but not required: what matters is what you've proven and built

 - Someone with good judgement about when a full proof is worth it and when a cheaper guarantee is enough

 - Someone who's pragmatic about tooling and knows when SMT works, when an interactive proof is necessary and when custom decision procedures are necessary

 - Someone who's comfortable owning an open-ended problem where you set the research agenda yourself

 - Someone who can explain a proof strategy to an engineer who doesn't know the math, and push back when they want to cut corners

NICE TO HAVE

 - Someone who's contributed to projects such as Mathlib, Flocq or seL4.

 - Someone with hands-on experience working with Lean or Rocq

 - Someone who's done work or published in the field of program verification

 - Someone who's done work or published in the field of numerical analysis or numerics

 - Someone who's done work or published in the field of optimization theory or the dynamics of stochastic training

 - Someone with deep knowledge in the field of floating-point formalization

WHY JOIN US

You will sit in the only place in the world right now working on guaranteeing the correctness and training stability of frontier models, which is one of the most important problems of our time, with the tools and freedom to actually solve it. The truth is that most formal methods work never leaves the paper and most ML work never gets near a proof. Here, the proof engine decides what is allowed to ship into production, so your work sits on the critical path of everything we do and gets tested against more kernels in a day than most verification tools see in their lifetime.

We invest heavily in AI tooling for mathematics, from our own model for large-scale Lean proof writing to bit-exact models of the hardware, so you spend your time on the theory and not the tedium, and get from idea to proof as fast as possible. Beyond that, the people who reverse-engineered the tensor cores, write the compiler and train the models you are proving and using for your mathematics are the same people you eat lunch with, so when a proof hinges on what the silicon actually does, the answer is a conversation away.

We're a small team operating at frontier scale. We pre-trained foundation models on 4,000 AMD GPUs as a team of three, designed and brought up GB300 NVL72 clu

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description:

Method has built the most modern way to connect to consumer financial accounts. Combining real-time liability connectivity with instant payment execution, Method’s API is designed to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use.

We have helped 45+ million users connect 350+ million liability accounts credential-less and processed over $2.5B in payments, helping users save millions in interest. One in every three credit cards in the United States is in the Method ecosystem and leading financial institutions like SoFi, Bilt, Cleo, Sezzle, Figure & Aven rely on our APIs to build magical experiences for millions of consumers.

To learn more about us, check out our blog https://methodfi.com/resources/company-updates!

Method’s largest customers are building the next generation of financial products. We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Product Manager to help shape what they build next and turn those ideas into meaningful growth for both their business and ours.

As part of Method’s Product team, you’ll be the dedicated product partner for a set of our most strategic accounts. You’ll work directly with senior product leaders to understand their ambitions, spot opportunities they haven’t considered, and bring a clear point of view on what’s possible with Method. You’ll bring them ideas of your own, develop theirs, and own the path from the first conversation through launch, bringing together Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to make it happen.

This role combines product strategy, deep customer relationships, and the resourcefulness to get things built. You’ll test ideas with customers early, turn feedback into concrete next steps, and stay accountable for the outcome. As an early member of this team, you’ll also help define how Method partners with its largest customers to build new products and grow.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the strategic product relationship with Method's largest accounts, working with these customers to identify, then build, new initiatives and revenue opportunities.

 - Collaborate directly with our customers’ CPOs and product leaders, building relationships where you are their first call for anything net-new involving Method.

 - Orchestrate the full account team, pulling in Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Engineering at the right moments to bring these initiatives to life.

 - Proactively put new ideas in front of customers early, learn from their response, and iterate quickly.

 - Help define the playbook for how Method runs forward-deployed coverage as the model expands to more accounts.

 - Work cross functionally to guide strategy on maximizing value from existing customer integrations

 

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have a consulting, client services, customer success, solutions, or account management background, and you are at your best in front of senior customers.

 - You have product instincts, either as a PM or through a track record of shaping what gets built from the customer side.

 - You are technically fluent enough to talk APIs, data flows, and performance tradeoffs with engineers and product leaders.

 - You stay with hard problems and do not need a perfect plan to get started.

 - You default to action: when you have an idea, you test it with the customer instead of talking yourself out of it.

 - You have taste, and you care about doing the work the right way.

 - You can operate both reactively (customer has an idea you run with) and proactively (you chase customers to explore your new idea)

 - You already use AI tools to move faster in your day-to-day work.
 
 

EXTRA AWESOME

 - Experience at a fintech, lending, payments, or financial data company (e.g., Plaid, Stripe, Cash App, SoFi).

 - Background at a top consulting firm before moving into an operator role (CS, bizops, solutions, or product for example)

 - Exposure to lending, underwriting, or credit data.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO FULL TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, Dental, Vision; basic medical plans 100% covered

 - Flexible PTO

 - $30/day Lunch allowance when working from the office

 - 12 weeks parental leave

 - Commuter benefits; employer-sponsored

 - Phone/internet stipend 

 - WFH stipend 

 - Student loan repayment contribution 

 - Lifestyle Spending stipend 

 - Learning & Development stipend 

 - Hybrid-office stocked with snacks

 - Quarterly team off-sites

IN-OFFICE POLICY 

For most roles are Method, we expect a regular in-person presence at one of our hubs in NYC, Austin, SF or DC. We have embedded flexibility to work remotely for a week here and there, but the general expectation is a minimum 2-3 days/week in office on average. What does not work is full-time remote.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Manager - LATAM

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-scaling, high-ambiguity environment where the brief changes and the answer is rarely handed to you.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing network within the LATAM growth or fintech ecosystem (operators, agencies, community leaders).

 - Fluency in Spanish, particularly in a professional or client-facing context.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

About the Role:

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. We work with some of America's largest financial institutions, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and have raised a $24M Series A led by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Growth Lead to build the systems and campaigns that bring Kastle into new accounts and markets.

You’ll figure out who we should reach, what matters to them, and how to get in front of them. You’ll write the message, launch the campaign, build the tools behind it, measure the response, and use what you learn to improve the next one. You’ll also own the product story across our website, sales materials, newsletter, and events.

This is a hands-on role with wide ownership. The right person is an excellent writer and a fast operator who can build with data, automation, and AI tools. They have the taste to make Kastle memorable and the discipline to see whether their work creates real sales opportunities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a live map of our market. Identify target accounts, buyers, relationships, and opportunities across our current segments and new verticals. Keep account maps current as we meet prospects, win customers, and learn where Kastle can expand.
 

 - Create paths into important accounts. Work with our investors and broader VC network to identify relevant connections, prepare thoughtful outreach, and turn warm introductions into conversations.
 

 - Own outbound and marketing experiments. Build lists, develop a hypothesis for each audience, write the copy, and launch campaigns. Test different messages and channels by segment; track replies, meetings, and pipeline; and keep improving the targeting and positioning.
 

 - Build the growth tooling. Create agents, automations, dashboards, and workflows that help us maintain the market map, run campaigns, track leads and ads, and give sales a reliable view of what is working.
 

 - Own Kastle’s product messaging. Turn customer conversations and product capabilities into clear positioning, website copy, slides, sales materials, and a product newsletter built from scratch.
 

 - Own Kastle presence at Events. Plan and execute conferences, smaller events, and campaigns across the industries we serve. Own the audience, invitations, experience, sales preparation, and follow-up.
 

 - Find creative ways to reach buyers. Test ideas such as thoughtful gifting, podcasts, customer programs, and Kastle-hosted events. Choose ideas for the audience they reach and the conversations they can create, then execute them with care.
 

A PROJECT YOU MIGHT OWN

Build a market map that is living and auto-updates daily. Start with the accounts and buyers we want to reach. Connect them to our existing relationships, outreach, meetings, customers, and events. Create a way for the map to stay current as the team books new calls and launches new products then use it to decide which accounts to pursue and what to say to them.

WHO YOU ARE

 - Creative with good taste: You can develop a sharp message or an unusual campaign that feels right for a senior buyer.

 - Resourceful: You find a way forward one way or another. You never stop at a no. 

 - Fast and thorough: You move quickly without losing details, deadlines, or follow-up.

 - Technical and curious: You’re comfortable building with data, AI tools, automations, and integrations. You can learn a new tool quickly and know when a simple system beats a complicated one.

 - Analytical: You care whether a campaign produces the right conversations, and you change your approach when it doesn’t.

 - Highly independent: You can take an ambitious goal, decide what to do first, and own the work through execution.

 - High energy: You enjoy talking to people, testing ideas, and making things happen in the real world.

You may have worked in growth, product marketing, GTM engineering, founder’s office, or built something yourself. We care most about what you’ve personally created and the results it produced.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile and one example of a campaign, event, or internal tool you built that you are proud of. Tell us what you owned, how you made decisions, and what happened as a result.

ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.

About the Role
High-growth companies spend thousands of hours on people operations: onboarding new hires, running payroll, managing benefits, provisioning devices, answering policy questions, approving time off and expenses. Most of that work still runs on spreadsheets, tickets, and people chasing people. We're building agents that do it for them.
Warp Agent works in the background for HR, finance, and people teams. It gets new hires ready for day one, reviews expenses against policy, handles time-off requests, checks payroll before it runs, and reports on what's happening across the company. Customers hand it a receipt or a notice and it takes care of the rest. Because Warp runs the full employee lifecycle on one platform, the agent has the context to finish the work, not just suggest it.
The hard part is trust. People data is the most sensitive data a company has, and people operations leave little room for error. Every agent action respects role-based permissions, so an IT manager's agent can provision a laptop without ever seeing anyone's salary, and every action is logged and auditable.
We believe agents will soon do more work on Warp than people do. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build those agents, the runtime they operate on, and the systems that make them reliable enough to run a company's people operations.

What You'll Do

 - Ship agentic features end to end, from the model call to the UI, across HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, and more

 - Build and extend Warp Agent's harness: tool-calling, durable execution for long-running work (triggers, scheduling, wait and resume), and a run log that makes every agent action auditable

 - Design evals and guardrails for workflows where mistakes are costly, and decide when an agent acts on its own versus asks for approval

 - Build new agent workflows and expand what customers can configure and author themselves

 - Extend our permission model to agents so every action respects who the agent is working for

 - Build internal agents and tooling that remove manual work across Warp's own teams

 - Build new surfaces for interactions with Warp agent across the web app, employee app, mobile app, and slack

 - Collaborate directly with the CTO and CEO

You'll Be Good for This Role If You

 - Have shipped LLM features that real users depend on in production, and know where they break

 - Think in systems: evals, observability, cost, latency, and failure modes

 - Are product-minded and care how an agent's work shows up for the person who delegated it

 - Get excited by hard domains where correctness matters more than demos

 - Use coding agents heavily in your own workflow and have opinions on what works

What You Need

 - Strong full-stack engineering skills and expertise in a modern, strongly typed language

 - A track record of building production AI systems: agents, tool use, retrieval, or structured extraction

 - Experience designing reliable backend systems

 - High agency. You figure things out.

 - Willingness to work from our NYC office five days a week

BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.
