CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance company in San Francisco. We're not bolting AI onto insurance — we're rebuilding the entire business as software, on a simple bet: turning expert human judgment into compute is one of the largest transitions left to make, and a trillion-dollar industry still run 90% by hand is the place to prove it. We've grown ~100x in the last year and we move at that speed — on-site, in person, long days, very high standards. Almost no one joins Harper for insurance; they join to build the company that replaces how it works.

THE ROLE

A contractor needs a certificate before they can walk onto a job site. A payment failed. A customer thinks a policy change is already done when it is not. You pick up the call, establish what is actually true, and keep ownership visible until the request is complete. Small-business owners are used to a broker who never calls back. You are the reason ours do.

Harper is building service around a simple promise: the customer can always see what is true and who owns the next action. AI surfaces the account, preps the routine work, and drafts the follow-up. What is left is judgment on the phone — hearing the difference between confused and genuinely upset, catching the thing the customer did not say, knowing exactly who to pull in when the problem is bigger than the call — and the follow-through that closes the loop. That part is you.

You do not need an insurance background to start. We teach the systems, the playbooks, and the vocabulary. Quoting and coverage advice belong to licensed teammates, so you will never be asked to advise on a policy. Everything else, you carry as far as it goes. There are real paths from this seat into licensed service, sales, and operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Answer inbound calls with judgment. Pull up the account, understand the real request, and explain the next step in plain language. Tell the customer who owns the next action and when they will hear back, then keep that promise.

 - Take the outbound list to zero. Payments, documents, renewals, at-risk cancellations, and open service requests. Standard follow-ups get three attempts across three days; a payment issue gets up to seven touches by phone, text, and email. You stop when it is solved, not when it is hard.

 - Carry the issue forward. Complete the work you are authorized to do, and when a licensed or specialized teammate has to step in, hand off the request, the urgency, and the work already done so nobody restarts the conversation.

 - Recognize urgency. Hear the difference between a routine request and a problem that could interrupt coverage, operations, or a customer's ability to work, and escalate it before it does.

 - Keep the record clean. Clear notes, current status, named owner, next action, and the promised update point on every open request. The next teammate picks up mid-story and the customer never repeats themselves.

 - Protect the advice boundary. Coverage and quoting questions go to a licensed owner. You never guess.

 - Improve the service system. Flag repeat contacts, confusing communications, and broken handoffs so Harper fixes the cause instead of the symptom.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have worked in a call center, dispatch, collections, front desk, customer service, or another high-volume phone environment.

 - You are clear, patient, and direct with people who may be confused or frustrated, and you can turn a rough call around.

 - You can manage a call, a record, and a next-action list at the same time — you talk and type simultaneously, and you can work a list of 80 calls without losing your place.

 - You are dependable and punctual, and you take that seriously.

 - You know when to solve, when to escalate, and when not to improvise. You would rather ask than guess.

 - You treat AI as leverage — it finds the account and preps the routine work so you can spend the call on the customer — and you have opinions about where it helps and where it gets in the way.

 - You learn systems and insurance vocabulary quickly. Spanish fluency is valuable.

THE REALITY — READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This job is the phone. On-site in Atlanta or San Francisco, Monday through Friday, in the building with the team. Two shifts cover the day — an early one for East Coast customers and a later one through the West Coast close — and you are assigned to one based on business need. Overtime is available and the volume is real: back-to-back inbound calls and long outbound lists, all shift, with an empty list at the end of it as the whole game.

This is not a low-volume relationship-management role, and it is not the seat for someone who thinks a transfer counts as resolving the problem, who avoids outbound follow-up or difficult conversations, who needs a remote or hybrid default, or who is comfortable giving an answer they are not sure is right. It is for someone who likes talking to people all day and ends it energized, who is bothered by an open item until it is closed, and who wants a first seat at an AI-native company that is actually shipping. If the intensity reads as a cost you'd rather avoid, this isn't the seat. If it reads as the point, keep going.

COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS

 - Salary: 23–26/hour, full-time, non-exempt, overtime eligible.

 - Equity: Yes.

 - Location: On-site, Atlanta or San Francisco. Based there or willing to relocate.

 - Schedule: Monday–Friday, in-office. Early shift (East Coast coverage) or late shift (West Coast coverage), assigned based on business need. Overtime available.

BENEFITS

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Meals provided — breakfast, lunch, and dinner

 - Snacks, drinks, and coffee stocked daily

 - Commuter benefits

 - Free gym membership

PROCESS

 1. Team call — 30 minutes on Zoom. You meet the team, we meet you.

 2. Office session — about two hours in person. You meet more of the team and work a real problem with us.

 3. Super day — how you act

jobs.description:

 - Serve as the point of contact and escalation resource for integration issues raised by Support, Customer Experience, or customers directly

 - Validate data accuracy after setup and during ongoing syncs

 - Document common integration issues, setup steps, and troubleshooting playbooks for internal and customer use

 - Gather and synthesize feedback on integration gaps and pain points, and take it to Product and Engineering to advocate for fixes and roadmap improvements

 - Represent the Implementation team's and customers' perspective in Product/Engineering discussions about integrations

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years in an implementation, integrations support, or technical customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or fintech company

 - Comfortable reading and reasoning about APIs, webhooks, and data mapping well enough to configure, troubleshoot, and clearly describe issues — not required to write integration code

 - Working knowledge of accounting/GL concepts (chart of accounts, journal entries, reconciliations, close processes), or the ability to learn them quickly

 - Familiarity with the ERPs customers migrate from (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct) and hands-on experience with the systems Campfire connects to - CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), spend tools (Ramp, Float), billing platforms (Stripe), payroll providers (Rippling, Justworks), or bank feeds

 - Comfortable with SQL and structured data (CSV/JSON/XML) for diagnosing issues

 - Strong troubleshooting instincts — able to isolate whether an issue is data, configuration, or connectivity, and know when to loop in Engineering

 - Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate technical issues for both customers and internal Product/Engineering teams

 - Able to manage multiple concurrent integration setups in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with iPaaS/integration tooling (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, Zapier, or similar) as a user or configurer

 - Background in accounting, finance, or consulting (CPA or CPA-track a plus)

 - Experience with bank connectivity or treasury data feeds

 - Prior experience at a high-growth startup or an implementation-heavy SaaS company

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Product or Engineering teams to turn customer feedback into roadmap input

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer

SENIOR FULL-STACK ENGINEER (VISA SPONSORSHIP)

Build the Spherecast Platform, the real-time operating system for global consumer-goods supply chains. Agnes, our AI Supply Chain Manager, runs on top of it to evaluate options, decide what to produce, where to make it, and how to move it through factories, warehouses, and channels.

You’ll own features end to end, from data models and APIs to the planning interfaces customers use every day. You’ll design the architecture that turns messy operational data into actions in real time, so physical goods flow reliably to the right place at the right time.

You’ll be part of the core team to make the physical flow of goods programmable.

If you're a builder who thrives at the intersection of large-scale data architectures, systems engineering, and interfaces that make messy real-world data feel simple, this is your opportunity to shape how global brands run their supply chains.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You are a great fit if you have:

 - Hands-on experience with our stack on both sides of the wire. Python and FastAPI on the backend. Vue 3 (or deep React experience and the willingness to switch), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend. A track record of shipping real products.

 - A track record of building full-stack apps end-to-end: designing the data architecture, building the API, and shipping the UI that puts it in users' hands.

 - Experience building data-dense product UIs such as interactive charts, editable tables, and
 drag-and-drop planning tools, and keeping them fast with server-state patterns like TanStack Query.

 - Proficiency in SQL, writing high-performance queries despite millions of data points for even a single customer.

 - A habit of testing what you ship: pytest on the backend, Playwright and Vitest on the frontend. Your features work, and stay working.

 - System design skills, one of your biggest assets. You know how to design architectures that not only scale in the short term, but can also grow with the company with minimal human supervision.

 - Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode are your best friends. You know how to parallelize instances to make sure we're shipping 24/7, even while you sleep, and you know the ins and outs of each of them at any time.

 - When it comes to engineering with your toolkit, you don't care whether it's a pickaxe or a shovel. You know which one to use at any time.

 - Excited to work directly with CPG operators and own product outcomes end to end, from understanding the workflow to shipping and operating the systems that improve it.

 - Motivated by the chance to join an exceptionally ambitious, high-ownership team that moves quickly, holds a high bar, and is determined to build a company that makes history.

 - Bonus: Experience building a company before, unstructured data ingestion systems, DevOps, and AWS.

ABOUT SPHERECAST

Spherecast is building the AI-native Operating System for Consumer Goods Supply Chains.

The Spherecast Platform brings demand, inventory, materials, capacity, costs, and business rules into one real-time operating context. It gives teams a single place to plan, evaluate tradeoffs, and execute the decisions that move physical goods.

Agnes, our AI Supply Chain Manager, runs on top of this foundation. It evaluates thousands of feasible options in seconds to decide what to produce, where to make it, and how to move it through factories, warehouses, and channels. Teams set the objectives and guardrails; Agnes turns them into approved actions in the ERP.

Our ambition is to make the physical flow of goods as programmable as code. When we succeed, every consumer product you touch will run on the Spherecast stack: planned in Spherecast OS, executed through Spherecast Rails, and optimized by the shared Spherecast Network.

Oracle made business data programmable. Spherecast makes the physical economy programmable.

Join us in the trenches in New York City to build the AI-native Operating System for Consumer Goods Supply Chains.

Be part of building the next trillion-dollar company.

jobs.title: Founding Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT VERA HEALTH

Vera is the fastest-growing clinical app for healthcare professionals in the world. We’re a team of just over ten.

We’re already operating at a scale most teams never reach, with a team most people would think is too small to pull it off. Everyone here takes on significant responsibility, moves fast, and holds their work to an exceptionally high standard.

We’re building the founding team. The people who join now will define how this company operates for the next decade and shape the future of healthcare.

THE ROLE

The product is the company. Every screen and interaction should help a clinician understand what they’re looking at, find what they need, and know what to do next.

You’ll own how Vera looks, feels, and works. 

We’re looking for someone with exceptional taste. You have a creative point of view and can turn it into beautiful interfaces. You also understand software: how information should be organized, how interactions should behave, and how to make a complicated task feel simple.

Just as much, we care about your drive. You notice things other people miss, take initiative, and keep pushing until the work is right. You’re excited by the responsibility of being the founding designer and ready to put in the effort it takes.

You’ll work directly with the founders and engineers, move from ideas to prototypes quickly, and see your work reach users within days (sometimes hours). You’ll help decide what we build and stay involved through implementation, because the details matter in the product people actually use.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own design across Vera’s product and brand, creating a visual identity that feels distinctive and consistent.

 - Turn complex clinical workflows into intuitive experiences, from the overall journey to the smallest interaction.

 - Talk to clinicians, watch how they use Vera, and identify where the product can serve them better.

 - Explore ideas through prototypes, make clear design decisions, and bring them to life with exceptional visual craft.

 - Work closely with engineers to get the shipped experience right.

 - Build and evolve a practical design system that helps a small team move quickly.

 - Work directly with the founders on product direction and push the experience forward every week.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Exceptional taste. You have a strong eye for typography, layout, color, and interaction. Your work shows care, creativity, and a point of view.

Product intuition. You can spot a confusing flow, question an unnecessary step, and find a simpler way. You think about the entire experience and can explain the decisions behind it.

Drive and ownership. You find problems worth solving and take them on. You’re resourceful, persistent, and comfortable making progress without a fully defined brief.

Speed with high standards. You explore quickly, seek feedback early, and know where refinement will make the biggest difference. You can ship, learn, and improve without losing your attention to detail.

Command of your tools. You’re fluent in Figma and comfortable using whatever helps you prototype, communicate, and refine your ideas. Coding is a plus, but isn’t required.

There’s no minimum experience requirement. You might have spent a few years at a startup or be coming out of school with exceptional internships and personal projects. Show us strong work, clear thinking, and the ability to follow through.

HOW WE WORK

Ship, then improve. We put thoughtful work in front of users quickly and use real feedback to make it better.

Own it completely. You take responsibility for the outcome, work through constraints with the team, and stay involved until the experience works as intended.

Keep raising the standard. We give direct feedback, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect everyone to care deeply about the quality of what we ship.

Always look out for the user. Every decision comes back to the clinician on the other end. Their time, attention, and trust matter.

We work hard and move quickly. This is a demanding role with substantial responsibility, close collaboration, and the opportunity to shape a product used in consequential moments.

WHY VERA

 - Traction: 100%+ month-over-month growth, built by a team of five.

 - Meaningful work: Help clinicians find and understand the information they need to make better decisions.

 - Creative ownership: Set the design direction for the product and brand, with direct access to the founders and the people using your work.

 - Timing: We’ve just raised our Series A. We grew from 10k to over 650k users since the beginning of the year, and we're just getting started.

DETAILS

 - Location: In person in San Francisco. For exceptional candidates, relocation support (O-1A / H-1B sponsorship) available.

 - Compensation: $140k-$220k + meaningful equity.

 - Employment: Full-time.

APPLY

Complete the application form, and use the "Additional information" to include a link to your your portfolio - include one or two projects you’re particularly proud of and tell us what you personally owned. Internship work and personal projects are welcome.

jobs.title: Product Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Humaans is building the next generation of infrastructure for the workplace; software designed for companies that are scaling fast, operating globally, and pushing into new boundaries.

What started as a system of record has evolved into a broader platform for operating people globally. With Athena, our agentic AI layer, Humaans moves beyond data management into intelligent orchestration, connecting workflows across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations so organisations can act faster and with greater confidence, redefining how work gets done.

We work with ambitious teams across Europe and the US, from AI-native companies like Lovable, Poolside, Fyxer AI, and Tandem Health, to established, high-growth organisations scaling internationally and through acquisition, including Quantexa, Sellpy, Manychat, Gigs, Croud, and Threecolts. These teams don’t buy software for features,they buy leverage. The ability to run faster, cleaner, and with more control as complexity compounds.

To date, we’ve raised $20m in venture funding from some of the most respected founders, operators, and funds in technology: Lachy Groom (Physical Intelligence), Stewart Butterfield (Slack), Tobias Lütke (Shopify), Dylan Field (Figma), Jeff Weiner (LinkedIn), Claire Johnson (Stripe), Oliver Jay (OpenAI), Jay Simmons (Bond) as well as Y Combinator, Moonfire, Frontline Ventures, Pathlight Ventures, and Exor.

If you have massive ambition and want to work on a hard problem, with a small team that moves fast, at a moment when the category is genuinely up for grabs - this is it.

THE ROLE

A great implementation sets the tone for everything that follows: product adoption, customer confidence and the quality of the long-term relationship.

As a Product Implementation Specialist, you’ll own the customer journey from signed contract to successful launch across both our core HRIS and Athena platforms. You’ll help customers migrate complex data, configure Humaans around their organisation and deploy AI agents that deliver value from day one.

You’ll work closely with customers and teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering. Alongside delivering excellent implementations, you’ll improve how the work itself gets done, using AI to increase accuracy, reduce manual effort and shorten time to value for every customer that follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own implementation projects from initial scoping through to launch, establishing clear requirements, timelines and responsibilities across the HRIS and Athena platforms.

 - Lead complex data migrations for global organisations, using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate data preparation, identify anomalies and validate accuracy at scale.

 - Configure Humaans around each customer’s organisational structure, workflows and policies, ensuring the platform reflects how they operate.

 - Act as a trusted adviser, guiding customers through implementation best practices and helping them achieve their operational transformation goals.

 - Manage stakeholders across HR, IT, Finance and Operations, maintaining alignment, resolving blockers and keeping multiple projects on track.

 - Guide customers through integrations, APIs and webhooks so they can take advantage of the platform’s technical capabilities.

 - Establish a seamless handover to Customer Success, ensuring the team has the context and foundations required to build a successful long-term relationship.

 - Improve our implementation approach by introducing AI-enabled workflows, refining playbooks and sharing recurring patterns, friction points and product feedback with Product and Engineering.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Evidence of owning SaaS implementation or onboarding projects involving complex data, ideally for enterprise or global customers.

 - A strong record of delivering projects on time and within scope while managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders.

 - Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when handling data migration, validation and product configuration.

 - Practical experience using AI to materially improve implementation work, with clear examples of what changed and the impact it delivered.

 - Confidence working with integrations, APIs and webhooks, with the ability to explain technical requirements clearly to customers.

 - Strong working knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel and the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.

 - Clear, credible communication and the judgement to manage expectations, resolve difficult situations and build trust with senior stakeholders.

 - Comfort operating in an environment where processes are still developing and you are expected to improve them through hands-on experience.

YOU MAY NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You prefer to inherit a fully established implementation process 

 - You are uncomfortable taking personal responsibility for project timelines, data accuracy and the quality of a customer’s launch.

 - You rely on customers or internal teams to drive progress when projects become complex or unclear.

 - You prefer to avoid technical conversations involving data, integrations, APIs or webhooks.

 - You have not yet incorporated AI meaningfully into your work.

 - You are uncomfortable managing several projects and stakeholder groups at the same time.

This is an in-person role. Our team comes together in the office Monday through Thursday, while most of the team collaborates in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.

PACKAGE & BENEFITS

Early stage startups can be messy – we know that. We're putting effort in providing you with the best employee experience and a quality driven environment in exchange for trusting us.

 - Market-leading compensation that reflects your value

 - 25 days paid time off each year plus public holidays

 - Share Options with 5-year exercise window so you don’t feel pressure to exercise if you leave

 - Quarterly team events, and company offsites

 - Top tier private coverage for health, vision and dental car

jobs.title: Member of Design Staff
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Giga has recently raised a $61M Series A and is working with Fortune 500 customers to deploy the next generation of customer experience - real-time AI agents that can understand emotion, resolve issues instantly, and scale across the world's largest enterprises.

Industry leaders like DoorDash trust Giga with their most complex support and operations workflows across voice, chat, and email, in high-stakes regulated environments where accuracy and compliance matter. We're at an exciting inflection point.

While we've found real commercial success, our ambitions are larger: to become the go-to AI platform for all enterprise automation, powered by our voice superintelligence. The work affects millions of people every day, and our team has the autonomy to make true impact - with brilliant founders, a clear path forward, and the kind of momentum that defines generational companies.
If being part of that resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you!

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Staff Product Designer to own experiences across significant surface areas at Giga. You’ll drive strategy-level design decisions in partnership with the design organization, technical team members, and our customers. You have a track record of zero-to-one work with an eye on one-to-one-million, and craft that others hold up as the bar.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Translate highly complex enterprise needs into experiences that evolve naturally as the product matures — including conversational and agentic interfaces that have no established playbook

 - Serve as the directly responsible designer for experiences across a large product surface area

 - Lead research with enterprise customers and use insights to drive product strategy

 - Be an author to help evolve the design system

 - Set and uphold quality standards collaboratively with design and engineering leaders

 - Mentor designers (up to ~20% of your time), participate in hiring, and help leadership kick off large, novel initiatives

 - Influence prioritization and present evidence for design decisions

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You have roughly 8+ years of product design experience, including demonstrated success on zero-to-one products across multiple industries

 - In each organization you join, you raise the quality bar of the product experience while meeting business metrics and goals

 - You have a track record of designing novel interaction experiences that scale across use cases, personas, and customer lifecycles

 - You have strong skills across the product design spectrum: from leveraging user research and quantitative product insights, to designing complex UX systems, and driving differentiation through visual design, delight, and magic moments

 - You’ve mentored other teammates and junior designers in craft, strategy, and execution

 - You lean on your collaboration and communication skills to build cross functional relationship across peer departments including GTM, engineering, and within customers

 - You capture attention and garner trust from teammates up to leadership levels

 - You show up with a “yes, and” attitude — under pressure your default is optimism and positivity

Bonus points:

 - Experience designing AI-native products — you've shipped experiences where models, agents, or generative UX are the product, and you understand designing for non-deterministic systems

 - Fluency with AI tooling in your own workflow — prompt-driven design, AI-assisted prototyping and research synthesis — and judgment about when to use it

 - A technical lean: design engineering, high-fidelity prototyping in code, or front-end experience (React or similar) — you can build what you design, or get close

 - Ability to speak with technical stakeholders in their own language

 

WHY GIGA

 - Audacious goal: We're building toward 98% automation of enterprise operations—support is just the beginning

 - Self-improving systems: Our agents get better with every interaction, automatically expanding what they can handle

 - Production scale: Already handling millions of calls monthly for Fortune 100 companies with 90%+ resolution

 - Technical differentiation: Sub-500ms multi-party orchestration and emotional intelligence that competitors can't match

 - Massive market: Customer support automation growing from $3B to $47B by 2034, and we're expanding into healthcare, finance, and beyond

 - World-class team: Founded by Forbes 30 Under 30, backed by Redpoint and YC, growing fast

 - High impact: Every feature you ship directly moves us toward a world where enterprises operate with near-complete automation

 

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base + bonus + equity

 - Catered lunch daily

 - Dinner stipend

 - $300/month wellness & commuter benefit (gym, fitness classes, mental health)

 - 401(k) plan

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

Giga is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Partnerships: New Verticals Associate
jobs.description:
THE PROBLEM

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance company in San Francisco. We're not bolting AI onto insurance — we're rebuilding the entire business as software, on a simple bet: turning expert human judgment into compute is one of the largest transitions left to make, and a trillion-dollar industry still run 90% by hand is the place to prove it. We've grown ~100x in the last year and we move at that speed — on-site, in person, long days, very high standards. Almost no one joins Harper for insurance; they join to build the company that replaces how it works.

THE ROLE

This role reports into Head of Partnerships and owns opening new markets and partner channels from zero. The partnerships motion already exists in early form — the job is not to invent company strategy from scratch. It's to take unproven markets and channels, get in the field, build the relationships, and turn first signal into a real motion. Early does not mean there is revenue yet. Early means the play is being built, and you are the person building it on the ground.

There is no inherent pipeline waiting for you. That's not a warning — it's the design. You will not inherit a book of partners or a warmed-up funnel. You report into someone who already set the direction; your job is to execute in market, run a clear distribution scoreboard, and make progress visible week to week. What you do here meaningfully moves whether a new market becomes real — or stays a thesis.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Open new markets and partner channels from zero. First meetings, first relationships, first referrals — before there is money to point at.

 - Travel is a core part of this job, not an occasional add-on. You will be on the road regularly; San Francisco is home base.

 - Run the distribution scoreboard. Outreach, meetings, referrals, conversion — make the motion measurable even when revenue is still early or zero.

 - Build 0→1 channel motions. Turn a cold market into a working partner or channel path under clear direction from Special Projects.

 - Bridge partnerships, sales, and ops. Make handoffs clean so nothing dies when you leave the room.

 - Own problems end-to-end within your markets. Gather signal, map the constraint, propose the next move, drive it to done.

 - Codify what works. When a market starts to click, write it down so it can scale beyond you.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF…

 - High agency — you move toward execution, not away from it.

 - Energized by building from zero rather than rattled by it.

 - Comfortable traveling constantly and operating from the field.

 - Experienced in high-pace environments — typically ~2–3 years in startups, GTM, BD, partnerships, ops, or equivalent, with real ownership already under your belt. Years at a startup are not the same as years elsewhere; we care about what you owned, not how senior your last title looked.

 - You want serious ownership and career capital — not a Head title on day one, not a desk job, not a hand-holding Associate seat.

REQUIREMENTS

 - 2–3 years in partnerships, business development, GTM, new markets, field sales, operations, or a high-intensity startup role, with demonstrated ownership (startup experience weighted heavily)

 - Evidence you can own messy work end-to-end

 - Strong written and verbal communication

 - Ability to operate autonomously and context-switch rapidly

 - Track record of delivering under pressure with high standards

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate immediately

 - Able and willing to travel heavily on a regular basis

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in insurance, fintech, or regulated industries

 - Prior work with founders or small teams

 - Familiarity with AI/automation tools and workflows

 - Prior startup or 0→1 experience

COMPENSATION

 - Salary: $125,000 - $150,000 + performance bonuses & equity

 - Location: San Francisco, in-office

BENEFITS

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Commuter benefits

 - Team meals and snacks

THE PROCESS

 1. Lead screen — initial fit and alignment

 2. Partnerships screen — how you think about opening a market from zero

 3. On-site day — Meet the team, work through real scenarios

TO APPLY

Send your resume and tell us about something you built or own from early/incomplete - what was unproven, what you did, and what moved. If you're okay with heavy travel, no inherent pipelines, and real ownership, apply!

 - Own field execution for priority partnership markets. Show up, run the play, learn what converts, write it down.

 - Travel constantly. Being in market is the core of the job, not a perk. San Francisco is home base.

 - Activate partners that produce signal. Meetings and logos without follow-through don't count; tracked outcomes do.

 - Run a simple scoreboard. Activity → meetings → referrals → conversion — visible even when revenue is still early.

 - Close the feedback loop. Turn field insight into messaging, collateral, and handoffs the rest of the team can use.

 - Experiment fast. Try plays, measure, double down or kill — learning speed over polish.

 - Own outcomes within your lane. When a motion isn't moving, fix the targeting, message, channel, or handoff.

 - Travel is the job. If you want a San Francisco desk role with occasional events, this is the wrong seat. You will be in market a lot.

 - It's measured in movement, not vibes. Events attended don't count if nothing converts or gets tracked. Early markets may not have clean revenue yet — your job is still to create and measure signal.

 

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF…

 

 - High agency — you move toward execution, not away from it.

 - Energized by building from zero rather than rattled by it.

 - You think in simple systems: insight → play → scoreboard → next move.

 - Experienced in high-pace environments — typically ~2 years in field marketing, partnerships, growth, BD, GTM, or startup roles, with real ownership already. Startup years are weighted heavily.

 - You want serious ownership and career capital, not a desk-only marketing job.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

 - 2 years in field marketing, partnerships, growth, demand generation, BD, GTM, or a high-intensity startup role, with demonstrated ownership (startup experience weighted heavily)

 - Evidence you can own messy work end-to-end

 - Strong written and verbal communication

 - Ability to operate autonomously and context-switch rapidly

 - Track record of delivering under pressure with high standards

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate immediately

 - Able and willing to travel heavily on a regular basis

 

NICE TO HAVE

 

 - Experience in insurance, fintech, or regulated industries

 - Prior work with founders or small teams

 - Familiarity with AI/automation tools and workflows

 - Prior startup or 0→1 experience

 

COMPENSATION

 

 - Salary: $125,000 - $150,000 + performance bonuses & equity

 - Location: San Francisco, in-office

 

BENEFITS

 

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Commuter benefits

 - Team meals and snacks

 

THE PROCESS

 

 1. Lead screen — initial fit and alignment

 2. Partnerships screen — how you think about opening a market from zero

 3. On-site day — Meet the team, work through real scenarios

 

TO APPLY

 

Send your resume and tell us about something you owned in market or on a team — what was incomplete, what you did, and what moved. If you're okay with heavy travel and real ownership, apply!

Technical Content Writer (Contract)

jobs.title: Junior IIOT Engineer, Shenzhen
jobs.description:
ABOUT OVERVIEW.AI http://Overview.ai

Overview.ai http://Overview.ai brings the cutting edge of AI computer vision to manufacturing, solving inspection problems that traditional machine vision could not handle. We build GPU-powered smart cameras, deploy them on production lines around the world, and operate the platform that keeps those fleets running.

Our customers love the product because it works: high accuracy, fast deployment, and an operator-friendly experience that makes real factory rollouts possible (not just pilots).

THE ROLE

As a Junior IIoT Engineer, you will help bring our systems live at customer sites: connecting smart cameras to line PLCs, building the logic that runs the inspections, and making sure everything runs reliably on the factory floor.

You will be mentored and grow into someone who can own an entire deployment. We provide structured training in Node-RED, camera inspection-recipe building, and English. We do not expect you to master these tools on day one, but we do expect you to already have a solid industrial-field foundation (see Requirements), which we build on to make you a fully capable engineer.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

DEPLOYMENT AND COMMISSIONING

 - Deploy and commission Overview.ai http://Overview.ai vision-inspection systems on customer production lines, on-site.

 - Create and tune camera inspection recipes for each product (regions of interest, models, pass/fail criteria).

 - Set up and troubleshoot on-site: cameras, industrial networking and switches, and connectivity issues, using our existing internal diagnostic tools.

INTEGRATION

 - Build and maintain integration logic in Node-RED (data flow between cameras, PLCs, HMIs, and dashboards).

 - Integrate cameras with factory PLCs over I/O, EtherNet/IP, and Profinet: triggering, handshake signals, and result reporting.

CUSTOMER SUPPORT AND TEAMWORK

 - Support customers on-site: basic training, issue resolution, and clear written and photo documentation of each deployment.

 - Work closely with the team, escalating complex problems while steadily taking on more independence.

REQUIREMENTS

 - A diploma or degree in Electrical, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related industrial field. A Computer Science or software background is also fine if paired with hands-on factory experience.

 - A working foundation in industrial fundamentals, which we expect you to have on day one:
 
 - Basic concepts of PLCs and industrial automation (signals, I/O, trigger and handshake logic).
 
 - A basic understanding of common manufacturing processes.
 
 - The ability to read and clarify on-site requirements, turning customer needs into actionable inspection and integration specs.
 
 - Solid troubleshooting instincts: systematically pinpointing what went wrong and why.

 - A strong hands-on drive and problem-solving mindset: you like to dig into why something is not working and fix it.

 - Basic English reading and writing, with a genuine willingness to improve.

 - Able and willing to travel frequently across China and Southeast Asia, with a valid passport.

 - Reliable, communicative, and comfortable working directly in a live factory environment.

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED, WE WILL TRAIN YOU)

 - Hands-on experience with specific PLC brands or industrial protocols (Keyence, EtherNet/IP, MQTT, or similar).

 - Any scripting or programming experience (JavaScript, Python), or low-code tools such as Node-RED.

 - Familiarity with machine vision, industrial cameras, or industrial networking.

 - Basic SQL or dashboard tools.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - A clear training path: Node-RED and camera-recipe building training, plus English training by an external instructor (two-year program).

 - On-the-job training and mentorship: you learn by doing on real projects.

 - Fast, real ownership: you will be commissioning live systems at major manufacturers.

 - A growth track from Junior IIoT Engineer to IIoT Engineer to Senior IIoT Engineer.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (£80k-125k + Equity)
jobs.description:
👋 HEY! WE'RE CONVEO.AI 

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

 

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to one of our engineering leads, and work incredibly closely with our CTO, Maarten.

Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here https://engineering.conveo.ai/engineering-at-conveo👈

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/82d8d474-2034-4e8c-990c-c2e828853c75/NRP19251.jpg]

WHAT WE'RE BUILDING AND WHY

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch — you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here — AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

 - Strong backend experience: designing APIs, working with PostgreSQL, and managing background jobs and async workflows.

 - Solid frontend skills with React. .

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) — you're comfortable with services like S3, media pipelines, and deployment tooling.

 - Experience building AI-driven applications (e.g. prompt engineering, working with LLM APIs, and/or fine-tuning experience are a plus).

 - Can independently lead projects from concept to launch.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with a keen eye for detail.

 - A collaborative mindset, able to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced team.

BONUS

 - Experience with React Router v7 or Remix.

 - Experience at a small, fast-moving SaaS company where you’ve been client-facing

 - Exposure to market research or qualitative research tooling.

 - You've shipped agentic AI systems to production and can speak to failure modes, evaluations, and tool design.

WHY JOIN US?

 - Ship alongside engineers who've built and scaled products used by millions.

 - Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

 - Join a YC-backed team that's growing fast and gives you room to grow with it.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

 - Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the office.

 - Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

 - Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal. 

 - Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

 - Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

 - Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000.

#LI-ML1

PRODUCT ENGINEER

At Complir we are building the system to enable safer physical products being sold across markets. The world of product compliance has been stuck in legacy systems, excel sheets and the brains of experts. The increasing amount of regulations and complexity is breaking these old systems, making it increasingly hard to sell safe compliant products to consumers. We are building the product that enables compliance experts to stay afloat.

We are a small team of generalists working on all parts of the stack. One day you might be working on improving the reliability of our AI systems, another you might be tweaking the UI of the product. Our team is one of high trust, collaboration and autonomy, therefore we’re looking for engineers who thrive when given responsibility from day one and are not afraid to figure out things on their own. We ship early and iterate directly with customers, therefore you will be expected to be comfortable talking directly to the users using the software you will build.

LOCATION

Our office is located in Copenhagen and you will be expected to work in person. We will provide the necessary help with relocation if needed.

DAY TO DAY AT COMPLIR

 - You will be working directly with the founders, customers and our in house specialists and you will help figure out what needs to be built

 - Build AI native software that integrates with the latest models to solve our customers' hardest problems. (we have plenty of tokens)

 - Build durable workflows to understand customers' unstructured data.

 - Improve the data structures that connects cross border regulatory data

 - Surface novel insights from unstructured and structured data

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2-5 years of experience

 - Strong understanding of React and TypeScript, with experience of working across the full stack. You understand browsers, but also the ins and outs of databases

 - Product taste. You have opinions about UI/UX and enjoy iterating to get to the correct product shape

 - High agency. You take responsibility and are able to work without a PM giving you tickets

 - Experience working at a startup

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Small collaborative team. We work hard but have a lot of fun. We are a diverse set of people with different backgrounds

 - Employee friendly equity package

 - Competitive salary

 - Work at a venture backed startup. Read our latest 11m seed round led by GC here: https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed

 - Assistance with relocation if need be

 - 0 -> 1 work. Have real influence on how the product is shaped and work on green field projects

jobs.title: Claims Handler-General
jobs.description:
READY TO BUILD YOUR CLAIMS CAREER FASTER THAN EVER?

We're looking for an early career Claims Handler to join ClaimSorted in downtown Dallas!

This role is ideal for:

An adjuster with 1–2 years of experience who wants to build their career at a company that rewards performance, not tenure, someone licensed and early in their career who is hungry to learn the business and grow fast

We are looking for people with talent, ambition, work ethic, and the drive to build a real career.

If you join us, we will give you the training and support to become the best adjuster possible - customer service, coverage, investigation, data, and quality. Our goal is to help you become one of the best claims leaders of the future.

TURNING RISK INTO OPPORTUNITY

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a desk of claims end to end: from first notification of loss through to resolution

 - Communicate with policyholders throughout the claims journey, ensuring a clear and positive experience

 - Make sound, well-documented decisions and manage claims within your authority

 - Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately

 - Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance

 - Contribute to continuous improvement by working with operations and engineering

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Willing to work 5 days in office in Dallas (in our amazing new office Downtown)

 - Texas All-Lines Adjuster license, with Texas designated as your home state

 - 1–2 years of adjusting experience

 - Sharp, organised, and able to prioritise independently

 - A clear communicator, in writing and on the phone

 - Genuinely curious about how claims and coverage work

 - Comfortable using data to make decisions

 - Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious

 - Startup or high-growth experience is a plus

WHY JOIN US

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

You'll be trained on our process and tools, but you'll be expected to ramp up fast and take ownership early. You'll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work.

If you're licensed, hungry to learn the adjusting business, and want in on a company early, we'd love to hear from you.

OUR VALUES

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

 - Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

 - Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with 4% company match

 - 20 days annual PTO

 - Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
Opportunity

 - ZeitMind is an autonomous data engineer for mid-market businesses. Agents and people work the same company data: ingest, pipeline, clean, analyse, build operational apps

 - we are growing fast and will be onboarding multiple enterprise customers a week. The backend isn't ready yet, your impact will decide the speed at which we can grow

 - load growth is compounding: more customers, multiple users per customer, many agent interactions per user and multiple agent artifacts (data pipelines, schedules, analyses) coming out of the interactions

 - you own the platform

What you'll do

 - scale a multi-tenant Postgres under unpredictable load: query and I/O optimisation, read/write separation, horizontal scaling

 - make agent-driven workloads survivable: one user can spin up 30 table syncs, some running hours, while others query large sources

 - manage the sandbox layer: Docker containers where agents run queries and reverse-engineer files, with compute and memory budgets

 - own connectivity into customer networks: SOCKS5 over WebSockets, authentication, routing

 - scope the architecture and build it

What we're looking for

 - staff or principal level, still hands-on, writing production code

 - built and scaled multi-tenant data platforms in a B2B startup or platform company before

 - deep Postgres or database knowledge: query plans, locking, I/O, caching, replication, sharding

 - understands startup pace and ownership without specs

 - pragmatic over ideal, wants to build foundations right without overengineering

 - strong TypeScript

 - English C1, German a plus

Nice to have

 - experience at a data platform or warehouse company (Snowflake, Databricks, Cloudflare or similar)

 - networking depth: proxies, VPN, routing

Location

 - preferred: Munich, on-site. We support relocation within Europe

 - already in London? We can make that work. We have people here and are opening a small office, and we'd expect regular Munich travel. In-person culture is important to us

Tech stack

 - TypeScript end to end. Bun, tRPC, Postgres, Supabase. React frontend (Mantine, TanStack Query). Docker, job/process management, VPN/routing, agentic frameworks

jobs.title: SAP Integration Architect
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

 - Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

 - Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

 - Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

 - Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

 - Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

 - Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

 - Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

 - Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

 - Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

 - Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

 - A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

 - Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

 - Fluent German and English.

 - Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

 - An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

 - Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

 - Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

 - Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

 - 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

 - A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

 1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

 2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

 3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

 4. Culture call with our CPO

 5. Meet the team

 6. Offer

jobs.title: Quantum Architecture and Device Theorist
jobs.description:
About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

What You'll Work On:

 - Develop theoretical and numerical models of qubit devices, gate operations, and physical-layer processes to guide next-generation processor design

 - Design and evaluate system architectures under hardware-specific constraints and realistic noise models

 - Translate device-level physics into architecture-level requirements, and architecture-level goals into concrete device specifications

 - Determine error budgets and gate fidelity requirements from architecture-level targets

 - Build simulation and modeling tools for system design, performance analysis, and roadmap planning

 - Work directly with the hardware team to inform device design and validate models

 - Lead high-impact research projects with a multidisciplinary team of experimental and theoretical physicists, engineers, and computer scientists

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have:

 - A PhD in physics, applied physics, computer science, electrical engineering, or an equivalent degree in a similar field

 - 5–10 years of experience in the theory and modeling of quantum computing hardware

 - Publications in quantum device physics, quantum architecture, or related fields

 - Strong programming skills in a scientific computing environment

 - Proven track record of successful cross-team collaborative projects

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Strong Candidates May Have:

 - Experience translating cutting-edge R&D into commercial products or roadmap milestones

 - Experience with the modeling of multiple or heterogeneous qubit platforms

 - Experience translating abstract models into hardware-aware protocols

 - Experience bridging theory and experiment on real quantum hardware

 - Familiarity with quantum error correction and fault-tolerant architecture

Why This Matters

Your work accelerates the path to quantum super intelligence. Each quantum component integrated, each AI model enhanced, each instruction set optimized brings us closer to a future where intelligence and quantum mechanics are inextricably intertwined. We're not building incremental improvements—we're creating exponential transformations that will make AI more affordable, sustainable, personalized, and fundamentally more capable.

How We’re Different

We’re building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence and pioneering new domains at the intersection of physics, engineering, and AI. At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail.

Culture & Benefits

 - The Best of Both Worlds: Access to industrial-scale compute and hardware resources

 - while retaining the intellectual freedom of an academic environment.

 - Visa Sponsorship: We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation: We value your high-level expertise. This position offers a salary significantly above standard academic postdoctoral rates.

 - Benefits: Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection: Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off: We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at [email in original advert].

jobs.title: Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Claim Health

Claim Health is the AI Revenue Platform for Post-Acute Care.

With the US population aging and preference for care moving to the home, post-acute care (home health, skilled nursing, home care, hospice) is one of the fastest growing verticals within healthcare. Post-acute providers operate across fragmented systems, manual workflows, and reactive processes that create operational drag and financial uncertainty. Claim Health replaces this fragmentation with an intelligent, software-driven platform that unifies data, automates execution, and enables real-time decision-making across revenue-critical operations.

We're building an adaptive platform that brings clarity, predictability, and scale to environments where reliability matters.

About the Role

We're hiring an Operations Specialist to own the accuracy of what our platform decides. Our automation runs the revenue cycle end to end for the majority of cases — referral intake, eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorization, notices of election, denials and appeals, and billing. You own the cases it can't, and you make sure the cases it can are right.

This is a high-autonomy role spanning the full revenue cycle, not a single workflow. Thousands of referrals, authorizations, eligibility checks, and claims move through the platform every week, and a missed detail means a delayed start of care or unpaid work. You'll sit directly alongside the team building the automation — the edge cases you catch and the patterns you surface become the next version of the product.

This role is open to recent graduates. Healthcare experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What You'll Do

Own the Exception Queue

 - Work a live queue containing edge cases for intake, eligibility, authorization, notices, and claims — resolving each case against payer, state, and agency requirements when no automation covers them

 - Meet turnaround expectations on time-sensitive work where a few minutes delay means delayed care or a missed filing window

Audit Quality and Accuracy

 - Review automation outputs for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before they reach the agency or the payer

 - Catch errors upstream — a wrong payer, a missing face-to-face, a misread document, a coverage gap — rather than discovering them as denials

 - Tag every exception with a clear cause so recurring failures become visible instead of absorbed

Denials, Appeals, and Revenue Recovery

 - Investigate denied and underpaid claims, determine root cause, and work the appeal through to resolution

 - Trace denials back to their origin — an eligibility miss at intake, a missing authorization, a coding or documentation gap — and close the upstream hole

 - Track denial patterns by payer and agency and flag the ones worth automating against

Turn Edge Cases Into Automation

 - Configure rules, mappings, coverage logic, and thresholds in internal tooling so solved problems stay solved

 - Document findings and write escalations with enough detail that engineering can act on them

 - Track patterns across payers, states, and EMRs and bring them to the team as automation candidates

Cross-Functional Execution

 - Partner with product and engineering to refine the logic powering intake, eligibility, authorization, and billing workflows

 - Build fluency across payers, plan types, and EMRs as you work an increasingly wide range of cases

 - Serve as the feedback loop between what actually happens in the queue and what gets built next

What We're Looking For

 - 0–2 years of experience; recent graduates encouraged to apply

 - Comfort making a judgment call on an unfamiliar case with no playbook — and the instinct to write the playbook afterward

 - Exceptional attention to detail. Revenue cycle work is unforgiving of small errors

 - Clear, concise written communication; you'll document causes and write escalations daily

 - Fast at picking up new software. You'll learn several EMRs and a long list of payer portals

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

 - High ownership mentality and bias toward action

Optional Nice to Haves

 - A healthcare-related degree — nursing, health administration, public health, health information management

 - A clinical background or license: LPN, LVN, RN, MA, or paramedic. If you've worked a floor and want out of shift work without leaving healthcare, this is a real path

 - Experience with healthcare operations, claims, billing, eligibility, denials and appeals, utilization management, or revenue cycle workflows

 - Familiarity with EMRs like HCHB, KanTime, WellSky, or Axxess

 - Comfort working with data and tools such as SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or internal dashboards

 - A habit of automating your own work — scripts, spreadsheets, whatever you built to stop doing something twice

Why Join Claim Health

 - Real impact: Your work affects mission-critical operations and financial outcomes

 - Ownership: Meaningful equity and influence over the platform's direction

 - Hard problems: Complex systems, real constraints, no toy use cases

 - Speed: Small team, fast feedback loops, high leverage work. We have a bias towards moving as fast as possible.

 - Culture: Low ego, high standards, deep respect for craft

 - Fun: One of the most important things we screen for is can you laugh with us.

jobs.title: MTS, Technology & Security Engineering
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

ROLE OVERVIEW 

As a MTS for Technology & Security Engineering is responsible for architecting and operating the security engineering foundation that protects the organization’s corporate environment, multi-cloud research infrastructure, and multi-million-dollar GPU training capacity. This leader owns the full technical security stack — from end-user compute and zero-trust access to cloud and container security, detection engineering, and security-as-code — ensuring the organization can move at research speed without sacrificing rigor.

Sitting at the intersection of security engineering, infrastructure, and research operations, this role is uniquely positioned to define how a frontier AI company protects its most sensitive assets — model weights, training data, and GPU capacity — while preserving the low-friction environment researchers and engineers need to do their best work. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on technical depth alongside the executive presence to lead a security engineering function, represent the organization’s security posture to auditors and enterprise customers, and negotiate vendor and contractual risk.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that operates across engineering, infrastructure, legal, and physical security. Success requires the ability to design guardrails rather than gates, build systems that assume compromise, and operate credibly as both an executive leader and a hands-on builder.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Secure diverse local toolchains and developer environments without breaking the workflows researchers and engineers depend on.

Securing the Research & Training Boundary

 - Architect cloud-native security controls across multi-cloud environments that contain multi-million-dollar GPU clusters.

 - Establish IAM governance, network segmentation, and isolation boundaries appropriate to the scale and sensitivity of training infrastructure and model assets.

 - Partner with infrastructure and research teams to ensure security controls scale with GPU capacity rather than constrain it.

 - Implement continuous, context-aware authorization using modern mesh networks and proxies (e.g., Tailscale, Cloudflare One).

 - Enforce hardware-backed authentication (WebAuthn/FIDO2 keys) across every corporate and production plane.

 - Eliminate standing and persistent access in favor of just-in-time, verifiable authorization.

Security as Code (SaC)

 - Ensure 100% of infrastructure, endpoint configurations, IAM policies, and cloud environments are declared in code (Terraform/Pulumi).

 - Eliminate configuration drift through automated CI/CD validation and continuous compliance checks.

 - Build repeatable, auditable deployment pipelines that make security posture provable rather than assumed.

Behavioral Detection Engineering

 - Build telemetry pipelines that ingest high-fidelity logs into a cloud-native data lake to support detection at scale.

 - Detect sophisticated post-exploitation techniques, lateral movement, and living-off-the-land attacks across corporate and production environments.

 - Continuously tune detection coverage against an assumed-breach threat model, prioritizing time-to-detect and blast-radius containment.

Compliance, Audit & Vendor Risk

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISO 22237, ISO 22301, NIST CSF, customer audits, and enterprise security reviews.

 - Lead vendor risk assessments, procurement security reviews, and security-related legal contract negotiations.

 - Own front-line defenses for a frontier AI company, including physical security and data center security operations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Experience & Background

 - 7+ years of deep engineering experience at high-valuation companies, or in defense-grade environments.

 - Battle-tested technical leadership with a track record of building and operating security engineering functions at scale.

 - Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISO 22237, ISO 22301, NIST CSF, customer audits, and enterprise security reviews.

 - Experience leading vendor risk, procurement security reviews, and legal contract negotiations.

 - Experience with front-line defenses for an AI company, including physical security and data center security operations.

Skills & Capabilities

 - Deep familiarity with Linux and macOS internals, including how to secure specialized hardware (NVIDIA GPUs) without breaking developer environments.

 - Expert-level knowledge of public cloud architectures, IAM governance at scale, and Kubernetes/container isolation primitives.

jobs.title: Founding Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAINDROP

Raindrop http://raindrop.ai/ is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2.0 (Self-Healing Agents) https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/introducing-raindrop-2/, the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions.

WHY IT MATTERS

AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing.

The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions.

That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns.

With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more.

In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used.

As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company - from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents.

OUR INVESTORS

We've raised $50M total https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/series-a/, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari).

THE ROLE 

You’ll own PLG at Raindrop, working directly with the founders to set our growth strategy and execute it. This is an ambitious role with large scope and ownership.

This will include running launches end to end, defining lifecycle marketing, AEO + SEO, curating creative digital and physical campaigns with the goal of driving demand gen and conversion.

You’ll also build our content engine alongside our CTO, Ben https://x.com/benhylak, who has 50K+ followers on X. That includes launching a podcast, publishing writing regularly, and collaborating on design. This is a rare opportunity to learn quickly and bootstrap your own audience.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

 - Proven experience growing a product targeted towards developers and technical buyers

 - Experience building AI agents or dev tools (+ avid user)

 - Excellent writing skills

 - Growth mindset

 - Willing to do whatever it takes to solve a problem

 - Must be in person in San Francisco (or willing to move)
