jobs.title: Founding Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Build the pipeline and drive qualified opportunities that accelerate Hypercubic’s growth and revenue.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’ve built an initial enterprise pipeline through founder-led sales. Now we’re looking for an exceptional founding salesperson to dramatically expand that pipeline, keep opportunities moving, and help turn early traction into a repeatable sales motion.

Your three core responsibilities:

 1. Own the entire top of funnel: sourcing, prospecting, outreach, and qualification.

 2. Drive opportunities from first call, owning demos, follow-up, and deal progression.

 3. Work with the CEO on strategy, pricing, negotiation, and closing.

You’ll have meaningful ownership over who we pursue, how we reach them, and how we advance opportunities. You’ll build the playbook through daily execution and customer feedback, with room to take on more of the sales cycle as you grow.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Create qualified pipeline. Research accounts and generate opportunities through outbound, warm introductions, partners, conferences, and inbound leads.

 - Run discovery. Lead first calls, understand the problem and urgency, identify stakeholders, and establish whether there’s a credible path to a purchase.

 - Keep deals moving. Build champions, engage decision-makers, identify blockers, and secure concrete next steps.

 - Partner with the CEO. Bring them into deeper demos, strategy, pricing, and negotiation with strong preparation. Own follow-through afterward.

 - Build the playbook. Test messaging and channels, document what works, maintain an accurate pipeline, and use AI and automation to increase your output.

Success means more qualified opportunities, faster deal progression, and more pilots converting into revenue.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven sales ability. You’ve built your own pipeline and won complex enterprise business, ideally including six- or seven-figure contracts. You can point to deals you personally created and advanced.

 - High agency. You find ways into accounts and move independently without an established playbook.

 - Enterprise judgment. You build champions, navigate buying committees, and know when to push, adapt, or walk away.

 - Technical curiosity. You learn complex products quickly and earn credibility with engineers and executives.

 - Sharp communication. You write compelling outreach, run focused discovery, and get to the point.

 - Disciplined execution. You prepare thoroughly, keep an accurate pipeline, and follow through.

 - Resourceful with tools. You’re hands-on with CRMs, prospecting tools, and AI. You build workflows that accelerate research, outreach, meeting preparation, and follow-up.

 - Ambition and coachability. You take ownership of results, seek feedback, and want to become exceptional at your craft.

You may be an AE who built your own pipeline, a standout BDR ready for broader ownership, or a founder who sold a technical product.

You’re excited to be Sales #1: own the playbook, learn directly from the founders, and shape the sales function as Hypercubic grows.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - A sustained increase in qualified enterprise opportunities.

 - More accounts progressing toward pilots and paid deployments.

 - Active deals with engaged stakeholders, understood blockers, and concrete next steps.

 - Repeatable sources of pipeline beyond the CEO’s personal network.

 - Driving the founders to spend more time in consequential bottom of the funnel customer conversations.

 - A repeatable sales playbook grounded in what actually wins business.

You’ll help build the commercial foundation of a company tackling some of the world’s most consequential software. You’ll work closely with the founders and engineering team, influence how we reach the market, and see your work directly shape the business.

LOGISTICS

 - Location: This role is in-person 5 days a week based in San Francisco, California near FiDi.

 - Sponsorship: Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor new H1B employment visas at this time.

BENEFITS

We offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

 - Founding-team level equity, 

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K)

 - Monthly stipend to support your wellness and commute

 - Daily lunches/dinners and snacks in the office to fuel you

 - Generous PTO and sick day policy to rest and recharge

ABOUT HYPERCUBIC

At Hypercubic, we’re building AI systems that can understand, reason about, and rearchitect large-scale legacy applications running on mainframes and COBOL. We work at the intersection of program analysis, knowledge extraction, and agentic systems, applied to some of the most critical enterprise software in the world.

We’re a small, deeply technical team in San Francisco, backed by top investors, and working with some of the largest organizations in the world.

Casca is building AGI for banking. We’re replacing decades-old legacy systems with AI-native technology that automates 90% of the manual work humans once had to do. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Projected Division of Responsibilities: 70% contributing code / 30% collaborating with stakeholders and mentoring

 - Lead Strategy with Urgency: Drive architectural decisions that support long-term stability while maintaining the pace required by a fast-growing banking platform. You will identify critical paths and make high-stakes technical calls to keep the organization moving efficiently.

 - Balance Coding & Leadership: Maintain a projected division of roughly 70% contributing high-quality code and 30% driving technical alignment. You will be expected to ship individually while unblocking the wider team.

 - Drive Execution: Lead the development of complex initiatives by chunking and sequencing work to maximize parallelization. You will be responsible for maintaining high throughput and ensuring features reach production without unnecessary delays.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Research (Intern)
jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: in the application form, please specify what term you would like to begin your internship (winter/summer/fall)

ABOUT ABUNDANT

AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data. NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience.

 

Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers.

 

Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience.

 

What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. What’s missing? The data necessary to move from general knowledge to domain expertise; from chatbots to agents; and from text to multimodal and physical AI. Ask any AI researcher or roboticist: the core bottleneck to progress is the availability of data, hence “abundant data”.

 

Abundant works with a majority of the top AI labs, as well as frontier startups and F500 enterprises.

 

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff, you will work directly with Abundant's founding team to architect the next generation of model reasoning and intelligence. You will lead at the absolute frontier where research and execution collide, co-designing strategies alongside top-tier researchers from AI labs to push SOTA boundaries. This is a role for a extremely strong engineers who are already contributing frontier research.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive Foundational Research & Execution: Architect and execute a core research agenda to discover simple, generalizable ideas that advance model reasoning and intelligence at scale. This includes owning the full research-to-production lifecycle and ensuring rapid deployment of your work in live systems.

 - Model Alignment & Data Strategy: Partner with the world's most advanced AI research teams to design, engineer, and iterate on high-impact datasets and large-scale benchmarking efforts that shape how frontier models behave, specifically focusing on critical alignment, safety, and defining optimal reward signals.

 - Autonomous Problem Selection: Autonomously identify, scope, and manage long-running research projects, choosing the most impactful problems that are critical to scaling data for AGI/ASI.

 - System Infrastructure: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on data pipelines, internal tooling, and high-performance deep learning algorithm implementations.

WHO YOU ARE

 - Exceptional Research Depth & Strategic Vision: Research expertise in a related field (e.g., CS, ML, NLP) ideally with that work published at a major conference (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). You must possess the velocity to master complex fields and a proven track record in the productization of research, encompassing high-stakes evaluation, large-scale benchmarking, and product feature development.
 
 - Proven experience shipping research directly to production and live systems, specifically focusing on advanced post-training, distillation, and high-stakes evaluation methodologies.
 
 - Large-scale agent systems: orchestration frameworks, tool APIs, distributed execution, observability, and logging infrastructure.

 - Strategic & Ethical Leadership: You possess a thoughtful, strategic perspective on the societal and safety impacts of deploying general-purpose AI systems. Experience advising on or shaping governmental policy related to AI safety and governance (e.g., House of Lords or Online Safety Bill initiatives) is required.
 
 

COMPENSATION

Base Salary

$10,000/month

Benefits

Health, dental, vision + flexible PTO

jobs.description:
- Location: Berlin (On-site)

 - Contract Type: Full Time

TL;DR

Hey, I’m Max https://www.linkedin.com/in/max-schulz1/, Chief Growth Officer at Kombo. We're currently growing our sales team and looking for an entrepreneurial Account Executive not just to hit numbers, but to help us build and scale our European sales team. This is a Berlin-based on-site role.

ABOUT KOMBO

Kombo is the unified API for HR, payroll, and recruiting systems. Instead of companies spending months integrating with dozens of different systems, they integrate once with Kombo and instantly connect to 250+ platforms.

Our traction since Y Combinator (end of 2022):

 - 8-figures in revenue with hundreds of customers

 - $30M+ raised from YC, Volition Capital, Acadian Ventures, and top-tier angel investors

 - Scaled to 80+ team members across Berlin & NYC

Your work will significantly impact our revenue growth. With new challenges rapidly arising (we're looking to scale our team and double the revenue next year!), you're assured of growth and progress.

Overall, if you’re looking for an opportunity with asymmetric career growth, a fantastic team spirit, inspiring people (details and fun pictures here!) https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21, and impactful work, Kombo could be a great match.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We can predictably create a more robust sales pipeline that we can close, and therefore, require more sales power to focus on closing those opportunities. That’s why we are seeking an Account Executive to join our team to help ~2x our revenue for 2027.

You will own a big part of our revenue generation to hit our 2027 goals.

You'll report to our CGO and work closely within a pod (an AE paired with a BDR), taking on a leading role in our Sales Team. You'll manage your pod's BDR to support pipeline generation. Historically, ~80% of pipeline created for an AE has come from our BD function, with a win rate of over 40%.

Your success can be measured by your ability to hit your revenue targets (quarterly/yearly).

Most of your time will be spent hunting and closing new business, but you will also be responsible for helping us improve our sales processes, and will have clear ownerships about managing your business development rep. 

If you are passionate about daily customer interactions, enjoy strategically thinking about go-to-market challenges, and value being part of an excellent team that empowers you to grow, we think you'll love this job!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: you'll be running every deal from first touch through close; working pipeline generated by marketing and BDRs, while also hunting and prospecting new business of your own

 - Act as a trusted advisor: guide customers through our market, challenging and educating them at every stage of their buying journey

 - Become an audience expert: develop deep intuition for our audience - developers and product leaders at startups building product integrations

 - Raise the bar: lead by example and mentor new sales team members as the team grows, using your input to continually improve our sales process and company performance

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: partner with marketing, engineering, product, growth, and platform teams to share customer insights and help improve Kombo's offering across the board
 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with a consistent, demonstrated track record of overachieving against ~EUR 800K+ annual quotas

 - Proven full-cycle sales experience at Seed–Series C startups, from hunting and prospecting through to closing

 - Experience selling technical B2B SaaS with ACVs in the EUR 35k–80k+ range

 - Experience selling to technical buyers: CTOs, CPOs, Heads of Product, and similar technical/product-oriented stakeholders

 - Comfortable acting as a solution architect in conversations: able to cover a lot of technical ground during the sales cycle and speak credibly to product/integration details

 - Training in a structured sales methodology (we use MEDDPICC)

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a hunger for rapid growth and pioneering a new market despite existing competition

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate, confidently close deals, and act as a bar-raiser on excellence within the team

WHY KOMBO?

 - Uncapped earning potential — No cap on comp, and you're selling into a market that's doubling again next year. Your upside grows as the business does.

 - Pipeline built for you — You work closely with a dedicated BDR, with ~80% of your pipeline generated for you and a 40%+ win rate. Less time prospecting cold, more time closing.

 - Full ownership of your territory — Your accounts, your number, your plan. You run it.

 - Proven motion, real traction — 8-figure revenue, doubling year over year, $30M+ raised, and a team that consistently overperforms. You're not selling something unproven.

 - Team that delivers — Our AEs averaged 130% of quota attainment over the last 12 months. Overperformance is the norm here, not the exception.

 - A problem every prospect already has — Every company in your CRM needs these integrations. They build them, suffer without them, or buy Kombo — the demand isn't going anywhere.

 - Work alongside the best — Today's top AEs shape the sales process and mentor the next wave of hires, with extremely high standards for craft and performance.

 - A clear path forward — Room to grow into an Enterprise Account Executive, with real support behind your career progression.

PUTTING IT DIFFERENTLY, WHY YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY

 - You prefer remote work or traditional corporate environments

 - You're looking for a pure execution role without building/leadership responsibilities

 - You want a laid-back, low-pressure sales environment

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (NYC, Weekend Shift)

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

WHAT WE VALUE:

WE’RE MAKING TRAVEL EFFORTLESS. JOIN US.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role crosses the boundary between Solution Engineering and Customer Success Engineering.

You'll partner with customers from the earliest discovery conversations through implementation and beyond, becoming their long-term technical counterpart as they build and grow on Duffel.

Working closely with Enterprise Account Executives, you'll lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture, run workshops and guide customers through complex technical decisions. Once a partnership is in place, you'll continue supporting their technical strategy as they launch new products, expand into new markets and scale their integrations.

You'll collaborate daily with Product, Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success and Technical Support, ensuring the solutions we design are practical, scalable and create long-term value for our partners.

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building trusted customer relationships and influencing both product direction and commercial success, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Partner with Enterprise Account Executives throughout the sales process, leading technical discovery and solution design.

 - Understand customer goals, technical environments and product requirements to design scalable solutions using Duffel's APIs.

 - Lead architecture discussions, technical workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concepts.

 - Become a trusted advisor to engineering teams, product leaders and technical decision makers.

 - Remain accountable for the integrity of the technical solution throughout implementation. Partner with an Implementation Manager, who owns the delivery programme, while you own the architecture and important solution decisions.

 - Advise customers on best practices around integrations, scalability, reliability and user experience.

 - Translate partner needs into clear problem statements and evidence for Product and Engineering, distinguishing one-off requests from recurring needs that should influence Duffel’s product strategy.

 - Work alongside Implementation Managers, Partner Managers and Technical Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.

 - Create reusable technical documentation, reference architectures and best practices that help us scale the Partner Engineering function.
 
 

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

 - Has significant experience leading technical work with large or complex enterprise customers in roles such as Solutions Engineer, Partner Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Sales Engineer.

 - Enjoys working directly with customers to understand complex technical challenges and design thoughtful solutions.

 - Has a strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, integrations and modern software architecture.

 - Is capable of investigating complex integration behaviour and significant technical risks when needed, while partnering with Technical Support Engineering, which owns routine questions and incidents.

 - Can confidently communicate with software engineers, product managers and senior technical stakeholders.

 - Balances technical excellence with commercial awareness, understanding how technology helps customers achieve business outcomes.

 - Thrives in collaborative environments, working closely across Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success.

 - Enjoys ambiguity, takes ownership and is excited to help build new ways of working as Duffel continues to grow.
 
 

NICE TO HAVE

We're more interested in your ability to solve customer problems than ticking every box, but experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

 - API-first or developer platform businesses.

 - Enterprise SaaS or B2B infrastructure products.

 - Fintech, payments, commerce or travel technology.

 - Building integrations or technical solutions for enterprise customers.

 - Supporting customers through complex implementation or onboarding projects.

 - Helping establish or scale a Solutions Engineering or Partner Engineering function.
 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT DUFFEL

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

🏡 Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void

jobs.description:

The impact you’ll make:

 - Set clear sales targets and objectives, and continually assess and adjust the strategy as needed to meet or exceed revenue goals

 - Responsible for recruitment and hiring top enterprise sales talent 

 - Delivers timely and accurate sales forecasts to the leadership team 

 - Demonstrated knowledge and interest in the physical security industry

 - Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

 - Ability to travel

The amazing skills you bring to Ambient.ai:

 - 10+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with a focus on hunter roles and new customer acquisition & pipeline growth

 - 4+ years of experience managing enterprise sales teams; hiring and training talent at scale

 - Outstanding track record of success managing enterprise accounts and opportunities to closure, consistent over-attainment of quotas of $1M annual recurring revenue

 - Success in small/fast-growing company environments 

 - Understands record keeping, sales process, and sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, etc)

 - Driven and loves to win

Why join us:

 - We are creating an entirely new category within a 120+ billion-dollar physical security industry and looking for team members who are also passionate about our mission to prevent every security incident possible 

 - We have an impressive customer roster of F500 companies, including Adobe, VMware, and SentinelOne

 - Regular Full-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share ownership in the success of our company

 - We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge, including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles depending on customer demand)

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (London, Weekend)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Serve as the trusted front-line contact for large enterprise customers, guiding them on AI prompting best practices, resolving bugs, and turning feedback into a better product experience, whilst adhering to strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Analyse recurring issues and identify process and documentation improvements to reduce time-to-resolution

 - Build and update internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience managing and delivering against operational SLAs for enterprise accounts

 - Strong hands-on debugging experience with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages, including the ability to read and reason through an unfamiliar codebase.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, databases, and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

 - Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).

WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems

Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
 
 

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

HERE IS WHY WE LOVE THIS JOB OURSELVES, AND HOPE YOU WILL ENJOY IT TOO:

 - We work on a wide range of IT projects including automation, security, networking, and building integrations.

 - We value modern IT tooling and novel approaches to traditional problems.

 - We prefer working autonomously and asynchronously, proactively identifying and addressing issues, and operating with a builder's mindset.

 - We practice thorough code reviews and have an open design process.

 - Our products are loved by their users.

HERE ARE THE PROJECTS YOU MAY BE WORKING ON:

 - Administering our core IT stack (Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, Chrome Enterprise).

 - Creating new workflows and integrations both within our IT stack and with other systems and platforms across Teleport.

 - Hardening our macOS endpoints and securing our SaaS services.

 - Building upon our IT workflow automation tooling written in Go and using Temporal running on Kubernetes.

 - Collaborating with the engineering team on dogfooding Teleport, specifically Teleport Identity (identity governance), Teleport Policy (access policies), and Beams (runtime for agentic workflows).

 - Governing and securing corporate generative AI usage.

 - Providing IT support to internal users as needed.

REQUIREMENTS:

 - Strong knowledge of modern IT platforms such as Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, Google Chrome Enterprise, Zoom, and Slack.

 - Hands-on experience administering and hardening macOS endpoints.

 - Deep understanding of corporate IT identity, automation, and security concepts.

 - Experience (and a preference for) building with IaC/Terraform and CI/CD with GitOps.

 - Scripting experience with shell and object-oriented programming experience.
 
 - Experience with Go is a plus.

 - Experience with Linux systems administration and engineering.

 - Willingness and ability to roll up your sleeves and work on traditional IT tasks when needed, such as managing our internal facing helpdesk.

WHAT TO EXPECT ONCE YOU APPLY:

 - You will join a 30-minute intro call where we will walk you through the compensation, interview process, and requirements.

 - We’ll invite you to a Slack channel and you’ll work on a coding challenge using Terraform and shell scripts (or Go) on GitHub.

Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities

Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

Candidate Privacy Notice: For information about our collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this position, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice of Collection at goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/ http://goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Documents Compliance Analyst, you own the compliance decisions behind whether a healthcare professional is cleared to work: background check disqualifications, credential and risk review, and how new state requirements get implemented. You set the standard the team applies, and you are the named decision-maker when a case is hard. What the law requires is a given. How we meet it is up to you, and you own that call.

This is not a people management role. The work is recurring by design. The same categories of questions arrive every week, alongside state license renewals and reporting that run on a fixed calendar and never finish. Your value is in reaching the same well-reasoned decision every time and documenting your reasoning well enough that others can apply it. You'll work closely with Agents, SMEs, Team Leads, and Legal, none of whom report to you, so your credibility comes from the quality and consistency of your judgment rather than from authority.

You will report to the Head of the Documents Team.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Judgment and decisions

 - Serve as the named escalation point for background check disqualification decisions

 - Make the initial call on agency compliance implementation

 - Handle escalations on worker credential verification, including license violations and reprimands

 - Decide which questions you resolve and document yourself, and which warrant partnering with Legal
 
 

Written analysis

 - Produce risk analyses in a consistent format: the question, your research, your reasoning, your recommended path.

 - Evaluate new state and agency requirements before implementation, quantifying what compliance costs a worker in time, money, and completion rate, and recommending how we implement.

 - Build and maintain the decision record that lets other people reach the same conclusion you would
 
 

Recurring compliance operations

 - Own the credential verification audits

 - Plan and drive the implementation of high-value requirements, such as continuing education

 - State license renewals

 - Ongoing state reporting
 
 

REQUIREMENTS:

 - Bachelor’s degree.

 - At least 5 years of professional experience.

 - Prior experience in a role where you applied regulations to real decisions. Examples:
 
 - regulatory or compliance-focused paralegal
 
 - regulatory compliance specialist
 
 - legal analyst
 
 - background screening adjudicator
 
 - trust and safety or eligibility policy at a marketplace

 - Experience interpreting statutes, regulations, or agency guidance and turning them into operational requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - You can reach a defensible decision when documentation is incomplete or unavailable, and you're explicit about what your reasoning rests on.

 - You can read complex regulatory material and work out how it applies in practice to a marketplace model.

 - You weigh compliance risk against business impact and find the path that meets the requirement without restricting more than it demands.

 - You write decision memos and business cases that leadership can act on.

 - You build credibility with people who don't report to you.

 - You own recurring work with hard deadlines, such as license renewals and state reporting.

 - Willingness to maintain overlapping working hours with Eastern and Pacific time (ET/PT).
 
 

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Compliance, regulatory, or licensing experience in healthcare, staffing, or another regulated industry.

 - Experience at a government or regulatory agency.

 - Experience with independent contractor or marketplace models.

 - Experience with background check adjudication or adverse action processes.

 - Experience with state licensing filings.
 
 

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

 - Minimum 15Mbps wired internet connection

 - Minimum i5 processor or equivalent

 - Minimum 12GB RAM

 - Dedicated, quiet working environment

 - Reliable power source and backup internet connection

Quick Note on Scammers:

jobs.title: Founding Content Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Phonely: 

At some point in the future, every business will answer their phone with voice AI. We are building the platform that makes it possible.

Phonely builds conversational voice AI agents for high volume phone workflows. Our customers use us to qualify leads, book appointments, route calls, and resolve real customer conversations in production. We just raised a Series A from top-tier investors, we are one of the fastest growing companies in San Francisco, and we are still early.

About the Role:

Audiences get built on stories. Distribution matters, but only after someone has something worth saying.

This role is for someone who can find those stories, shape them, and make people care. You will own how Phonely shows up in public.

Our buyers are not a generic tech audience. They run phone lines for a living: car dealerships, home services companies, insurance agencies, lenders. They do not wake up looking for AI content. Your job is to make them stop, watch, and care about what happens on their phones.

Nobody has built this at Phonely before. There is no playbook, so you will write it. This is on-site in San Francisco, five days a week, working directly with the founders.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the public voice: what we sound like, what we talk about, and what people remember us for.

• Publish constantly: start at 5 to 10 pieces a week and ramp. The best company in our category publishes 10 times a week. We want to pass them.

• Build the system behind the output: your taste sets direction, AI tools and repeatable workflows carry the lift. Forty good pieces a month beats eight perfect ones.

• Mine the tape for stories: find the moments that show what is actually changing on real phone lines, then get them out fast.

• Run the whole chain: concept, shoot, direct, edit, publish, reply.

• Put the right people on camera: sometimes you, sometimes an engineer, a rep, a founder, or a customer.

• Figure out the channels: start with LinkedIn, YouTube, and Meta, then go wherever our buyers actually spend time.

• Turn shoot days into paid creative: cut the best moments into assets the growth team can put spend behind.

• Learn from the people closest to the work: the engineers building the models, the reps selling it, the customers running their businesses on it.

• Represent Phonely outside the office: launches, customer sites, industry events, podcasts, anywhere the story should be told.

What You’ll Bring:

• A body of work nobody assigned you. A hundred pieces or more on your own account, no client, no brief.

• AI-native production habits. You already use tools to multiply your output and have opinions about which ones actually help.

• Comfort on camera without a script. One take, phone camera, no autocue.

• A sharp read on your own work. You can explain why one piece landed and another did not.

• Range across the production chain: shooting, producing, editing, and publishing with whatever tools you taught yourself.

Bonus Points:

• You are an athlete, or you have a background worth telling a story about.

• You have made paid creative for a startup.

• You have worked at an early-stage company.

Where you went to school, and whether you have held this title before, are not the point. We will read what you made.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 to 12 months:

• Cadence: a daily rhythm that holds, with a production system that makes the next piece easier than the last.

• Audience: real growth on Phonely’s channels from a standing start.

• Measurement: total impressions, impressions viewed, marketing qualified leads, and conversion from content engagement into qualified sales conversations.

• Voice: a Phonely voice on camera the rest of the team can learn from and repeat.

Why Join Phonely:

We are a team of ex-athletes, founders, and builders with low egos and high standards. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. On-site in San Francisco, meals covered, quarterly offsites to interesting places (Rocky Mountains, Costa Rica, Indonesia), and meaningful equity in a company that is growing fast. You will work directly with the founders and have real ownership over the brand.

The brand you build will be Phonely’s, but the work will be yours, and we will say so publicly.

Interview Process:

1. 15 minute intro call to hear your story and what you have built.

2. Send your best performing piece plus a 60 second video shot on your phone, one take, no script: a true story about a phone call that changed something.

3. Portfolio review. We go through your feed together and talk through two pieces, one that landed and one that did not.

4. Paid test week at your day rate. Two days with us, twenty pieces published by Friday, at least five on subjects you chose. Then show us the system you built to make twenty possible.

5. Final conversation with Will.

Details:

• Location: San Francisco, CA (on-site, 5 days a week)

• Type: Full time

• Compensation: $80K to $150K, offers equity

You would be joining a close-knit team that has reached product market fit, and your work would directly help to multiply our revenue.

You can see some of our work here: https://idler.ai/collections

ABOUT THE ROLE

Special Projects Operators are responsible for the relationships and the operations that connect our network of experts to our data production. As an SPO, you will recruit, onboard, and manage our experts, and you will build the systems and tooling to automate your recruitment and management processes. This role is half project management, half engineering.

If you want to start a company one day, this is a good place to learn how.

In this role, you will:

 - Recruit experts into our network — find the communities they belong to, build relationships within those communities, and bring the best people on board.

 - Design our expert hiring process — work with our research team to build the screening rubric for each new domain, run it, and automate as much of it as you can.

jobs.title: Head of Research & Editorial
jobs.description:
ABOUT FIRSTWORK

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

WHY THIS ROLE

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the research agenda

 - Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

 - Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

 - Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

 - Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulation

 - Produce the CEO's long-form writing and speaking material

 - Build partnerships with academics, institutions and industry bodies

 - Manage a Content Producer who turns the research into video, graphics, podcasts and report design

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Seven or more years in research, journalism, think tanks, policy, or a strategy function producing original published work

 - A portfolio with at least one piece that changed how someone thought about a subject

 - Quantitative comfort. You can interrogate a dataset and recognise when it won't support the claim you want to make

 - Real interest in labour markets, migration, regulation or the economics of work

 - The spine to hold a line on accuracy when there is commercial pressure not to

 - Editorial judgement. You can commission, edit and improve other people's work

 - Use of AI across the research process, on the understanding that it raises the verification bar rather than lowering it

This is a rare opportunity for a serious writer and content creator to help shape the future of work at a high-growth, well-funded company with strong opinions about what the world should look like in the age of AI. If the idea of running a research desk on a dataset nobody else has access to excites you, send us your best work.

jobs.description:
💫 This job description was written by a person

 

ABOUT US

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 130-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our GTM org has a lot of questions. Most of the questions we care about can’t be answered by spinning up a cute dashboard. Is branded search creating new customers or capturing demand that already existed? Did the homepage redesign improve conversion, or did our traffic mix change? If we’ve got some wild ideas for our next bet, where should the money go?

These kinds of big-picture questions require someone who can interrogate the metric, trace it through the warehouse, understand the business context, and turn it into action. This person will be our first Full Stack Data Analyst dedicated to GTM. You’ll work alongside GTM leadership to make consequential decisions while still staying hands-on in the nitty gritty of all the data.

The best part: the way we answer these questions is changing. Effective SQL is just a few tokens away, dashboards can be Claude-ed in minutes, and teammates increasingly expect to find their own answers. You’ll build the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that make self-service possible, even trustworthy, then determine where an analyst’s expertise is indispensable.

YOU ARE

 - An experienced analyst. You have roughly 8 years of hands-on, highly technical analytics experience. Most importantly: you’re backed by the pattern recognition that comes with having seen all sorts of hairy problems. You’re at the point in your career where you can take an ambiguous business question, dive head-first into the data, turn your findings into a decision, and bring everyone else along with you.

 - A bridge between the technical and the business. You can build a model in dbt, work directly in Snowflake, and translate it into something actionable. You’ll partner closely with our Lead Analytics Engineer but you need to be willing and able to dive in and self-serve.

 - Fluent in the quirks of GTM data. Attribution, channel definitions, UTMs, bots and broken tracking are known quantities. You don’t need to have been a dedicated GTM Analyst, but you should certainly know your way around this part of the business.

 - Pushing the boundary of what AI means for analytics. AI is writing your first-draft SQL, analysis, and reporting and you’ve shifted that energy to bringing analysis into the future: building the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that let the team self-serve trustworthy answers.

jobs.description:
TL;DR

Hey, I'm Konsti https://www.linkedin.com/in/konstantin-bol/, CS Lead at Kombo. We're the unified API for HR and recruiting integrations. Kombo is growing fast, so I'm hiring our first Scaled Customer Success Manager. You'll own adoption and growth for our scaled segment, reaching the right teams at the right time through automations, signals, and campaigns. You're the first, so you'll define how the function works. This is a Berlin-based, on-site role.

WHY KOMBO

Kombo is on a mission to power the world's people data, from hire to retire. We're the unified API for HR, payroll, and recruiting systems: our customers connect once and get access to 250+ integrations, instead of spending months building them one by one.

Indeed, Pleo, and Juicebox run their integrations on Kombo, alongside 400+ other teams, syncing data for 250+ million people worldwide.

We're past $XXM ARR, backed by $30M+ from YC, Volition Capital, and Acadian Ventures. 60+ people across Berlin and NYC. Take a peek at the team and how we work https://app.notion.com/p/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the system that helps customers launch and expand their integrations faster, while identifying the teams with the strongest potential to grow into larger plans.

Kombo is on track to double revenue in 2026, and a lot of that growth will come from the scaled segment: several hundred teams, each adding integrations as they grow. Today our CSMs run mixed portfolios, but these customers need a different kind of support than larger accounts. Your role is to build the dedicated motion for this segment: helping customers make progress through timely outreach, useful self-serve resources, and direct support when it matters most.

This role combines two big streams:

 - Designing the scalable motion: build automations, workflows, in-product enablement, and commercial work at scale.

 - Selective 1:1 engagement: use customer signals to decide when a direct touchpoint is needed, then jump in to unblock onboarding, drive adoption, support renewals, or turn expansion potential into a real opportunity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own net revenue retention and the customer experience across $2M book of business managing over 100 scaled customers.

 - Build the motion that guides customers through the whole post-sale lifecycle. Design and run onboarding, adoption campaigns, expansion triggers, risk signals, and the renewal flow.

 - Build the automation engine behind it: one-to-many campaigns that land the right touchpoint at the right time, drive adoption, recover stuck customers, and upsell.

 - Own the self-serve customer experience. Tell product what makes setup and scaling hard, so it gets fixed. Build educational materials that help customers get going on their own.

 - Your first projects: build the onboarding flow that powers ~20-30 onboardings next quarter, plus the system that tracks customer health at scale.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Expertise in Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or Solutions, with experience of working on a portfolio of 100+ accounts.

 - Owned a revenue target for a scaled segment. You know how to spot growth signals in usage and customer behavior data and turn them into expansion opportunities.

 - Automation is your first instinct. You've covered hundreds of accounts with emails, in-app nudges, and workflows that don't read like a robot wrote them.

 - You are ready to work with engineers and technical customers. You’re comfortable with APIs, can solve high-level technical problems independently, and curious to learn how the product works in depth.

 - You've automated work with AI, whether that was n8n, Zapier, Notion, or just an LLM. Bring one build and walk us through it, from the idea to what it actually changed.

 - You can answer your own data questions. You are able to read and tweak a SQL query and set up your own dashboard.

THIS ROLE IS LIKELY NOT A FIT IF

 - You want a remote role or cannot commit to being in the office.

 - You prefer a purely relationship-managed book.

 - You need structured processes and aren't comfortable building from scratch.

 - You are uncomfortable with commercial conversations: renewals, expansions, negotiation.

 - You do not enjoy technical projects: reading docs, debugging, figuring out how integrations work.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Platform Team)
jobs.description:
Hey, I'm Niklas https://www.linkedin.com/in/niklashigi/, co-founder and lead of our Platform Engineering team at Kombo! I’m looking for an excellent backend engineer with high agency who gets excited about the hardest technical parts of scaling a product: performance bottlenecks, risky migrations, reliability, infrastructure, and the tooling that helps engineers operate all of it safely.

This is a Berlin-based on-site role.

WHAT WE ARE BUILDING

We are building the infrastructure platform that HR tech products are built on, from emerging category leaders like Juicebox https://juicebox.ai/ to established players like Indeed.com http://Indeed.com. Because my three co-founders and I are engineers ourselves, we were always drawn to the deeply technical problems. That's how we ended up building infrastructure for HR tech providers.

Concretely, we’ve built a unified API, a massive data synchronization engine, an observability platform, and an embedded integration setup/configuration UI. We offer this to other software companies so that they can provide prebuilt integrations with HR, ATS, LMS, and Payroll systems to their customers, instead of building and maintaining hundreds of integrations themselves. You can read more about our product here: What is the Kombo product? https://app.notion.com/p/What-is-the-Kombo-product-2fb6526d848a806793d1ccde34243879?pvs=21

We reached product-market fit about 1.5 years ago. Since then, both our revenue and product usage picked up with insane growth. Currently, we are at >10M annual recurring revenue, power integrations for more than 15,000 companies, and sync data of more than 250 million people globally. We are setting the standard for how companies build product on top of the most complicated enterprise systems. We’ve raised $30M of total funding to date and our growth rate puts us in the top 5% of VC funded startups worldwide.

PLATFORM ENGINEERING AT KOMBO

Most Engineering teams at Kombo are organized around the different product verticals we serve. The Platform team exists as a “horizontal” team that serves the needs of our Engineering org across the board. We work on shared technical problems whose impact cuts across our Product Engineering teams: scaling our infrastructure, finding and fixing bottlenecks in our application and databases, improving our CI and development workflows, and evolving how we handle on-call and incident response.

This is not a traditional infrastructure or SRE role.

We are looking for an excellent backend engineer who wants to work on the parts of our system where application code meets infrastructure: scalability bottlenecks, database performance, reliability, high-risk migrations, developer tooling, and production incidents.

You will work across both backend code and infrastructure. Deep prior expertise in every part of our stack is not required, but strong software engineering fundamentals and genuine excitement about infrastructure-heavy problems are.

Just some examples of projects you would’ve worked on in the past:

 - migrating all our API services from Cloud Run to Kubernetes, including autoscaling, graceful shutdown, traffic routing, and production health dashboards

 - investigating and fixing memory leaks in our Node.js application using heap snapshots, allocation profiles, and garbage collection metrics

 - investigating Postgres performance bottlenecks using query plans and production traces, then improving queries and designing appropriate indexes

 - designing and rolling out a new scalable and more cost-efficient storage layer for our customer-facing logs product using Google Cloud Storage and Parquet

 - building a flexible static egress IP infrastructure so integration partners and enterprise customers can allowlist Kombo traffic

 - moving alerting and on-call from OpsGenie to incident.io http://incident.io, including team routing, priorities, severity tagging, and Terraform-managed alert policies

 - collaborating with our ATS Product Engineering team to design a new syncing approach that fixes timeout and rate limiting troubles when synchronizing data for large ATS tenants

 - improving local developer tooling with Cursor/Claude/Codex workflows, VS Code tasks, Git hooks, gcloud auth helpers, and CI automation

While we’re currently the ones holding “god mode” access to our infrastructure and handling on-call for P1/P2 alerts, part of our work for the coming 1-2 years will be empowering the individual Product Engineering teams to own and operate more of their own infrastructure - making sure we can scale our Engineering org without us becoming the bottleneck.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

First and foremost, we are looking for an excellent backend engineer. You do not need to arrive as an expert in every part of our infrastructure, but you should have strong software engineering fundamentals and be genuinely excited to work closer to infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.

WHAT MATTERS MOST

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services, APIs, and database-backed systems

 - A methodical approach to debugging complex problems and finding their actual root cause

 - The diligence to make high-risk changes safely, including thinking through failure modes, observability, rollout, and rollback

 - The ability to own ambiguous technical problems and communicate clearly without needing close management

 - Curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of a system quickly

STRONG SIGNALS

 - Deep experience with TypeScript and Node.js

 - Postgres performance work, including query analysis, indexing, or data-model design

 - Profiling, benchmarking, tracing, or debugging production systems

 - Ownership of large-scale or high-risk migrations

 - Experience with distributed systems, internal tooling, or shared backend infrastructure

HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED

 - Kubernetes, GCP, and Terraform

 - CI/CD systems and local development environments

jobs.title: Enterprise Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BOLNA

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India - and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don’t have to.

We’re a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast.

THIS ROLE

As an Enterprise Lead, you will own the success of Bolna’s largest and most strategic enterprise deployments.

You will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), ensuring enterprise customers move from business problem → deployment → measurable outcomes. You’ll work closely with CXOs and senior stakeholders on the customer side while partnering with Bolna’s Product, Engineering, and Business teams internally.

This is a high-ownership role. You will be expected to bring structure to complex enterprise problems, drive execution through your team, and ensure that deployments are not just launched - but successful.

You’ll operate at the intersection of enterprise delivery, customer success, technology, and business.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead and manage a team of FDEs, setting clear priorities, driving execution, and maintaining a high bar for customer delivery.

 - Own the end-to-end success of strategic enterprise deployments - from scoping and solution design to launch, adoption, and expansion.

 - Work directly with enterprise stakeholders and CXOs to understand business objectives, define success metrics, and communicate progress.

 - Translate complex business requirements into clear execution plans across FDE, Product, and Engineering teams.

 - Review deployment strategies, solution architecture, agent performance, and customer outcomes to ensure quality and scalability.

 - Identify risks and bottlenecks early and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution.

 - Build repeatable enterprise deployment playbooks, processes, and best practices.

 - Analyze customer and deployment data to identify patterns, improve outcomes, and make informed decisions.

 - Present deployment plans, business cases, performance reviews, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

 - Partner with Sales and Business teams on enterprise opportunities, solutioning, pilots, and expansion conversations.

 - Act as the senior escalation point for critical enterprise accounts.

 - Develop the FDE team through regular feedback, coaching, and high-quality problem-solving standards.

 - Bring customer insights back to Product and Engineering to influence product priorities and platform improvements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in management consulting, B2B enterprise deployments, enterprise SaaS, or a fast-growing startup.

 - Strong preference for candidates with prior corporate/enterprise experience and exposure to complex stakeholder environments.

 - Experience leading teams and driving execution through others.

 - Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, executable plans.

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills - comfortable presenting to CXOs and senior enterprise stakeholders.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving ability; you can work with data to understand what is happening and why.

 - Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

 - Ability to operate across business, technology, and customer-facing teams without needing a predefined playbook.

 - High ownership and bias towards execution - you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

GOOD TO HAVE

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, or technology deployments.

 - Experience managing or mentoring FDEs, consultants, solution engineers, implementation teams, or customer success teams.

 - Experience working with large enterprise customers and complex deployment environments.

 - Exposure to enterprise sales, solution consulting, or pre-sales.

 - Experience building processes or playbooks from scratch.

 - Consulting experience from a top-tier consulting firm is a plus.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, success means:

 - Enterprise deployments launch on time and with high quality.

 - Customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their Bolna deployments.

 - FDEs operate with increasing ownership, speed, and technical/business depth.

 - Enterprise escalations are resolved quickly and systematically.

 - Deployment processes become increasingly repeatable and scalable.

 - Customer insights translate into meaningful improvements across Product and Engineering.

 - Strategic enterprise accounts expand because of the outcomes delivered.

WHY BOLNA

 - Work directly with some of India’s largest enterprises and solve high-impact business problems.

 - Lead a team operating at the intersection of AI, technology, and enterprise business.

 - High ownership and visibility - your work directly impacts customer outcomes and company growth.

 - Work closely with founders and senior leadership on strategic enterprise initiatives.

 - Build the playbook for deploying Voice AI at enterprise scale.

 - Competitive compensation + meaningful ESOPs.

 - Delhi office with a highly collaborative, in-person working environment.
