jobs.title: MLRO, Ireland (PCF-52)
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi is the financial engine for people the world was not built to serve - we move money, store it, grow it, and lend it across 21 countries and counting. Our Irish entity is a regulated payment institution under the Central Bank of Ireland, and as we grow across Europe this licence becomes more critical by the day. We need a designated MLRO (PCF52) who can own the Irish compliance function with confidence, be the face of LemFi with the CBI and FIU Ireland, and keep our AML/CFT programme sharp enough to withstand serious regulatory scrutiny.

This is not a policy-maintenance role. You will sit on the compliance leadership team, contribute to the group framework, and be the expert voice the business leans on when Irish and EU regulatory requirements shift. You will manage relationships with banking and payments partners, submit STRs and regulatory filings, and hold the line on standards - while staying genuinely collaborative with a team that moves fast.

What you'll build and own

 - Own the Irish AML/CFT programme end to end - policy, procedures, controls, training, and MI - ensuring full alignment with the Criminal Justice Acts 2010 to 2021, CBI guidelines, and EU AML directives as transposed into Irish law.

 - Act as designated MLRO (PCF52): receive, assess, and report suspicious transactions to FIU Ireland and ROS, and oversee the investigation, escalation, and documentation of all STRs.

 - Be the primary point of contact with the Central Bank of Ireland, FIU Ireland, banking partners, and other competent authorities - managing inspections, correspondence, notifications, and licensing obligations.

 - Lead and manage internal and external AML/CFT audits, own the remediation tracker, and make sure findings are closed properly and on time.

 - Prepare board-level MI and compliance reports that give Directors and Senior Management a clear, honest picture of the Irish risk environment - not sanitised summaries.

 - Collaborate with global compliance counterparts to embed Irish regulatory requirements into the group framework, and support wider LemFi Group compliance initiatives as they arise.

 - Use AI tools to accelerate drafting of regulatory correspondence, policy documents, and compliance reports - applying rigorous self-validation before anything goes out the door.

Your experience

 - At least 5 years in a senior compliance or MLRO role within an Irish or EU-regulated financial services or payments institution, with direct PCF or CF designation experience strongly preferred.

 - Comprehensive, working knowledge of the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Acts 2010 to 2021, CBI AML/CFT requirements, and the EU AML Directives as transposed into Irish law.

 - Proven track record of direct regulatory engagement with the Central Bank of Ireland or equivalent competent authority - inspections, supervisory queries, licensing applications.

 - Experience managing or mentoring compliance staff and driving operational improvements in a live, regulated environment.

 - Strong analytical skills with comfort handling data: able to review MI, identify patterns in transaction monitoring outputs, and present findings clearly to a Board.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills - you can translate dense regulatory text into clear business guidance and write board-ready reports without a communications team.

 - Demonstrable ability to operate in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the regulatory rulebook and the business are both evolving simultaneously.

Nice to have

 - CAMS certification or equivalent professional AML qualification.

 - Experience working within a group compliance structure across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Familiarity with regtech or transaction monitoring platforms used in payments or remittance businesses.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
CAN YOU HELP US FIX THE WORLD'S MOST BROKEN SUPPLY CHAIN?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. In July 2026 we closed our Series B, led by Burda Principal Investments with participation from eBay and FJ Labs, alongside existing backers a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, plus angels who helped build Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

Today, we connect suppliers across India, Pakistan and Dubai with roughly 50,000 retailers and resellers in 100+ countries. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to grow Fleek's vendor and seller base in India. You'll sit in our Supply team, reporting to our Supply Lead and own a portfolio of India's most important vendor accounts end to end: finding them, signing them, onboarding them and scaling them.

India is one of Fleek's most important supply markets and this role is the engine of its growth. You'll build a portfolio of key accounts, put milllions of dollars of healthy inventory on the platform every month and drive India toward its goals in monthly marketplace GMV.

This is a hunting role as much as a farming one. The best vendors in India aren't waiting in an inbox: they're in godowns, wholesale markets and aggregator networks and you'll go find them.

WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT

Most account management jobs hand you a book of existing clients and a renewal target. This one hands you a market. India's used-clothing trade is enormous and almost entirely offline, and every vendor you bring onto Fleek is inventory that 50,000 buyers in 100+ countries can suddenly see and order.

You'll own real commercial outcomes early: negotiating pricing, commission and payout terms, deciding which accounts to scale and writing the playbooks that the whole India supply org will run on as it grows. Your numbers will be visible to the whole company.

And you'll do it AI-native. FleekSort and our internal tools automate the grunt work of cataloguing and account management, so your time goes into relationships and growth, not spreadsheets.

WHAT MAKES YOU A FLEEK KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER?

 - Hunter: You proactively source and close new accounts rather than waiting for inbound and you get a kick out of the chase.

 - Relationship Builder: You're equally credible with a small boutique seller and a large aggregator and you build trust that lasts beyond the first deal.

 - Commercial Negotiator: Pricing, commission and payout terms don't scare you. You find the structure that works for the vendor and for Fleek.

 - AI-Native: You reach for AI tools to automate and scale your workflows by default and you're excited to work somewhere that runs that way.

 - Bias for Action: You're comfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous startup environment and would rather ship an imperfect first version than wait for a perfect plan.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Hunt and close key accounts: Build a portfolio of vendor accounts, each averaging $35K+ in monthly GMV, by proactively sourcing aggregators, godowns and quality sellers across India.

 - Own onboarding and activation: Take new vendors from first conversation to live, healthy catalog on the platform, fast.

 - Grow catalog depth and quality: Drive healthy inventory onto the platform every month, growing over 20% month on month, with listing quality and freshness to match.

 - Drive GMV: Grow India's contribution in healthy monthly marketplace GMV, growing 30% month on month.

 - Improve retention and performance: Manage account health hand in hand with vendors, bringing cancellation rates down.

 - Deepen share of wallet: Strengthen relationships across your portfolio so Fleek captures a growing share of each vendor's inventory.

 - Build the playbooks: Turn what works into repeatable onboarding and scaling playbooks for the India vendor base.

 - Automate your workflows: Use AI tools to scale account management, reporting and vendor communication, so you can run a bigger book than a traditional KAM ever could.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3 to 5 years in key account management, vendor or seller management, or B2B growth. Ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce or D2C business.

 - A proven track record of growing a supply-side or seller base. You've onboarded, activated and scaled sellers and can talk through the numbers.

 - Commercial negotiation experience. You've negotiated pricing, commission or payout terms directly with vendors or sellers.

 - A working understanding of catalog and inventory operations. Listing quality, SKU management and product categorisation aren't foreign concepts.

 - An AI-first mindset. You already use AI tools to work faster and want to get better at it.

 - Structured communication. You can report account health clearly and escalate issues to Ops, Supply and Product

jobs.title: Strategic GTM, Principal
jobs.description:
STRATEGIC GTM, PRINCIPAL

New York City · On-site

THE VOICE AI WORKFORCE FOR HEALTHCARE

Healthcare runs on phone calls and loses $450B a year to the administration around them. Patients wait on hold, staff spend hours calling insurers, and revenue leaks at every handoff.

At Prosper, we're building the AI workforce that runs healthcare operations end to end. Our voice AI agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments directly in the EHR, verify insurance benefits, automate billing, and get payors on the phone when humans would otherwise wait on hold. We've grown revenue 5x in the last year, partnered with 100+ healthcare organizations covering more than 150,000 providers, and raised $35M, including a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Strategic Account Principal to own a segment of the largest provider organizations in the country: national MSOs, PE-backed platform groups, and multi-region specialty organizations.

Think of it as running a business rather than working a patch. You'll own the segment the way a GM would. You decide how it's defined, which organizations belong in it, what the thesis is for winning each one, and what Prosper has to build, say, and do to get there. Then you go make it happen: a named account list you built yourself, run from first touch to signature, with marketing, product, solutions, and the founders working against the plan you set.

Prosper is at an inflection point. Revenue is up 5x on a lean sales team. It's early enough that the strategy is yours to write, and consequential enough that writing it well changes the trajectory of the company.

If you've spent years building strategy for other people's businesses, this is the version where you own the thesis, run the execution, and see the number move. This is the best opportunity for someone who wants a path to be a founder or learn the entrepreneurial joruney

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a segment of the market

 - Build the strategy from a blank page: market map, account segmentation, prioritization logic, and a defensible point of view on where Prosper wins and why

 - Construct the named account list, a finite and deliberately chosen set of organizations, along with the entry hypothesis for each one

 - Set the commercial architecture for the segment: pricing posture, pilot design, and land-and-expand paths from a single site or specialty to the full organization

 - Bring the rest of GTM with you. Marketing, outbound, solutions, and product should be executing against your plan, not adjacent to it. You'll define the campaigns, content, and product priorities the segment needs and drive them cross-functionally

Run the outcome of the deals

 - Own long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals end to end: account planning, prospecting, discovery, pilot, negotiation, and close

 - Build durable relationships with the people who decide. The best strategic sellers are trusted before they're needed. You'll invest in multi-year relationships with CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and VPs of Revenue Cycle, arriving with a point of view on their business rather than a pitch

 - Multi-thread across revenue cycle, finance, IT, security, compliance, clinical operations, and procurement, and hold every thread yourself

 - Author the ROI case. Every strategic deal at Prosper is won on a quantified business case: cost-to-collect, denial rate, days in A/R, FTE hours redeployed, cash recovered. You'll build these models from the customer's own data and defend them in front of a CFO

 - Navigate the enterprise gauntlet of RFPs, security reviews, HIPAA and BAA diligence, legal negotiation, and phased multi-site rollouts without losing momentum

Build the playbook

 - Codify what works into an outreach strategy, business-case templates, and qualification criteria the next five hires on this team will run

 - Feed the top of the market back into roadmap, and turn roadmap into commercial advantage

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - MBB or top-tier strategy consulting experience (McKinsey, Bain, BCG) is strongly preferred, specificially, 6-10 years of experience. You've demonstrated you can take an unstructured market, break it into a defensible framework, and turn that into a prioritized plan to execute, and iterate on

 - Relationship-building as a core competency. You build trust with senior operators over years, and people who've worked with you once seek you out again. You can win a room of C-suite executives and excel at building trust and product knowledge

 - Entrepreneurial eagerness. You're eager to build, comfortable getting in the mud, and just as comfortable stepping back to decide what actually deserves your time. If you want to find the ceiling of what you're capable of, or build a billion dollar company of your own one day, this is where you learn how
 
 

BONUS POINTS

 - Healthcare or PE/provider-services practice experience in consulting

 - Experience selling AI, automation, or voice technology into regulated industries

 - Fluency with EHR and practice management ecosystems (Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) and clearinghouse/RCM stacks

 - An existing network across provider group leadership or PE-backed provider platforms

 - Early-stage or hypergrowth startup background

WHY PROSPER

 - A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

 - A segment you own outright: the strategy, the accounts, and the number

 - Direct access to founders, product, and engineering. Deals get unblocked in hours

 - Competitive base, commission, and meaningful equity

 - Convert pilots into platform commitments, designing land-and-expand paths from a single site or specialty to the full organization

 - Direct the resources around your deals: outbound, marketing, solutions engineering, and founders all work against the plan you set for your accounts

 - Codify what works into the battlecards, business-case templates, and qualification criteria the next five reps will run

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record of outperformance. You've consistently finished in the top tier of your team, and you can point to the numbers: quota attainment, President's Club, the year you closed the deal nobody thought was closable

BONUS POINTS

 - Healthcare provider, payer, or RCM selling experience

 - Experience selling AI, automation, or voice technology into regulated industries

 - Fluency with EHR and practice management ecosystems (Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) and clearinghouse/RCM stacks

 - An existing network across provider group leadership or PE-backed provider platforms

 - Early-stage or hypergrowth startup background, especially as an early rep who helped build the motion

WHY PROSPER

 - A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

 - Greenfield named accounts with no legacy pipeline and no internal competition for logos

 - Direct access to founders, product, and engineering. Deals get unblocked in hours, not quarters

 - Backed by the best investors in the world. Andreessen Horowitz manages $90B and sits behind OpenAI, Databricks, and Coinbase

ABOUT INSCRIBE

At Inscribe, we're on a mission to catch fraud with confidence. In 2017, we set out to build the first document fraud detection product. Today, we process millions of applications each year and work with many of the leading fintechs and banks across the U.S. We believe the game of cat-and-mouse in fraud requires a fundamentally new approach. With care for our customers, attention to detail, and grounded execution, we’re reimagining how fraud is detected and prevented.

Inscribe is trusted by leading banks and fintechs, including Coinbase, Plaid, Bluevine, and Ramp. Inscribe is backed by Threshold Ventures, Uncork Capital, Y Combinator, Crosslink Capital, and Foundry, and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Inscribe is seeking our first dedicated Partnerships Lead to build and scale a partner-sourced revenue channel. You will be a core member of our GTM team, working across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, and Legal to source, close, and grow partnerships across our four models: referral, white-label, reseller, and integration. You'll own the partner relationship end to end, from first conversation through signature through ongoing enablement and support. This is a high impact role with the mandate to build partnerships into a repeatable, quota-carrying revenue motion. We have ambitious goals as a company that are dependent on distribution beyond direct sales, and in turn dependent on a strong partnerships function.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Source and qualify new partnership opportunities across referral, white-label, reseller, and integration models, prioritizing core banking platforms, loan origination systems, fraud and KYC orchestrators, and credit bureaus

 - Own the partner sales process end to end: NDA, business case, technical and integration review, commercial terms, and contracting, working closely with Legal on agreement terms and Engineering on integration scope

 - Carry a partner-sourced pipeline and revenue quota, and report on progress the way our AEs report on theirs

 - Manage the ongoing relationship with signed partners: regular syncs, unblocking issues on both sides, and driving renewal and expansion conversations as volume and use cases grow

 - Partner with Marketing to plan co-marketing, partner announcements, and enablement materials such as battlecards and train-the-trainer decks

 - Act as the voice of the partner within internal team discussions, and feed competitive intel, feature gaps, and partner feedback back to Product

ABOUT YOU

 - 4+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or a quota-carrying sales role, ideally at a B2B fintech or SaaS company

 - You have exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills, and you're comfortable closing a deal yourself, not just managing one someone else signed

 - You are obsessed with finding the right partner fit rather than chasing every logo

 - You are relentlessly resourceful in unblocking a stalled deal or a quiet partner

 - A true team player and enjoy working with cross-functional teams

 - You are a natural communicator with an ability to represent Inscribe externally and rally internal stakeholders around a partnership

The on-target earnings (OTE) for this role range from $205K–$255K, with a competitive base salary and commission structure, plus accelerators for top performance. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, and internal equity considerations across the team. This role will also be hybrid - three times per week.

BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Comprehensive healthcare

 - Unlimited vacation policy 

 - 401(k) and pension plans

 - Complete work setup

Inscribe provides equity employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regards to race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, genetics, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by company policy.

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. In July 2026 we closed our Series B, led by Burda Principal Investments with participation from eBay and FJ Labs, alongside existing backers a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, plus angels who helped build Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

Today, we connect suppliers across India, Pakistan and Dubai with roughly 50,000 retailers and resellers in 100+ countries. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

THE ROLE

RevenueCat helps app developers manage subscriptions and make more money from them. Maybe you're an indie developer who doesn’t know what "conversion" even means, you just want your app to make money so you can keep building it. Or maybe you're a growth specialist at a company doing millions a month, and pricing experiments are already your whole job. Either way, you probably didn't get into this to spend your days staring at a dashboard. So we built two AI agents to do that work for you, or make you even sharper at it if you're already a pro.

Enter Rico. Rico watches over your subscription business and can help you make sense of it, and act on what it finds. Say your revenue dropped last week. You don't need to go digging through charts to find out why. Just ask Rico. It pulls the data, explains what happened in plain language, and shows you how you compare to similar apps. Then it can fix things itself, like setting up a new plan or restoring a customer's access, with you approving the change before it goes live. Run a pricing experiment and Rico will read the results for you and tell you which version is winning. There are so many things we want Rico to be able to do!

Then there's our AI Paywall Editor, a specialized agent to build and edit paywalls, the screen that asks someone to subscribe. Most developers are not designers, and a paywall that actually gets people to tap "subscribe" is harder to build than it looks, so the AI Paywall Editor helps you with that. Use it in our online editor, from the command line, or hook your own AI tools into it over MCP.

You can see both agents in action in our most recent product launch recap https://www.revenuecat.com/blog/engineering/launch-party-june-26-the-new-features-you-should-know.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Evals & Post-Training)
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Ambral Labs helps enterprises own the intelligence behind their most important workflows.

Every company has years of historical evidence showing how work gets done: the context people had, the decisions they made, the actions they took, and the outcomes that followed. Today, most of that history is inert. It isn’t structured in a way that companies can use to evaluate models and improve agent behavior.

Ambral turns this history into replayable environments and eval sets grounded in real workflows and observed outcomes. We use those environments to improve model performance through reinforcement learning and other post-training techniques, alongside context engineering, harness design, and agent engineering.

The result is better, more cost-efficient AI for each enterprise’s specific work, powered by open-weight models that the company owns and controls. This allows each company to retain ownership of its core intelligence instead of outsourcing it to a model provider.

We graduated from YC S2025, raised millions in funding, and are already deployed within multi-billion dollar enterprises. Now we're growing the founding team

 

What you’ll do

At the center of Ambral Labs is a replayable environment engine for the enterpirse.

The system reconstructs a company’s world as it existed at a particular moment in the past then exposes that state through the same tools an agent would use in production. This lets us place new policies and agent configurations inside real historical environments, observe how they reason and act, and grade their performance against real outcomes.

You'll work across research, infrastructure, and production systems including:

 - Building an environment factory that converts recorded enterprise data and task definitions into runnable environments

 - Designing graders that turn ambiguous business objectives into verifiable rewards

 - Developing methods for mining useful tasks, trajectories, and evaluation cases from historical workflows

 - Creating eval sets that are representative, reproducible, and resistant to overfitting

 - Finding the right combinations of models, tools, context, and policies to maximize performance while reducing inference cost

 - Training and evaluating agents that operate over long horizons, incomplete information, and large tool spaces

 - Building replay and observability systems that make agent behavior explainable and measurable

 - Scaling from individual environments to thousands of concurrent training and evaluation runs

These problems are wide open. You’ll have significant ownership over both the research direction and the production systems that make it real.

You’ll work directly with the CTO, deploy into real enterprise workflows, and see your research tested against consequential problems and observable outcomes.

 

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 1-7 years of experience building production software or machine-learning systems (we're hiring at multiple levels for this role).

 - Bonus points for working on reinforcement-learning environments, LLM post-training, evaluation infrastructure, agent harnesses, or closely related systems

 - You understand how environment design, reward design, context, tooling, and policy behavior interact

 - You’re comfortable turning fuzzy business objectives into tasks and signals that can be evaluated reliably

 - You can diagnose whether a model’s limitations come from the model itself, its context, its tools, its harness, or its training

 - You can move between research questions and production implementation without treating them as separate jobs

 - You write strong software and can build systems that process large, messy datasets at scale

 - You care about reproducibility, observability, and understanding why a model behaves the way it does

 - You’re looking to do the best work of your life and build something you’ll be proud of for decades

We care much more about what you’ve built and how you think than credentials or conventional career paths.

BENEFITS

 - Significant equity and ownership

 - Equinox membership

 - Free meals, coffee, and snacks

 - Health insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - CRM (USA Only, 100% Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 130-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

 

OUR STACK

Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger https://github.com/closeio/tasktiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API https://developer.close.com/ that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools. 

We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub https://github.com/closeio and on The Making of Close https://making.close.com/, our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark https://github.com/closeio/socketshark, TaskTiger https://github.com/closeio/tasktiger, LimitLion https://github.com/closeio/limitlion and ciso8601 https://github.com/closeio/ciso8601.

AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

The CRM team owns everything that Close’s customers touch all day, every day: leads, contacts, opportunities, tasks, activities, custom objects, and search. Each time a call is logged, an email is threaded, a meeting is summarized, it lands on the record this team owns, and every agent we ship starts there.

Today, this team is making big moves towards the next iteration of Close's core data model, our largest engineering effort currently underway. We're reopening assumptions made a decade ago and asking what a modern CRM's data model should look like — one that makes Close flexible for our small, scaling business customers. This is a long series of migrations and rearchitecture projects. If you like greenfield and you like hairy, this is both: help design the next version of Close, and untangle the current one.

One thing to know: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close — this team is where you'd start, but over time you'll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects.

YOU ARE

 - A seasoned engineer. Python is our backbone, but perhaps you've worked across Go, Rust, or TypeScript. You pick the right tool for the workload rather than retreating to what you know.

 - Architecturally minded. This is the thing we care about most. You've designed systems others built on, planned a migration that couldn't take the product down, and know how to sequence a rearchitecture into pieces that ship independently.

 - Drawn to data model and retrieval problems. Schemas, relationships, normalization, query design, type systems. The plumbing decides whether a CRM feels fast and we pride ourselves on being fast.

 - Experienced in search — this is a serious bonus. Elasticsearch especially, and anything adjacent: Lucene internals, query planning, relevance, indexing at scale, building or operating a search engine.

 - AI-native in production. You've shipped meaningful LLM-backed or agentic features to real users, and you have a POV on where AI earns its place in a CRM workflow and where a structured system wins.

 - Working with AI in your day-to-day. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund best-in-class developer tools and treat experimentation as part of the work.

 - Battle-tested. You've debugged incidents where latency budgets didn't hold, owned a system everyone else relied on, or carried a pager for something with real customer impact.

 - A builder first. You'd rather get a sloppy v1 in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks on abstractions. You ship.

YOU WILL

 - Rearchitect the core CRM data model. Rework how leads, contacts, opportunities, and custom objects relate to each other so each of our customers can represent their business the way it operates.

 - Make Close usable by agents. The Agents team builds the MCP foundation; we build the tools and endpoints on top of it that expose the CRM's data and actions. The hard part is search: any MCP-compatible harness should be able to traverse, filter, and reason over a customer's CRM without learning our private query language first.

 - Ship AI-native CRM features. This team built agentic enrichment: instead of paying a third-party data provider, an agent goes and researches whatever field you need, in bulk or automatically inside a workflow. There's a lot more of this ahead, including AI-powered data cleaning and richer AI search.

 - Keep the hot paths fast. Finding a lead, updating a deal, scanning a pipeline, running a bulk action. Salespeople do these hundreds of times a week and no amount of clever architecture matters if they're slow.

Tech you'll touch: Python, Flask, FastAPI, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis, TaskTiger, MCP — plus whichever LLM ships nex

 - Energized by internal customers. Your users are a Slack DM away. You'll talk to them directly instead of through a PM, and you'll use most of what you build yourself.

YOU WILL

 - Expand DevDawg and Spice. Cloud development environments for our full stack, paired with automated review and root-cause tooling that can approve real pull requests. Making that safe enough to cover more of our review surface is one of the team's biggest projects.

 - Build the paved roads for our API layer. REST blueprints, GraphQL schema

jobs.title: Head of Research
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Ambral Labs helps enterprises own the intelligence behind their most important workflows.

Every company has years of historical evidence showing how work gets done: the context people had, the decisions they made, the actions they took, and the outcomes that followed. Today, most of that history is inert. It isn’t structured in a way that companies can use to evaluate models and improve agent behavior.

Ambral turns this history into replayable environments and eval sets grounded in real workflows and observed outcomes. We use those environments to improve model performance through reinforcement learning and other post-training techniques, alongside context engineering, harness design, and agent engineering.

The result is better, more cost-efficient AI for each enterprise’s specific work, powered by open-weight models that the company can own and control rather than permanently renting from a model provider.

We're YC S2025 , have raised millions in funding, and are already deployed inside multi-billion dollar enterprises. Now we're growing the founding team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re building a replayable environment engine over real enterprise history.

The system reconstructs a company’s context as it existed at any past time, then exposes that state through the same tools an agent would use in production. This lets us place new policies and agent configurations inside real historical environments, observe how they reason and act, and grade their performance against real outcomes.

As Head of Research, you'll own the research agenda required to make that possible. You'll identify the highest-leverage technical questions, design the experiments needed to answer them, and remain deeply hands-on in building the systems that turn those answers into production.

Some of the problems you'll work on:

 - Building an environment factory that converts recorded enterprise data and task definitions into runnable environments

 - Designing graders that turn ambiguous business objectives into verifiable rewards

 - Developing methods for mining useful tasks, trajectories, and evaluation cases from historical workflows

 - Creating eval sets that are representative, reproducible, and resistant to overfitting

 - Finding the right combinations of models, tools, context, and policies to maximize performance while reducing inference cost

 - Advancing post-training methods for agents that operate over long horizons, incomplete information, and large tool spaces

 - Building replay and observability systems that make agent behavior explainable and measurable

 - Scaling from individual environments to thousands of concurrent training and evaluation runs

These problems are wide open. You’ll have significant ownership over both the research direction and the production systems that make it real.

You’ll work directly with the CTO, deploy into real enterprise workflows, and see your research tested against consequential problems and observable outcomes. 

You'll also help establish the research culture at Ambral Labs: how we run experiments, evaluate progress, choose technical bets, and recruit and develop an exceptional research team. 

WHO YOU ARE

You'll likely thrive here if:

 - You have a PhD in machine learning, computer science, mathematics, or an equivalent track record of significant research experience

 - You have deep experience in reinforcement learning, LLM post-training, evals, agent environments, or closely related areas

 - You've taken ambitious, open-ended research problems from hypothesis through experimentation into working systems 

 - You’re comfortable turning fuzzy business objectives into tasks and signals that can be evaluated reliably

 - You can move between research questions and production implementation without treating them as separate jobs

 - You’re looking to do the best work of your life and build something you’ll be proud of for decades

We’re especially interested in candidates who have worked at a leading foundation model lab, top AI research organization, or high-performing AI startup.

BENEFITS

 - Significant equity and ownership

 - Equinox membership

 - Free meals, coffee, and snacks

 - Health insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code, invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

 - AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

 - AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

 - Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

 - Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

 - Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

 - Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

 - Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

 - Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

 - Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

 - Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

 - Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

 - Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

 - 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

 - Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

 - Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

 - Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

 - Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

 - Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

 - Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.

jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Measure the effectiveness of programs and processes, and adjust based on what the data shows.

 - Coach managers and senior leaders as they grow, and help them confidently guide their teams through change and navigate complex organizational challenges.

 - Lead org design, team structure, and succession planning with your business leaders.

 - Design leadership development and offsites that lift manager capability across the org, with a clear learning arc.

 - Partner closely with the HR team, pairing your proactive work on org health with the structure and judgment they bring to how people are supported, so the People function is stronger for it.

 - Bring modern tools, including AI, to work faster and sharpen how you diagnose org health, and help the managers you support do the same.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 12+ years partnering with senior leaders as a People or HR Business Partner or in organizational development, or 8+ years with an advanced degree in a related field.

 - Deep experience partnering with go-to-market organizations such as Sales, Revenue, Marketing, Finance and Business Operations, and fluency with how commercial teams operate, including pipeline and quota-carrying dynamics.

 - A track record of developing senior-level leaders and above, and coaching managers to improve their effectiveness.

 - Strength in org design, succession, change management, and measuring the effectiveness of the programs you run.

 - The presence to influence senior leaders and offer a candid point of view, without formal authority.

 - Sound judgment on when to act, when to bring in HR, and how to hold confidentiality, working primarily from aggregate team-health data.

HOW WE HIRE:

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

jobs.description:

AfterQuery https://www.afterquery.com/ is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it. 

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

WHY APPLY

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

Strong Team: Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AfterQuery is hiring our first dedicated, in-house legal role: a Corporate Counsel who will own commercial contracting and employment law matters as we scale rapidly in revenue and headcount. This is a generalist, individual-contributor role embedded within our internal Operations team. This is not a General Counsel or Head of Legal position.

You'll be the day-to-day legal voice on deals and people matters, working closely with outside counsel on specialized or high-stakes matters. Contract velocity and precision on data rights, compute terms, and compliance matter directly to revenue and risk; getting employment law right matters just as directly to how we scale our team and manage risk as we grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Commercial Contracts

 - Draft, negotiate, and redline data acquisition and data licensing agreements with enterprise customers

 - Draft and negotiate Master Service Agreements (MSAs), SOWs, and vendor paper for compute/cloud infrastructure providers and frontier lab & other clients

 - Own data processing agreements (DPAs) and related data rights provisions in customer and vendor contracts

 - Maintain and improve contract templates, playbooks, and redline positions to speed up deal cycles

 - Partner with Sales/GTM and Finance on deal structuring, pricing terms, and contract risk tradeoffs

Employment & Labor Law

 - Draft and review independent contractor agreements, employment agreements, offer letters, and compensation/bonus plan language

 - Advise People team on day-to-day employment and labor law questions: including but not limited to compensation agreements, equity administration, hiring, separation and termination, leave, wage and hour, and handbook/policy compliance

 - Advise on worker classification and help manage related compliance risk across engagement types

 - Support HR compliance projects (e.g., international hiring, policy updates, state-specific requirements) as AfterQuery's footprint grows

General Legal & Advisory

 - Triage incoming legal questions across the business and resolve what's appropriately in-house

 - Know when to escalate: export control/sanctions review, corporate financing/cap table matters, and data incident/privacy investigations stay with outside counsel — you'll partner with them on these, not run them solo

 - Help manage the outside counsel relationship and budget as in-house scope grows

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - JD and active California bar admission

 - 3-6 years of experience spanning both commercial contracts and employment law

 - Background at a boutique tech/startup-focused or generalist business law firm, ideally combined with in-house experience at an early-stage tech company

 - Strong judgment on risk vs. reward tradeoffs; provides decisive recommendations on business and strategy matters informed by legal knowledge

 - Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal oversight, including sound judgment on when to escalate to outside counsel

 - Motivated by hands-on individual contribution rather than team-building; you'd rather solve a problem yourself or find the right tool than hire your way out of it

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and People teams

BONUS

 - Prior experience with AI/data companies, data / technology licensing, or technology transactions with hyperscalers/cloud providers

 - Experience as the first or second legal hire at another startup with focus on contract and/or employment law

 - Experience with equity administration tools (Pulley, Carta) or HRIS platforms (Gusto)

COMPANY BENEFITS (FOR ELIGIBLE EMPLOYEES):

 - Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

 - 401(k) with Employer Match

 - Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT VITALIZE

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

ABOUT VITALIZE’S ENGINEERING TEAM

Every recommendation Vitalize makes flows through this team. We build the intelligence that helps hospitals decide who should float, when to call someone in, when staffing is becoming unsafe, and eventually when the system can safely make those decisions on its own.

This is where Vitalize evolves from software that reports what’s happening into software that actively runs hospital operations.

 

THE ROLE

Clinical leaders make hundreds of staffing decisions every day under time pressure using disconnected systems. We’re replacing that with software that reasons through the problem, recommends, and eventually executes the best next actions.

You’ll own the decision engine behind those recommendations, turning messy operational reality into software customers trust with some of the most important decisions inside a hospital.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build the decision logic behind staffing recommendations, alerts, and workflows

 - Own systems that balance staffing rules, hospital policies, patient needs, and operational constraints

 - Partner with our Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to build complex software solutions that are easy for our customers to use

 - Work directly with clinical leaders to understand how staffing decisions are made

 - Build software that explains why it reached a recommendation so users can trust, validate, or override it

 - Define where automation ends and human judgment begins, helping Vitalize safely automate more hospital operations over time

 - Continuously improve the system using customer feedback, production data, and real-world outcomes

 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Technical expertise—You have expertise with TypeScript

 - Problem-solving instinct—You instinctively dive into the why

 - Full-stack experience—You have experience working across the entire tech stack

 - Systems thinking—You can reason through complicated edge cases

 - Customer orientation—You’re comfortable working directly with customers to understand problems and rapidly improve the product

 - Ownership and communication—You communicate clearly and take strong ownership of your work

 

OUR STACK

Bun • TypeScript • Effect • React • TanStack Router • PlanetScale

 

BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Twice-yearly company off-sites

 - Free meals in the office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Litigation Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This isn’t the type of in-house counsel position where you will be siloed into a few narrow workstreams or deal with the same issue day after day. At Clipboard, you’ll be tasked with tackling novel legal challenges, flexing different muscles across various areas of law, and making high-impact decisions in a fast-moving environment. You’ll be tasked with building internal processes and systems, not simply managing a docket of individual cases.

You have both the sharp instincts of a high-stakes litigator and an entrepreneurial spirit. You crave a creative and collaborative—rather than purely adversarial—experience in the law. You are a skilled and concise writer and communicator, and excel at and enjoy detail-oriented tasks, fact-finding, and investigative work. You have a strong degree of curiosity and are particularly adept at identifying subtle clues which may be indicative of a much wider and important universe of issues you need to dive into. You can navigate fairly esoteric internal databases to collect and digest complex sets of data. You are eager to bring your experience with litigation and investigations to an in-house role on a small and supportive team that affords opportunity for professional growth. You look forward to channeling your skills as a litigator into supporting and advocating for a mission-driven and groundbreaking business. You embrace and are not daunted by ambiguity or a challenge, have a perennially positive attitude, and are eager to help build a legal department and support the business in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy taking the lead on projects, and naturally take the initiative to solve problems and improve and streamline systems and processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Manage various litigation workstreams relating to independent contractor classification, including but not limited to matters relating to unemployment insurance claims and disputes with users of the Clipboard marketplace.

 - Manage other litigation workstreams, including but not limited to professional negligence and data privacy matters.

 - Partner with both internal and outside counsel on managing high-stakes litigation matters, including by drafting responsive pleadings, briefs, and other important documents.

 - Work closely with outside counsel on developing and participating in the company’s eDiscovery strategy, including custodial document collection, review, and production.

 - Manage the company’s third-party subpoena response strategy.

 - Provide legal guidance to a wide range of cross function teams, including the Company’s product and operations teams.

 - Support other legal workstreams depending on the needs of the team and company.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 90 DAYS IN:

 - You are deeply familiar with all pending litigation and investigation matters and have taken over leadership of at least one high-stakes matter, including communicating and coordinating with outside counsel and internal stakeholders.

 - You have a deep understanding of the company’s internal databases and can quickly collect and analyze complex sets of data, both for the purposes of developing proactive risk mitigation strategies and responding to high-stakes litigation document requests.

 - You fully own the unemployment response workstream, third-party subpoena response process, and a docket of other litigation matters, including a subset of the company’s medical malpractice matters, and can operate completely independently on these fronts with minimal supervision.

 - In at least one litigation matter, you worked with outside counsel to develop an eDiscovery plan that minimizes the costs related to custodial document collection and review while still meeting our discovery obligations.

 - You proactively and quickly jump in to respond to requests for legal guidance from other business functions, and provide high quality legal advice that incorporates the risk tolerance of the business.

 - You are contributing to legal strategy decisions made by the Head of Legal.

NEED TO HAVE:

 - JD with at least 5 years of experience

 - Bias toward action and solving (not just spotting) problems

 - Ability to take ownership of your work and manage projects independently

 - Excellent communication and writing abilities

 - Comfort and skill in navigating complexity and ambiguity, and working on a leanly staffed team

 - Willingness to quickly dive into new and “unfamiliar” legal issues

 - Ability to work under pressure and autonomously, and meet tight deadlines

 - Agility and flexibility to take on new tasks and responsibilities when necessary to support the business and legal team’s needs in a fast-moving, rapidly scaling, and dynamic tech company

 - Willingness and ability to engage with and interpret data, especially from unfamiliar sources

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience handling arbitrations and class actions

 - Experience with eDiscovery issues, including large-scale custodial data collection, review, and production

 - Clerkship experience

 - Government experience

 - Experience working cross-culturally and with diverse, global teams

INTERVIEW PROCESS: 

 - Application Review 

 - Case

jobs.title: AI Systems Performance Architect
jobs.description:
About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

What You’ll Work On

This role is focused on the modeling and simulation of high-performing AI hardware, and does not require prior knowledge of quantum computers. It will interface with a variety of internal teams and external partners with whom we are planning to collaborate. We will share more detail about this role during in-person discussions.

Key responsibilities:

 - Develop performance models and simulators for large-scale distributed ML systems and emerging AI acceleration platforms.

 - Model end-to-end training and inference performance across compute, memory, networking, and communication.

 - Analyze workload parallelism, collective communication, scheduling, and data movement to identify system-level bottlenecks.

 - Explore system architectures and hardware/software tradeoffs to improve performance, scalability, and efficiency.

 - Build simulation frameworks for rapid design-space exploration across distributed GPU and next-generation accelerator systems.

 - Collaborate with ML researchers, compiler engineers, and system architects to guide next-generation AI system design.
 
 

You May Be a Fit if You Have:

 - PhD in Computer Engineering or Masters in Computer Engineering with 2-5 years relevant work experience

 - A strong research track record, including publications at top-tier venues such as ISCA, MICRO, ASPLOS, MLSys, SOSP, VLDB, OSDI, or other leading systems conferences.

 - Strong foundations in ML systems, distributed computing, and performance modeling.

 - Experience with large-scale ML training or inference systems and distributed execution frameworks.

 - Understanding of model parallelism, data parallelism, collective communication, and distributed scheduling.

 - Experience building simulators, analytical performance models, or system-level benchmarking tools.

 - Familiarity with GPU clusters, high-performance networking, and AI accelerator systems.

 - Ability to reason from first principles, identify bottlenecks, and independently tackle open-ended research problems.

 - Passion for rethinking how next-generation AI systems are designed and scaled.
 
 

How We’re Different

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.

Culture & Benefits

 - Visa Sponsorship - We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation - We value your contribution and invest in your future with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Benefits - Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection - Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off - We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at [email in original advert].

Location: This position can be located on-site in San Francisco, CA or Ann Arbor, MI

jobs.title: Engineering Manager/TLM, Platform
jobs.description:
THE PROBLEM

36 million businesses in America need insurance—it's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflows—by building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this year—and that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

THE THESIS

Harper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisible—it's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

THE ROLE

This role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experience—we're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase—we need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this role—EM or TLM—will need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own infrastructure — cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it

 - Build developer productivity — the AI tooling and harnesses that make every other engineering team genuinely AI-first

 - Own SRE and production support — bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

 - Build out the team — grow from 2 people to five to six over the next three months

 - Stay hands-on — with a team this small, work directly alongside your engineers and do the work yourself, not just direct it

 - Grow each function over time — infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support can each become a larger team of its own

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF...

 - Have at least 2 years as a line manager directly managing teams of six to ten people—or clear readiness to grow into that role

 - You've been a line manager for at least two years, directly managing teams of six to ten people—or you're on a clear path there and want to grow into it

 - You have hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and strong database troubleshooting skills

 - You've seen real scale—on the order of at least a million requests per minute

 - You can troubleshoot across databases, networking, compute, Docker, Kubernetes, and other aspects of infrastructure

 - You care as much about developer productivity and AI tooling as you do about raw infrastructure

 - You know on-call practices, SLAs, SLOs, and SRE practices generally

 - You want to stay hands-on and grow into a fuller managerial role over time

 - You move fast, with the same appetite as the rest of Harper

NICE TO HAVE

 - Your own network to draw on for hiring—otherwise, comfort working closely with recruiters

 - Experience building developer productivity tooling and AI harnesses for other engineering teams

 - Experience building a team from a very small base

 - Prior startup experience—especially at a company scaling through hypergrowth

COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS

 - Salary: $225,000–$275,000

 - Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based in SF or willing to relocate.

 - Schedule: Monday–Friday, in-office five days a week.

 - Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks, drinks, and coffee daily; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision insurance.

THE PROCESS

 1. Hiring Manager screen - 30 min video chat.

 2. Technical screen — 60 min remote: project deep dive + system design

 3. Super Day on-site — meet the team, sit in on the operation, do real work alongside us.
