ABOUT CODES HEALTH

At Codes Health, we are building the modern platform for medical record retrieval. Legacy record retrieval is notoriously slow and unreliable; our system uses AI to deliver decision-ready records much faster and more accurately.

Started just over a year and a half ago, our volume is doubling MoM with a clear path to category leadership. We support practices ranging from Plaintiff Law to Specialty Healthcare. We are a well-funded, rapidly growing team focused on growing 100x from where are today.

Our mission is to automate record retrieval, which will only be achieved through innovative engineering and relentless execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Law firms run on deadlines, and every comment, task, or email from a customer is a small trust test — respond fast and clearly, and we keep that trust; let it sit, and we risk the case and the relationship. As our Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the person making sure nothing from our key accounts slips through the cracks. You'll work inbound tickets, comments, and emails across email, and portal, keeping every interaction inside the SLAs we've set. You will also be This is an execution-focused role: you're both helping build the playbook from scratch, and pressure-testing every day to flag where it needs to flex and evolve.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Manage the daily queue of comments, tasks, and emails from key accounts across email, portal, and phone — first response within 2 business hours, resolution within 24–48 hours for standard tickets

 - Triage and resolve the majority of inbound tickets without escalation: record status questions, document delivery, billing questions, general how-to inquiries

 - Recognize and escalate technical issues (portal bugs, access issues, submission errors, document retrieval errors) to the right owner, and keep the customer updated while it's being worked

 - Hit SLA targets consistently and flag early when a ticket, account, or theme is at risk of missing one

 - Keep tickets and account notes clean and well-documented so account health, complaint themes, and volume patterns are easy to roll up

 - Surface recurring issues or customer feedback themes to the Support Lead to feed into the monthly VoC review

 - 3–5 years of B2B customer support experience, ideally in SaaS, with a track record of owning a complex or high-volume queue

 - Comfortable owning a queue independently at senior scope — you don't need heavy oversight to hit response and resolution targets, and can be trusted with our highest-touch key accounts

 - Clear, warm written communication — you can de-escalate a frustrated customer over email without losing empathy or speed

 - Strong attention to detail; you don't let things slip between email, portal, and phone channels

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and manual process — we're early-stage, so not everything is documented yet, and you're willing to help build it as you go

 - Experience with ticketing systems (Pylon, or similar) a plus

 - Legal services, healthcare, or document workflow background a plus

SUCCESS METRICS

 1. First Response Time: < 2 business hours for all inbound tickets during business hours

 2. Resolution Time: Standard tickets resolved or workaround provided within 24–48 hours

 3. SLA Adherence: Consistent adherence across comments, tasks, and emails for key accounts

jobs.title: Key Accounts Associate
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNTS ASSOCIATE

Location: New York
Employment Type: Full time
Location Type: On-site

ABOUT CODES HEALTH

At Codes Health, we are building the modern platform for medical record retrieval. Legacy record retrieval is notoriously slow and unreliable; our system uses AI to deliver decision-ready records much faster and more accurately.

Started just over a year and a half ago, our volume is doubling MoM, with a clear path to category leadership. We support everything from Personal Injury Law to Specialty Healthcare. We are a well-funded, rapidly growing team focused on growing 100x from where we are today.

Our mission is to automate record retrieval, which will only be achieved through innovative engineering and relentless execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Accounts Associate
New York, NY
Full-time | In-person | 2+ year of relevant experience required

Our customers include some of the largest law firms in the world, who entrust us with one of their most critical and time-sensitive workflows. They expect excellence, service, and timeliness and we deliver on those expectations. The Key Accounts team exists because those relationships require someone who both owns the customer communications and has the operational expertise to deliver consistent value.

As an Associate, you will own the proactive layer underneath a book of our most important accounts. That means knowing the state of every open request before the customer does, auditing what's in flight, building the data that drives every customer conversation, and driving resolution on anything stuck. When a partner at one of the biggest firms in the country asks why a record hasn't arrived, the answer comes from your work.

This is a role with an obvious next step. Associates are expected to grow into Key Accounts Leads with their own book of accounts, and we will point you at accounts early so that happens quickly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own request-level monitoring across a book of key accounts — what's aging, what's stalled, what's at risk, and why

 - Run systematic account audits to find incomplete returns, misrouted responses, and gaps before the customer catches them

 - Build the data layer for every account — per-account cuts, turnaround and volume analysis, and the recurring reporting customers rely on

 - Drive escalations with our key accounts retrieval team on urgent and blocked requests, and stay on them until they move

 - Prepare every customer touchpoint — call briefs, visit materials, and quarterly review decks

 - Turn recurring account-level problems into specific, evidenced asks for product and engineering

 - Join customer calls and visits, and take direct ownership of accounts as you ramp
 
 

WHO YOU ARE

 - 1–3 years in investment banking, consulting, or a comparably demanding analytical role

 - Obsessed with details. The core of this job is catching the thing that everyone else missed

 - Strong with data. Fluent in Excel, and either sharp in SQL and internal tooling or genuinely eager to get there fast

 - High ownership by default. Our accounts are large enough that mistakes are expensive, and nobody will be checking your work line by line

 - A clear communicator. You will be writing updates that go to customers and flagging problems to people senior to you, often on the same day

 - Comfortable with unglamorous work. Some of this is analysis. Some of it is chasing a single record through four systems and three phone calls

 - Comfortable with urgency. Our customers work against deadlines and expect responsiveness

 - Willing to travel occasionally for customer visits
 
 

WHY JOIN CODES HEALTH

You will work on the accounts that matter most to the company, from day one, alongside the person who owns them. Key accounts are where we invest the most and learn the fastest — what gets built by hand on these accounts becomes the standard for how every customer is served. Your work will directly accelerate how quickly law firms settle cases.

The path here is deliberate. This role is designed to produce Key Accounts Leads. You will start on the operational and analytical side, take on customer-facing work as you ramp, and grow into owning a book of accounts yourself as the function expands.

You will also get real exposure to the AI work our team is shipping every day, and to leadership across operations, customer experience, and product. This is a small team growing quickly, and the ceiling is set by what you can carry.

COMPENSATION DETAILS

 - Competitive salary

 - Healthcare, vision and dental insurance

 - Early-stage equity opportunity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Additional benefits such as paid dinner in office and Ubers from the office

jobs.title: Conversation Quality Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT BOLNA

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India - and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don’t have to.

We’re a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast. Our team of ~25 is based in Bengaluru.

THE ROLE

Every voice AI agent Bolna deploys makes real-time judgment calls - when to speak, when to go silent, when a customer is done talking, when to hand off. We’re building automated systems to grade these calls at scale, using LLMs as judges of call quality. But before you trust a model’s judgment, you verify it against a human’s.

That’s this role. You’ll listen to real calls, annotate what actually happened, and check whether our automated systems - LLM-as-judge evals and quantitative signal detection - got it right. It’s precise, high-attention work, and it sits right at the center of how we know our voice agents are actually working.

This is an internship role for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to how a voice AI company builds trust in its own AI.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Annotation

 - Listen to and annotate real customer calls - transcription review, issue tagging, labeling - using tools like Label Studio

 - Follow (and help sharpen) annotation guidelines for a multilingual environment (Hindi, English, Hinglish, )

Verifying LLM-as-Judge Evaluations

 - For calls flagged by our automated eval pipeline, verify whether the model’s call was actually correct - for example, confirming whether a detected barge-in (agent/customer talking over each other) genuinely happened by listening to the audio

 - Mark agreements and disagreements clearly, with reasoning, so we can measure and improve model accuracy over time

 - All tools needed for this will be provided

Verifying Quantitative Measures

 - Check system-flagged quantitative signals against the actual call - e.g., confirming whether an “agent interruption” the system detected really occurred at that timestamp

 - Flag false positives/negatives so we can tighten detection logic

 - Help identify edge cases that current rubrics or detection logic don’t handle well

Inspecting Calls & Surfacing New Issues

 - Regularly inspect calls beyond flagged ones to spot new or emerging issues our rubrics and detection systems don't yet cover

 - Bring these patterns back to the team so rubrics, prompts, and detection logic keep improving

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have

 - Strong attention to detail and the patience to do focused, high-precision work across many calls

 - Multilingual comfort preferred - Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, or Bengali, in addition to English/Hindi

 - Comfortable learning new tools quickly - Label Studio, dashboards, internal QA apps

 - Genuine curiosity about AI and voice AI - you want to understand why a call was flagged, not just complete a checklist

Good to have

 - Any prior exposure to data annotation, labeling, or QA work

 - Familiarity with spreadsheets/basic SQL or comfort reading dashboards (e.g., Metabase)

 - Background in linguistics, call center operations, or content moderation

HOW THIS ROLE GROWS

This is designed as an entry point, not an endpoint. Based on where you show strength, we’ll shape what comes next:

 - Strong rigor and consistency in annotation → QA Lead / Annotation Lead

 - Curiosity about agent logic and how voice AI actually works → Forward Deployed Engineer track

 - Strong pattern recognition and rubric thinking → Data/Eval Engineer, Voice AI Analyst

We’ve seen people join in QA and grow into much broader voice AI builder roles - this is meant to be a real foot in the door, not a dead-end task.

WHY BOLNA

 - Direct exposure to how a fast-growing AI infra company builds trust in its own models

 - Real ownership over a function (call quality) that directly affects what customers see

 - Fastest way to learn the guts of voice AI - ASR, agent logic, eval pipelines - from the ground up

 - Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration

The mission

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a strategic, proactive EA / workplace manager to amplify our founders impact and make Lucis run seamlessly. You will watch their back.

You’ll be the operational backbone of our Paris HQ, orchestrating founder logistics, shaping the company rhythm, and enabling the team to scale fast and smoothly.

You'll scale faster than the founders, and will grow faster than the company.

 

What you'll own

 - Founder velocity: Owning the complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics to ensure the founders are always in the right place at the right time with the right information.

 - Assisting the founders in their day-to-day important events: board meetings, client meetings, and co. You'll help founders be on top of their game.

 - Inbox & communication: Triaging high-volume inboxes and ensuring 100% accountability on follow-ups with partners, investors, and the ecosystem.

 - The Paris hub: Managing our physical HQ end-to-end: from vendor relationships to hosting VIPs.

 - Operational rigour: Handling invoice payments, accounting workflows, and HR admin (employee requests and office onboarding).

 - Culture infrastructure: Designing and executing the logistics for team events and marketing pop-ups as we expand across Europe.

 - Founder proxy: Acting as the first point of contact for the team and external stakeholders, protecting the founders' deep work time while ensuring the team has what it needs.

 

ABOUT YOU

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You're curious about AI and how it can be used to move faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if you

 - 1 to 3+ years in a challenging / fast-growing environment (Series A/B preferred) or a rigorous professional services environment (law, finance, or consulting). 

 - Fluent in English and in French.

 - Take radical ownership and default to action: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and ensure that once a task is started, the loop is closed every single time.

 - You’re used to fast change and context-switching: You can jump from complex multi-time-zone calendar management to fixing an office infrastructure issue without losing momentum. 

 - You're very comfortable using AI, and learn super fast. 

 - You're willing to take anything that has to be done. Anytime, anywhere. No matter how fun that is. 

 - You can act as a high-level gatekeeper and founder proxy: You are comfortable hosting investors, partners and protecting the founders' time for 10x deep work.

 - You bring extreme rigor to operational admin: Experienced in handling invoice payments, expense tracking, and basic HR/onboarding workflows. 

 - You’re strong at stakeholder management and culture-building: You take pride in building a world-class environment in the Paris HQ for both local and visiting remote employees.

 

We might not be a fit if

 - You need a clearly defined role with stable responsibilities.

 - You prefer strategic advisory work over hands-on execution.

 - You've only worked in large, well-established companies.

 - You need perfect information before making decisions.

 - You prioritise predictable 9-5 work over mission intensity.

 - You're uncomfortable with frequent context-switching and urgent pivots.

 

HOW WE WORK

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side.

 

 - Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

 - Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

 - Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

 

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (New Grad)
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Ambral helps enterprises own the intelligence behind their most important workflows.

Every company has years of historical evidence showing how work gets done: the context people had, the decisions they made, the actions they took, and the outcomes that followed. Today, most of that history is inert. It isn’t structured in a way that companies can use to evaluate models and improve agent behavior.

Ambral turns this history into replayable environments and eval sets grounded in real workflows and observed outcomes. We use those environments to improve model performance through reinforcement learning and other post-training techniques, alongside context engineering, harness design, and agent engineering.

The result is better, more cost-efficient AI for each enterprise’s specific work, powered by open-weight models that the company owns and controls. This allows each company to retain ownership of its core workflow intelligence instead of outsourcing it to a model provider.

We graduated from YC S2025, raised millions in funding, and are already deployed within multi-billion dollar enterprises. Now we're growing the founding team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re building a replayable environment engine over real enterprise history.

The system reconstructs a company’s context as it existed at any past time, then exposes that state through the same tools an agent would use in production. This lets us place new policies and agent configurations inside real historical environments, observe how they reason and act, and grade their performance against real outcomes.

You’ll help build the infrastructure and work hands-on with customers to turn their real enterprise data into a scalable, continuous model-improvement system. The core problems include:

 - Forward deploying with our customers to understand their tasks and data

 - Developing the environment factory that converts recorded enterprise data and task definitions into runnable environments

 - Designing graders to turn ambiguous business objectives into verifiable rewards

 - Developing methods for mining useful tasks, trajectories, and evaluation cases from historical workflows

 - Experimenting with learning objectives and task design

 - Creating eval sets that are representative, reproducible, and resistant to overfitting

 - Finding the right combinations of models, tools, context, and policies to maximize performance while reducing inference cost

 - Building replay and observability systems that make agent behavior explainable and measurable

These problems are wide open. You’ll have significant ownership over the production systems that make it real.

You’ll work directly with the CTO, deploy into real enterprise workflows, and see your implementations tested against consequential problems and observable outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have experience building production-grade software (internships are ok) or in a quant role

 - You write strong software and can build systems that process large, messy datasets at scale

 - You have great intuition about systems, abstraction, and data structures

 - You’re comfortable turning fuzzy business objectives into tasks and signals that can be evaluated reliably

 - You can diagnose whether a model’s limitations come from the model itself, its context, its tools, its harness, or its training

 - You can move between research questions and production implementation without treating them as separate jobs

 - You care about reproducibility, observability, and understanding why a model behaves the way it does

 - You’re looking to do the best work of your life and build something you’ll be proud of for decades

We care much more about what you’ve built and how you think than credentials or conventional career paths.

BENEFITS

 - Significant equity and ownership

 - Equinox membership

 - Free meals, coffee, and snacks

 - Health insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Product Manager, Editing Foundations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom https://www.photoroom.com is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

ROLE SUMMARY

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the editor: the surface every Photoroom user touches, on iOS, Android and the web. You'll sit in our Product Foundations team, whose mission is to build the core experiences that power Photoroom. You will work on the last-mile editing problem, giving users control with fine-grained edits for photos and videos. Working closely with engineers, designers, and the PMs who depend on you, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.

Location: Paris, Ile de France (Hybrid)

ABOUT THE ROLE

 - Own the single- and multi-image editing experiences end to end. Build one unified visual editing experience across three platforms, iOS, Android, Web and API.

 - Integrate visual editing experiences within chat editing. Photoroom gives users the ability to start with AI generation and then graduate into fine-grained editing tasks. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to make sure our users can traverse the full editing journey in Photoroom.

 - Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless. On a surface this heavily used, the difference between "works" and "feels right" is the whole job.

 - Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, watch them edit, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

 - Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, including crash rates, latency and cross-platform parity, to form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

ABOUT YOU

 - You've shipped products people love. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you’ve convincingly solved the user problem and delivered business value.

 - You've owned a creative product surface. An editor, a canvas or another tool where you are giving a user creative control.

 - AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

 - You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 - You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

 - You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; experience shipping native mobile alongside web; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

BENEFITS

 - 30 days annual leave plus local public holidays

 - Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

 - €1000 one-time home office grant OR €400 per month co-working space stipend

 3. Take-home assignment (duration varies by role) and live review with the team (90min)

Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND BELONGING

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Dedalus Labs builds persistent computers for AI agents. Our flagship product, Dedalus Machines, gives agents an isolated environment where they can run software, keep files and state, and work over time.

We're looking for someone who notices a slow build, a repeated manual step, or a service that fails in a way nobody can explain, and wants to make it better. You'll improve the team's development tools and workflows through focused fixes and speed improvements.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP

This is a paid, full-time internship or co-op in San Francisco lasting 3-9 months, depending on the program and agreed scope. Applications are open throughout the year, including off-cycle terms. Share your available start date and duration. You'll work alongside Dedalus engineers with direct feedback on your implementation and decisions.

We want evidence that you can learn something difficult, finish a working version, and improve it when the first approach fails. You do not need prior production ownership. You should already have a project you understand well enough to explain its hardest bug, its limits, and your personal contribution.

Your main work will be fixing bugs and papercuts, simplifying code, improving tests and tooling, and making focused speed improvements. You will work within existing systems with support from an engineer. This is how you learn the codebase and our standards. Responsibility grows as you demonstrate sound judgment, reliable execution, and clear communication.

WORK YOU MIGHT TAKE ON

 - A build, test, or deployment improvement. Trace where the time goes, identify repeated work or a reliability problem, and verify the change against the same workload.

 - A provisioning or developer-tooling workflow that another engineer can run and troubleshoot from its documentation.

 - A small code change that eliminates repeated work, improves build or cache efficiency, or speeds up a developer workflow, with tests for the behavior it changes.

 - Diagnostics that connect a failed operation to the relevant logs, metrics, and resource state, followed by a fix for the underlying problem.

Your project will have an agreed scope and completion criteria. The outcome should be usable by the team, with tests, documentation, and a clear account of its limitations.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

You have completed a meaningful programming project in Go, Rust, C, C++, or a similar language. You can explain its design, inspect its behavior on Linux, and investigate a failure. Experience with CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networking, or infrastructure as code is useful.

Show us a tool someone used, a service you operated, a difficult bug you reproduced, or an experiment that led to a working improvement. Research and coursework are welcome too. Tell us what you personally implemented, including any decisions or extensions beyond the starting instructions.

When you get stuck, you narrow the problem, read the relevant source or documentation, and try an experiment that can teach you something. You ask for help with the evidence you've collected and explain what you need to understand next. You act on feedback and keep ownership of the result.

You use AI coding tools where they help. You must be able to explain the resulting code, test its behavior, and correct it when it is wrong. We care about your judgment and understanding throughout the work.

We evaluate the work relative to your experience and opportunities. A degree, a particular employer, or owning hardware is not a prerequisite. Be specific about what you have already learned and where you want to go deeper.

THIS INTERNSHIP MAY BE A POOR FIT IF

 - You want to configure tools without understanding or investigating the software they run.

 - You need every next step supplied before trying a small experiment or asking a focused question.

 - You declare an improvement without checking whether another engineer can use it and whether the result is measurable.

LOGISTICS

 - Rolling applications throughout the year.

 - An agreed term of 3-9 months, depending on the co-op program and scope. Share your available dates, expected graduation date, and earliest possible full-time start.

 - Paid, full-time, and five days per week in person in San Francisco.

 - Meals and office benefits included.

 - Relocation support may be available.

 - Visa support may be considered depending on the candidate and circumstances.

 - Possible consideration for full-time employment, without a guarantee of conversion.

SHOW US YOUR WORK

Use your application to show us one thing you built and one difficult problem you investigated. They can come from the same project. Choose work you already have. We are not asking you to build a new project for this application.

 - Work: Show the code, demo, design, or result. Explain what you personally owned, what you reused, and one decision that made the result better or simpler.

 - Investigation: Describe the symptom, your first explanation, the evidence that changed your thinking, and how you established the result. Include the workload or users involved and any important limitations.

 - Writing: Share one piece of writing you care about as a separate, required sample. Any medium or length is welcome. Tell us why you wrote it, who it was for, and what you wanted to communicate. Looking back, what works well and what would you change? We care about the quality of your thinking and writing, and your reflection on the work. Link it or paste a redacted excerpt. Explain your contribution and any coauthors or AI assistance.

Work from employment, open source, research, coursework, or independent projects is welcome. Public source code is optional. A redacted excerpt or a concrete account of private work is fine. Keep confidential information out of your application.

Tell us which problem in this role you want to own and why. If your strongest evidence is easy to miss on a resume, point us to it. A

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About David AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

About our Technical Product Manager team

Our Technical Product Manager team builds the Data Factory at David AI. We set the strategy for how raw audio becomes high-quality training data, decide what gets built, and own the outcomes: scale, quality, cost, and the experience of our contributors. Working across Operations, Engineering, and Research, we move fluidly across all three to solve some of the most challenging problems at David AI.

About this role

David AI is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own a core part of our Data Factory, from early prototypes through production scale. Depending on your background and where we need you most, that could cover our contributor marketplace, our Operations infrastructure, a new or scaling business unit, or the systems our ML team relies on. You'll need the operational chops to lead complex efforts, the instinct to automate them, the technical ability to build the first MVP yourself, and the judgment to partner with engineering and research to implement at scale.

In this role, you will

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for your area of the Data Factory, from 0→1 prototypes through scaled production systems.

 - Lead complex operational efforts and design the workflows and automation that let them scale.

 - Build the first version yourself—scripts, queries, dashboards, and prototypes—then partner with engineering to implement it at scale.

 - Translate the model capabilities our customers care about into concrete workflows, requirements, and project plans.

 - Partner with Operations, Engineering, and Research to focus the team on the most important problems and take new systems from idea to deployment.

 - Use data to guide decision making, diagnose issues, and measure performance against throughput, quality, and cost.

 - Know when to move fast and when to slow down for alignment, with a bias for rapid prototyping.

 - Take full-stack accountability across product, operations, engineering, and customers, solving bottlenecks and ensuring delivery.

Your background looks like

 - Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or another technical / STEM field, or comparable work experience.

 - 2-8 years of experience in product, operations, consulting, or startup environments.

 - Direct experience as a product manager, technical program manager, founder, or technical operator accountable for outcomes.

 - Highly proficient in SQL and able to develop lightweight prototypes end-to-end.

 - A track record of building your own tools in operationally complex roles, or of taking a messy business problem from data foundation through analysis to implementation.

 - Strong product intuition, able to work with engineers and researchers to get to the right answer fast.

 - High-execution operator: fast, detail-oriented, and uncompromising on quality.

 - Collaborative and low-ego, willing to roll up your sleeves.

Benefits

 - FSA & HSA access.

 - 401k access.

RUN GREAT DEALS

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
WHAT DO WE DO?

Our mission is to radically accelerate the pace of software development by empowering every engineer to ship at the speed their agents write code. We’re building the last piece of the puzzle to enable this - the part that makes it actually safe to ship.

AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever before. But software review and testing hasn’t caught up. Engineering leaders are drowning in long software review cycles and more bugs than ever. The bottleneck isn’t writing code anymore, it’s everything that comes after it.

We spent 3 years building patented foundational technology to solve this. Our CTO, Quentin, spent over a decade at Palantir, where he led the 0 to 1 of core products that insiders credit as the primary value drivers behind Gotham and Foundry. We now work with the world's top engineering orgs - Notion, ElevenLabs, Mercor, Dropbox, Discord, LaunchDarkly, Wiz, CoreWeave, Wealthsimple, and more.

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time. We’ve raised $20m from Chemistry, Menlo and Coatue, the same investors behind Twilio, Twitch, Intercom and PagerDuty and are backed by angels including the founders of Vercel, Datadog, Segment, Dropbox, the CTO of GitHub, CPO of Adobe, head of engineering at Cursor and many more.

This is an opportunity to join a company going through hypergrowth as we scale from millions of annual recurring revenue to $100m ARR.

If this excites you, come help us build it!

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

Join us as a Founding AE hire in London and own the full sales motion end-to-end, from first discovery to strategising pilot deployment to closing the deal.

Most AEs work a narrow slice of the stack, repeating the same sales scripts and motion deal after deal and handing off to a sales engineer the moment a conversation turns technical. Here, you’ll own the sales cycle from discovery to pilot, then stay on as deployment lead to make sure it actually succeeds. You’ll own technical conversations, building real technical authority with engineering leaders and understand exactly what their software development workflow looks like, why they buy and what they’d like to see different about the product.

This is an IC role, there is no team beneath you and no one to delegate work to.

Examples of what you will work on

 - Own end-to-end cycles: You’ll build and manage your own sales pipeline, win pilots and close deals, growing to lead a geography or sector or team as we scale

 - Lead enterprise sales: Navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses (up to $XXX BN market cap), initially securing low-six then mid-six figure deals

 - Strategise complex deployments: Work alongside our engineers on pilots to figure out how to make them successful, run training sessions and build strong relationships at the user level

 - Help steer our roadmap: You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product and can take specific customer feedback back to our product teams

 - Events: You’ll network with CTOs & engineering leaders, attend our dinners and conferences across the US, and become well-known in this space
 
 

YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF

 - ⭐ You learn fast and want to dive deep into the product - you have strong analytical thinking and can work from first principles; ambiguity / lack of experience in a technical domain doesn’t faze you / you are excited to learn!

 - ⭐ You are highly agentic - you have a bias to action, move fast, take ownership without being asked (e.g. if you need sales collateral you build it yourself!)

 - ⭐ You’re a hunter - chasing down revenue feels energizing, not exhausting or stressful, you create your own pipeline if there isn’t one!

 - ⭐ You want to work with engineers - you will spend most of your time externally and internally with developers, and this excites you!

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You expect to work regular working hours and to travel infrequently; our teams, customers, investors span SF, London, NY

 - You need a team of BDRs, RevOps and Marketing to support you across the sales motion

 - You expect to lean entirely on engineers for technical demos and discovery calls

 - You expect never to have to build your own pipeline

REQUIREMENTS

 - STEM degree

 - 3-7 years of work experience outperforming in a B2B SaaS sales, strategic deployment or adjacent role

 - Experience with outbound-led sales

 - Bonus if you have experience selling a deeply technical product to senior engineering leaders or have been an early GTM hire (< #20) at a fast growing startup

 - If you were previously or are currently a software engineer with strong commercial acumen looking to pivot into tech sales, we’d strongly encourage you to apply!

YOU MAY LOOK LIKE THIS

 - Ex-STEM: You were always on the STEM track but realised being around people is what drives you! You are currently an AE but want to go back to doing something that is a bit more technical.

 - Builder: You are an AE but were previously a founder, have been part of an incubator (YC, EF, Antler) or want to be a future founder. You spike at commercial work but want to build knowledge outside of that to be a more well rounded leader in the future.

 - Early-stage operator: You have been or want to be an early founding hire to help shape what sales looks like and work to build up the processes, materials and strategy that will help us win!

 - AI lover: You work in b2b sales but feel like AI is developing so quickly you’re being left behind and want to build out a more technical skillset

PERKS ♥️

 - Competitive comp + significant equity

 - 🍲 Unlimited food & drinks in office - including daily lunch as a team, and your own Amazon business account to buy whatever snacks you want for the office.

 - 💻 A setup you’ll love - everyone has a standing desk, brand new Macbook, your choice of ergonomic peripherals, and a £2k WFH budget to make home just as good

 - 🏄‍♀️ £300 monthly welln

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Healthcare is in crisis and the people behind the results deserve better. With more and more data coming from wearables, lab tests, and patient–doctor interactions, we’re entering an era where data is abundant.

Junction is building the infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare, making patient data accessible, actionable, and automated across labs and devices. Our mission is simple but ambitious: use health data to unlock unprecedented insight into human health and disease.

If you're passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in.

Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare personalized, proactive, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast.

SHORT ON TIME? 

 - You: You’ve led experienced engineers, stayed close to the code, and care about the product and the customers using it.

 - Ownership / Focus: You’ll lead a small and growing engineering team, you’ll own its engineering direction, technical delivery, team health and hiring.

 - How we manage: We don’t believe in purely pastoral engineering managers. You’ll manage and develop people, but you’ll also ship, unblock, review and make technical decisions alongside them.

 - Salary: £120-£150k + equity (based on experience and location)

 - Location: Fully remote (GMT). We have one company offsite each year, with possible travel to London every couple of months for team meet-ups.

WHY WE NEED YOU

Our engineering team is growing, and we need another Engineering Manager to grow with it. You’ll report to Mark, our Head of Engineering, and work alongside Rui, our other Engineering Manager. You’ll initially take ownership of a small engineering team, working closely with product and other teams to decide what to build and get it shipped.

At Junction, engineering management is a technical job. We want our managers close enough to the work to know what’s going on, give good feedback and get involved when needed. But we don’t want you to become the person everyone waits for when something gets difficult.

Six months in, your team should trust you, people outside the team should know where things stand, and the team should be delivering what it says it will.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

 - Own the engineering direction, delivery and health of a small team of senior product engineers.

 - Work with product on what the team commits to, then make sure it gets delivered.

 - Stay close to the code: review PRs, give technical feedback, pair on problems and ship when it makes sense.

 - Unblock the team when decisions are unclear or things go wrong.

 - Give engineers regular feedback, run useful 1:1s and performance reviews, and actively help them grow in their careers.

 - Notice what’s slowing the team down and fix it, surface problems early and keep the rest of the company clear on what’s happening.

 - Own hiring for your team and play an active role in helping Junction grow.

REQUIREMENTS

 - You’ve led and directly managed experienced software engineers.

 - You’ve stayed technically involved while managing

 - You’ve owned a team’s delivery, not just its people management.

 - You can give useful technical feedback and make sound calls on engineering trade-offs.

 - You’ve worked with product and other teams to turn customer problems into shipped software.

 - You’ve helped engineers develop through direct feedback, coaching and meaningful opportunities to take on more.

 - You’ve hired engineers and helped raise the technical or operating standards of a team.

You don’t need to tick every box to fit in here. If the problems we’re solving genuinely interest you and you know you can contribute, we’d love to talk.

 
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - You’ve worked at an early-stage or scaling company where managers are expected to manage people and build product.

WHAT THIS ROLE ISN’T

 - If you want to stay out of the code and spend most of your time in 1:1s, planning and status meetings, it won’t be a good fit.

 - You’ll have to make tough calls on technical and non-technical topics and own the outcomes

 - It isn’t a tech lead role with a few 1:1s either. Developing people, giving difficult feedback, hiring and building a healthy team are core parts of the job.

How you'll be compensated

 - Your salary is dependent on your location and experience level

 - Equity (extended exercise post 2 years of employment) 

 - Company and team offsites

 - Monthly learning budget of $150 for personal development and productivity

 - $100 monthly wellness budget

 - Flexible, remote-first working, including $1K for home office equipment

 - Coworking budget

 - 36 days paid time off (including bank holidays)

 - Premium healthcare coverage 

 - 4% monthly contribution to pension/401k

 - Yearly blood test on us

 - Enhanced parental, foster, and adoption leave
 
 

Important details before applying:

 - We only hire folks physically based in GMT and EST timezones 

 - We do not sponsor visas right now given our stage

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Offstream is looking for a talented implementation engineer to join our growing team. You will own the success of our customer implementations. This means taking a project from signed deal to a fully configured deployment on the Offstream platform. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, software implementation, and project management, and will have a direct impact on how quickly and reliably our customers can operate.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own the end-to-end success of MRV implementations, from kickoff through go-live, managing timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders along the way

 - Project-manage through change: re-scope and re-plan when requirements, registry guidance, or stakeholder priorities shift, while keeping timelines, owners, and risks clear

 - Translate project design documents into complete MRV plan requirements - identifying gaps, making judgment calls where the guidance is ambiguous, and writing MRV plans for registry submission

 - Communicate directly with registries and compliance bodies to resolve open questions and get plans approved

 - Configure the Offstream app to match each project's specific monitoring, reporting, and verification needs

 - Make judgment calls on app updates and configuration changes as project requirements evolve or compliance guidance is released

 - Work closely with engineering to flag where the platform needs new functionality versus where a project can be solved with configuration

 - Build systems that improve upon themselves so that each new project goes faster and smoother than the last
 
 
 
 
 WHAT YOU WILL BRING
 
 (If you don't meet all of these requirements, you should still apply. We want to find high-slope individuals, so if you can quickly grow into this profile we'd love to hear from you)

 - 3+ years in an implementation, project management, or MRV/technical advisory role, ideally in carbon markets, energy, or another data-heavy regulated industry

 - Comfort making judgment calls under ambiguity and owning the outcome

 - Experience configuring or working closely with software platforms to meet customer-specific requirements

 - Strong project management instincts. You keep projects on track without needing to be told to and intrinsically enjoy managing many workstreams

 - Experience working on capital project development and/or on-the-ground operations (construction/startup/commissioning), with an ability to translate field realities into clear plans, schedules, and execution

 - Excitement about using AI tools to move faster, whether that's drafting MRV plans, digging through registry guidance, or configuring the app

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. You'll be writing plans for registries and talking directly with customers

 - Passion for startups

 - Ease balancing multiple stakeholders along an ambiguous path to get to a final outcome

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AS AN IMPLEMENTATION ENGINEER AT OFFSTREAM

 - We are an AI native team that rarely does anything the slow, manual way by default, but we still expect a high level of rigor and expect ownership over what you produce

 - We believe that applying steady effort over a long period of time will result in incredible progress

 - Relentless ownership means we take full responsibility for outcomes: anticipating problems, driving solutions end to end, and never waiting for someone else to make progress.

THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - Month 1 - you will shadow live implementations to learn our MRV plan process, registry relationships, and app configuration end to end

 - Month 2 - you will independently own an implementation from kickoff to go-live

 - Month 3 - you will be running multiple implementations in parallel and contributing improvements to our playbooks and internal processes

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and equity ($100 - $160k) depending on qualifications and experience: $115k - $160k in SF, $100k - $145k in Denver

 - A full suite of benefits

 - Unlimited PTO with a minimum of 2 weeks off per year + all federal holidays and a company shut down for the week between Christmas and New Years

LOCATION

Denver, CO - we work in an office near union station 3 days per week

San Francisco, CA - we work in an office near the 4th and King Caltrain station 3 days per week

ABOUT THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Intro call: Learn about Offstream in more detail including the mission, goals, and what implementations look like today. You'll be asked about projects you've managed and how you think about ambiguity and tradeoffs

 - Take home SOP writing exercise: Write an SOP document to implement software with a hypothetical customer

 - Live implementation role-play: Live execute on your SOP with a member of Offstream's team

 - Technical systems and reasoning: Deal with messy data and show off your ability to handle ambiguity when faced with the reality of complex, real-world systems

 - Team interview: Meet the team to talk about your background, experience, and motivations for joining an early-stage startup

About Kernel

Kernel is crazy fast, open source browser infrastructure for AI agents. We handle autoscaling, observability, and the messy details of web interaction, so developers can focus on what their agents do instead of how they do it.

Teams at Cash App, Framer, and 7000+ others use Kernel for deep research, QA automation, and real-time web analysis. We've raised $22M from Accel, YC, and Vercel.

If you're interested in building critical infrastructure for agents on the web, we'd love to chat.

https://www.onkernel.com/docs/careers/browser-security-engineer#about-the-role

We’re hiring a Browser Security Engineer to harden and extend our Chromium-based browser runtime. You’ll work at the intersection of sandboxing, networking, and virtualization — ensuring our browsers run securely and efficiently across thousands of concurrent users.

https://www.onkernel.com/docs/careers/browser-security-engineer#what-you%E2%80%99ll-do

What you’ll do

Debug, patch, and optimize Chromium builds running inside Kernel’s microVM environments.

 - Implement and maintain network isolation, proxy routing, and IP handling for browsers.

 - Collaborate with infra engineers on unikernel-based isolation, process scheduling, and kernel security policies.

 - Build internal tooling for binary analysis, crash triage, and vulnerability monitoring.

 - Support the team in maintaining secure supply chain and reproducible builds for our browser images.

https://www.onkernel.com/docs/careers/browser-security-engineer#what-we%E2%80%99re-looking-for

What we’re looking for

 - Deep familiarity with Chromium internals, browser sandboxes, or renderer/network stacks.

 - Experience with Linux kernel, microVMs (Firecracker, Cloud-Hypervisor, Kata, gVisor, etc.), or container isolation.

 - Strong debugging skills with strace, gdb, perf, or similar low-level tools.

 - Knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, proxies, TLS).

 - Background in security engineering or browser hardening a plus.

https://www.onkernel.com/docs/careers/browser-security-engineer#what-you-can-expect-as-a-kernel

What you can expect as a Kernel

 - Industry-competitive salary

 - Above market equity

 - Premium medical + dental coverage + dependent coverage

 - Small, trusting team of senior + staff engineers

 - Default async with minimal bureaucracy

 - Daily lunches on us

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k + company match

 - Relocation assistance

https://www.onkernel.com/docs/careers/browser-security-engineer#hiring-process

Hiring process

We have a simple process focused on real world collaboration and jointly getting to know each other:

 1. 30 minute intro calls with one of Kernel’s co-founders 

 2. 45-minute technical interview (virtual)

 3. Half-day on-site (in-person) working with our team on relevant technical challenges.

 4. Offer!

jobs.title: Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAINDROP

Raindrop http://raindrop.ai/ is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2.0 (Self-Healing Agents) https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/introducing-raindrop-2/, the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions.

WHY IT MATTERS

AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing.

The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions.

That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns.

With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more.

In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used.

As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company - from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents.

OUR INVESTORS

We've raised $50M total https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/series-a/, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari).

YOUR FOCUS

 - Ensure customers have a world-class developer experience integrating and using Raindrop

 - Maintain, improve and add SDKs

 - Help customers debug integration

 - Write clear documentation, tutorials, and guides

 - Quick iteration without compromising on quality

 - Deeply understand the customer

IDEAL CANDIATE

 - Knows how to balance short-term and long-term speed

 - Strong programming, problem solving, and debugging skills

 - Passion for working with developers and building developer communities

 - Excellent technical writing skills

 - Interest in AI products + tools (ideally experience building these or an avid user)

 - Growth mindset https://www.amazon.com/Mindset-Psychology-Carol-S-Dweck/dp/1400062756/ref=asc_df_1400062756/?tag=hyprod-20&linkCode=df0&hvadid=693552282123&hvpos=&hvnetw=g&hvrand=4674755525298314094&hvpone=&hvptwo=&hvqmt=&hvdev=c&hvdvcmdl=&hvlocint=&hvlocphy=1014226&hvtargid=pla-404766125919&psc=1&mcid=f98b4cf9fde83f4189d30cfe308d0799&gad_source=1

 - Cares about building well-designed products

 - Willing to do whatever it takes to solve a problem

 - Must be in person in San Francisco (or willing to move)

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAINDROP

Raindrop http://raindrop.ai/ is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2.0 (Self-Healing Agents) https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/introducing-raindrop-2/, the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions.

WHY IT MATTERS

AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing.

The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions.

That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns.

With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more.

In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used.

As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company - from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents.

OUR INVESTORS

We've raised $50M total https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/series-a/, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari).

Your Focus:

 - Anomaly detection: Improve how we find unusual agent behavior across every customer’s production data, including issues no one has defined yet.

 - Custom models: Train and serve the small, private models we build for each customer, and make them more accurate over time.

 - Labeling and feedback: Build the loops that turn customer signals into better models.

 - Cost and latency: Keep our models fast and affordable as event volume grows.

Your responsibilities:

 - Design, build, and scale the ML pipelines behind Raindrop’s issue detection.

 - Train, evaluate, and deploy models, and monitor their quality in production.

 - Iterate quickly without sacrificing quality.

 - Work with customers to understand how their agents fail and what they need to catch.

 - Bring new detection methods into production.

Ideal Candidate:

 - Ownership of ML systems end to end, from data and training through deployment and monitoring.

 - A track record of shipping models to production that real users depend on.

 - Experience scaling applications that serve millions of requests.

 - Expertise in an area such as anomaly detection, classification, representation learning, or LLM fine-tuning.

 - Good judgement about when to move fast and when to build for the long term.

 - Use and build AI agents and tools

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
About David AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

About our Engineering team

At David AI, our engineers build the pipelines, platforms, and models that transform raw audio into high-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We're a tight-knit team of product engineers, infrastructure specialists, and machine learning experts focused on building the world's first audio data research company.

We move fast, own our work end-to-end, and ship to production daily. Our team designs real-time pipelines handling terabytes of speech data and deploys cutting-edge generative audio models.

About this role

As a Backend Engineer at David AI, you'll build the systems and infrastructure that power how our users process and make sense of the audio data they'll use to train their models, working closely with researchers to consistently iterate on how to best collect our data.

In this role, you will

 - Design and build scalable backend systems and core data processing pipelines that derive actionable insights from terabytes of audio data every day.

 - Architect and maintain the APIs and services that power features thousands of users interact with daily.

 - Build, deploy, and evaluate LLM and DSP based solutions to increase our customers' understanding of nuanced features across our datasets.

 - Iterate rapidly on our research hypotheses by working closely with researchers and our Operations team to deploy backend infrastructure that supports new data collection.

 - Stay up-to-date with cutting edge technologies and frameworks to apply to our current product offering across backend engineering, data engineering, machine learning, and signal processing.

Your background looks like

 - 2+ years of backend engineering experience.

 - Strong backend fundamentals with experience designing scalable systems, APIs, and data pipelines that handle significant scale and volume.

 - A proven track record of delivering engineering solutions that contributed value to customers.

 - Experience working in a high-pace environment where constant progress was enabled by detail-oriented execution.

 - Emphasis on building robust, reliable infrastructure that supports highly polished, production-grade products.

 - AI/ML or audio experience is not required but you should be excited to learn.

Bonus points if you have

 - Educational or professional experience with digital signal processing and a deep understanding of speech.

 - Experience building and deploying ML models in a production environment.

 - Led (managed or tech-led) engineering teams in high-growth environments.

Some technologies we work with

 - Node.js, tRPC, PostgreSQL, AWS, Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev, WebRTC, FFmpeg, TypeScript.

Benefits

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.

 - FSA & HSA access.

 - 401k access.

 - Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.

 - Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Manager of Account Management to lead and scale a team of Account Managers responsible for retention and expansion across our customer base. You'll coach your team to run a disciplined, consultative motion - from health monitoring through QBRs to signed expansion contracts - while owning the operational rigor (forecasting, pipeline hygiene, coaching cadence) that turns individual performance into a predictable, repeatable team result. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success and play a key role in building out Warp's Account Management function as it scales.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own team-level retention and expansion targets, translate company NRR goals into individual quotas and coach the team to hit them

 - Recruit, hire, and ramp new Account Managers as the team scales

 - Run a consistent coaching cadence (deal reviews, call shadowing, QBR prep) to raise the floor and ceiling of team performance

 - Maintain forecasting rigor across the team's book of business

 - Partner with RevOps/Sales leadership to refine segmentation, territory assignment, and health-scoring models 

 - Spot systemic churn patterns across the team's portfolio and drive proactive intervention playbooks, not just deal-by-deal firefighting

 - Document the SOPs, templates, and processes the team runs on (QBR structure, renewal motion, expansion methodology) 

 - Design a distinct motion for smaller or early-stage accounts

 - Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to escalate and resolve complex customer issues, and represent the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions

 - Partner with Sales and Activations leadership for a seamless handoff and shared account strategy from close through onboarding into steady-state management

WHAT YOU NEED

 - Minimum 4-5 years of B2B account management, customer success, or sales experience, including at least 2-3 years directly managing a quota-carrying team

 - Proven track record of leading a team to consistently meet or exceed retention and expansion targets

 - Strong coaching instincts and ability to diagnose why a rep is underperforming (skill, activity, or account quality) and correct it

 - Experience building or significantly improving account management processes, playbooks, or tooling from the ground up

 - Comfort with forecasting and reporting rigor; fluency with a modern CS/sales stack (e.g., Salesforce, Metabase, Pylon, Linear or equivalent)

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 - High adaptability and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage startup

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience managing account managers who serve early-stage startup or high-growth B2B SaaS customers

 - Background scaling an Account Management function through a period of rapid headcount growth

 - Experience designing compensation structures, quota frameworks, or account segmentation/tiering models 

BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

jobs.description:

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. jobs.title: Account Executive (NYC)
jobs.description:
- Location: New York City, United States (On-Site)

 - Contract Type: Full Time

 - Comp Range: $200k - $260k OTE (uncapped) + Equity

TL;DR

Hey, I’m James https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamesmcmullan1/, Head of Sales (US + Global Enterprise) at Kombo. We're currently growing our sales team and looking for an entrepreneurial Account Executive not just to hit numbers, but to help us build and scale our sales team. This is a NYC-based on-site role.

ABOUT KOMBO

Kombo is the unified API for HR, payroll, and recruiting systems. Instead of companies spending months integrating with dozens of different systems, they integrate once with Kombo and instantly connect to 250+ platforms.

Our traction since Y Combinator (end of 2022):

 - 8-figures in revenue with hundreds of customers

 - $30M+ raised from YC, Volition Capital, Acadian Ventures, and top-tier angel investors

 - Scaled to 80+ team members across Berlin & NYC

Your work will significantly impact our revenue growth. With new challenges rapidly arising (we're looking to scale our team and double the revenue next year!), you're assured of growth and progress.

Overall, if you’re looking for an opportunity with asymmetric career growth, a fantastic team spirit, inspiring people (details and fun pictures here!) https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21, and impactful work, Kombo could be a great match.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We can predictably create a more robust sales pipeline that we can close, and therefore, require more sales power to focus on closing those opportunities. That’s why we are seeking an Account Executive to join our team to help ~2x our revenue for 2027.

You will own a big part of our revenue generation to hit our 2027 goals.

You'll report to our Sales Lead and work closely within a pod (an AE paired with a BDR), taking on a leading role in our Sales Team. You'll manage your pod's BDR to support pipeline generation. Historically, ~80% of pipeline created for an AE has come from our BD function, with a win rate of over 40%.

Your success can be measured by your ability to hit your revenue targets (quarterly/yearly).

Most of your time will be spent hunting and closing new business, but you will also be responsible for helping us improve our sales processes, and will have clear ownerships about managing your business development rep. 

If you are passionate about daily customer interactions, enjoy strategically thinking about go-to-market challenges, and value being part of an excellent team that empowers you to grow, we think you'll love this job!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: you'll be running every deal from first touch through close; working pipeline generated by marketing and BDRs, while also hunting and prospecting new business of your own

 - Act as a trusted advisor: guide customers through our market, challenging and educating them at every stage of their buying journey

 - Become an audience expert: develop deep intuition for our audience - developers and product leaders at startups building product integrations

 - Raise the bar: lead by example and mentor new sales team members as the team grows, using your input to continually improve our sales process and company performance

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: partner with marketing, engineering, product, growth, and platform teams to share customer insights and help improve Kombo's offering across the board

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with a consistent, demonstrated track record of overachieving against ~$1M+ annual quotas

 - Proven full-cycle sales experience at Seed–Series C startups, from hunting and prospecting through to closing

 - Experience selling technical B2B SaaS with ACVs from $50,000 - $100,000

 - Experience selling to technical buyers: CTOs, CPOs, Heads of Product, and similar technical/product-oriented stakeholders

 - Comfortable acting as a solution architect in conversations: able to cover a lot of technical ground during the sales cycle and speak credibly to product/integration details

 - Training in a structured sales methodology (we use MEDDPICC)

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a hunger for rapid growth and pioneering a new market despite existing competition

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate, confidently close deals, and act as a bar-raiser on excellence within the team

WHY KOMBO?

 - Uncapped earning potential — No cap on comp, and you're selling into a market that's doubling again next year. Your upside grows as the business does.

 - Pipeline built for you — You work closely with a dedicated BDR, with ~80% of your pipeline generated for you and a 40%+ win rate. Less time prospecting cold, more time closing.

 - Full ownership of your territory — Your accounts, your number, your plan. You run it.

 - Proven motion, real traction — 8-figure revenue, doubling year over year, $30M+ raised, and a team that consistently overperforms. You're not selling something unproven.

 - Team that delivers — Our AEs averaged 130% of quota attainment over the last 12 months. Overperformance is the norm here, not the exception.

 - A problem every prospect already has — Every company in your CRM needs these integrations. They build them, suffer without them, or buy Kombo — the demand isn't going anywhere.

 - Work alongside the best — Today's top AEs shape the sales process and mentor the next wave of hires, with extremely high standards for craft and performance.

 - A clear path forward — Room to grow into an Enterprise Account Executive, with real support behind your career progression.

 

PUTTING IT DIFFERENTLY, WHY YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY

 - You prefer remote work or traditional corporate environments

 - You're looking for a pure execution role without building/leadership responsibilities

 - You want a laid-back, low-pressure sales environment

Ziina is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. We laid a strong foundation upon which we’ve shipped our product. We are looking for someone to help us build out innovative new features, prepare our technology to scale, and help shape our engineering organization to be the kind of place that bright minds from across the region and the world aspire to work for.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker excited to solve hard problems and to build something from the ground up. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and have the judgement to own features independently. They are obsessive about delivering great, high quality products to our users. We are ambitious and excited to build big things, and we’d love to bring on someone who is as well. In short, we are looking for owners.

 - Possess excellent communication skills and a desire to collaborate

 - Live in, or be willing to relocate to the UAE
