jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Ziina is looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team and help build the internal tools that power our operations.

You will improve and extend the tools our teams use today while helping us gradually bring our back-office platform in-house. This includes understanding complex operational processes, integrating with our existing third-party solution, and building intuitive workflows that enable teams to operate safely and efficiently.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker who enjoys understanding how a business operates and translating ambiguous requirements into reliable software. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and independently own features from discovery through production.

We are ambitious about building internal platforms that scale with the company, and we’d love to bring on someone who shares that ambition.

AS A FULL-STACK ENGINEER ON THE PLATFORM TEAM AT ZIINA, YOU WILL:

 - Collaborate with operations, compliance, risk, customer support, product, and engineering teams to understand workflows and identify opportunities for better tooling and automation.

 - Improve and extend the workflows supported by our existing third-party back-office solution, including building the integrations and supporting services it requires.

 - Help define and incrementally build Ziina’s in-house back-office platform, taking features from discovery and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Turn complex operational processes into intuitive and reliable experiences with appropriate permissions, safeguards, and auditability.

 - Establish consistent patterns for internal interfaces and service integrations, while ensuring critical workflows are tested, monitored, and resilient to failure.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU LIKELY:

 - Have 4+ years of full-stack development experience and are comfortable working across web applications, APIs, backend services, and relational databases.

 - Enjoy understanding operational workflows and solving problems for internal users.

 - Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous requirements and can independently drive work forward.

 - Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, and maintainability.

 - Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical collaborators and demonstrate high integrity and a team-first mindset.

 - Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE.

WHAT WOULD AMAZE US

 - Deep proficiency with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong experience building backend services using Node.js and Nest.js.

 - Experience building internal tools, administrative platforms, operational dashboards, or workflow-management systems.

 - Experience designing permissions, approval workflows, audit logs, and other controls for sensitive operations.

 - Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows.

 - An AI-forward mindset, with experience using AI-assisted development tools and applying AI to simplify or automate operational workflows.

OUR TECH STACK

We’ve built a modular architecture with reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

 - TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, and React.

 - GraphQL Federation and Kafka.

 - PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.

 - AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

 - GitHub Actions for CI/CD.

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT CORVUS ROBOTICS

Corvus Robotics is building autonomous robots that help warehouses operate more efficiently. Our robots navigate large distribution centers, collecting inventory data and helping customers maintain accurate, real-time visibility into their facilities.

We’re looking for Field Technicians to help us map customer warehouses and prepare sites for our autonomous robots. This is a hands-on, travel-heavy contractor role for someone who enjoys working in the field and is comfortable navigating large warehouse environments.

You don't need prior robotics experience — we'll train you on our mapping tools and processes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Travel to customer warehouse sites and perform onsite mapping

 - Walk large warehouse facilities to collect accurate information about racking, aisles, storage locations, and other relevant infrastructure

 - Use Corvus's proprietary mapping and editing tools to build and update warehouse maps

 - Capture measurements, photos, and other site information as needed

 - Perform quality checks to ensure maps are accurate and complete

 - Identify and document discrepancies or site conditions that could impact robot operations

 - Work closely with our Deployment teams to communicate mapping findings and resolve issues

 - Follow standardized mapping procedures and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of your work

 - Represent Corvus professionally while working onsite with customer teams

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Willingness and ability to travel frequently to customer sites

 - Comfortable spending several hours walking and working in large warehouse environments

 - Strong attention to detail and an ability to accurately follow technical instructions

 - Comfortable working independently and managing tasks onsite

 - Basic computer and technical skills

 - Strong communication skills

 - Ability to learn new software tools quickly

 - Comfortable working around active warehouse operations, including forklifts and other industrial equipment

 - Reliable, organized, and safety-conscious

Prior experience in warehouse operations, field service, surveying, mapping, construction, or a similar hands-on field role is a plus, but not required.

ROLE DETAILS

 - Contract position

 - Frequent travel to customer sites required

 - Travel will involve multi-day trips

 - Training on Corvus mapping tools and processes will be provided

 - This role is primarily focused on warehouse mapping and site data collection rather than full robotic deployment

WHY CORVUS?

You'll be working directly in the field with a team building and deploying real-world autonomous robotics. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with robotics, and warehouse automation while working across a variety of customer facilities.

If you're someone who likes being out in the field, traveling, working independently, and getting hands-on with new technology, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

ABOUT THE ROLE

LemFi is building the financial infrastructure for people the world wasn't built to serve - cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts, savings, credit, and eSIMs across 21 countries and growing. Security is not a checkbox here; it is a core part of how we earn trust with customers, regulators, and partners in some of the most scrutinised payment corridors in the world.

This role sits at the intersection of security engineering, operations, and compliance. You will monitor and respond to real threats, extend our DLP and identity controls, run vulnerability management, and translate audit requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA) into working technical controls. One day you might be triaging a researcher submission through our Bug Bounty programme; the next you are scripting an automated compliance check or briefing a board-level vulnerability report. If you want to own a broad, meaningful security remit at a fast-scaling fintech rather than a narrow lane at a large bank, this is the role.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts and incidents across cloud, endpoint, and SaaS environments - keeping detection tooling sharp and well-tuned.

 - Own and extend our Data Loss Prevention controls: policy tuning, coverage gap analysis, and coordinating endpoint rollout across the business.

 - Manage device compliance and identity workflows via MDM platforms, including scripting for group management, provisioning, and reporting through REST APIs.

 - Run vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking, and contribute to board-level reporting that gives leadership a clear, honest picture of risk.

 - Translate SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and DORA requirements into working technical controls, evidence collection processes, and automated compliance checks - and support external auditor engagements directly.

 - Operate LemFi's Bug Bounty and Responsible Disclosure programme: triage researcher submissions and coordinate remediation with engineering teams.

 - Build scripts and lightweight tools to cut manual security operations work, improve audit evidence quality, and use AI to accelerate wherever it adds genuine value.
 
 

YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - 2 to 5 years in a security engineering, security operations, or equivalent hands-on technical security role, ideally in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry.

 - Practical experience across at least some of: cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP), endpoint and MDM tooling, DLP platforms, identity and access management, and SIEM or alerting tools.

 - Scripting ability sufficient to automate workflows and integrate with REST APIs - you write the script, you don't just find it on Stack Overflow.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or DORA); direct audit-support experience is a strong plus.

 - A clear written communicator who can produce control narratives, incident summaries, and stakeholder-facing documentation that non-technical people actually understand.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and able to shift between hands-on engineering work and compliance or documentation in the same week without losing momentum.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience operating or running a Bug Bounty or Vulnerability Disclosure programme.

 - Exposure to building or contributing to a Security Trust Centre or external-facing security documentation.

 - Familiarity with DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) requirements in a practical, implementation context.

WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

jobs.title: Agent Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
AgentMail is building the identity layer for AI agents, starting with email. Our most important user is an agent: it discovers us through model answers and docs, then signs up and integrates on its own. We're looking for an Agent Experience Engineer to own how AI models and agents discover and use AgentMail. That means AEO, evals, benchmarks, agent traces, docs, and llms.txt.

AgentMail has raised $6M from investors including General Catalyst, Y Combinator, Paul Graham (founder of YC), Karim Atiyeh (founder of Ramp), Paul Copplestone (founder of Supabase), and Dharmesh Shah (founder of HubSpot).

You'll work on:

 - Answer-engine presence: when someone asks an LLM about email or identity for agents, AgentMail is the recommendation. You measure share of voice on the prompts that matter and move it

 - Original research: evals and benchmarks on how well frontier models, open source models, and agent harnesses use AgentMail

 - Agent traces: running agents against our docs and site, reading their reasoning, and fixing what confuses them. A stray Reddit thread once convinced LLMs we have a feature that doesn't exist

 - The agent-facing surface: llms.txt, MCP descriptions, docs structure, and the error messages agents hit at 3am with no human watching

 - The AEO content engine: steering and verifying our automated page pipeline, briefing freelancers, and doing backlink outreach to the pages models already cite

 - The weekly AEO briefing's action queue, from freshness debt to competitor watch

You're a fit if:

 - You build with agents daily and have opinions about what makes a product easy or miserable for an agent to use

 - You work cross functionally by default

 - You express your opinion early, and you'll publish an honest writeup even when the result is inconvenient

 - You go deep on messy technical problems. You'd rather spend a day reading agent traces than guess

 - You understand retrieval: models pull chunks, not pages, and you write accordingly

Strong preference for published technical writing or benchmarks people actually cited. SEO or AEO experience helps, as do contributions to docs or MCP servers in the wild.

Compensation: $110K to $175K, plus 0.2% to 0.5% equity.

PS. our bar for this position is ridiculously high. We are aiming to build one of the most distributed products of all time. If selected for an interview, expect growth discussions and case studies as part of our process.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.

That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.

We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

 - Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

 - Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

 - Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

 - Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you.

 - Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong.

 - Evidence of analytics. You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered.

 - Taste. You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made.

 - Real code shipped to real users. React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it.

 - AI as leverage, not as identity. We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made.

 - German and English. Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one.

How we work

In the office, Munich, five days a week. We build in the same room — decisions happen at desks, not in tickets. Relocation support if you're not here yet.

High pace, steep learning curve. Most of the team is here well past six. That's not a policy or a number we track, it's what building something this size with sixteen people currently takes, and it's a phase, not a permanent state. If you're optimising for predictable hours right now, this is the wrong role, and that's a completely reasonable thing to be optimising for.

This is not the role if you want specs handed to you, you separate "my design work" from "my engineering work," you need a design system before you can start, or your best work needs a slide to explain it.

ABOUT THE FOUNDERS

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean, the co-founders of Mercura. 

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. 

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. 
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. 

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. 
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

jobs.title: Senior Bookkeeper
jobs.description:
Ready to make an impact? At Hive Health http://ourhivehealth.com, we’re on a mission to make healthcare radically more accessible for all—and we need passionate, driven individuals to help us make it happen. If you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment and want to work on solutions that truly matter, we’d love to meet you!

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Bookkeeper is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the company’s accounting records. The role oversees bookkeeping and the month-end close, prepares financial statements, manages the general ledger and reconciliations, and supports regulatory compliance and audits.

The Senior Bookkeeper also helps strengthen accounting policies, controls, and processes while providing guidance and review to junior accounting team members.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Oversee Bookkeeping & Month-End Close: Ensure transactions are accurately recorded and drive timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities

 - Prepare Financial Statements & Reports: Prepare balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, supporting schedules, and other financial reports for management review

 - Manage the General Ledger: Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, and other adjustments to maintain accurate financial records

 - Reconcile Accounts: Review bank, balance sheet, and other key account reconciliations; investigate and resolve discrepancies and long-outstanding items

 - Ensure Financial Compliance: Maintain accounting records in accordance with PFRS and support requirements of the BIR, SEC, Insurance Commission, and other regulatory bodies

 - Coordinate Audits: Prepare schedules and supporting documents and coordinate accounting requirements with Finance Operations and other teams for internal and external audits.

 - Maintain Policies & Controls: Implement accounting policies and internal controls and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and audit readiness

 - Perform Financial Analysis: Analyze account movements, variances, and unusual balances and assist the Accounting Manager with financial statement analysis

 - Support the Accounting Team: Review work and provide technical guidance to junior team members, escalating material accounting or compliance issues as needed

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy

 - Certified Public Accountant (CPA)

 - At least 4 years of relevant accounting experience, with strong exposure to audit, general accounting, financial reporting, and month-end close
 
 - Experience preparing financial statements, journal entries, account reconciliations, and audit schedules
 
 - Proficiency in accounting systems such as QuickBooks or Xero and Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.

 - Strong knowledge of accounting principles, and Philippine regulatory requirements

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy

 - Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills

 - Ability to handle confidential and sensitive financial information with integrity

 - Must be willing to work onsite in Ortigas, Pasig twice a week

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

ROLE AT A GLANCE

Gecko is seeking an Enterprise Security Engineer to help build and operate the shared systems that protect our people, devices, applications, and sensitive data.

You will sit within InfoSec Engineering and partner closely with IT Engineering. Your primary focus will be workforce endpoint and device security, identity security, SaaS and OAuth governance, enterprise detections, and the protection of regulated data.

Our goal is to eliminate friction: solve shared security and technology problems so everyone else can focus on their unique roles. Security and compliance should create trustworthy paths for the company to move faster and remain in compliance, not unnecessary barriers that teams must work around.

Responsible use of AI tools is an important example. Gecko should be able to benefit fully from emerging technology without misusing sensitive data or creating unacceptable security, privacy, contractual, or compliance risk. This role will help establish the systems, guardrails, and guidance that make responsible adoption possible.

This role supports U.S. Government programs. Its essential functions require regular access to export-controlled technical data, U.S. Government information systems, and customer facilities subject to U.S.-person access requirements. To satisfy the U.S. Government contractual and customer-access requirements applicable to this role, the selected candidate must qualify as a “U.S. person,” that is, a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, or other protected individual, including a refugee or asylee, as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). This requirement applies only to roles with these access needs and is not a general condition of employment at Gecko Robotics or its affiliates.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build, configure, and operate endpoint-management, device-compliance, browser-security, and endpoint detection and response controls; harden workforce devices and shared enterprise systems.

 - Own and improve identity security—including Okta policies, MFA, Conditional Access, and lifecycle controls—and establish practical governance for SaaS applications, OAuth access, browser extensions, AI tools, and other third-party technology.

 - Create clear, usable paths that let employees adopt approved AI tooling and other technology while protecting regulated and sensitive data and meeting security, privacy, contractual, and compliance obligations.

 - Translate requirements into effective configurations and workflows, partnering closely with IT Engineering to solve shared problems, reduce recurring friction, and make controls easy to operate.

 - Build and tune enterprise detections; evaluate alerts and control gaps; lead corporate-side incident response; make proportionate risk decisions and coordinate remediation with the teams that own the affected systems.

 - Partner with Product Security, Cloud Infrastructure, IT, and Facilities when enterprise-security concerns intersect with applications, cloud services, engineering systems, or physical security.

 - Establish and maintain governance for the adoption and use of AI tools and other rapidly emerging workplace technologies, ensuring security, privacy, and compliance requirements are met.

 - Travel up to 20% to Gecko offices and other locations as needed to support enterprise security initiatives, physical security projects, incident response, and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Identity management (e.g., Okta, Onelogin, Active Directory)

 - EDR/MDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, TrendMicro, SentinelOne)

 - AI management (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok)

 - Government security frameworks (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, CUI handling)

 - Commercial security frameworks (SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001)

REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 3+ years of experience in Enterprise Security Engineering, Security Engineering, IT Security, or a related hands-on security engineering role.

 - Hands-on experience administering endpoint management and endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions in production environments.

 - Experience administering or securing identity and access management (IAM) platforms, including SSO, MFA, or lifecycle management

 - Experience evaluating, governing, or administering SaaS applications, OAuth integrations, and enterprise security controls.

 - Experience working with regulated, customer-protected, or other sensitive data (e.g., CUI, HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2).

 - Strong systems configuration, troubleshooting, workflow design, and operational ownership skills.

 - Demonstrated ability to balance security and compliance requirements with business needs and user experience.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Security, IT, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and other cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Experience governing AI tools or other rapidly adopted workplace technology.

 - Experience in government, defense, critical infrastructure, or another highly regulated industry, including familiarity with CUI, CMMC, FedRAMP, NIST, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO 

Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

ROLE AT A GLANCE 

Gecko Robotics is building production-grade robotic manipulation systems that embed intelligent inspection directly into active manufacturing environments. In this role, you will architect and develop ROS2-based control, perception, and motion planning systems for 6-axis articulated manipulators operating in real-world industrial settings. These robotic systems integrate a wide range of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and sensing and optimize inspection throughput, improve product quality, and enable better downstream manufacturing decisions.

Given the work you'll be doing on some of our impactful government projects, you must also be eligible for a US clearance.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Architect and evolve Gecko’s ROS2-based control framework and planning systems for articulated manipulators

 - Develop perception-driven motion planning using visual and other sensor inputs

 - Design closed-loop inspect → analyze → rework workflows

 - Optimize robotic inspection throughput within active manufacturing lines

 - Own system-level integration between robot control stack, industrial hardware and Gecko’s inspection software

 - Support system deployment and validation in production environments

TECHNOLOGIES WE USE

Our robotic systems are currently built on a ROS2 framework and integrate motion planning from MoveIt for brand agnostic control of 6-axis articulated manipulators.

 - Core stack: ROS2, Python, C++

 - Planning & simulation: MoveIt, RoboDK, Roboguide, RobotStudio

 - Hardware platforms: Fanuc CRX, Yaskawa, ABB industrial manipulators

 - Both off the shelf sensors and custom designed sensing payloads for NDT

REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 5+ years experience developing production robotics software in C++ and/or Python

 - Strong experience with ROS2-based robotic systems

 - Experience with motion planning frameworks (MoveIt2)

 - Experience integrating perception systems (vision, 3D sensors) into robotic workflows

 - Ability to work across software and hardware boundaries in industrial environments

PREFERRED

 - Experience programming industrial 6-axis articulated robots (FANUC, ABB, Yaskawa)

 - Familiarity with PLCs and industrial communication protocols

WHO WE ARE

At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. 

Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve - and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact.

Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Account Executive Nordics/UK - AI & Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT ESCAPE

Escape secures the code-to-cloud attack surface. Our platform maps every asset a company actually exposes to the internet including undocumented APIs and endpoints then tests them continuously. We run automated AI penetration testing and DAST at the pace that engineering teams ship code, not just once a year for auditors.

 

We’re 45+ people based in Paris, Amsterdam, Hawaii, Boston, New York, Series A funded, and rapidly growing.

 

WHY WE’RE HIRING

Escape has growing customer demand and inbound interest in the Nordics and UK with an already existing client base.

 

This is a first-in-region role with full ownership. You’ll be responsible for end-to-end sales, your own pipeline, building a territory plan, and shaping how we go to market in these regions. Successful approaches will directly influence our future playbook working in autonomy, direct impact, and shaping our approach.

 

THE ROLE

You’ll own the full sales cycle, from first contact to signature, selling to technical buyers CISOs, Heads of AppSec, Security Engineers, and platform leaders. These stakeholders have deep expertise, strong preferences, and often existing tools, and will challenge you on how things work.

 

While you’ll partner closely with Sales Engineers for POCs and technical validation and have direct access to founders and the product team you’ll need to confidently handle first conversations and independently build most of your pipeline.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Proven cybersecurity sales experience, you’ve sold real security products to real security teams.

 - Closed complex enterprise deals: six-figure ACVs with long cycles, buying committees, procurement, legal, you’ve managed deals through stalls and restarts.

 - Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from scratch via successful cold outbound.

 - Track record of meeting/exceeding quota ready to discuss your targets and results.

 - Fluent English plus either native/fluent Swedish or deep UK market expertise.

 - Eligible to work in Sweden or the UK (required). We don't do VISA sponsorship.

 

Bonus points for:

 - Experience with AppSec or developer tooling

 - Being the first AE in a new market

 - Knowledge of structured selling methods (e.g., MEDDIC)

 - Experience with partner-led sales

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 3 Months:

 - Confidently demo the product solo and explain our differentiators

 - Deep knowledge of ICP, competitors, and security buying cycles in your region

 - Own and move existing opportunities in the pipeline

 - Write a territory plan: key accounts, segments, priorities

 - Launch consistent outbound and generate your first qualified opportunities

 

3–6 Months:

 - Independently run end-to-end deals

 - Deliver your first closed-won accounts in-region, including at least one sourced cold

 - Pipeline at 3x forward quota with reliable forecasting and CRM hygiene

 - Bring valuable market insights: why buying cycles start, recurring objections, who we’re losing to and why

 - Strong collaborative rhythm established with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product with your feedback driving change

 

6–12 Months:

 - Consistently hit quota with a scalable pipeline 

 - Recognized as the point owner for Nordics/UK; you set the direction, we support it

 - Documented playbook new AEs can ramp using your processes

 - See expansion, multi-year deals, reference customers, and case studies

 - Help hire and onboard additional AEs for the region

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary with uncapped commission [OTE, currency, split provided during interviews]

 - [Equity Package]

 - Remote-first, with regular trips to Paris and company offsites

 - Local benefits via Deel EOR

 - Full autonomy and genuine ownership in a high-impact role, with direct access to founders who value your input

 

HIRING PROCESS

 - 30 min intro call with People & Talent

 - 30 min sales deep dive with our Head of Growth

 - 60 min sales simulation (“Sell Escape back to us”) with an AE and Sales Engineer

 - 45 min conversation with the founders

 - References check, then offer

 

Total process: 2–3 weeks. We’ll keep you informed throughout.

 

Escape is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our vision is to become the marketplace for everything expensive, specialized, and difficult to move. We’re building the infrastructure that powers the procurement and disposition of assets across America’s essential industries, automating everything from discovery and payments to freight, warranty, and financing. Today, Garage operates in cities and towns across all 50 states and has surpassed $100M+ in annualized transaction volume on the platform.

Our mission is to save local governments and essential services businesses time and money. We started with fire departments two years ago and have since expanded into EMS and heavy-duty, launching new verticals while growing revenue >10x last year.

If you move fast, hold a high bar, and want meaningful ownership in building a category-defining company, Garage is the place to do it.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Own operational initiatives and special projects — take initiative on projects that improve workflows, strengthen operations, and help the team scale.

 - Maintain operational accuracy and visibility — update and manage trackers and internal systems to ensure deal status, documentation, and timelines are always current.

 - Problem-solve and exercise judgment — identify issues, gather missing information, resolve straightforward requests efficiently, and escalate when needed to keep deals moving.

 - Internal Collaboration — own the operational coordination between clients, Sales, Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and accurately, while surfacing opportunities to improve the customer experience.

 - Operate with speed and precision — manage multiple active transactions at once while maintaining high attention to detail in a fast-moving environment.

 - Support users in navigating the product — help buyers and sellers understand how to use the Garage platform and complete required actions smoothly, and identify ways to improve the user experience.
 
 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

 - Takes ownership, works effectively with a high degree of autonomy, and is proactive about identifying and driving solutions.

 - Is comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining attention to detail.

 - Is skilled at engaging with customers and building trust through clarity, responsiveness, and professionalism.

 - Is able to prioritize and manage multiple active requests and deadlines efficiently.

 - Is confident navigating spreadsheets, trackers, and multiple data sources, with the ability to interpret and communicate insights clearly.
 

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.

 - 3+ years of experience in operations, customer-facing, or analytical roles.

 - Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

 - Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from frontline operators to CEOs, via phone and email.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience operating in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

 - Proficient with ticketing and project management tools (e.g., Notion, Jira, Linear) to manage tasks, workflows, and client requests

 - A curious, proactive mindset, with a willingness to contribute new ideas 

 - Low ego and willing to roll up their sleeves—taking ownership of projects and doing whatever it takes to move the work forward

OUR VALUES

 - Take Big Swings. We are here to transform an overlooked industry—not make small improvements around the edges. We set ambitious goals, take calculated risks, and push through setbacks. We never trade lasting impact for short-term comfort.

 - Customers Come First. Our customers operate in an industry burdened by slow, expensive, and outdated processes. We attack the problems that cost them the most and measure our success by the time and money we give back to them.

 - Play For the Front of the Jersey. We put the mission ahead of ourselves. We challenge each other directly, support each other relentlessly, and step up whenever the team needs us. We win together, and we have fun doing it.

 - All Gas, No Ego. Building something that matters takes relentless effort. We move fast, take ownership, and see hard problems through. When we fall short, we own it, learn quickly, and come back stronger.

WHY JOIN GARAGE?

 - Do work that matters. Our platform helps people buy the assets that local communities rely on to keep their communities safe, clean, and operating every day.

 - Help shape the company. Join as one of our first 40 employees and work directly alongside the founders.

 - Make an outsized impact. You’ll join a talent-dense, high-performance team where every person moves the company forward.

 - Build from a strong foundation. We’ve raised $18M, including a $13.5M Series A, from Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, Infinity Ventures, FJ Labs, and other leading investors.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and stock options

 - 100% medical, dental and vision insurance coverage

 - Unlimited PTO (in addition to company observed holidays)

 - Daily lunch & dinner (for employees based in NYC)

 - $100/month wellness stipend

 - 401(k) w/ employer match

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Annual team offsite

 - Relocation assistance

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. We don’t expect you to check all the qualification boxes and encourage you to apply if you have experience in some of the areas.

Equal Opportunity

As an equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, natural origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Elyos AI

We’re building the next generation of customer service with AI Agents. Our agents answer calls, reply to emails and WhatsApp messages, make bookings, take payments, and operate the CRM in the same way a human would.

We founded Elyos in June 2023 and took part in the Y Combinator S23 batch. Our founders spent four months in San Francisco living and breathing AI. Since then, we’ve been growing revenue ~30% month on month and shipping fast. It’s been wild so far - and we’re just getting started. We recently raised a $13m series A to turbocharge our growth.

The product has grown faster than any one of us can hold in our head - agent configuration, calls, email, campaigns, scheduling - and design has been shared out across whoever happened to be building the feature. It needs an owner. Someone to give it one language, and enough depth that it holds up when hundreds of customers use it in ways we didn't plan for.

There are two sides to it. How the agents behave, on the phone and in the inbox and over chat. And the product behind them, where a trade business sets up what its agents do and checks what they did.

You'd be our first designer, working directly with the two CEOs, the CTO and with engineers to build what you design.

The work, roughly in order:

 - How our customers work alongside their agents. Watching a call, correcting the agent, deciding what it can and can't do, trusting it a bit more next time. Nobody has good patterns for this yet.

 - One design language. Type, colour, icons, components, written down and held to.

 - Joining the product up. Onboarding, creating an agent, setting up on-call, reviewing what it books - separate islands today, and you'd be central to fixing it.

You'll spend real time with customers. They run vans, not product teams, and they'll tell you exactly what's wrong. Their current software was designed in the 2000s and has been cobbled together ever since. Nobody has seriously designed for this industry. There's nothing to inherit and nothing to copy, so the patterns would be yours to set. And they're the best users you could ask for: they've never had good software, so they know within a day whether something works.

We're looking for someone who's designed something genuinely complicated. Dense screens, real operational workflows, software people sit in all day. You prototype fast, you're fluent with AI tools, and you won't be the one shipping the React unless you want to be. You'll need opinions and the willingness to push them.

Brand and the marketing site sit elsewhere. This is the product.

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - 💸 Competitive salary & equity - we are building together, we win together

 - 💪 Wellhub Gold subscription - access 1000's of gyms and health related activities (inc. GymBox, 1Rebel, F45 etc)

 - 📚 AI-focused learning & development - stay ahead of the curve.

 - ✈️ Team socials & annual offsites - cool destinations included (last year we went to Greece!).

 - 🏥 Private healthcare - because your well-being matters.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive

We use AI in conjunction with human review to pull decision-ready records in a fraction of the time, with a level of accuracy legacy vendors can't match.

We just turned two, doubling order volume month over month, and on a clear path to category leadership. We're well-funded (post Series A) and building toward 100x our current scale.

Our mission is to fully automate record retrieval. Getting there takes sharp engineering and relentless execution, in equal measure.

About the Role

Sales is how Codes Health grows. We have doubled our sales team since January. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own our largest, most complex accounts: law firms and healthcare systems where deals involve multiple stakeholders, longer cycles, and higher stakes. Our customers hand us mission-critical workflows that directly affect legal outcomes and patient care, so how we close, how we set expectations, and how we build long-term partnerships matters as much as whether we close at all.

What You'll Do

 - Own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts: prospecting, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close for a complex, high-trust product sold to multi-stakeholder buying committees.

 - Navigate long, complex enterprise sales cycles, including procurement, legal, and multiple internal stakeholders on the buyer side.

 - Manage and grow relationships post-close, building strategic account plans and identifying expansion opportunities within the large accounts you land.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - San Francisco

About Flai

AI has transformed B2B SaaS, but has struggled to penetrate the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for car dealerships.

A $1.3 trillion industry, auto dealerships sell 96% of the 16 million new cars sold each year. Yet they universally run on outdated systems and manual processes, which is why dealerships spend $36B each year on operations. That’s our opportunity.

Role Overview

Working shoulder to shoulder with a founding team that moves fast and never sits still, you'll get to onboard and scale accounts, drive real adoption and outcomes, and run the playbooks and processes that make Flai the standard for AI in this industry. jobs.title: Head of Marketing

AI has transformed B2B SaaS, but has struggled to penetrate the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for car dealerships.

We’ve grown insanely quickly with a small, scrappy team and continue to move at that pace.

The Opportunity

You'll work directly with the founders to shape Flai's brand, tell customer stories, launch products, and help write the playbook to build a differentiated identity. The raw material is there: measurable ROI, customers who love the product, and a market that's woken up to AI’s immense potential. You’ll start hands-on and eventually earn a team by proving the motion.

Our typical buyer is the store’s general manager. They are not primarily on LinkedIn/X, don’t read tech press, and constantly get pitched by vendors. The winner in the category will be the company that dealers have heard of, trust, and can point to a peer already using the product. 

We want a marketer who is interested in solving this different kind of challenge.

Who You Are:

 - You want to be close to the physical world: dealerships are high-stakes environments where trust is earned slowly and can be lost even faster.

 - You’d rather build the playbook than follow one: you generate ideas, test relentlessly, and quantify what works.

 - You are a player-coach: senior enough to think big picture, but willing to do it yourself. Over time you’ll grow your scope via additional team members, contractors, agencies, and automation.

 - You are high ownership: strong follow-through, and a bias toward shipping.

Make the best product in the category obvious. We win head-to-head evaluations, and customers who try us keep us. But being better isn't good enough. We want to be the leading brand. You'll decide how Flai is positioned, our value props and differentiators, what language makes our buyers tick, and how to distribute that consistently across channels.
Build a story that grows with us. We started with voice; now the product surface is expanding fast. You'll set positioning that still holds when Flai does considerably more than today, and own how we reveal that over time.
Turn our results into the industry's reference numbers. jobs.title: Applied AI Scientist (Senior/Principal)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYGALDRY

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to superintelligence, and addressing the problem of rising compute costs and energy bottlenecks. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

THE ROLE

Our AI & algorithms team develops quantum approaches to training, inference, and reasoning, including quantum-native generative modeling. Much of this work runs today on classical hardware at small scale, built so that results transfer directly to quantum processors as they come online.

Increasingly, that research meets real problems. Partner organizations bring workloads from their own domains, and someone has to carry our methods into each one and find out how well they hold. That is this role. You are a computational scientist who takes scoped collaboration and does the technical work: understand the partner's problem well enough to know where our methods can genuinely help, prototype, benchmark against what they already trust, and be the technical voice in the room when results are discussed. Our partnerships managers own the relationships and run the programs; our research scientists develop the algorithms. You produce the evidence.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Applied Work in Partner Domains

 - Assess where our quantum-native generative methods apply to a specific domain: which algorithm, under what assumptions, in which regime it wins, and what would count as evidence

 - Build and run the proof-of-concept work, and adapt research-team implementations to relevant domains

 - Validate against the reference methods the partner already trusts, whether that's molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo, a classical solver, or their production model

 - Present and refine results in technical working sessions, and carry what you learn -- model scales, data characteristics, evaluation criteria -- back into decisions about what we develop next

Benchmarking & Evidence

 - Produce evidence by whichever route fits the question: approximate simulation where a structured representation scales, circuit emulation where exact small-scale results matter, and analytic resource models to reach past what either can run

 - Design benchmarks that hold up: quantum, classical, and hybrid compared under realistic assumptions, against the strongest classical method rather than a convenient one

 - Use our internal modeling and simulation environment to show a partner what their own workload would look like on our architecture

 - Extend those models to new algorithm workloads, and produce the charts, comparisons, and reproduction artifacts behind our published and partner-facing results
 
 

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Are a scientist who ships: you write code daily, and your results are reproducible by someone else

 - Are quantitatively deep enough to judge whether a result is right, not only whether the pipeline ran

 - Can hold a technical conversation with a domain expert in a field you didn't train in, and come out knowing where the real bottleneck is

 - Value rigor: you are comfortable assessing where quantitative methods help, where they don't, and what evidence distinguishes the two

 - Move fast, and can carry several engagements in parallel without letting any of them go stale

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE

 - Advanced training (MS, PhD) in a computational field -- physics, chemistry, applied mathematics, computational biology, engineering -- or equivalent depth built in industry

 - Strong Python and scientific computing: linear algebra, ODE/SDE solvers, sampling and Monte Carlo methods, uncertainty quantification

 - Generative modeling experience: diffusion, flow matching, normalizing flows, score-based or energy-based models

 - Exposure to tensor network methods or other structured representations for high-dimensional problems

 - Applied domain experience in molecular or materials modeling, time-series forecasting, physical simulation, or generative design

 - Technical writing ability, and a track record of reproducible research artifacts or collaborative publications

 - Curiosity about quantum computing; prior experience is welcome but not required
 
 

HOW WE'RE DIFFERENT

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We publish our algorithm work when it meets our bar, and we lean into agentic AI tools as part of daily workflows. We're looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.

Culture & Benefits

 - Visa Sponsorship - We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We're open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation - We value your contribution and invest in your future with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Benefits - Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection - Whether it's a company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off - We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

Location: San Francisco - On Site. Occasional travel for cross-site

jobs.title: Technical Storyteller
jobs.description:
About Blacksmith

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

What you'll do

 - Build and run the content engine. We are constantly working on complex infrastructure problems and have a lot of features to launch this year, but there's no machinery yet for turning launches and engineering work into content on a reliable cadence. Today that overhead falls on engineers and founders, which means it often doesn't happen at all. You'll build the machine and own the cadence, so a regular stream of high-quality technical content ships.

 - Design how we launch. We're shipping several 0-to-1 products and features this year and each needs a narrative: the announcement, the docs-adjacent explainers, the demos. You'll work closely with the Product team to build up this playbook and reduce the overhead with every launch.

 - Turn customers into stories. We have engineering teams who cut their CI times by an order of magnitude. Find those stories, interview these teams and write compelling content that other engineers will naturally draw parallels to in their own work.

 - Set the bar for technical content in this category. Deep dives, benchmarks, teardowns, comparisons, the occasional argumentative essay. Things that get to the front page of Hacker News on merit.

 - Extend past the blog. Video, YouTube, docs, changelog, conference talks, the company account. Whatever format the story actually needs.

You're a good fit if you

 - Have 5+ years writing for a technical audience - developer media, technical content marketing, DevRel, or engineering-adjacent journalism.

 - Have published work that traveled: pieces that hit the front page of Hacker News, threads that got quoted, posts engineers send each other, or an audience you built yourself. We will ask for links to get to better know your style of writing.

 - Understand technical concepts deeply enough to present them credibly. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about what we're building and the wider market.

 - Can pull a story out of engineers who don't think of themselves as storytellers. You can read a design doc or a pull request and come out with a thesis, and you ask questions to build a content piece.

 - Write with a point of view. We'd rather publish something arguable than something safe.

 - Are very online: you follow the right channels, know what's moving through Hacker News, X, and developer social chatter, and catch things early. You have instincts about what will work and what won't.

 - Work with autonomy. There's no manager, no brief, no existing calendar. You'll decide what's worth writing.

Compensation and benefits

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401k match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)

LiteLLM is the open-source AI gateway used by developers and enterprises to access, manage, and govern LLMs through a unified interface.

Teams use LiteLLM to route requests across model providers, control spend, monitor usage, implement security policies, and reliably operate AI applications in production.

We are looking for our first Developer Relations hire to help more developers discover LiteLLM, understand what they can build with it, and successfully deploy it in production.

WHY WE’RE HIRING

LiteLLM has a large and growing technical community. Developers discover the project through GitHub, documentation, search, technical content, and recommendations from other engineers.

But discovering LiteLLM is only the beginning.

Developers need to quickly understand how LiteLLM fits into their stack, see credible examples of it solving real problems, and get from their first request to a production deployment. They also need clear ways to share feedback, contribute to the project, and learn about new capabilities.

You will help us build that developer journey.

This is LiteLLM’s first dedicated Developer Relations role. You will establish how we educate developers, engage with the community, support product launches, and turn developer feedback into better documentation, examples, and product decisions.

This is a hands-on technical individual-contributor role.

In a typical month, you will:

 - Use developer feedback and adoption data to decide which educational resources, integrations, and community initiatives will have the greatest impact.

 - Represent LiteLLM publicly through technical talks, workshops, videos, podcasts, and conversations with the developer community.

This is not a traditional social-media or event-marketing role, and it is not a frontline support position.

You will help individual developers, but the goal is to turn what you learn into resources and improvements that help the entire community. You will not be measured by content volume or impressions alone. The best outcome might be a runnable example that unlocks an important use case, an explanation that becomes the canonical resource for a difficult topic, or a pattern of feedback that leads us to improve the product.

Because this is a founding role, you will also help define our Developer Relations priorities, operating cadence, and measures of success. You will shape the function while continuing to ship technical work yourself.

We built that foundation with a brand advisor (and investor) who we continue to work with today. Your role will be to own this internally, our first in-house brand designer. You would be inheriting a real system, not a blank page, and taking ownership of where it goes next.

What you'll do

 - Own how Blacksmith looks and sounds across every surface: website, social, events, decks, swag and more.

 - Translate genuinely complex technical concepts into visuals that engage and build credibility with engineers.

 - Build a flexible visual system that holds up across multiple product lines and scales as we ship more, rather than a static brand guideline that goes stale in a quarter.

 - Work directly with the founders and with engineering on launch narratives, from the shape of the story down to the assets that carry it on Hacker News, X, and the blog.

 - Ship fast and iterate in public; treat the brand as something that evolves alongside the product.

 - Raise the bar on craft across the team, ensure we maintain quality whilst we move at speed.
 

You’re a good fit if you have

 - You're maniacal about polish and know what earns trust with a developer audience. Instinct and taste are critical here.

 - 5+ years in brand design role, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or at the least in a complex B2B product environment.

 - A portfolio that shows both systems thinking and range across mediums - web, motion, print, and presentation, with strong typography and layout at its core.

 - Evidence you've built or meaningfully evolved a brand for a technical product, not just executed against someone else's system.

 - The ability to articulate why a design decision is right and bring engineers and founders along with it.

 - Comfort with ambiguity.

 - You love to prototype, you want multiple options for every design choice and you're an expert at leveraging agentic tools to expedite this process.
 

Compensation and benefits

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401k match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)

jobs.title: Founding Content Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT OFFDEAL

OffDeal is the world’s first AI-native investment bank for founder- and family-owned businesses looking to sell their life’s work. We combine experienced investment bankers with purpose-built technology to bring institutional-quality M&A advice and execution to an underserved market.

We’ve closed transactions across trades, healthcare, and business services, built a fast-growing team, raised $17M from top VCs (Radical Ventures, Y Combinator), and we’re just getting started. We have no shortage of stories worth telling, and this is the role that tells them.

See the momentum: The Wall Street Journal https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/ai-companies-staffing-c9029343 · CNBC https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-gIqEitH6fg · Financial Times https://www.ft.com/content/9daf5c7e-e301-4b7d-809a-ff9fb336bdbc · Watch our Series A launch https://x.com/leveredvlad/status/1950192434790457849?s=20

THE ROLE

OffDeal has already earned meaningful organic attention and press, but the work has behind it has been founder-led, opportunistic, and built one asset at a time. Meanwhile, our growing volume of closed deals, client outcomes, and company milestones is creating more great raw material than we currently capture.

You will turn that momentum into a scalable trust and proof engine. Your first mandate is to make OffDeal’s success real to business owners considering a sale. The same body of work will also support buyers, partners, and future teammates.

We believe AI radically expands what one exceptional content operator can produce. You’ll use it to research, organize, draft, adapt, and systematize content across formats. You will own what AI cannot: the story, the interview, the voice, the judgment, and the taste that make the finished work worth a business owner’s attention.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced, scrappy builder. You will set the creative bar by making the work yourself and directing the partners who help bring it to life. You’ll own stories from initial concept through final delivery, working directly with the Head of GTM, senior leadership, our investment bankers, and our engineering team.

Once the credibility foundation is in place, you will also have the opportunity to identify and build new organic formats and channels for reaching business owners.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Deal and client stories: Turn closed deals and client outcomes into memorable case studies, testimonials, and stories across written, visual, and video formats. Own each story from concept and interview preparation through final delivery.

 - Production: Source and direct videographers, photographers, and other creative partners. Own the brief, production plan, handoffs, captions, on-screen text, graphics, and final cut.

 - Blog and website credibility: Own OffDeal’s blog and core website content, including case-study pages, tombstones, team content, company updates, and other proof surfaces that help business owners understand and trust OffDeal.

 - AI-native content engine: Build repeatable workflows for finding stories, organizing source material, and turning one strong asset into many distinct, channel-native formats. Maintain a content library that teams across OffDeal can easily use.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

 - Are an outstanding storyteller with taste. You can absorb complex raw material, find the story that matters, and make it clear, human, and memorable.

 - Love building with AI. AI is already your default way of working, not a tool you’re evaluating. You’ve built prompt systems, Skills, or AI workflows that materially multiply your output, and you can demonstrate the leverage they create. If you believe AI inherently compromises serious creative work, this isn’t your role.

 - Are a builder and owner. You’re energized by taking an idea from initial concept through production and finished output.

 - Understand owner-operators. You know that playbooks designed for corporate software buyers do not automatically translate to practical, time-constrained business owners who are skeptical of jargon. You can make complex subjects simple without talking down to the audience.

 - Can run the machine. You are highly organized and resourceful, comfortable directing outside partners and managing several productions at once.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3–6 years creating content in a marketing, editorial, agency, or startup setting, with meaningful ownership of both the process and finished work.

 - A portfolio that demonstrates strong writing and range, including at least one video, customer story, or case study you drove from concept to finished asset.

 - Experience creating content for SMB owners and owner-operators, ideally in trades, healthcare practices, industrials, or other Main Street sectors.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with financial services or M&A, or a track record of quickly mastering unfamiliar, technical subjects.

 - Experience testing, launching, or growing an organic content format or channel.

A specific degree is not required. We weigh what you’ve built far more heavily than your credentials.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our process includes a live work sample: raw material in, finished asset out, using the tools you actually work with. We care about the quality of the work, the speed of execution, and the leverage you create with the tools at your disposal.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer

If you love building things from the ground up, solving complex technical challenges, and working with cutting-edge AI tech, you’re in the right place.

WHAT YOU BRING

BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Evidence of customer empathy - support experience, founder experience, or just building things that solved real user pain.

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - 💪 Wellhub Gold subscription - access 1000's of gyms and health related activities (inc. GymBox, 1Rebel, F45 etc)

 - 📚 AI-focused learning & development - stay ahead of the curve.
