jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive, Existing Business
jobs.description:
MID MARKET ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, EXISTING BUSINESS

THE REALITY

You'll own a book of existing mid-market accounts, and your job is to make them bigger. Renewals matter and we expect you to protect them, but nobody here is going to hand you a retention number and call it a career. You carry an expansion quota, and the accounts you grow are the ones that count.

We're in the office five days a week in San Francisco. We move quickly, we expect a lot, and the bar for what a single AE owns here is higher than most places you've worked.

This will probably be one of the hardest jobs you’ve had, but the pay off is real. Our NRR was 200%+ last quarter and we’re expected to grow at least 30% from new customers over the next 6-12 months.

WHAT WE'RE BUILDING

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform and agentic operating system for sales, built across Hyperbound Practice (AI roleplay), Hyperbound Perform (real call scoring and coaching), and Kota, our AI agent that acts on what we find. As we put it internally, we don't just record what happens on a call, we change what happens next.

Founded in 2023 out of YC (S23), we're about 45 people now, Series A, $18M raised total. Last quarter we doubled headcount, revenue nearly doubled with it, and net revenue retention landed above 300%. Teams at LinkedIn, Workday, and Intel run their sales orgs on us. When your own product drives that kind of expansion inside an account, this job gets a lot more fun.

THE ROLE

You'll own a book of Hyperbound's existing mid-market accounts and a quota based on growing them. That means finding the next team, the next use case, and the next budget inside accounts that already trust us, then running a sales cycle to land it. Practice, Perform, and Kota each open a different expansion path, and part of the craft is knowing which one a given account is ready for.

Renewal is table stakes here. The work that defines this seat is expansion: new seats, new divisions, new products, and turning a happy pilot into a company-wide standard.

You'll multi-thread across each account, build relationships past your original champion, and get in front of the economic buyer early instead of showing up at renewal hoping the numbers hold. Real product usage and customer outcomes are your best expansion signal, and reading them well is most of the game.

In your first 90 days, success looks like knowing your book cold, a live expansion pipeline built on named opportunities, and your first meaningful upsell closed. We'll show you where the whitespace is, and we're trusting you to go take it.

THE TEAM

We're assembling a cracked team of builders, operators, and hunters. On the GTM side that means people who have built and scaled sales engines before, not folks who inherited a territory and coasted. We've hired from our competition, brought on former founders, and hired people who first met us as customers and loved the product enough to come build it.

Nobody here is precious about their lane. People see something broken and fix it, whether or not it's technically their job. You'll sit close to product and the founders, and the loop between what a customer tells you and what we ship is short on purpose.

We work hard and we celebrate properly. After our Series A we took the whole team to Bali. 

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/dc682caf-65e4-456d-8c74-c4a052bd4d85/af7279f1-13c5-4121-a14c-fc76bef6422f/bali.jpg]

At the same time, this isn't a mattress-under-your-desk startup: plenty of people here have kids, people leave to make dinner, and they come back the next morning and close deals. High standards don't require burnout, and we care about building something people can do for years.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/dc682caf-65e4-456d-8c74-c4a052bd4d85/628ae514-9086-4038-8243-2e8decca744e/image_large.png]

(we've doubled in size since this photo was taken a few months ago)

OWNERSHIP AND EQUITY

You own the account end to end: the expansion strategy, the relationships, the forecast, and the number. That cuts both ways, and when an account triples on your watch, that's yours too. Equity here is real, with secondary opportunities, and we genuinely want the people who help build this early to end up meaningfully rewarded for it.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $240k OTE, split 50/50

 - 0.05% to 0.075% equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Medical, dental, vision

 - Commuter benefits

 - In office lunch and dinner

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - 30 min intro call with James, Founding Recruiter

 - 30 min screening call with Mason, Chief of Staff

 - Take home exercise (1-3 hours)

 - Take home exercise review with Sai, Co Founder

 - Final onsite interview with founders and team

We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1-2 weeks.

Equal Opportunity

Hyperbound is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and we don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Channel Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT WARP

Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform.

Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. Warp is built for AI to be the primary operator. Every advance in LLM capability widens our lead.

We process $X billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 US states + globally.

We've raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Peak XV, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), and Y Combinator, alongside operators including Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Claire Hughes Johnson (Stripe), and the founders of Dropbox and Replit. Our team comes from MIT, Ramp, Brex, Google, Gusto, Rippling, and more.

We hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. If you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.

About the Role

Channel partnerships are one of Warp's biggest growth opportunities.

We're looking for our first Channel Partnerships Lead hire to build this function from the ground up. You'll create a repeatable partner motion that generates qualified pipeline through trusted advisors who already serve our ideal customers. Think accounting firms, benefits brokerages, fractional HR leaders, executive advisors, and other firms helping founders build and operate their companies.

In this role, you'll own the entire channel motion, from identifying the right partner segments and developing the playbook to sourcing new partners, launching relationships, generating revenue, and building the systems that make the channel scalable.

You'll work directly with company leadership and have significant ownership over one of Warp's highest-leverage growth initiatives. As the channel grows, so will your scope.

What You’ll Do

 - Build Warp's partner ecosystem across accounting firms, benefits brokerages, fractional HR firms, executive advisors, and other trusted advisors.

 - Source, negotiate, and launch strategic partnerships that generate qualified pipeline and revenue.

 - Own partner-sourced pipeline and work closely with Sales to convert referrals into customers.

 - Build strong, long-term relationships with partner leaders and create repeatable referral motions.

 - Develop the playbooks, onboarding, enablement, and reporting that allow the channel to scale.

 - Help build one of Warp's highest-leverage growth channels from the ground up.

What You Need

 - 5+ years of experience in Partnerships, Business Development, Sales, or another GTM role

 - At least 3 years building or managing strategic partnerships

 - Experience creating or meaningfully scaling a partner or channel program

 - Strong communication and executive relationship-building skills

 - High agency - you identify problems and solve them without waiting for direction

 - Previous startup experience is a plus

BENEFITS AT WARP: 

 - 100% Health Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents.

 - 401(k) Matching: Start investing in your future from day one.

 - Flexible PTO: We offer uncapped flexible PTO, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments.

 - Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our NYC office.

 - Catered Lunch Daily: Great food, every day, on us. No meal prep, no decision fatigue.

 - Quarterly Offsites: Beautiful locations to connect as a team. Past locations include Spain, Catskills, and San Francisco.

Warp is based in New York City, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. Please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model.

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 300k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have strong taste in what not to build. Blacksmith cares deeply about delight and keeping things simple, and enterprise roadmaps are where products go to bloat. You'll make real progress for our largest customers while fighting the “enshittification” of the product.

 - Have shipped enterprise capabilities at a growth-stage infrastructure or developer-tools company. You've personally taken a product through the SSO/RBAC/audit-log/security-review gauntlet and know what makes a buyer's security team say yes.

 - Have matured a post-PMF product, not just launched new ones. You find "make the core product undeniable for the biggest customers" more compelling than greenfield exploration.

 - Are technical enough to earn trust with infrastructure engineers and technical buyers. You understand CI/CD, cloud networking, and compute platforms, and can go deep on how ours work.

 - Have sold to or worked closely with enterprise buyers (VP Eng, Head of Platform, CISO) and understand procurement cycles, security reviews, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA).

 - Are AI-native in your own workflow: Claude/Cursor-style tools daily, comfortable with MCP and CLI-based tooling, and instinctively automate the manual parts of the PM job.

 - Always take a customer-first approach and enjoy being the voice of the customer internally.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

This is not a 0-to-1 exploration role. Our products have strong pull; your job is to make them enterprise-grade as we move upmarket from high-growth startups to large engineering organizations.

 - Own the roadmap that makes Blacksmith enterprise-ready across our product lines (CI, sandboxes, and our coding agent). You'll operate like a GM for our enterprise segment: you own the outcome across product lines and work with whichever engineering teams own the relevant systems, rather than owning one team going after a greenfield opportunity.

 - Define and drive our security, auditability, and compliance surface: audit logging and SIEM integrations, certifications, and the trust documentation that gets us through enterprise security review.

 - Shape our enterprise networking story: static egress identity, egress policy controls, private connectivity, and tenant isolation, in partnership with the engineering teams that operate our fleet.

 - Own enterprise identity and administration: SSO, roles and permissions, org management, and least-privilege integration models.

 - Build the programmatic surface enterprises expect: usage and cost APIs, cost attribution, and integrations into the observability and cost-management tools our customers already run.

 - Sit in on enterprise deals with sales; turn procurement blockers, security questionnaires, and POC feedback into a prioritized roadmap. Own packaging and pricing for the enterprise tier with GTM.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401k match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options.

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US).

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
WE'RE UNLOCKING ACCESS TO THE NHS, BECAUSE HEALTHCARE IS NOT TRULY FREE UNTIL IT'S TRULY ACCESSIBLE 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable https://bookable.health/?utm_source=ashby Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ OUR PRINCIPLES 

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

 1. 💙 Care deeply

 2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

 3. 🤝 Be your word

 4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

 5. 🚀 Do your life's best work

 6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook https://link.ht1.uk/handbook.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

This is for a product-minded full stack senior or staff software engineer who wants to move with extreme urgency and have complete autonomy. You'll help build and scale our product, working across teams and directly with our customers.

 - You are operating at a senior or lead level and have 7+ years of experience

 - You're comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end. You may have a founders/entrepreneurial mindset or have been a technical founder yourself.

 - You’ve experienced a startup or scale up especially at an early stage. You’ve been part of a small squad of high performing engineers and you weren’t just “one of many”.

 - You care deeply about user experience, performance, and simplicity - you seek the feedback loop!

 - You constantly raise the bar for both engineering and product.

 - You pride yourself on producing high quality code which scales effectively into different environments.

 - You understand and mitigate the risks of distributed systems, ensuring code that is failsafe even in the cases where things go wrong.

 - Someone that thrives in autonomy, responsibility, and building things that truly matter.

Tech environment:

 - Fullstack (Backend leaning): TypeScript or similar

 - APIs: Designing and consuming scalable, well-structured services

 - Data: Working with production systems and performance considerations

 - AI: Integrating modern AI models into real-world healthcare workflows

 - Experience in scaling product environments or high-stakes domains (health, finance, infra) is a strong advantage.

What success looks like

 - You ship intuitive, high-quality user experiences that clinicians and patients rely on daily

 - You influence product direction, not just implementation

 - You identify and solve performance and usability challenges before they become problems

 - You become a trusted voice across engineering, product, and design

 - The team delivers faster and better because of you!

What’s on Offer
Salary: £90-130,000k (DOE) + founding-level equity
Location: London (Stratford) - Onsite 4 days

💙 A BIT ABOUT US

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world. 

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception. 

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it. 

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together. 

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London http://DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 AN OPPORTUNITY FOR REAL UPSIDE

jobs.title: Founding Member, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARGON

The next decade belongs to biology. Bio foundation models are turning experimental guesswork into prediction, and the industry built on that science is set to produce more medicine, faster, than at any point in history.

The bottleneck for bringing these medicines to patients will be everything downstream of the science: clinical & regulatory strategy, portfolio decision making, the governance reviews, launch planning. That work is still done by smart people manually assembling context from a hundred sources, and it moves at the speed of headcount.

Argon builds the AI workforce for that layer. Our platform provides workflow automation purpose-built for biopharma commercial and portfolio teams, specialized from the data model up.

We're an early-stage YC-backed company founded in 2024, working with top-tier pharma and several of the largest life sciences consultancies. We're growing quickly, with 7-figure ARR up 5x year-to-date.

We pride ourselves on outsized output, being kind, and balancing excellence and progress. Join us if you want to be productive, move fast, and shape the future.

WHY THIS ROLE

You'd be the first industry hire on the Life Sciences team. The Life Sciences team is the group of industry experts that help bridge industry expertise with AI systems. We are looking for an expert with first-hand experience navigating pharma’s portfolio strategy, governance and commercial operations to help us bridge that critical domain knowledge with our platform.

You will help our partners get value from our software products, drive deployments, and identify use-cases and opportunities to drive our product execution.

Concretely, the split looks like:

 - 40% client-facing business development. Industry events, prospect conversations, and translating what Argon does into the specific decision VPs in Commercial teams are trying to make next quarter.

 - 40% deployment. Hands-on onboarding, training, and working sessions with new and current accounts. You own whether users get real value in the first 60 days.

 - 20% product. You're the voice of the customer in our roadmap. Surface the workflows we're not serving and the gaps between what the current version of Argon can do and what the job actually requires.

This is a founding role. There is no playbook, no established territory, and no one above you who knows this domain better. You'll write the playbook and help to build this function from the ground up.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years in commercial and portfolio strategy in biopharma. Direct biotech or big pharma experience is preferred over pure consulting.

 - Deep working knowledge of pharma's internal governance process for clinical and commercial decision-making with first hand experience seeing how decisions actually get made.

 - Experience running client-facing, multi-stakeholder engagements with real complexity.

 - Genuine comfort operating without structure. The most common way this role fails is someone excellent who needs a defined process to work inside.

 - You already use AI tools in your own work.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Drive business development efforts including attendance of industry events and leading client conversations for tailored use cases of Argon’s platform

 - Lead customer deployments with hands-on training and working sessions to help users get value from the platform quickly

 - Help shape product strategy and roadmap by deeply understanding customer workflows and the gaps in the current product

COMPENSATION

Compensation is dependent on experience and fit. We aim for a culture of competitive market salary and top 10% in equity.

 - Cash compensation: $170,000 – $240,000

 - Equity: .2% - 1%

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

ROLE SUMMARY

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to establish our product analytics function and bring deep analytical rigor to product decision-making. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design on product planning, designing A/B tests, and creating analytics frameworks that enable data-driven product development.

Compensation: 90-110k

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

ABOUT THE ROLE

 - Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Design on product planning, bringing a data lens to ideation and concept evaluation throughout the product development lifecycle

 - Design and structure A/B tests to ensure statistical rigor, including experiment design, sample size calculations, and analysis of results using cohort analysis and causal inference methods

 - Strong product sense with ability to generate product and behavioral hypotheses from data insights and experiment results, translating business questions into structured analytical approaches

 - Excellent communication skills, able to communicate clearly around data insights, limitations, and approaches to technical and non-technical audiences, comfortable using AI tools to enhance analytical output
 
 

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

HIRING PROCESS

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND BELONGING

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT VERITUS

Consumer lending and collections are among the last corners of financial services that AI has not reached. The average collections team still relies on human agents in call centers, dialing as many people as possible. AI can be transformative here, but the regulatory burden makes it very hard for lending and collections teams to put generic AI to work.

Veritus is the solution. We deploy production voice and text agents for consumer lenders and collections agencies, designed from the ground up to be fully compliant and effective in highly regulated conversations. At AWA, one in five collections calls our AI agent handles ends in a payment, 67% of those customers pay on the call itself, and the agent resolves more than 70% of conversations without a human. Read the case study at veritus.com/awa-case-study http://veritus.com/awa-case-study

We are backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, Threshold, Surgepoint and others. We’ve been growing rapidly with founder-led sales, and this is our first full-cycle sales hire.

THE ROLE

You will find your own deals and close them.

Cold calling and conferences are the two strongest channels we have. We publish content, run digital outreach and take inbound as well, but the pipeline that closes tends to start with a rep who dials collections agencies and turns up at the industry events. You will do both, and then you will run what you source all the way to signature.

Outbound. Build the target list, write the sequences, and dial. You own the top of your own funnel, and the best predictor of your success here is how many collections operators you talk to each week.

Conferences and events. RMAI, ACA, Money20/20, LendIt, plus client dinners. Lending and collections is a small world where being known is a real asset. You will work these rooms and own the follow-up that comes out of them.

The whole deal. Discovery, demo, pricing, security review, redlines, signature. The CEO joins the deals that need a founder in the room. You run the rest.

Collections agencies and midsize lenders first. These deals move in weeks rather than quarters, and they are the core of your number.

Enterprise lenders next. Large fintech lenders and credit card issuers are already Veritus clients, and that is the growth path for this role. Those deals take longer and involve more people around the table. Over time they are where your number gets large.

Product input. Every "we already use X", every compliance question you cannot answer, every reason a deal dies comes straight back into the roadmap. You will be closer to the product than anyone outside engineering.

WHO YOU ARE

Two or more years selling, including at least one closing your own deals. You do not need a long track record. You do need to have taken deals from first conversation to signature yourself. If you have only ever booked meetings for someone else to close, this is not the right seat yet. If you have been an AE with an SDR feeding you and would rather not prospect, it is the wrong job too.

You will pick up the phone. Willingly. Cold calls are still the fastest way into a mid-sized prospect.

You will travel for events. Conferences are where this industry meets, and we expect you to come back from them with pipeline.

You already use AI every day. Claude should already be doing your account research, working out who actually owns collections at a target, drafting outreach that reads like a person wrote it, and pulling apart your call recordings. Show us what you have built.

You will learn the rules. FDCPA, TCPA, CFPB, right-party contact, roll rates, recovery rate. You do not need to know any of it on day one. You do need to be the kind of person who reads the regulation instead of guessing at it, because our clients get fined when vendors guess.

You are in San Francisco, in person. You will sit next to the CEO. Early sales teams learn faster in a room together.

Low ego, high standards. Calls get reviewed candidly here, from the CEO down. You should want that.

TOOLS YOU WILL USE ON DAY ONE

Claude for account research, outreach, call transcript analysis and industry briefings. HubSpot for CRM and pipeline. Apollo for contact data and sequencing. Granola for meeting notes. LinkedIn Sales Navigator for contact discovery. Plus whatever we build internally next, which you get first access to and will help us create.

WHY THIS ROLE, RIGHT NOW

Veritus is growing quickly and there are now more deals in front of us than founder-led sales can run. We are the clear leader in this segment, and the constraint on growth is selling capacity.

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT INTERFERE

Interfere is building the self-healing layer of the internet: software that detects broken product experiences, understands what caused them, and helps teams fix them before users notice. Modern teams have logs, dashboards, traces, and session replay. They still find out about too many problems from their users. We exist to close that gap for engineers, PMs, designers, and founders who care how their product actually works in the real world. The product surface is large. The category is still being defined. The people who join now will shape the standards and the operating system of the company. We've raised $5.1M from Y Combinator, Vercel Ventures, Hummingbird, Designer Fund, and others. We're in person in New York City.

THE ROLE

You will own end-to-end features, from data model to interface, that define how the best teams understand and fix their products. You'll architect core systems, design the surfaces engineers actually use, and decide what "excellent" means for a category that doesn't exist yet.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Detection and diagnosis systems that reason about codebases and runtime behavior at scale

 - Developer-facing interfaces that make complex system failures legible in seconds

 - Pipelines that ingest, structure, and correlate billions of product events

 - Agentic workflows that triage issues and propose or ship fixes safely

 - APIs and integrations that meet developers inside the tools they already use

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've shipped production software that real users depend on, end to end, across the stack.

 - You move comfortably between frontend behavior, backend systems, and the seams between them.

 - You can take an ambiguous product or infrastructure problem, define the next useful step, and ship without waiting for a fully specified plan.

 - You can explain complex system behavior clearly enough that engineers, designers, and PMs can make the right decision quickly.

 - You are willing to stay with hard problems long enough to understand them deeply, not just route around them.

NICE TO HAVE

 - You are fluent in TypeScript and modern web tooling (Next.js, React, Node).

 - Built or operated systems handling high-throughput event data

 - Shipped agentic or LLM-powered features into production

 - Distributed systems depth, or strong eye for product and UI craft (either is a strong asset; both is rare and valuable)

STRONG SIGNALS

 - A product, tool, or system you built that other engineers chose to use

 - Open-source work, technical writing, or research with real depth

 - Took on more scope than your title suggested at a previous company

 - Started something from zero: a company, a team, a product line

 - Picked up an unfamiliar domain quickly and shipped something good in it

 - A portfolio piece (code, product, writing) where the taste is obvious in the first 30 seconds

HOW WE WORK

We're in-person in New York City. We move quickly, write clearly, and expect high ownership. We care about the difference between something that works and something that is excellent. We expect you to push back when you disagree, and to do the work to be right when you do.

COMPENSATION AND LOGISTICS

 - Founding-team equity and competitive cash compensation (specific ranges shared in first conversation)

 - Health, dental, and vision

 - Visa sponsorship for exceptional international candidates

 - We'll help you move to New York

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Intro conversation with a founder

 2. Technical deep-dive on past work

 3. Paid project or pairing session on a real Interfere problem

 4. Onsite with the team in New York

 5. References and offer — we move fast and tell you where you stand

HOW TO APPLY

Send us your resume or LinkedIn, plus one piece of work we should look at: a repo, a live product, a technical essay, a side project, a postmortem. We want to see how you think and build. A short note on why Interfere helps, but the work matters more.

 - The context engineering that lets a model actually understand a customer's codebase: retrieval, indexing, context construction, and the integrations into their stack

 - Systems that get sharper over time, turning every bug found and fixed into signal that improves the next detection, so continual learning is a product advantage rather than an afterthought

 - You've shipped ML or LLM-powered systems into production, where real users depend on the output, not just a notebook or a demo

 - You can own something 0→1, beginning to end. You can take an ambiguous AI problem, define the next useful step, and ship without waiting for a fully specified plan

 - You treat evals as a first-class engineering problem. When the system is making decisions for users, intuition isn't a substitute for measurement

 - Experience with agent architectures, tool use, multi-step reasoning, or autonomous workflows in production

NICE TO HAVE

 - Background in code understanding, program analysis, or systems that reason over source code

 - Built retrieval, RAG, or context-construction systems against large or messy data

 - Anomaly detection, time-series modeling, or learned monitoring systems experience

 - Internalized understanding of AI/ML systems - a heightened understanding of the inner workings of the systems you'll be building

STRONG SIGNALS

 - An agentic system you built that other engineers actually chose to use, or that ran in production at meaningful scale

 - Open-source work, technical writing, or research with real depth — bonus if it shows where you disagree with the consensus

 - You've shipped agents or LLM features into production and have informed opinions about what works, what's hype, and what's still broken

 - You designed and ran evals that materially changed the trajectory of a product or research direction

 - You started something from zero, whether a research direction, a product feature, or an internal tool

 - You dropped into an unfamiliar domain, whether a new modality, a new codebase, or a new sub-field, and shipped real work in it fast

HOW WE WORK

 - We're in person in New York City. The hardest parts of building Interfere, from system design to architecture tradeoffs to taste calls on the product, happen faster and better at a whiteboard with people physically in the same room.

 - We measure work, not hours. Time at a desk is a poor proxy for whether work is getting done. But there's a lot to do and genuine urgency to being the category winners. Most people who do well here end up putting in serious hours because the problems are interesting and the upside is real.

It's your job to make your work into what it needs to be.

Full-time, hybrid | Dallas, TX; Fort Worth, TX; Miami, FL; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL; Cincinnati, OH; Cleveland, OH; Long Island, NY preferred

 - Infectious charisma and professional presence in front of senior executives.

 - High EQ and the ability to think in second-order effects.

 - Able to be in the field minimum 3 days a week

 - Valid driver's license, reliable vehicle, and current auto insurance.

 - Comfortable walking into a building cold and talking your way into the room of whoever runs it

NICE TO HAVE

 - Sharp judgment about who the real decision-maker is and how to reach them.

 - Coachable. We iterate the playbook weekly while you help write it.

COMPENSATION

 - Base pay: local minimum wage

 - $500 per qualified meeting. $500 for every qualified decision-maker meeting (C-suite, SVP, or VP) you book that is held. Uncapped.

 - $1,000 per meeting above quota. Once you exceed monthly quota, each additional qualified meeting that is booked and held pays $1,000 in place of the standard $500 rate.

 - Two decision-maker meetings a week clears $135,000 a year. Match the door rate our own team hits, about one meeting per field day, and you hit around $250,000. Zero means base only, and if that is your trajectory, this is the wrong job.

20-minute phone screen → 45-minute interview with role-play → Final interview with a founder, including a live door simulation

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
THE PROBLEM

36 million businesses in America need insurance—it's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflows—by building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this year—and that's why we're hiring.

You'll ship AI-powered product features end-to-end. Real systems, real users, real revenue—the same week you write the code.

THE THESIS

Turning judgment into compute isn't a one-time project. It's a constant hunt for leverage. New models drop monthly. What was impossible in January is table stakes by June. Someone needs to be on the frontier—figuring out what's newly possible and applying it before anyone else does.

The best product engineers here don't just write features. They embed with the operators who live inside the systems—sales, service, underwriting—find where things break, and build the AI-powered solution before anyone else notices the problem. Your code doesn't sit in a repo. It runs the business.

THE ROLE

You're a full-stack engineer with applied-AI fluency. Frontend, backend, agents, evals—you move across the stack because the problems don't respect stack boundaries. You optimize for user and business impact, not code elegance. You treat AI tooling as a core part of the workflow, not a novelty.

You work directly with founders. No committee. No approval chain. You build it, you ship it, you own the outcome. Prototype Monday, ship Tuesday, measure Wednesday. If it works, push to production. If not, try something else.

We are hiring product engineers across all levels, which we determine during the interview process.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship AI-powered features end-to-end — Frontend, backend, agents, and evals; you own the whole thing, not a slice

 - Embed with operators — Sit with sales, service, and underwriting; find what's broken before they tell you

 - Build systems that compound — Every decision gets traced; every outcome feeds back; the AI gets smarter with each interaction

 - Stay on the frontier — New model drops? You're testing it that day. New capability lands? You're the one who ships it

 - Move fast with AI tooling — Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next; manage multiple coding sessions to compress weeks into days

 - Own the metric, not the feature — "We increased conversion by 15%," not "we shipped the thing"

 - Prove impact — Set up metrics, track results, present what worked to the company

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF...

 - You get energy from user and business impact, not code elegance

 - You write code with AI (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf) and can manage multiple coding sessions

 - You're full-stack by instinct—frontend, backend, and the AI layer that makes decisions

 - You've shipped AI to production—real systems serving real users, not demos

 - You ship fast and iterate—meaningful features in days that others take months on

 - You can present to non-technical people and explain why a metric moved

REQUIREMENTS

 - Software engineering experience shipping production systems (level determined during interviews)

 - Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or similar

 - Experience building and shipping AI-powered features—LLM applications, agent pipelines, or workflow automation

 - Ability to work across the stack: frontend, backend, and the AI layer

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate

NICE TO HAVE

 - Voice AI or real-time systems experience

 - RAG, agent frameworks, or evaluation systems

 - Background in operations tooling, sales tech, or workflow automation

 - Prior startup experience

COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS

 - Salary: $140,000–$280,000 depending on experience + performance bonuses & equity

 - Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based in SF or willing to relocate.

 - Schedule: Monday–Friday, very early morning start, in-office five days a week.

 - Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks, drinks, and coffee daily; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision insurance.

THE PROCESS

 1. Technical screen — 60 min remote: project deep dive + system design

 2. Super Day on-site — meet the team, sit in on the operation, do real work alongside us.
 
 

TO APPLY

If you want to build AI capabilities against business problems you discover yourself, ship code that runs a real business, and work with people who show up with the same intensity every day—send your resume and a link to something you've built that had measurable business impact.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About Bland AI

Bland AI is the voice AI platform built for enterprises with high-volume, complex call center operations. Bland started by solving the core infrastructure problem that made voice AI unusable for business: latency, reliability, and the inability to handle real-world complexity. Where early voice AI took 7 seconds to respond and could only handle basic FAQs, Bland built the entire stack from scratch.

 

Today, Bland's platform fully resolves up to 65% of inbound calls autonomously – handling not just FAQs, but multi-step workflows, authentication logic, business-rule-based routing, and live data lookups. For large call center operators, each percentage point of resolution Bland drives is worth $500K–$1M+ per year in savings. Bland's biggest technical differentiator: they own and operate the entire voice AI stack in-house – transcription, LLM, and TTS – rather than relying on third-party API providers. This is a deliberate architectural choice that enables the uptime guarantees, data security standards, and customization depth that regulated industries require.

 

Why This Role Matters

We are roughly 80 people today and operate with a very lean internal team. There is currently one person in finance. This role exists because the company needs someone who can help build the financial and operational foundation as we grow.

This is not the most glamorous role and it is not narrowly defined. You will do a lot of everything. The work is foundational, sometimes repetitive, and often unstructured. It is also one of the best ways to learn how a startup actually works.

 

Role Overview

Day to day, this role requires strong organization and comfort working in low context environments. Often, you will be given problems, not instructions. You will regularly need to figure out what the right next step even is before executing.

Much of your time will be spent supporting compensation plans and commissions, building reporting and dashboards, analyzing bookings and revenue trends, helping with budgeting and forecasting, and improving the systems the company uses to make decisions. You’ll partner closely with accounting, sales, and operations to ensure leadership has accurate data and actionable insights.

You will work across teams and functions and will regularly interact with leadership. Because the finance function is largely unbuilt, there is direct visibility into how decisions are made and how the business operates. You will see the full picture earlier than most people in their careers.

Over time, as you build trust and ownership, this role can expand significantly. You may take on larger projects, help define processes, or move into more strategic finance or operations work.

Ideal Candidate Profile / Role Requirements

This role is for someone early in their career who wants responsibility and learning over polish and prestige.

You should have some exposure to finance, accounting, operations, consulting, or a related field, but deep experience is not required. What matters more is that you care, you are capable, and you follow through.

You should be comfortable with ambiguity. Startups are chaotic. Things change. Systems are imperfect. You should be energized by that rather than frustrated by it.

You should have strong problem solving instincts and be willing to do unglamorous work well. The people who succeed here are the ones who treat small details seriously and take pride in making things work.

 

Must-Have Experience

• Bachelors degree in Finance, Economics, or a related track

• Strong financial foundation, including comfort in Power BI, Excel, and other tools

• Highly self-directed — does not need heavy management or a fully built playbook to be effective

 

Nice-to-Have Experience

• 1+ years experience in IB (Tech focus preferred), in a finance role at a high growth start-up, or an equivalent role

• Experience with accounting, FP&A, and revenue recognition

• Experience with M&A or strategic financial projects

 

Compensation & Benefits

 - Salary range is 80,000 to 135,000 dollars depending on experience.

 - Equity range is 50,000 to 150,000 dollars.

 - Health insurance, dental, vision, and a 401K is provided.

 - Unlimited PTO.

This is a role for someone with energy, curiosity, strong technical instincts, and a real give a f*ck factor who wants to build something real and grow fast while doing it.

This is a full-time, in-person role based in San Francisco. Candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: General Manager, Sandboxes
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 10,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 20x so far in 2026.

 - We’ve raised $125M from Seed to Series C, led by Sequoia, Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.
 

THE ROLE

Blacksmith is building the fastest cloud for code: the infra layer where software gets run, tested, and fixed. As AI makes code generation cheaper, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to running it quickly, at scale. Every agent workflow needs a fast, isolated place to run.

We are hiring a General Manager to build Blacksmith’s Sandboxes business.

You will own the business end-to-end: product strategy, customer development, go-to-market, pricing, partnerships, adoption, revenue, unit economics, and team-building.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will work directly with Blacksmith’s founders and engineering team to make Blacksmith the default execution platform for AI agents and software work.

The role should feel like building a new infrastructure company, except you will start with Blacksmith’s compute and storage fleet, execution stack, customers, capital, and distribution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop a clear view of the sandbox market, customers, product, and how Blacksmith wins.

 - Work directly with early customers building agents and other code-execution products, turning their needs into the roadmap.

 - Make Blacksmith the default sandbox provider for AI startups, developer companies, and larger enterprises.

 - Build repeatable acquisition, onboarding, retention, and expansion motions.

 - Own pricing, packaging, partnerships, adoption, revenue, and unit economics.

 - Establish Blacksmith as the technical and commercial leader in sandbox infrastructure.

 - Recruit and lead a dedicated cross-functional team.

WHO YOU ARE

You may be a former founder, an early leader at a developer-infrastructure company, or someone who has built a technical product from zero to meaningful adoption.

You are:

 - Technically credible with engineers and technical founders.

 - Strong across both product and go-to-market.

 - Exceptionally ambitious and hungry to build something enormous, not merely launch a successful product.

 - Comfortable personally selling, onboarding customers, and doing unscalable work before a mature motion exists.

 - Highly urgent, hands-on, and effective in ambiguous environments.

 - Able to move between strategy, customer conversations, product decisions, and execution.

 - Excited to own an entire business rather than a single function.

You do not need to be a systems engineer, but you should be fluent in developer platforms, distributed systems, workload isolation, infrastructure economics, APIs, reliability, and security.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

 - You have primarily managed mature products with established product-market fit.

 - You want to build a large team before personally doing the work.

 - You need a well-defined roadmap or organizational structure to make progress.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
MEMBER OF TECHNICAL STAFF

Inference performance depends on how efficiently models use the underlying hardware. Techniques across kernels, compilers, runtimes, and serving systems can dramatically improve latency and throughput, but these optimizations are difficult, hardware-specific, and slow to reproduce across new accelerators. And none of it counts until it is running in a customer's production traffic.

At Wafer, we are building AI systems that automatically optimize inference workloads across silicon. The goal is fungible token capacity. Any accelerator optimized toward serving inference most efficiently.

Wafer is well funded and serves trillions of tokens a month for mission critical workloads. We serve the highest performance inference to fast-growing AI startups.

Members of Technical Staff build the systems that make that possible and own the customers running on them. There is no separate solutions team, and no layer between you and the workload.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and optimize high-performance computing kernels, and work across inference engine internals and serving infrastructure

 - Develop AI agents to do autonomous inference engineering

 - Design, deploy, and operate heterogeneous clusters across vendors

 - Own customer accounts end to end. Sales gets the first meeting. From there you decide what to prove, you build it, you keep it running in production, and you carry the relationship

 - Win the technical evaluation. Prove Wafer on the customer's own workload rather than a synthetic benchmark, and be the person who can explain the result to their engineers

 - Own production for your accounts. When latency moves or error rates climb, you find it, you fix it or route it, and you are who the customer hears from

 - Inform product roadmap. You sit closer than anyone to how Wafer behaves under real load, and the engineering team builds against what you report

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You are an exceptional engineer. You have shipped and operated production systems, and you can still open a profiler, read a trace, and find the problem yourself. Inference experience helps, but it matters more that you can be handed an unfamiliar system and own it inside a week.

 - You have owned a customer relationship. You can name an account that was yours, say what was going wrong, and describe what you personally did about it.

 - You are credible in a room full of engineers. You can take a skeptical ML team through a benchmark, defend the methodology, and concede the point when they are right.

 - You work without a spec. The problem arrives half-defined from a customer who does not yet know what they need, and you come back with a scoped answer rather than a list of questions.

 

HOW WE EVALUATE

We score every candidate on seven values:

 1. Infinitely Resourceful

 2. Exceptionalism

 3. Unreasonable Standards

 4. Company Over Self

 5. High EQ

 6. Learns Quickly

 7. First Principles Thinker

 

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $250K + generous equity.

 - Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Daily lunch and dinner, unlimited PTO, and parental leave.

 - $1K/month housing stipend (post-tax) if you live within walking distance (0.5 miles) from the office.

 - Covered Uber/Waymo from/to office.

 - Relocation allowance and benefits.

 - Visa sponsorship available.

 

HOW WE WORK

On-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Small team with massive surface area and ownership. You operate with complete autonomy of how to solve problems. We don't see engineers as code writers, but as problem solvers. You will work across the stack to build a company scaling extremely quickly.

This is not a role that lives in meetings. Nearly all of your time is engineering. What makes it different is who that engineering is for: you are responsible for a named set of customers, their workloads run on what you build, and you are the person they hear from when it matters.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for consumer lending. We work with some of America's largest banks and mortgage lenders, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $1 billion in transactions and are backed by Y Combinator and Commerce Ventures. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’re joining at an inflection point. Our usage has grown 40x in the last 6 months and our customers view us as their enterprise AI partner and want us to transform their operations across different lines of business. To help support that we are founding our product team and hiring for leaders to own product for one business vertical each. You will start by partnering closely with customers to build new features for our existing originations agents, guide deployments, support adoption and ensure they have the tools and insight they need to achieve meaningful outcomes. Overtime you will own the product strategy, product execution, integrations, and partnerships for the originations vertical to deliver an end-to-end AI originations platform. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the originations product line end to end — roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for both of our AI origination agents

 - Work directly with AI engineers on failure modes, eval criteria, and the judgment calls of autonomy — when the agent acts, when it asks, when it escalates

 - Own deployments of your product: project-manage post-sale implementations, drive customer adoption, and be the reason the exec sponsor's rollout worked

 - Close the loop from field reality back into the roadmap

 - Own originations product marketing. Positioning, demo narrative, case studies from live deployments.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in product management, or equivalent ownership as a founder, engagement manager, or operator who shipped real product

 - You've built with LLMs hands-on — you can write and critique prompts, reason about evals, and engage engineers on how, not just what

 - A metrics habit: every claim you make about your product traces to instrumentation you made sure existed

 - You've owned customer-facing outcomes, not just internal roadmaps — deployments, implementations, or embedded work with enterprise customers

 - You write persuasively enough that an EVP forwards it internally

 - Comfort in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you build it

Experience in mortgage, lending, or another regulated industry is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you originations faster than we can teach product instinct.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Whether our origination agents beat the best human baseline on the same work — conversion, cycle time, touches per file, error rates. Whether customers are live, adopted, and expanding on both agents. 

HOW WE WORK

Small team, high bar. You'll have full ownership of a product line with top 10 lenders live on it from day one. 

Why join Kastle

 - Opportunity to work with a world class team building a generational AI company that will redefine how every loan in America is made and managed

 - Ability to move fast while your work impacting millions of customers. Add a new feature in a few days and ship it to top 10 lenders the next week.

 - Competitive Compensation + Meaningful Equity at a high growth company

 - High ownership and direct input on product direction, company culture, and how the FDE function scales

 

Other Perks and Benefits

 - Covered Health and Wellness Memberships

 - Robust medical, vision, & dental coverage

 - 401(K) plan offering

 - Paid Company Meals

 - Company offsites to get to know the team

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Ziina is searching for a dynamic Head of Marketing to lead our strategic product-led growth initiatives. This includes product marketing, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

This role is ideal for a data-driven, creative leader who can develop and execute impactful marketing strategies while inspiring a high-performing team. We are seeking a versatile marketing leader with a full-stack background, with deep expertise in product marketing—including positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution—while also combining creative flair with analytical acumen to position Ziina as the go-to payments solution in the region. The ideal candidate should have a track record of success in both startup environments and scaling organizations.

This is simultaneously a hands-on role while leading a phenomenal team of passionate high performers. We expect this role to lead by example by rolling their sleeves up and diving into the details including how every pixel aligns on the latest ad.

AS A HEAD OF MARKETING AT ZIINA YOU WILL:

 - Own product positioning and messaging strategy, translating Ziina's payment features into compelling customer benefits that drive adoption and differentiate us in the fintech market.

 - Lead comprehensive go-to-market execution for new product launches, coordinating cross-functional teams and establishing measurable success metrics for user adoption and retention.

 - Build data-driven quarterly marketing roadmaps aligned with company growth objectives, including strategic budget allocation across channels and initiatives.

 - Drive multi-channel customer acquisition through paid media, content marketing, social media, and partnership strategies while optimizing for healthy CAC payback periods.

 - Establish and maintain marketing analytics frameworks to continuously optimize campaign performance, forecast business impact, and inform strategic decision-making.

 - Craft Ziina's brand narrative and storytelling that positions us as the go-to payments solution in the region through high-quality, creative content.

 - Build and lead a high-performing marketing team, providing coaching, setting clear goals, and fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and data-driven results.

 - Facilitate seamless cross-functional collaboration with product, sales, and executive teams to ensure alignment on messaging, goals, and strategic initiatives.

 - Conduct customer research and competitive analysis to inform product positioning, messaging frameworks, and marketing strategies that resonate with target audiences.

 - Manage marketing budgets strategically, allocating resources across channels and campaigns to achieve maximum ROI and sustainable, scalable growth.

 - Oversee creative asset development with strong aesthetic vision, ensuring all marketing materials maintain brand consistency and premium quality standards.

 - Select and manage external vendor relationships, including agencies and consultants, while maintaining high delivery standards and alignment with marketing objectives.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE YOU LIKELY HAVE:

 - 7+ years of progressive marketing experience with a proven track record of scaling growth in startup or high-growth environments, including demonstrated success in product marketing leadership roles

 - Strategic thinking beyond immediate needs, developing and implementing medium to long-term marketing strategies that scale effectively as the business grows

 - Deep go-to-market expertise, with experience driving successful product launches and scaling user adoption across multiple channels and customer segments

 - Experience in leading and inspiring teams, with strong mentorship skills and a focus on empowering team members to achieve peak performance and professional growth

 - High data fluency, with expertise in marketing analytics and a demonstrated ability to use metrics for forecasting, optimization, and strategic decision-making

 - The ability to combine creative flair with growth mindset, bringing natural aesthetic sense and innovative thinking to develop tailored marketing solutions that drive results

 - Confidence and decisiveness, comfortable pushing back when necessary and prioritizing initiatives that align with long-term brand vision and business objectives

 - Exceptional communication skills, with strong verbal and written skills that enable you to engage stakeholders and convey complex marketing concepts clearly

 - Resilience and problem-solving ability, with a proactive, organized approach to overcoming challenges and managing risks in a fast-paced environment

 - Passion for fintech innovation, with genuine excitement about shaping the future of payments in the Middle East through creative, data-driven marketing
