 Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness. 
 Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles. 

 
What You'll Bring: 
 Required Qualifications: 

 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems. 
 Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes 
 Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems. 
 Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis. 
 Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.

This position will work across engineering disciplines to establish reliability requirements, manage system reliability budgets, perform reliability analyses, and identify design improvements that increase aircraft availability and mission success.
The successful candidate will have direct experience working on aircraft or other complex aerospace systems and be proficient with industry-standard reliability tools and methods. This engineer will serve as the primary reliability point of contact for assigned programs and communicate reliability performance, risks, and improvement plans to engineering leadership and customers.

What You'll Do: 

 Develop and maintain aircraft-level reliability requirements, objectives, and program reliability plans. 
 Establish, allocate, and manage reliability budgets across systems, subsystems, and line-replaceable units. 
 Track predicted reliability against program targets and identify components or subsystems driving reliability risk. 
 Perform reliability predictions using component failure-rate data, operating environments, and mission profiles. 
 Conduct Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) analysis. 
 Support aircraft system safety assessments by providing failure rates, failure modes, and reliability data. 
 Develop and maintain Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF), mission reliability, availability, and related reliability metrics. 
 Perform reliability allocation, trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and design assessments. 
 Lead or support Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) activities. 
 Analyze ground-test, flight-test, supplier, maintenance, and field-performance data to identify reliability trends. 
 Apply Weibull analysis and other statistical methods to evaluate failure behavior and predict component life. 
 Work with design teams to eliminate single-point failures, reduce high-risk failure modes, and improve fault tolerance. 
 Review supplier reliability analyses, test results, and supporting technical data. 
 Define reliability demonstration and growth-test requirements, success criteria, and data-collection needs. 
 Support technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and reliability review boards. 
 Communicate reliability performance, budget status, assumptions, risks, and recommended corrective actions to customers and program leadership. 
 Mentor junior engineers and improve organizational reliability processes, tools, and standards. 

 
What You'll Bring: 
 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor’s degree in reliability engineering, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field 
 5+ years of related experience in reliability engineering, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field 
 Direct experience supporting aircraft development, integration, testing, sustainment, or operations. 
 Experience developing and managing reliability budgets at the system, subsystem, or equipment level. 
 Proficiency with reliability methods such as FMEA/FMECA, FTA, RBD, Weibull analysis, reliability predictions, and FRACAS. 
 Familiarity with reliability metrics such as MTBF, MTBCF, failure rate, mission reliability, operational availability, and inherent availability. 
 Experience using reliability analysis tools such as ReliaSoft, Windchill Quality Solutions, Isograph, RAM Commander, or equivalent. 
 Ability to interpret aircraft mission profiles, operating environments, duty cycles, and test data. 
 Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and suppliers. 
 Strong analytical, technical writing, presentation, and customer communication skills.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist
jobs.description:
About Us:
You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you’ll help scale cures to patients that need them sooner.
We’ve developed fully-automated cell manufacturing sites powered by custom robotics - to scale therapies to millions of patients. Last year, patients were cured of diseases like Parkinson’s Disease and vision loss using stem-cell derived cells - but today these Regenerative Medicines are produced by hand, meaning they’re too expensive and hard to scale. With our automated CDMO, these therapies can now be scaled globally at low cost.
We've announced partnerships across multiple therapies so far ranging from Parkinson’s, to hearing loss, to bone repair - and raised $24m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development! Within the next 12-18 months, neurons grown on our machines will be going into Parkinson’s patient brains.
We’ve assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. You can learn more about your potential Mytos teammates here: Team
Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks.

The Role:: 
 We are looking for a hands-on Associate Scientist to join our Biology team and help push the limits of automation in cell therapy manufacture. . You'll work alongside our scientists and engineers, with mentoring from senior scientists, and generate the data that shapes how our processes and platforms develop. Your work will feed directly into process development, new platform R&D and the running of the lab that makes it all possible. 
 This is a unique opportunity to build your career at the interface of engineering and biology. You'll start with well-defined, SOP-based work packages and, through structured training grow towards independent execution. 
 
Core Responsibilities:: 

 Research and Development – Run experiments across process development, product testing and new platform R&D, then present your results to the team. Your data will help decide how our processes and platforms evolve. 
 Cell culture – Help maintain the team's iPSC lines and differentiation cultures, including feeding, passaging, cryopreservation and banking. Every experiment we run is built on these cells, and you'll learn to culture them to a high standard. 
 Lab operations – Keep the lab running as part of the maintenance rota (stock checks, waste, autoclaving, cleaning hoods, incubators and shared equipment), and own the upkeep of your assigned equipment. Fast, reliable science depends on a well-run lab, and everyone on the team contributes. 

 
Skills & Experience: 
 Required: 

 BSc or MSc in Cell Biology, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline 
 Hands-on laboratory experience in mammalian cell culture with strong aseptic technique. 
 Experience running standard assays for cell characterisation (e.g. cell counts and viability, flow cytometry, plate reader based assays), and preparing reagents and media accurately. 
 Strong attention to detail: you follow SOPs consistently, document your work to a high standard, and spot and report deviations, unexpected results or equipment issues promptly. 
 Understanding of good experimental design principles, including the role of controls and replicates.

jobs.title: Field Maintenance Specialist (Brazil only)
jobs.description:
About Pyka
Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.
To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. 
We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.
Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce C02 emissions in their respective industries. 
What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. 

Role Overview
Pyka is looking for a Field Maintenance Specialist to support the development and commercial deployments of its advanced autonomous aircraft. This position requires a proactive, hands-on person with a strong technical background and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is adaptable, detail-oriented, and capable of thriving in dynamic field and test environments.
As a Field Maintenance Specialist, you will report directly to the Brazil Maintenance Manager and play an active role in the preparation and execution of maintenance for our fleet of deployed autonomous aircraft within Brazil .
Your duties will vary significantly from week to week depending on our operations schedules and the needs of our customers. This position plays a critical role in maintaining fleet readiness, supporting field operations, and providing technical feedback to inform design and manufacturing decisions. You’ll be deeply integrated with our Engineering, Testing, and Operations teams, and your contributions will directly impact aircraft reliability, safety, and product evolution. Finally, you will support Pyka's agricultural fleet in Brazil in various locations.

Responsibilities: 
 Troubleshoot, repair, and test the aircraft's electrical and mechanical subsystems, including motors, ESCs, batteries, sensors, actuator, and onboard computer Inspect and execute field repairs on composite structures (carbon and glass fibers). 
 Execute preventive and corrective maintenance, as well as pre and post-flight inspections, and field repairs in accordance with Pyka procedures. 
 Document all technical interventions to ensure fleet-wide traceability and quality control Develop, review, and update operational procedures and support ongoing development of Pyka aircraft maintenance manuals 
 Act as a technical interface with the engineering team in the US, reporting field performance and proposing product improvements. 
 Occasionally support logistics and transportation planning for operations and customer deliveries 
 Service the client fleet in various regions of Brazil, requiring frequent travel and periods of independent work. Provide On-call support to Pyka’s deployed teams debugging and troubleshooting mechanical issues with the Pyka system 
 Conduct basic maintenance and inspection training program for pilots and partners 

Minimum Requirements: 

 Solid practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

 Lamination and repair of composites (carbon, glass, epoxy, infusion, or vacuum processes), with previous experience in the nautical, automotive, aeromodeling sectors, or academic projects (e.g., AeroDesign, Formula SAE). 
 Assembly and maintenance of fixed wing aircraft, multirotor drones, or FPV systems. 
 Applied electronics: soldering, crimping, wire harness manufacturing, and the use of measuring instruments (multimeter, continuity, voltage, and current). 
 Maintenance of vehicles and/or robotic systems 

 Solid knowledge of drone architecture: flight controllers, GPS/RTK systems, ESCs, BLDC motors, telemetry, and log analysis (experience with ArduPilot or PX4 is a plus). 
 Aptitude to operate safely with basic high voltage systems of 120 VDC, 20 ~ 30 kW 
 Analytical and methodical profile for problem-solving (troubleshooting), ensuring root cause isolation and validation before aircraft release. 
 Excellent organization and attention to detail, for the documentary recording of maintenance logs. Full availability for travel and staying in rural areas. 
 Driver’s license (Category B / Standard car license). 

 
Preferred Qualifications: 
 Degree or technical certification in Electronics, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics, Mechanics, or related fields. 
 Portfolio of practical projects highlighting a maker profile, prototyping, or 3D printing. 
 Intermediate English, with the ability to communicate directly (written and verbal) with the international engineering team. 
 ANAC certification is strongly preferred, but not required.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
About Mytos

You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you'll help scale cures to patients that need them sooner.
We've developed fully-automated cell manufacturing sites, powered by custom robotics - to scale treatments to millions of patients. Last year, patients were cured of diseases like Parkinson's and vision loss using stem-cell derived cells - but today these Regenerative Medicines are produced by hand, meaning they're too expensive and hard to scale.
With our automated manufacturing sites, these therapies can now be scaled globally at low cost. We've announced partnerships across multiple therapies so far ranging from Parkinson's, to hearing loss, to bone repair - and raised $37m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development! Within the next 12 months, neurons grown on our machines will be going into Parkinson's patient brains.
We've assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks

The Role: 
 This is a foundational role for the BD team and you’ll be joining on the ground floor of a business that is helping scale regenerative medicines to as many patients as possible. Having entered the regenerative medicine space only 2 years ago we have already established ourselves as a leader and developed a groundswell of market support in the field. Your job is to take what we’ve proven out and maximise the surface area of opportunity for the company by scaling our Proof of Value (PoV) study framework. 
 This role reports directly to our Co-Founder & CCO, Ignacio. 
 
What you’ll be doing: 
 
 
 Driving top-of-funnel through dogged and creative prospecting through to close. This is a full-funnel role where you will generate your own pipeline. We do not have SDRs or a marketing team yet so you’ll need to apply the hunter mindset that has gotten us the success to date. 
 
 
 Running discovery with scientific and economic buyers. You'll be across the table from VPs of Manufacturing, Heads of CMC, CEOs and founders and you'll need to be credible with all of them quickly and authentically. 
 
 
 Selling on value vs price or features. Teams work with us because we buy them time to data, market and scale. If you sell on a feature list or by negotiating against yourself, this isn’t for you. 
 
 
 Qualifying deeply and killing dead deals fast. We run MEDDPICC-style with go/no-go calls to protect the pipeline. Happy ears will lose you time and opportunities. 
 
 
 Working with our internal teams and customer teams to design effective proof of value studies that prove the technical fit and the ROI of our platform at a level executives will understand. You’ll keep internal and external teams organised, up to date and running on time. 
 
 
 What you learn in the field changes what we build and how we do business. You'll be expected to capture and share insights. 
 
 
 Working the floor. Conferences, events and dinners are some of our highest ROI activities. You’ll prepare the target list, execute outreach, chase down prospects and earn customer trust by being helpful and helping them succeed with our team and product. 
 
 
 Going above and beyond to win customers' trust and make their programme succeed. For example, helping your customer find a critical consultant or finding a key supplier for our team to make our offering fit their needs. 
 

 
What you’ll need to demonstrate: 
 
 
 Multiple years selling complex deals into biotech, cell and gene therapy, bioprocessing, CDMO services, or life-science tools. Deal sizes from six to seven figures with multi-stakeholder buying processes. 
 
 
 A track record of selling an innovation from a company few have heard of. If your numbers came from a brand that opened doors for you, this will be a tough gig. 
 
 
 High ownership in a low-resource environment . You've built your own lists, written your own decks, built your own ROI models and you’re hungry and willing to do work that sits outside the usual job description. 
 
 
 Enough scientific fluency to earn trust. 
 
 
 Willingness to travel up to 40% of time including to the UK, Asia and across the US. 
 
 
 Rigour under speed . 
 
 
 Grit. The hours can be long but you’re driven by the patient impact your work has.

We believe that as a supply chain manager, you’d be hard pressed to find a more interesting and impactful problem to work on. We'd love to hear from you if you think you would enjoy:: 
 Building a supply chain that gives Mytos the ability to deliver accessible cures to patients. This includes lower COGS, shorter lead times, resilient supply, and a supplier base ready for GMP regulatory scrutiny. 
 Working across two tech stacks: electromechanical automation systems with custom robotics, and sterile fluidic plastic consumables made to GMP standards. You'll own the supply chain for both. 
 A foundational, hands-on role setting strategy: who we buy from, what we pay, and how we plan for scale. This can span from negotiating a volume deal with a third-party manufacturer to keeping on top of incoming orders to catch manufacturer delays early. 

 You'll report to our Hardware Lead and work closely with manufacturing, biology, engineering, operations, quality and finance. 
What you'll be doing: 
 Own purchasing, invoicing and inventory end to end, from requisition and PO through to goods-in and invoice resolution. 
 Find creative ways to remove unnecessary COGS through sourcing, negotiation, competitive tendering and make-vs-buy decisions. 
 Qualify alternative suppliers and remove single-source risk on critical components. 
 Own our consumables supply chain and third-party manufacturer relationship through GMP validation and into scaled production. This includes working with our engineering team on COCs, NCs and change notifications. 
 Build on our ERP/MRP system and set up demand planning. Run supply and demand reviews with manufacturing, our in house teams, finance and sales, so we never run out. 
 Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times and Ts & Cs that protect our cash flow and our IP. 
 Write clear decision documents and win buy-in from finance and leadership on major purchases. 

What you'll need: 
 5 to 8+ years in procurement or supply chain, ideally in hardware, medtech or another regulated manufacturing setting. 
 A track record of building or scaling a supply chain function. 
 Cost-down programmes you've led and delivered 
 Hands-on experience qualifying and auditing suppliers and setting up quality agreements. 
 Experience with ERP/MRP systems. 
 A strong grasp of manufacturing economics: BOM cost, unit-cost modelling and how sourcing choices affect COGS. 
 Experience with demand planning and inventory strategy across best and worst case scenarios. 
 The ability to influence decisions across manufacturing, finance and R&D, to control our supply chain risks 
 A self-starter who is as comfortable on the build floor as at the negotiating table. 

Nice to have: 
 Startup experience. 
 GMP or regulated supply chain experience, including COCs, NCs, approved supplier lists and change notifications. 
 Experience managing a third-party manufacturer, or in-house production. 
 Experience building a supplier risk framework and contingency plans for supply disruption. 
 Awareness of export controls and shipping hardware internationally. 

Salary and Benefits:: 
 Competitive salary with stock options 
 Lunch covered daily 
 Collaborative team environment with very high potential to learn new skills 
 24 days holiday (excluding bank holidays) 
 Pension 
 Full time role working with awesome colleagues and an office in the Imperial College Innovation hub in White City, where you’ll be based. 
 Because of the hands on aspect of this role, we are unable to support remote-first working and potential colleagues must be happy to work from our site.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Strategy and Finance (New York)
jobs.description:
About Us
 
Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs.

About the Role
The Athletic is looking for a Manager, Commercial Strategy and Finance to serve as the primary architect and steward of our most complex and high-value commercial initiatives and partnerships. This is a high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of business development, strategy, deal-making, and operational rigor; it is a hybrid role based in New York City, reporting into a Vice President of Advertising Finance.
We are looking for a "dual-threat" professional: someone who has a deep reverence for analytical rigor, paired with a commercially-minded approach that helps guide projects and deals to success. You will be the quantitative engine driving our commercial strategy; not just evaluating ideas before launch and deals before they are signed; but rigorously tracking performance once they are live. 
This is a hybrid role and will require 3 days / week in office for candidates in the greater New York City Metropolitan area. 

Responsibilities : 

 Commercial planning and analysis: You will translate dense financial data and analysis into high-impact visual narratives for discussions with The Athletic’s leadership team. You'll articulate the "why" behind every major investment. 
 Modeling and evaluation: Build clean, flexible financial models to value complex and integrated deals and commercial initiatives across licensing and advertising, as well as other revenue streams. 
 Deal construction: Analyze and aid in negotiation of deal mechanics, focusing on minimum guarantees (MGs), revenue shares, and recoupment schedules. You will partner closely with Legal and Accounting to ensure term sheets translate into sound financial realities. 
 Post-close performance tracking: Own the "full-lifecycle" of the deal. Once a partnership is live, you are on the hook for tracking actuals vs. benchmarks, managing P&L impact, and providing the FP&A oversight needed to course-correct or double-down. 
 Forecasting and variance analysis: Integrate live deal performance into our broader rolling forecasts, explaining variances to leadership and identifying trends in audience monetization and rights costs. 

 
Requirements : 
 5+ years of experience in corporate development, strategic finance, consulting or investment banking. 
 Analytically rigorous individual with experience performing high stakes evaluation of potential deals, ideally including content licensing. 
 Deep understanding of the leverage points in a negotiation; can anticipate how a legal clause might impact a financial outcome. 
 Someone who understands the value of accuracy; whether it's a pre-deal valuation or a post-deal performance report, you own the numbers from start to finish. 
 Genuinely motivated by The Athletic’s mission; you understand the value of premium sports journalism and the gravity of the shifting media landscape. 
 Expert-level financial modeling. 
 Strong executive presentation development skills. 
 Deep understanding of commercial deal terms, negotiations, and deal processes. 
 Experience with key FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis). 
 BS in Finance/Economics, MBA a plus.

jobs.title: Salesforce Architect (Salesforce CPQ)
jobs.description:
Who We Are: 
 
At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

We are looking for a Salesforce Architect (Salesforce CPQ) to serve as the master technical builder of our enterprise revenue engine. In a high-growth, private-equity-backed SaaS environment, simply "configuring" Salesforce isn't enough—we are actively transforming how our business scales. Reporting directly to the Director of Business Systems, you will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Salesforce CRM and CPQ while partnering closely with our teams responsible for Billing, ERP, and marketing applications.
We are looking for an architect who built their career on deep developer roots. You aren't an "ivory tower" consultant; you are a pragmatic technical leader who can design complex Quote-to-Cash data flows, dive deep and guide dev teams on code standards, and challenge business stakeholders to simplify processes rather than digitizing messiness.
What You Will Do
Architect the Revenue Engine: Lead the technical design and redesign of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) and Lead-to-Cash (L2C) architecture, focusing on Salesforce CPQ and CRM along with the integrated Q2C ecosystem.
Drive Business Transformation: Work directly with business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable enterprise architecture—challenging existing processes to drive simplification and automation in our Sales motions.
Define System Boundaries: Architect clean, robust integrations between Salesforce, CPQ and integrated enterprise systems (BillingPlatform(™), NetSuite, Marketo, HubSpot, and more ).
Provide Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor technical teams and developers by leveraging your significant developer background to perform code reviews, enforce Apex/LWC standards, and drive robust solutioning discussions.
Triage & Optimize: Evaluate trade-offs between out-of-the-box functionality vs. custom development, eliminating technical debt while prioritizing business velocity.
What You Will Bring
Hands-on Developer Roots: Proven background as a Salesforce CPQ Developer who has successfully transitioned into a Technical/Solution Architect role.
Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end Digital or Business Transformation projects specifically focused on Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash redesign and optimization.
Cross-Platform Integration Mastery: Broad familiarity and integration design experience with enterprise systems like NetSuite, Marketo, HubSpot, BillingPlatform(™), Gong, and Snowflake.
Process Simplification Mindset: A strong track record of rethinking and optimizing business processes rather than simply recreating legacy workflows in Salesforce.
Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to communicate technical tradeoffs, system limits, and architectural decisions to non-technical business leaders.
Who You Are
A Pragmatic Architect: You know how code should be written because you’ve written it. You use that best-practice knowledge to guide dev teams and build architectures that work fluidly in production.
A Problem Solver: You love a challenge and figuring out how to solve them because optimizing Salesforce ecosystems has been the driving factor in your successful career.
A Business Partner: You aren't a master of your domain. When a stakeholder asks for a shortcut that adds technical debt, you offer a better, more scalable alternative.
An Efficiency Champion: You live to eliminate friction in sales cycles, streamline quote line calculations, and ensure data flows cleanly from lead generation to revenue recognition.

jobs.description:
The Role: 
 We're looking for a Manufacturing Lead to own how we make our Systems & Consumables - and to make sure we can do it reliably, quickly, at scale, to the standard our customers and regulators require. Our product offering intersects two different tech stacks: electromechanical automation systems packed with custom robotics, and sterile fluidic plastic consumables made to GMP standards. You'll own both. 
 This is a foundational, hands-on lead role. You'll contribute to the strategic direction for manufacturing while staying close enough to the floor to fix problems yourself when it matters. You'll be working directly with the Head of Engineering and with leadership, sales, finance, and planning to make sure manufacturing keeps pace with an ambitious commercial roadmap. You'll lead and grow the team that builds everything we ship. 
 We want someone who has built or scaled a manufacturing function before and is ready to do it again, faster. Experience across both electromechanical assembly and sterile / GMP plastics manufacturing is a strong differentiator. 
 
What you'll be doing: 

 Own and continuously improve manufacture of our automation systems/consumables - growing volume while driving up yield/quality and driving down cost/lead time. 
 Track and actively drive down COGS, model unit economics, develop and implement large capex/opex strategies. 
 Bring new products into stable manufacture smoothly and on schedule. 
 Lead planning, build out & setup of greenfield manufacturing facilities. 
 Recruit, line-manage and develop the manufacturing team so each person grows in scope, skill, and independence. 

 
What you'll need: 

 A track record of building or scaling manufacturing functions, ideally in a fast-moving hardware, lab automation, or regulated manufacturing environment. 
 Deep hands-on manufacturing engineering ability - facility design, process development / scale-up, equipment and process qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), and root-cause problem solving on the floor. 
 Strong grasp of manufacturing economics: COGS ownership, unit-cost modelling, capex and make-vs-buy decision-making. 
 GMP and regulatory knowledge (ISO 13485, cleanroom manufacturing) - or the demonstrated ability to get up to speed fast. 
 Experience managing suppliers and contract manufacturers: qualification, audits, quality agreements, and negotiating strong scalable outcomes for the business. 
 Fluency with ERP/MRP systems for manufacturing and capacity planning, and comfort making data-driven decisions (SPC, DOE, yield analysis, COPQ). 
 Personality who leads a team while staying technical, and who builds capability rather than dependency. 
 Experience across both electromechanical assembly and sterile / GMP plastics manufacturing is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Emburse Solution Advisor (ESA) - Extended Services
jobs.description:
Role Overview
Emburse Solution Advisors (ESAs) are trusted technical advisors to customers, providing ongoing product expertise, configuration support and strategic guidance to help customers maximize the value of their Emburse solutions.
Working with a portfolio of customers, the ESA combines deep product knowledge with strong consulting and customer-management skills. They partner closely with Customer Success, Support, Product and other internal teams to understand customer requirements, recommend best-practice solutions, manage configuration and change requests, resolve complex issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer's use of Emburse.
The role requires the ability to manage multiple customer priorities while building strong, long-term relationships and providing a consistently high level of service.

Key Responsibilities: 
 
 
 Manage a portfolio of ESA customers, acting as a trusted technical and product advisor. 
 
 
 Develop a strong understanding of each customer's configuration, business requirements and use of Emburse solutions. 
 
 
 Consult with customers on product capabilities, configuration options and best practices to support their business requirements and long-term use of the platform. 
 
 
 Manage customer configuration changes, technical requests and small to large projects from requirements gathering through to delivery. 
 
 
 Translate customer requirements into appropriate product and configuration solutions. 
 
 
 Provide proactive guidance to help customers optimize their use of Emburse products and identify opportunities to improve adoption and value. 
 
 
 Facilitate requirements-gathering and solution-design discussions with customers and internal stakeholders.

 Manage multiple concurrent customer requests and priorities within agreed service levels and workload expectations.

 Act as a technical product knowledge resource for colleagues and collaborate on training, testing and troubleshooting activities. 
 
 
 Partner closely with Customer Success Managers and other internal teams to support customer health, retention and successful outcomes.

 Contribute to the continuous improvement of ESA processes, documentation and ways of working. 
 
 
 Continuously develop product and technical knowledge through training, testing, research and collaboration with internal subject-matter experts. 
 

 
Experience: 
 
 
 Experience in a customer-facing technical, consulting, implementation, customer success or similar SaaS role. 
 
 
 Experience working with configurable software platforms, workflow solutions and/or financial management software is preferred. 
 
 
 Experience managing multiple customer requirements, projects or technical requests simultaneously. 
 
 
 Experience translating business requirements into practical technical or product solutions. 
 
 
 Experience working with enterprise customers in the Travel & Expense management industry is advantageous. 
 

 
Skills & Capabilities:

jobs.title: Principal Scientist (PD/MSAT)
jobs.description:
About Us:
You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you’ll help scale cures to patients that need them sooner.
We’ve developed fully-automated cell manufacturing sites powered by custom robotics - to scale therapies to millions of patients. Last year, patients were cured of diseases like Parkinson’s Disease and vision loss using stem-cell derived cells - but today these Regenerative Medicines are produced by hand, meaning they’re too expensive and hard to scale. With our automated CDMO, these therapies can now be scaled globally at low cost.
We've announced partnerships across multiple therapies so far ranging from Parkinson’s, to hearing loss, to bone repair - and raised $24m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development! Within the next 12-18 months, neurons grown on our machines will be going into Parkinson’s patient brains.
We’ve assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. You can learn more about your potential Mytos teammates here: Team
Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks.

The Role:: We are looking for a high-growth principal PD/MSAT Scientist to join our Biology team and push the limits of automation in cell therapy manufacture. This is a unique opportunity to learn how to execute projects at the interface of engineering and biology with a direct impact to patients. 
Core Responsibilities:: 

 Provide technical leadership in the set up and operation of Mytos Bio’s CDMO site in Stevenage. Travel between London and Stevenage sites will be required where necessary. 
 Lead process development and analytical method development projects in line with customer requirements. 
 Plan and execute technology transfer activities, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory standards. 
 Drive continuous process improvement through the implementation of best practices, methods, and high quality standards. 
 Support resource planning and timeline development for new projects. 
 Help build out the teams technical capabilities by supporting hiring efforts and mentoring colleagues. 
 Support business development activities through direct client engagement and involvement in the drafting of sales proposals. 

 
Skills & Experience: 
 Required: 

 PhD in Cell Biology (or related discipline) with 3+ years of industry experience, or 5+ years of relevant industry experience. 
 Subject matter expertise in cell therapy development and manufacture across the PD → MSAT → cGMP pipeline. 
 Subject matter expertise in optimising human stem cell culture (ESC/iPSC), differentiation, and characterisation under cGMP conditions. 
 Strong understanding of regulatory requirements for cell therapy manufacture (MHRA, EMA, or FDA). 
 Experience authoring quality documentation for cGMP manufacturing and QC. 
 Demonstrated ability to lead, manage and deliver complex projects with multiple dependencies. 
 Strong experimental design and analytical skills. 
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills across multiple levels (customers, team members and inter departmental). 
 Experience in a line manager capacity. 

 Desired: 

 Prior experience developing cell therapy products that have been taken to Phase I clinical trials or beyond. 
 Prior experience working in or with CDMOs. 

 
Salary and Benefits: 

 Competitive salary with stock options 
 Lunch covered daily 
 Collaborative team environment with very high potential to learn new skills 
 24 days holiday (excluding bank holidays) 
 Pension

 Develop and improve our frontend applications using TypeScript, React, and GraphQL to create intuitive interfaces for complex biological workflows. 
 Build backend services that communicate with our hardware systems and learn about data integrity throughout the cell manufacturing process. 
 Collaborate across disciplines with hardware engineers, biologists, and commercial teams to build reliable and effective systems in record time. 
 Learn and contribute to our testing methods to help us deliver quality software at speed. 
 Learn and contribute to architecture and infrastructure, system performance, and interesting distributed system challenges. 
 Write code that you can immediately see the real-world impact: testing on our prototype machines in our own lab. 
 Up-skill in domains outside software engineering, from donning a lab coat and be trained on the nuances of stem cells, to the basics of fluid mechanics. 
 Be given a lot of autonomy, responsibility, and ownership of product problems and the technical solutions you design and deliver to address customer needs. 

 
What We're Looking For (depending on experience level): 

 Are early in your software career and want to join an environment that gives you the chance to grow quickly 
 Have demonstrated technical promise so far in your studies or work 
 Want to work on difficult technical challenges in a field that will define the biggest scientific advancement this century 
 Self-starter attitude with a drive for producing quality work. 
 Care and compassion for customers and colleagues. 
 Experience with full-stack web development using TypeScript or other typed languages. 
 Experience with modern frontend frameworks (React preferred). 
 Experience with backend development and API design (Node.js preferred). 
 Experience working with databases (PostgreSQL and Prisma or similar ORM experience ideal). 

 
Our technologies: 

 Frontend (Netlify): React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Storybook 
 Backend (AWS & Heroku): NodeJS, TypeScript, GraphQL, MQTT, PostgreSQL, Python, Pulumi IaC 
 Physical Device (on-premise): NodeJS, Typescript, FastAPI, Python, MQTT 
 Firmware: C++, GTest, GMock, Bazel, Platformio 

 
How We Use AI: 

 Every engineer gets an AI tools budget. Pick what makes you faster. 
 AI and its tooling keep getting better. We want to keep getting better at using it to ship quality code. So we keep an eye on the latest developments, and we try out & share workflows across the team. You'll find a setup that fits how you work. 
 Right now, our team runs on Linear, and most of us use Claude Code. We’re trialling AI review platforms and low-friction cloud agents to tighten the loop from ‘needs doing’ to ‘shipped code’. Our company knowledge base is Notion — perfect for AI information retrieval and document drafting. 

 The bar for quality doesn't drop because AI wrote the first draft. You own your code, you understand it, and you can stand behind every line - whoever or whatever typed it. 
 
Nice-to-Haves:: 

 Understanding of distributed systems concepts. 
 Experience with Python for data processing or image analysis. 
 Background or interest in biology, lab automation, or scientific instrumentation. 
 Any experience with regulated environments (GMP, HIPAA, etc.) 
 Any experience with UI/product design processes and tools (wireframes, mockups, looks-like prototypes, etc.). 

 
Why You'll Love Working Here: 
 Impact : Your work will directly enable the production of cell therapies that can transform patients' lives. 
 Growth : We're solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and biology—you'll constantly learn and develop new skills. 
 Autonomy : You'll have the freedom to shape our approach to GMP readiness, with support from a talented cross-disciplinary team. 
 Team : Work with the best engineers and scientists in a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation.

jobs.description:
We are looking to hire an Enterprise Customer Success Manager looking to join an early yet executive CS team and have an impact on a category-defining company, backed by some of the best investors in Silicon Valley. CS Managers at Emi are the CEOs of our Portfolio Partners, not only managing relationship with our customer’s leadership team, but leading the strategy in order to have a larger impact in each account.

About the Customer Success Team
At Emi we are focused on solving real problems for our clients and for our candidates, which is why we are a customer-focused company. Our customer success team is responsible of leading the relationship with our clients and ensuring they obtain the best results from our projects together. Our team is composed of people with strong client relationship skills who are also extremely data-driven and capable of pivoting between multiple internal teams in terms of implementation, sales, product, and tech in order to drive results.

About Us
At Emi Labs (YC '19) we are on a mission to increase frontline workers' access to professional opportunities by building the infrastructure for Frontline Workers (check our manifesto online). As our first step, we are transforming the high-volume recruiting process of Frontline Workers to make it as simple, human, and fair as possible for both Candidates and Recruiters. Our product is a SaaS recruitment platform powered by AI that helps companies engage with candidates via text to drive faster and more efficient hiring processes. We are growing fast, well funded, and obsessed with making our mission a reality.

Responsibilities: Build a long term, value based relationship with the leadership team and champions of our clients (CHROs, VP of Talent) Being the trusted partner for the customer on use-case and product functionality Deliver and communicate ROI for our clients throughout the customer lifecycle in Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs) Be the voice of the customer in Emi, providing insights to work side-by-side with our product and tech teams Identify potential account growth (upsells) and help execute them to guarantee we’re adding more value in our clients 
What we're looking for in Candidates: +3 years of work experience managing relationships with enterprise accounts - Management Consulting, Customer Success, Account Management, Business Development, is a plus. Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations and design effective processes Strategic and analytical mentality Executive presence and communication abilities Strong leadership skills Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Marketing, Services) Thrives working in a growing environment, with the uncertainty and chaos of an early stage startup Fluent English Speaker, native is a plus 
What we offer: 🧑🏽‍💻 Flexible remote-first work culture . We work towards goals* 📈 Stock Options: Stock Options Package as part of your compensation package. 🏖️ Vacations: 3-weeks of vacation 🧑‍🎄 Holiday season: Week off between Christmas and New Years' eve 🩺 Health coverage : Up to $1500 per year for local health insurance coverage 💆 Physical Wellness program: we have partnered up with Gympass, a wellbeing platform that offers the best coverage of top gyms, studios, and activities for you to choose from 🇺🇸 English Lessons: Improve your English skills with our in-company teachers 📚 Internal library: Get all the free books - digital, physical - you like, anytime

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Us
You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you’ll unleash scientists, accelerate their research and help get cures to patients sooner.

We’ve developed machines to fully automate human cell production - the most manual process in Biotech. Cells are used to discover and develop new drugs, and now they're being used to treat cancer too. Mytos will impact cure development across the board.

We're live in multibillion dollar biotechs on both coasts of the US, and just raised $19m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development!

We’ve assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. You can learn more about your potential Mytos teammates here: Team

Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks. 

The Role
This is an opportunity to redefine how the future of the biotech lab works. As the founding member of the Design team, you will be responsible for all aspects of Design at Mytos: from research, to concepting, to testing, to pixel-perfect UI. You’ll also define the design systems used across the whole company.

Aside from occasional hardware interactions, the entire surface area of our product is in software - ranging from setting up experiments, managing cell batches in real-time, and analysing data. 

What you’ll be doing: Working with the founders + product teams to lead our design process from start to finish: from research, to concepting, to testing, to pixel-perfect UI Solving complex problems using customer-centric, validated and delightful product design Spending time with our internal lab biologists, to understand how biologists think Defining interaction models, task flows and screen designs. Defining our design systems, so others in the company or externals can create assets that are cohesive Taking part in discovery, workshop and co-design sessions with customers and colleagues. 
Who you are: You want an environment where you have high autonomy and decision-making agency to influence the direction Broad set of design skills across all aspects: from research, to human-centred design, to prototyping and visualisation You're curious and learn new areas fast A master of your toolkit - Figma (Our main tool), and your other preferred design and graphics tools Mastered the range of qualitative and quantitative research methods and when to apply them to validate your design 
Nice to have: Have been the first designer at a startup in the past Ability to code: we welcome designers polishing the front-end in production / contributing to the codebase A background in Biology or another science 
Salary and Benefits: Competitive salary with stock options Lunch covered daily Collaborative team environment with very high potential to learn new skills 24 days holiday (excluding bank holidays) Pension Awesome colleagues and an office in the Imperial College Innovation hub in White City, where you’ll be based.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
About Us
 
You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you’ll help scale cures to patients that need them sooner.
 
We’ve developed fully-automated cell manufacturing sites, powered by custom robotics - to scale treatments to millions of patients. Last year, patients were cured of diseases like Parkinson’s and vision loss using stem-cell derived cells - but today these Regenerative Medicines are produced by hand, meaning they’re too expensive and hard to scale. 
 
With our automated manufacturing sites, these therapies can now be scaled globally at low cost. We've announced partnerships across multiple therapies so far ranging from Parkinson’s, to hearing loss, to bone repair - and raised $24m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development! Within the next 12-18 months, neurons grown on our machines will be going into Parkinson’s patient brains.
 
We’ve assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. You can learn more about your potential Mytos teammates here: Team
 
Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks.

Responsibilities:: 
 We believe that as an Engineering Technician, you’d be hard pressed to find a more interesting and impactful problem to work on. We’d love to hear from you if you think you would enjoy 
 Working alongside our engineering team to assemble/commission new prototypes, our machines & our fluidic consumables. 
 Responding to and diagnosing equipment breakdowns / assembly problems, resolving issues and actioning repairs. 
 Working closely with our engineering team in finding ways to improve process and increase machine reliability and performance. 
 Helping shape our assembly engineering culture and processes so that we keep continually improving. You’ll enjoy the autonomy, accountability and customer-focus that we bring to our work. 
 Multi-disciplinary collaboration across the whole team, which includes two Forbes 30 under 30 founders, ex-Dyson engineers, rock climbers and Nature-published scientists 

We’d love to hear from you if:: 
 You're a fast learner and a great communicator who can support the engineering needs of the team and may come from a variety of technical backgrounds. . 
 You take great pride in a high level of craftsmanship in the work you do. 
 You’ve set up new processes & have fabrication experience. 
 You have experience of soldering & preparation of cable harnessing to a high level of quality. 
 You have excellent IT skills. 

Salary and Benefits:: 
 Competitive salary with stock options 
 Lunch covered daily 
 Collaborative team environment with very high potential to learn new skills 
 24 days holiday (excluding bank holidays) 
 Pension 
 Awesome colleagues and an office in the Imperial College Innovation hub in White City, where you’ll be based. 
 Because of the device assembly aspect of this role, we are unable to support remote-first working and potential colleagues must be happy to work from our lab. 
 Traveling to customer sites (national and international) may be occasionally required.
